بيانات المصنف البرمجي الرسمية (Official Software Metadata)
اسم المصنف الرسمي: حضر — Haderedu
المكون البرمجي المودع: تطبيق الهاتف المحمول الموجه للمعلمين (Mobile Application - iOS & Android)
رقم الإصدار (Version): Version 1.0.0 (Build 1.0.1+2)
تاريخ إنشاء / إصدار المصنف: 12-08-2026
صاحب الحق المالي: مؤسسة مواهب المملكة
فريق التطوير البرمجي (المؤلفون): عزة خالد محمد احمد ، حمدي صلاح كامل
لغات البرمجة وأطر العمل: Dart Language (SDK ^3.11.1), Flutter Framework (Cross-Platform)
نمط المعمارية وإدارة الحالة: Clean Architecture (Feature-First), BLoC Pattern (flutter_bloc 9.x), GetIt (DI), Dio REST Client
المنصات والبيئات المستهدفة: Android (Google Play / Android SDK API 21+), iOS (Apple App Store / iOS 12.0+)
إجمالي عدد الملفات البرمجية: 383 ملف برمجي أصلي (يشمل كافة طبقات lib/ وملف pubspec.yaml)
إجمالي عدد الأسطر البرمجية: 53,306 سطر برمجي موثق بالكامل
نطاق الحماية والتسجيل: تسجيل حقوق المؤلف بموجب نظام حماية حقوق المؤلف الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي في المملكة العربية السعودية ولائحته التنفيذية.
إشعار وتنويه رسمي: تحتوي هذه الوثيقة على الكود المصدري الأصلي والكامل للتطبيق المذكور أعلاه وفق متطلبات الهيئة السعودية للملكية الفكرية (SAIP). تم فحص وتطهير الكود من أي مفاتيح اعتماد سرية أو بيانات وصول حساسة لضمان أعلى معايير الأمان المعلوماتي وحماية الملكية الفكرية.
القسم الثاني: بطاقة التوصيف الفني والمعماري للمصنف Technical & Architectural Specification
1. نبذة عن التطبيق والوظائف التعليمية المبتكرة
يعد تطبيق "حضر — Haderedu" منصة برمجية ذكية وشاملة مخصصة لخدمة المعلمين والمعلمات في الميدان التعليمي بالمملكة العربية السعودية. يهدف التطبيق إلى رقمنة وأتمتة المهام اليومية للمعلم ورفع كفاءة التخطيط الدراسي والتدريس التفاعلي، حيث يقدم حلولاً متكاملة تشمل:
📘 توزيع المناهج وتصفح الكتب المدرسية
استعراض وتنزيل المقررات الدراسية لكافة المراحل التعليمية (الابتدائية، المتوسطة، الثانوية)، ومتابعة الخطة الدراسية وتوزيع الأسابيع تلقائياً.
✍️ تحضير الدروس الذكي والمخصص
إنشاء وتوليد خطط الدروس والتحاضير المتوافقة مع معايير وزارة التعليم، وتخصيص استراتيجيات التدريس والوسائل والتقويم وتصديرها بصيغ PDF وWord.
📝 بنك الأسئلة وتوليد الاختبارات الآلي
توليد نماذج الاختبارات الدورية والنهائية ونماذج الإجابة وتوزيع الدرجات آلياً عبر بنوك أسئلة مصنفة حسب مستويات بلوم المعرفية.
📊 العروض التقديمية التفاعلية (PPTX)
استعراض وتحميل عروض البوربوينت التفاعلية لكل درس مع دعم التخصيص والعرض المباشر داخل الفصول الدراسية.
📅 الجدول المدرسي وإدارة الحصص
تنظيم جدول الحصص الأسبوعي والتنبيه بمواعيد الدروس وإدارة سجلات التحضير اليومية ومتابعة المهام التعليمية.
💳 الاشتراكات والدفع الإلكتروني ونظام الإحالة
تكامل شامل مع بوابة الدفع الإلكتروني (MyFatoorah) لدعم مدى وApple Pay، وإدارة باقات الاشتراك، ونظام إحالة متطور للمكافآت والخصومات.
2. المعمارية البرمجية وتصميم النظام (Software Architecture)
تم بناء التطبيق باتباع معمارية Clean Architecture القائمة على مبدأ فصل المسؤوليات (Separation of Concerns) وتنظيم الشيفرة بأسلوب Feature-First لضمان قابلية التوسع والصيانة والأمان وقابلية الاختبار:
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | HADEREDU MOBILE APPLICATION | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | [PRESENTATION LAYER] | | - Screens & UI Views (Widgets, Dialogs, Responsive Layouts) | | - State Management: BLoC / Cubit (Event -> State Reactive Flow) | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ │ ▼ +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | [DOMAIN LAYER] | | - Use Cases (Business Logic & Workflow Operations) | | - Entity & Model Definitions (Data contracts & Validation) | | - Repository Contracts (Abstract Interfaces) | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ │ ▼ +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | [DATA LAYER] | | - Repository Implementations (Data coordination) | | - Remote Data Sources (Dio HTTP Client, RESTful API Endpoints, Token Interceptors)| | - Local Data Sources (FlutterSecureStorage, SharedPreferences, Local Cache) | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ │ ▼ +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | [CORE / SHARED INFRASTRUCTURE] | | - Dependency Injection: GetIt Service Locator | | - Error Handling: Failures, Exceptions, ApiErrorHandler | | - Theme & Design System: Colors, Typography, Dimension Constants | | - Utilities & Helpers: DateFormatters, Sanitizers, PDF/File Exporters | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
3. إقرار وتعهد أصالة المصنف والملكية الفكرية
إقرار وتعهد أصالة العمل البرمجي:
يقر ويشهد كل من المؤلفين (فريق التطوير البرمجي) والممثل النظامي لصاحب الحق المالي (مؤسسة مواهب المملكة) بأن الشيفرة المصدرية (Source Code) المودعة في هذه الوثيقة هي ثمرة عملهم البرمجي والفكري الأصلي والمستقل، وأنه تم تطويرها بالكامل دون نقل أو اقتباس أو انتهاك لأي حقوق ملكية فكرية أو أسرار تجارية عائدة لأي طرف ثالث، وأن صاحب الحق المالي يمتلك كافة الحقوق الحصرية للاستغلال المالي والنظامي للمصنف.

  15import 'dart:developer' as developer;
  16import 'package:moean/core/services/referral_service.dart';
  17
  18final RouteObserver<ModalRoute> routeObserver = RouteObserver<ModalRoute>();
  19final GlobalKey<NavigatorState> navigatorKey = GlobalKey<NavigatorState>();
  20
  21void main() async {
  22  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  23
  24  SystemChrome.setEnabledSystemUIMode(SystemUiMode.edgeToEdge);
  25  SystemChrome.setSystemUIOverlayStyle(
  26    const SystemUiOverlayStyle(
  27      statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
  28      systemNavigationBarColor: Colors.transparent,
  29    ),
  30  );
  31
  32  await initInjections();
  33
  34  // Initialize ReferralService safely in the background
  35  // We do not await it tightly so it doesn't block startup
  36  ReferralService.init().catchError((e) {
  37    developer.log('ReferralService init error: $e');
  38  });
  39
  40  final bool isDark = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'isDark') ?? false;
  41  final bool isArabic = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'isArabicLang') ?? true;
  42
  43  developer.log('Main: Loading translations...');
  44  final String translation = await rootBundle.loadString(
  45    'assets/translations/${isArabic ? 'ar' : 'en'}.json',
  46  );
  47  developer.log('Main: Translations loaded');
  48
  49  // ── Restore token from secure storage ──────────────────────────
  50  final secureStorage = sl<SecureStorageHelper>();
  51  final String? savedToken = await secureStorage.getToken();
  52
  53  String initialRoute = Routes.login;
  54
  55  if (savedToken != null && savedToken.isNotEmpty) {
  56    // Token found – verify it is still valid via /auth/me
  57    token = savedToken;
  58    developer.log('Main: Token found, verifying via /auth/me...');
  59
  60    final meResult = await ApiService.getMe();
  61
  62    meResult.fold(
  63      (error) {
  64        // 401 or network error – clear token
  65        developer.log('Main: Token invalid ($error), clearing...');
  66        token = null;
  67        secureStorage.deleteToken();
  68        initialRoute = Routes.home; // start at home
  69      },
  70      (user) {
  71        developer.log('Main: Token valid, user=${user.name}');
  72        if (user.email == 'admin@moeen.com' || user.email == 'admin@moeen.sa') {
  73          initialRoute = Routes.adminTeachers;
  74        } else {
  75          initialRoute = Routes.home; // start at home
  76        }
  77        sl<MadrasatiSessionService>().notifySessionActive();
  78      },
  79    );
  80  } else {
  81    developer.log('Main: No token found, going to home');
  82    initialRoute = Routes.home;
  83  }
  84
  85  runApp(MyApp(
  86    isDark: isDark,
  87    isArabic: isArabic,
  88    translation: translation,
  89    initialRoute: initialRoute,
  90  ));
  91}
  92
  93class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  94  final bool isDark;
  95  final bool isArabic;
  96  final String translation;
  97  final String initialRoute;
  98
  99  const MyApp({
 100    super.key,
 101    required this.isDark,
 102    required this.isArabic,
 103    required this.translation,
 104    required this.initialRoute,
 105  });
 106
 107  @override
 108  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 109    final themeCubit = sl<ThemeCubit>();
 110    themeCubit
 111      ..init(isDark: isDark)
 112      ..initializeLanguage(isArabic: isArabic, translations: translation);
 113
 114    return MultiBlocProvider(
 115      providers: [
 116        BlocProvider(create: (context) => themeCubit),
 117      ],
 118      child: BlocBuilder<ThemeCubit, ThemeState>(
 119        builder: (context, state) {
 120          final themeCubit = context.read<ThemeCubit>();
 121
 122          return MaterialApp(
 123            navigatorKey: navigatorKey,
 124            debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
 125            routes: Routes.routes,
 126            initialRoute: initialRoute,
 127            theme: ThemesManager.lightTheme,
 128            darkTheme: ThemesManager.darkTheme,
 129            themeMode:
 130                themeCubit.isDarkMode ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light,
 131            builder: (context, child) {
 132              return Directionality(
 133                textDirection: themeCubit.isArabicLang
 134                    ? TextDirection.rtl
 135                    : TextDirection.ltr,
 136                // SessionMonitorWrapper listens to session expiry globally
 137                child: SessionMonitorWrapper(child: child!),
 138              );
 139            },
 140          );
 141        },
 142      ),
 143    );
 144  }
 145}

  39final sl = GetIt.instance;

  41Future<void> initInjections() async {
  42  // ─── Theme ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  43  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => ThemeCubit());
  44
  45  // ─── SharedPreferences (for non-sensitive prefs like theme) ───
  46  final sharedPref = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
  47  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => sharedPref);
  48
  49  // ─── Secure Storage ──────────────────────────────────────────
  50  const androidOptions = AndroidOptions(encryptedSharedPreferences: true);
  51  const secureStorage = FlutterSecureStorage(aOptions: androidOptions);
  52  sl.registerLazySingleton<FlutterSecureStorage>(() => secureStorage);
  53  sl.registerLazySingleton<SecureStorageHelper>(
  54    () => SecureStorageHelper(sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()),
  55  );
  56
  57  // ─── Session Service ──────────────────────────────────────────
  58  sl.registerLazySingleton<MadrasatiSessionService>(
  59    () => MadrasatiSessionService(),
  60  );
  61
  62  // ─── Dio ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  63  // NOTE: Dio is registered first without the session interceptor,
  64  // then the interceptor is added afterwards (because the interceptor
  65  // itself needs the Dio instance to replay requests).
  66  sl.registerLazySingleton<Dio>(() {
  67    final dio = Dio(
  68      BaseOptions(
  69        baseUrl: baseUrl,
  70        connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 30),
  71        receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 60),
  72      ),
  73    );
  74
  75    // ── Language header interceptor ─────────────────────────────
  76    dio.interceptors.add(
  77      InterceptorsWrapper(
  78        onRequest: (options, handler) {
  79          try {
  80            final isArabic = sl<ThemeCubit>().isArabicLang;
  81            options.headers['Accept-Language'] = isArabic ? 'ar' : 'en';
  82          } catch (_) {}
  83          return handler.next(options);
  84        },
  85      ),
  86    );
  87
  88    // ── Madrasati silent session refresh interceptor ─────────────
  89    // Uses QueuedInterceptor to ensure only one refresh request
  90    // fires even if multiple API calls fail simultaneously.
  91    dio.interceptors.add(
  92      MadrasatiSessionInterceptor(
  93        dio: dio,
  94        secureStorage: sl<SecureStorageHelper>(),
  95        sessionService: sl<MadrasatiSessionService>(),
  96      ),
  97    );
  98
  99    return dio;
 100  });
 101
 102  // ─── Exam Generation ──────────────────────────────────────────
 103  sl.registerLazySingleton<moean_exam.ExamRepository>(() => moean_exam.ExamRepositoryImpl());
 104  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => moean_exam.GenerateExamUseCase(sl()));
 105  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => moean_exam.GetExamUseCase(sl()));
 106  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => moean_exam.UpdateQuestionPointsUseCase(sl()));
 107  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => moean_exam.AddManualQuestionUseCase(sl()));
 108  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => moean_exam.GetMyQuestionsUseCase(sl()));
 109  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => moean_exam.UpdateCustomQuestionUseCase(sl()));
 110
 111  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => moean_exam.ExamInfoCubit());
 112  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => moean_exam.LessonSelectionCubit());
 113  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => moean_exam.QuestionCountCubit());
 114  sl.registerFactory(() => moean_exam.GenerateExamCubit(sl()));
 115  sl.registerFactory(() => moean_exam.ExamPreviewCubit(
 116        getExamUseCase: sl(),
 117        updateQuestionPointsUseCase: sl(),
 118        examRepository: sl(),
 119      ));
 120  sl.registerFactory(() => moean_exam.MyExamsCubit(sl()));
 121  sl.registerFactory(() => moean_exam.ManualExamCubit(sl()));
 122  sl.registerFactory(() => moean_exam.BankQuestionsCubit());
 123  sl.registerFactory(() => moean_exam.CustomQuestionsCubit(sl(), sl()));
 124
 125  // ─── Admin Exams ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 126  sl.registerLazySingleton<AdminExamRemoteDataSource>(
 127      () => AdminExamRemoteDataSourceImpl());
 128  sl.registerLazySingleton<AdminExamRepository>(
 129      () => AdminExamRepositoryImpl(sl()));
 130  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => GetPendingQuestionsUseCase(sl()));

 133        getPendingQuestionsUseCase: sl(),

 135      ));
 136
 137  // ─── Subscription ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 138  sl.registerLazySingleton(() => SubscriptionCubit());

  53class AdminTeacherModel {
  54  final int id;
  55  final bool active;
  56  final bool isInTrial;
  57  final bool isSubscribed;
  58  final String? subscriptionEndsAt;
  59  final String? trialEndsAt;
  60  final int trialDaysRemaining;
  61  final AdminTeacherUserModel user;
  62  final AdminTeacherSubscriptionModel? subscription;
  63
  64  const AdminTeacherModel({
  65    required this.id,
  66    required this.active,
  67    this.isInTrial = false,
  68    this.isSubscribed = false,
  69    this.subscriptionEndsAt,
  70    this.trialEndsAt,
  71    this.trialDaysRemaining = 0,
  72    required this.user,
  73    this.subscription,
  74  });
  75
  76  factory AdminTeacherModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  77    return AdminTeacherModel(
  78      id: json['id'] as int? ?? 0,
  79      active: json['active'] == true || json['active'] == 1 || json['is_active'] == true || json['is_active'] == 1,
  80      isInTrial: json['is_in_trial'] as bool? ?? false,
  81      isSubscribed: json['is_subscribed'] as bool? ?? false,
  82      subscriptionEndsAt: json['subscription_ends_at'] as String?,
  83      trialEndsAt: json['trial_ends_at'] as String?,
  84      trialDaysRemaining: json['trial_days_remaining'] as int? ?? 0,
  85      user: json['user'] != null
  86          ? AdminTeacherUserModel.fromJson(json['user'] as Map<String, dynamic>)
  87          : const AdminTeacherUserModel(id: 0, name: '', email: '', role: 'teacher', active: true),
  88      subscription: json['subscription'] != null
  89          ? AdminTeacherSubscriptionModel.fromJson(json['subscription'] as Map<String, dynamic>)
  90          : null,
  91    );
  92  }
  93
  94  DateTime? get parsedSubscriptionEndsAt =>
  95      subscriptionEndsAt != null ? DateTime.tryParse(subscriptionEndsAt!) : null;
  96
  97  DateTime? get parsedTrialEndsAt =>
  98      trialEndsAt != null ? DateTime.tryParse(trialEndsAt!) : null;
  99
 100  DateTime? get effectiveEndsAt {
 101    if (isSubscribed) return parsedSubscriptionEndsAt;
 102    if (isInTrial) return parsedTrialEndsAt;
 103    return parsedSubscriptionEndsAt ?? parsedTrialEndsAt;
 104  }
 105
 106  int get dynamicDaysRemaining {
 107    final endsAt = effectiveEndsAt;
 108    if (endsAt == null) return trialDaysRemaining > 0 ? trialDaysRemaining : 0;
 109    final now = DateTime.now();
 110    if (endsAt.isBefore(now)) return 0;
 111    return (endsAt.difference(now).inHours / 24).ceil();
 112  }
 113
 114  bool get isExpired {
 115    if (isSubscribed) {
 116      final ends = parsedSubscriptionEndsAt;
 117      return ends != null && ends.isBefore(DateTime.now());
 118    }
 119    if (isInTrial) {
 120      final ends = parsedTrialEndsAt;
 121      if (ends != null && ends.isBefore(DateTime.now())) return true;
 122      return dynamicDaysRemaining <= 0;
 123    }
 124    if (parsedTrialEndsAt != null && parsedTrialEndsAt!.isBefore(DateTime.now())) {
 125      return true;
 126    }
 127    if (parsedSubscriptionEndsAt != null && parsedSubscriptionEndsAt!.isBefore(DateTime.now())) {
 128      return true;
 129    }
 130    return false;
 131  }
 132
 133  bool get isTrialExpired => !isSubscribed && (isExpired || (!isInTrial && parsedTrialEndsAt != null));
 134
 135  bool get isFreePlan =>
 136      subscription == null ||
 137      subscription?.slug == 'free' ||
 138      subscription?.name == 'مجاني' ||
 139      subscription?.name == 'الخطة المجانية';
 140
 141  String get planTitle {
 142    if (isSubscribed && subscription != null && !isFreePlan) {
 143      return subscription!.name;
 144    }
 145    if (isInTrial && !isExpired) {
 146      return 'تجربة مجانية';
 147    }
 148    if (isTrialExpired) {
 149      return 'انتهت التجربة';
 150    }
 151    if (subscription != null && !isFreePlan) {
 152      return subscription!.name;
 153    }
 154    return 'مجاني';
 155  }
 156}

  31          ? DateTime.tryParse(json['expires_at'] as String)
  32          : null,

  34    );
  35  }

  37  /// Encode to JSON string for secure storage
  38  String encode() => jsonEncode(toJson());
  39
  40  /// Decode from JSON string
  41  static MadrasatiSessionData? decode(String? raw) {
  42    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return null;
  43    try {
  44      final map = jsonDecode(raw) as Map<String, dynamic>;
  45      return MadrasatiSessionData.fromJson(map);
  46    } catch (_) {
  47      return null;
  48    }
  49  }

  53    return DateTime.now().isAfter(expiresAt!);
  54  }

  57      refreshToken != null && refreshToken!.isNotEmpty;
  58}

   3class TeacherModel {
   4  final int id;
   5  final int? userId;
   6  final int? subscriptionId;
   7  final bool canPrepareLesson;
   8  final int aiQuotaRemaining;
   9  final bool isInTrial;
  10  final bool isSubscribed;
  11  final DateTime? subscriptionEndsAt;
  12  final DateTime? trialEndsAt;
  13  final int trialDaysRemaining;
  14  final SubscriptionPlanModel? subscription;
  15
  16  TeacherModel({
  17    required this.id,
  18    this.userId,
  19    this.subscriptionId,
  20    required this.canPrepareLesson,
  21    required this.aiQuotaRemaining,
  22    required this.isInTrial,
  23    required this.isSubscribed,
  24    this.subscriptionEndsAt,
  25    this.trialEndsAt,
  26    required this.trialDaysRemaining,
  27    this.subscription,
  28  });
  29
  30  factory TeacherModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  31    return TeacherModel(
  32      id: json['id'] as int? ?? 0,
  33      userId: json['user_id'] as int?,
  34      subscriptionId: json['subscription_id'] as int? ?? (json['subscription'] != null ? json['subscription']['id'] as int? : null),
  35      canPrepareLesson: json['can_prepare_lesson'] as bool? ?? false,
  36      aiQuotaRemaining: json['ai_quota_remaining'] as int? ?? 0,
  37      isInTrial: json['is_in_trial'] as bool? ?? false,
  38      isSubscribed: json['is_subscribed'] as bool? ?? false,
  39      subscriptionEndsAt: json['subscription_ends_at'] != null
  40          ? DateTime.tryParse(json['subscription_ends_at'])
  41          : null,
  42      trialEndsAt: json['trial_ends_at'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['trial_ends_at']) : null,
  43      trialDaysRemaining: json['trial_days_remaining'] as int? ?? 0,
  44      subscription: json['subscription'] != null ? SubscriptionPlanModel.fromJson(json['subscription']) : null,
  45    );
  46  }
  47
  48  /// تاريخ انتهاء الصلاحية الفعلي (سواء للاشتراك المدفوع أو التجربة)
  49  DateTime? get effectiveEndsAt => isSubscribed ? subscriptionEndsAt : trialEndsAt;
  50
  51  /// حساب الأيام المتبقية ديناميكياً
  52  int get dynamicDaysRemaining {
  53    final endsAt = effectiveEndsAt;
  54    if (endsAt == null) return 0;
  55    final now = DateTime.now();
  56    if (endsAt.isBefore(now)) return 0;
  57    return (endsAt.difference(now).inHours / 24).ceil();
  58  }
  59
  60  int get dynamicTrialDaysRemaining => dynamicDaysRemaining;
  61
  62  bool get isLastTrialDay => isInTrial && dynamicTrialDaysRemaining <= 1;
  63
  64  /// هل انتهت الصلاحية تماماً؟
  65  bool get isExpired {
  66    if (isSubscribed) {
  67      return subscriptionEndsAt != null && subscriptionEndsAt!.isBefore(DateTime.now());
  68    }
  69    return !isInTrial || dynamicTrialDaysRemaining <= 0;
  70  }
  71
  72  bool get isTrialExpired => !isSubscribed && !isInTrial;
  73
  74  /// عنوان الخطة الحالي
  75  String get planTitle {
  76    if (isSubscribed) return subscription?.name ?? 'اشتراك مدفوع';
  77    if (isInTrial) return 'تجربة مجانية (7 أيام)';
  78    return 'انتهت التجربة';
  79  }
  80
  81  /// نص موعد الانتهاء
  82  String get expirationSubtitle {
  83    final endsAt = effectiveEndsAt;
  84    // ignore: avoid_print
  85    print('[TeacherModel] expirationSubtitle → isSubscribed=$isSubscribed, isInTrial=$isInTrial, subscriptionEndsAt=$subscriptionEndsAt, trialEndsAt=$trialEndsAt, effectiveEndsAt=$endsAt');
  86    if (endsAt == null) return 'بدون تاريخ انتهاء';
  87    final formattedDate = "${endsAt.year}/${endsAt.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${endsAt.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}";
  88    
  89    if (isSubscribed) {
  90      return 'ينتهي في $formattedDate (متبقي $dynamicDaysRemaining يوم)';
  91    }
  92    if (isInTrial) {
  93      return 'تنتهي في $formattedDate (متبقي $dynamicDaysRemaining ${dynamicDaysRemaining == 1 ? "يوم" : "أيام"})';
  94    }
  95    return 'انتهت الصلاحية في $formattedDate';
  96  }
  97
  98  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
  99    'id': id,
 100    'user_id': userId,
 101    'subscription_id': subscriptionId,
 102    'can_prepare_lesson': canPrepareLesson,
 103    'ai_quota_remaining': aiQuotaRemaining,
 104    'is_in_trial': isInTrial,
 105    'is_subscribed': isSubscribed,
 106    'subscription_ends_at': subscriptionEndsAt?.toIso8601String(),
 107    'trial_ends_at': trialEndsAt?.toIso8601String(),
 108    'trial_days_remaining': trialDaysRemaining,
 109    if (subscription != null) 'subscription': subscription,
 110  };
 111}

   1import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/core/di/injections.dart';
   3
   4class CacheHelper {
   5  static dynamic getData({required String key}) {
   6    final prefs = sl<SharedPreferences>();
   7    return prefs.get(key);
   8  }
   9
  10  static Future<bool> saveData({
  11    required String key,
  12    required dynamic value,
  13  }) async {
  14    final prefs = sl<SharedPreferences>();
  15
  16    if (value is String) return await prefs.setString(key, value);
  17    if (value is int) return await prefs.setInt(key, value);
  18    if (value is bool) return await prefs.setBool(key, value);
  19    if (value is double) return await prefs.setDouble(key, value);
  20    if (value is List<String>) return await prefs.setStringList(key, value);
  21
  22    throw ArgumentError(
  23      'Unsupported type for SharedPreferences: ${value.runtimeType}',
  24    );
  25  }
  26
  27  static Future<bool> removeData({required String key}) async {
  28    final prefs = sl<SharedPreferences>();
  29    return await prefs.remove(key);
  30  }
  31}

   1import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/core/models/madrasati_session_data.dart';
   3
   4/// Secure storage keys
   5const _kAuthToken = 'secure_auth_token';
   6const _kMadrasatiSession = 'secure_madrasati_session';
   7
   8/// A secure wrapper around [FlutterSecureStorage] for sensitive app data.
   9/// Use this for tokens and Madrasati session instead of [CacheHelper].
  10class SecureStorageHelper {
  11  final FlutterSecureStorage _storage;
  12
  13  SecureStorageHelper(this._storage);
  14
  15  // ─── Auth Token ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  16
  17  /// Saves the Bearer token securely.
  18  Future<void> saveToken(String token) async {
  19    await _storage.write(key: _kAuthToken, value: token);
  20  }
  21
  22  /// Returns the saved Bearer token, or null if not found.
  23  Future<String?> getToken() async {
  24    return await _storage.read(key: _kAuthToken);
  25  }
  26
  27  /// Deletes the saved token (used on logout / 401).
  28  Future<void> deleteToken() async {
  29    await _storage.delete(key: _kAuthToken);
  30  }
  31
  32  // ─── Madrasati Session ─────────────────────────────────────────
  33
  34  /// Saves Madrasati school session data securely.
  35  Future<void> saveMadrasatiSession(MadrasatiSessionData session) async {
  36    await _storage.write(key: _kMadrasatiSession, value: session.encode());
  37  }
  38
  39  /// Returns the saved Madrasati session, or null if not found.
  40  Future<MadrasatiSessionData?> getMadrasatiSession() async {
  41    final raw = await _storage.read(key: _kMadrasatiSession);
  42    return MadrasatiSessionData.decode(raw);
  43  }
  44
  45  /// Deletes the saved Madrasati session (used on disconnect).
  46  Future<void> deleteMadrasatiSession() async {
  47    await _storage.delete(key: _kMadrasatiSession);
  48  }
  49
  50  // ─── Misc ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  51
  52  /// Clears all secure data (logout).
  53  Future<void> clearAll() async {
  54    await _storage.deleteAll();
  55  }
  56}

 707  static Future<Either<Failure, List<CurriculumStageModel>>> getSubjects() async {

 710      return responseEither.fold(
 711        (error) => Left(ServerFailure(error)),
 712        (response) {
 713          final List<dynamic> data = response.data is List ? response.data : (response.data['data'] ?? []);
 714          return Right(data.map((e) => CurriculumStageModel.fromJson(e)).toList());
 715        },
 716      );
 717    } catch (e) {
 718      return Left(ServerFailure('An unexpected error occurred: $e'));
 719    }

 741  // Exam Generation
 742  // ===========================================================================
 743
 744  static Future<Either<String, Map<String, dynamic>>> generateExam(Map<String, dynamic> request) async {
 745    try {
 746      final options = Options(
 747        receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 120),
 748        sendTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 120),
 749        headers: {
 750          'Accept': 'application/json',
 751          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 752          if (token != null && token!.isNotEmpty) 'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
 753        },
 754      );
 755
 756      final response = await DioHelper.getDio().post(
 757        examsGenerateApi,
 758        data: request,
 759        options: options,
 760      );
 761      
 762      return Right(_decodeData(response.data) as Map<String, dynamic>);
 763    } on DioException catch (error) {
 764      // Return the error so our new repository logic can parse it
 765      return Left(DioHelper.parseError(error));
 766      // Actually we will handle DioException in repository, but since api_service returns String, we'll let api_service return error string.
 767    } catch (e) {
 768      return Left(e.toString());
 769    }
 770  }

 143      final Response response = await getDio().delete(

 149            if (token != null && token!.isNotEmpty)
 150              'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
 151          },
 152        ),
 153      );
 154      return Right(response);
 155    } on DioException catch (error) {
 156      final msg = parseError(error);
 157      if (error.response?.statusCode == 401 && (msg == 'Error 401' || msg == 'Unauthenticated')) {

 165
 166  static String parseError(DioException error) {
 167    final response = error.response;
 168    if (response == null) return 'No response from server';
 169
 170    if (response.statusCode == 402 && response.data is Map) {
 171      final map = response.data as Map;
 172      final code = map['code']?.toString() ?? 'quota_exceeded';
 173      final message = map['message']?.toString() ?? 'ترقية الحساب المطلوبة';
 174      return '__402__:$code:$message';
 175    }
 176
 177    if (response.data is Map) {
 178      final map = response.data as Map;
 179
 180      // ── Detect Madrasati session expiry from error code ───────
 181      final errorCode = map['code']?.toString() ?? '';
 182      const sessionExpiredCodes = [
 183        'madrasati_session_expired',
 184        'madrasati_session_required',
 185      ];
 186      final fullMapStr = map.toString();
 187      final isSessionExpired = sessionExpiredCodes.contains(errorCode) ||
 188          fullMapStr.contains('معرف المدرسة غير موجود في الجلسة') ||
 189          fullMapStr.contains('أعد ربط حساب مدرستي');
 190
 191      if (isSessionExpired) {
 192        debugPrint('🔴 DioHelper: detected session expired code or message');
 193        try {
 194          sl<MadrasatiSessionService>().notifySessionExpired();
 195        } catch (_) {}
 196      }
 197      // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 198
 199      if (errorCode == 'account_suspended' ||
 200          (response.statusCode == 403 && (errorCode == 'account_suspended' || fullMapStr.contains('تعليق') || fullMapStr.contains('موقوف')))) {
 201        final message = map['message']?.toString() ?? 'account_suspended';
 202        return '__403__:account_suspended:$message';
 203      }
 204
 205      final errors = map['errors'];
 206      if (errors is Map && errors.isNotEmpty) {
 207        final buffer = <String>[];
 208        errors.forEach((key, value) {
 209          if (value is List && value.isNotEmpty) {
 210            buffer.add(value.join(', '));
 211          } else if (value != null) {
 212            buffer.add(value.toString());
 213          }
 214        });
 215        if (buffer.isNotEmpty) {
 216          return buffer.join('\n');
 217        }
 218      }
 219
 220      final errorObj = map['error'];
 221      if (errorObj is Map && errorObj['detail'] != null) {
 222        final detailStr = errorObj['detail'].toString();
 223        if (detailStr.isNotEmpty) {
 224          return detailStr;
 225        }
 226      }
 227
 228      final message = map['message']?.toString();
 229      if (message != null && message.isNotEmpty) {
 230        return message;
 231      }
 232
 233      return 'Error ${response.statusCode}: ${response.statusMessage}';
 234    }
 235    return 'Error: ${response.statusCode}: ${response.statusMessage}';
 236  }
 237}

   1import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/models/madrasati_session_data.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/network/local/secure_storage_helper.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_endpoints.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/core/services/madrasati_session_service.dart';
   7
   8/// A [QueuedInterceptor] that silently refreshes the Madrasati session
   9/// whenever the backend returns a session-expired error.
  10///
  11/// ## How it works
  12/// 1. Catches `DioException` with:
  13///    - Status 401, OR
  14///    - Status 422 with `code: "missing_madrasati_auth_cookie"`
  15/// 2. Reads the saved `refreshToken` and `schoolId` from [SecureStorageHelper].
  16/// 3. Calls `POST /api/madrasati/refresh-session` to get a new session.
  17/// 4. On success: saves the new `session_cookie` and `refresh_token`, then
  18///    replays the original failed request transparently.
  19/// 5. On failure (refresh itself returns 401): clears stored credentials and
  20///    fires `MadrasatiSessionService.notifySessionExpired()` to prompt the
  21///    user to do a manual WebView login.
  22///
  23/// Using [QueuedInterceptor] ensures that if multiple requests fail at the
  24/// same time, only ONE refresh call is made; the rest are queued and retried
  25/// once the refresh completes.
  26class MadrasatiSessionInterceptor extends QueuedInterceptor {
  27  final Dio _dio;
  28  final SecureStorageHelper _secureStorage;
  29  final MadrasatiSessionService _sessionService;
  30
  31  MadrasatiSessionInterceptor({
  32    required Dio dio,
  33    required SecureStorageHelper secureStorage,
  34    required MadrasatiSessionService sessionService,
  35  })  : _dio = dio,
  36        _secureStorage = secureStorage,
  37        _sessionService = sessionService;
  38
  39  @override
  40  Future<void> onError(
  41    DioException err,
  42    ErrorInterceptorHandler handler,
  43  ) async {
  44    // Skip: if this request is the refresh call itself (avoid infinite loop)
  45    if (err.requestOptions.path.contains(refreshMadrasatiSessionApi)) {
  46      debugPrint('⏭️ [Interceptor] Skipping — request is the refresh call itself');
  47      return handler.next(err);
  48    }
  49
  50    final response = err.response;
  51    final bool isMadrasatiSessionError = _isMadrasatiSessionError(response);
  52
  53    debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  54    debugPrint('🛡️  [MadrasatiSessionInterceptor] onError() triggered');
  55    debugPrint('   failed request : ${err.requestOptions.method} ${err.requestOptions.path}');
  56    debugPrint('   statusCode     : ${response?.statusCode}');
  57    debugPrint('   isMadrasatiErr : $isMadrasatiSessionError');
  58    if (response?.data != null) {
  59      debugPrint('   error body     : ${response?.data}');
  60    }
  61    debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  62
  63    if (!isMadrasatiSessionError) {
  64      debugPrint('⏭️ [Interceptor] Not a Madrasati session error — passing through');
  65      return handler.next(err);
  66    }
  67
  68    debugPrint('🔄 [Interceptor] Madrasati session error detected — attempting silent refresh…');
  69
  70    try {
  71      // 1. Read saved credentials
  72      debugPrint('');
  73      debugPrint('📂 [Interceptor] Step 1 — Reading saved credentials from SecureStorage…');
  74      final savedSession = await _secureStorage.getMadrasatiSession();
  75      final refreshToken = savedSession?.refreshToken;
  76      final schoolId = savedSession?.schoolId;
  77
  78      debugPrint('   schoolId      : ${schoolId ?? '❌ null'}');
  79      debugPrint('   refreshToken  : ${refreshToken != null && refreshToken.isNotEmpty ? '✅ "${refreshToken.substring(0, refreshToken.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null or empty'}');
  80
  81      if (refreshToken == null ||
  82          refreshToken.isEmpty ||
  83          schoolId == null ||
  84          schoolId.isEmpty) {
  85        debugPrint('⚠️ [Interceptor] No refresh_token or schoolId — cannot silent refresh → notifySessionExpired()');
  86        _sessionService.notifySessionExpired();
  87        return handler.next(err);
  88      }
  89
  90      // 2. Call the silent refresh endpoint
  91      debugPrint('');
  92      debugPrint('📡 [Interceptor] Step 2 — Calling POST $refreshMadrasatiSessionApi …');
  93      debugPrint('   payload: { refresh_token: "${refreshToken.substring(0, refreshToken.length.clamp(0, 20))}…", madrasati_school_id: "$schoolId" }');
  94
  95      final refreshResponse = await _dio.post(
  96        refreshMadrasatiSessionApi,
  97        data: {
  98          'refresh_token': refreshToken,
  99          'madrasati_school_id': schoolId,
 100        },
 101        options: Options(
 102          headers: {
 103            'Accept': 'application/json',
 104            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 105          },
 106        ),
 107      );
 108
 109      // ── طباعة كاملة لكل حقل راجع من /madrasati/refresh-session ──────────
 110      debugPrint('');
 111      debugPrint('┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐');
 112      debugPrint('│   📦 /refresh-session RESPONSE — Full Breakdown          │');
 113      debugPrint('├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤');
 114      debugPrint('│ HTTP statusCode : ${refreshResponse.statusCode}');
 115      debugPrint('├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤');
 116      debugPrint('│ [top-level]                                              │');
 117      debugPrint('│   success  : ${refreshResponse.data['success']}');
 118      debugPrint('│   message  : ${refreshResponse.data['message']}');
 119      debugPrint('├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤');
 120      debugPrint('│ [data] object:                                           │');
 121
 122      final rawData = refreshResponse.data['data'];
 123      if (rawData == null) {
 124        debugPrint('│   ⚠️  data is NULL — backend did not return a data object');
 125      } else {
 126        final d = rawData as Map;
 127
 128        final sCookie = d['session_cookie'] as String?;
 129        debugPrint('│   session_cookie    : ${sCookie != null ? '✅ "${sCookie.substring(0, sCookie.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null'}');
 130
 131        final newRT = d['new_refresh_token'] as String?;
 132        debugPrint('│   new_refresh_token : ${newRT != null ? '✅ "${newRT.substring(0, newRT.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null — old token will be reused'}');
 133
 134        final rt = d['refresh_token'] as String?;
 135        debugPrint('│   refresh_token     : ${rt != null ? '✅ "${rt.substring(0, rt.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null'}');
 136
 137        final exp = d['expires_at'];
 138        debugPrint('│   expires_at        : ${exp ?? '❌ null — fallback: now + 30 days'}');
 139
 140        final knownKeys = {'session_cookie', 'new_refresh_token', 'refresh_token', 'expires_at'};
 141        final extras = d.keys.where((k) => !knownKeys.contains(k)).toList();
 142        if (extras.isNotEmpty) {
 143          debugPrint('│   [extra fields]    : $extras');
 144        }
 145      }
 146      debugPrint('└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘');
 147      debugPrint('');
 148
 149      final refreshData = refreshResponse.data;
 150      final bool success = refreshData['success'] == true;
 151
 152      if (!success) {
 153        debugPrint('❌ [Interceptor] success=false → notifySessionExpired()');
 154        _sessionService.notifySessionExpired();
 155        return handler.next(err);
 156      }
 157
 158      // 3. Extract and save the new session data
 159      debugPrint('💾 [Interceptor] Step 3 — Saving new session to SecureStorage…');
 160      final data = refreshData['data'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
 161      final newSessionCookie = data?['session_cookie'] as String?;
 162      final newRefreshToken = data?['new_refresh_token'] as String?;
 163      final expiresAtRaw = data?['expires_at'] as String?;
 164
 165      if (newSessionCookie == null || newSessionCookie.isEmpty) {
 166        debugPrint('❌ [Interceptor] session_cookie missing in refresh response → notifySessionExpired()');
 167        _sessionService.notifySessionExpired();
 168        return handler.next(err);
 169      }
 170
 171      final expiresAt = expiresAtRaw != null
 172          ? DateTime.tryParse(expiresAtRaw.replaceAll(' ', 'T'))
 173          : DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30));
 174
 175      final tokenSaved = newRefreshToken ?? refreshToken;
 176      debugPrint('   refresh_token to save : ${newRefreshToken != null ? '✅ new token from backend' : '⚠️  no new token — reusing old token'}');
 177      debugPrint('   expiresAt parsed      : $expiresAt');
 178
 179      await _secureStorage.saveMadrasatiSession(
 180        MadrasatiSessionData(
 181          sessionCookie: newSessionCookie,
 182          schoolId: schoolId,
 183          expiresAt: expiresAt,
 184          refreshToken: tokenSaved,
 185        ),
 186      );
 187      debugPrint('   SecureStorage saved ✅');
 188
 189      _sessionService.notifySessionActive();
 190      debugPrint('🔔 [Interceptor] notifySessionActive() called ✅');
 191
 192      // 4. Replay the original failed request
 193      debugPrint('');
 194      debugPrint('🔁 [Interceptor] Step 4 — Replaying original request: ${err.requestOptions.method} ${err.requestOptions.path}');
 195      final opts = err.requestOptions;
 196      final retryResponse = await _dio.request<dynamic>(
 197        opts.path,
 198        data: opts.data,
 199        queryParameters: opts.queryParameters,
 200        options: Options(
 201          method: opts.method,
 202          headers: opts.headers,
 203          responseType: opts.responseType,
 204          contentType: opts.contentType,
 205        ),
 206      );
 207      debugPrint('✅ [Interceptor] Retry succeeded — statusCode: ${retryResponse.statusCode}');
 208
 209      return handler.resolve(retryResponse);
 210    } on DioException catch (refreshErr) {
 211      final statusCode = refreshErr.response?.statusCode;
 212
 213      // ── نفرّق: خطأ شبكة (انقطاع) vs خطأ مصادقة (session منتهية) ────────
 214      // لو مفيش response = مشكلة شبكة مش مصادقة
 215      final bool isNetworkError = refreshErr.response == null;
 216
 217      debugPrint('');
 218      debugPrint('💥 [Interceptor] DioException during refresh call!');
 219      debugPrint('   statusCode    : ${statusCode ?? '❌ null (no response)'}');
 220      debugPrint('   isNetworkErr  : $isNetworkError');
 221      debugPrint('   error body    : ${refreshErr.response?.data}');
 222      debugPrint('   message       : ${refreshErr.message}');
 223
 224      if (isNetworkError) {
 225        // ✋ انقطع الإنترنت — مش نظهر الدايلوج ومش نحذف الجلسة
 226        debugPrint('📵 [Interceptor] Network error — passing through WITHOUT showing dialog');
 227        return handler.next(err);
 228      }
 229
 230      // خطأ مصادقة حقيقي (401/403/...) — لازم يعمل connect من أول
 231      if (statusCode == 401 || statusCode == 403) {
 232        await _secureStorage.deleteMadrasatiSession();
 233        debugPrint('🗑️ [Interceptor] refresh_token rejected ($statusCode) — cleared all session data');
 234      }
 235
 236      _sessionService.notifySessionExpired();
 237      debugPrint('❌ [Interceptor] notifySessionExpired() called → SessionExpiredDialog will show');
 238      return handler.next(err);
 239    } catch (e, st) {
 240      debugPrint('💥 [Interceptor] Unexpected error: $e');
 241      debugPrint('   StackTrace: $st');
 242      // خطأ غير متوقع — نعامله كخطأ شبكة (مش نظهر الدايلوج)
 243      debugPrint('⚠️ [Interceptor] Unexpected error — passing through WITHOUT showing dialog');
 244      return handler.next(err);
 245    }
 246  }
 247
 248
 249  /// Returns true if the response indicates a Madrasati session problem.
 250  bool _isMadrasatiSessionError(Response<dynamic>? response) {
 251    if (response == null) return false;
 252
 253    final statusCode = response.statusCode;
 254    if (statusCode == null) return false;
 255
 256    if (response.data is Map) {
 257      final data = response.data as Map;
 258      final code = data['code']?.toString() ?? '';
 259      
 260      // Standard App Authentication Error (Bearer token expired/missing)
 261      // We should NOT treat this as a Madrasati session error!
 262      if (statusCode == 401 && code == 'unauthenticated') {
 263        return false;
 264      }
 265
 266      // 422 with specific Madrasati session error codes
 267      if (statusCode == 422 || statusCode == 401) {
 268        return code == 'missing_madrasati_auth_cookie' ||
 269            code == 'madrasati_session_expired' ||
 270            code == 'madrasati_session_required';
 271      }
 272    }
 273
 274    return false;
 275  }
 276}

   1import 'dart:async';
   2import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
   3
   4/// Represents the current status of the Madrasati school session.
   5enum MadrasatiSessionStatus {
   6  /// Status not yet determined (app just started).
   7  unknown,
   8
   9  /// Session is valid and active.
  10  active,
  11
  12  /// Session has expired (detected from API error response).
  13  expired,
  14}
  15
  16/// Application-level service that monitors the Madrasati school session.
  17///
  18/// Any screen or widget can listen to [onSessionExpired] to react when
  19/// the backend reports a session expiry (code: madrasati_session_expired).
  20///
  21/// Usage:
  22/// ```dart
  23/// sl<MadrasatiSessionService>().onSessionExpired.listen((_) {
  24///   // show dialog
  25/// });
  26/// ```
  27class MadrasatiSessionService {
  28  MadrasatiSessionService();
  29
  30  // ─── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  31
  32  MadrasatiSessionStatus _status = MadrasatiSessionStatus.unknown;
  33
  34  MadrasatiSessionStatus get status => _status;
  35
  36  bool get isExpired => _status == MadrasatiSessionStatus.expired;
  37
  38  // ─── Stream ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  39
  40  final StreamController<void> _sessionExpiredController =
  41      StreamController<void>.broadcast();
  42
  43  final StreamController<void> _sessionActiveController =
  44      StreamController<void>.broadcast();
  45
  46  /// Fires whenever the Madrasati session is detected as expired.
  47  /// The [SessionMonitorWrapper] listens to this to show the dialog.
  48  Stream<void> get onSessionExpired => _sessionExpiredController.stream;
  49
  50  /// Fires whenever the Madrasati session is successfully refreshed.
  51  Stream<void> get onSessionActive => _sessionActiveController.stream;
  52
  53  // ─── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  54
  55  /// Called by [DioHelper] when it detects session-expired error codes.
  56  /// Only fires the event once per expiry cycle (prevents multiple dialogs).
  57  void notifySessionExpired() {
  58    if (_status == MadrasatiSessionStatus.expired) return; // already notified
  59    _status = MadrasatiSessionStatus.expired;
  60    debugPrint('🔴 MadrasatiSessionService: session expired detected');
  61    if (!_sessionExpiredController.isClosed) {
  62      _sessionExpiredController.add(null);
  63    }
  64  }
  65
  66  /// Called after a successful session refresh or fresh connect.
  67  void notifySessionActive() {
  68    _status = MadrasatiSessionStatus.active;
  69    debugPrint('🟢 MadrasatiSessionService: session is active');
  70    if (!_sessionActiveController.isClosed) {
  71      _sessionActiveController.add(null);
  72    }
  73  }
  74
  75  /// Reset to unknown (e.g., on logout).
  76  void reset() {
  77    _status = MadrasatiSessionStatus.unknown;
  78    debugPrint('⚪ MadrasatiSessionService: reset');
  79  }
  80
  81  void dispose() {
  82    _sessionExpiredController.close();
  83    _sessionActiveController.close();
  84  }
  85}

   1import 'dart:async';
   2import 'package:app_links/app_links.dart';
   3import 'package:android_play_install_referrer/android_play_install_referrer.dart';
   4import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/core/network/local/cache_helper.dart';
   6
   7class ReferralService {
   8  static final AppLinks _appLinks = AppLinks();
   9  static StreamSubscription<Uri>? _linkSubscription;
  10
  11  static Future<void> init() async {
  12    // 1. Check Google Play Install Referrer
  13    await _checkInstallReferrer();
  14
  15    // 2. Handle Initial Deep Link (App opened via link)
  16    try {
  17      final initialUri = await _appLinks.getInitialLink();
  18      if (initialUri != null) {
  19        _handleDeepLink(initialUri);
  20      }
  21    } catch (e) {
  22      debugPrint('Failed to get initial app link: $e');
  23    }
  24
  25    // 3. Listen for incoming Deep Links while app is open
  26    _linkSubscription?.cancel();
  27    _linkSubscription = _appLinks.uriLinkStream.listen(
  28      (Uri uri) {
  29        _handleDeepLink(uri);
  30      },
  31      onError: (err) {
  32        debugPrint('AppLinks Stream Error: $err');
  33      },
  34    );
  35  }
  36
  37  static Future<void> _checkInstallReferrer() async {
  38    try {
  39      // Check if we already have a referral code
  40      final existingCode = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'referral_code');
  41      if (existingCode != null && existingCode.toString().isNotEmpty) return;
  42      
  43      // Also check if user is already authenticated (token exists)
  44      final existingToken = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'auth_token');
  45      if (existingToken != null && existingToken.toString().isNotEmpty) return;
  46
  47      final ReferrerDetails referrerDetails = await AndroidPlayInstallReferrer.installReferrer;
  48      final referrerUrl = referrerDetails.installReferrer;
  49      
  50      if (referrerUrl != null && referrerUrl.isNotEmpty) {
  51        debugPrint('Install Referrer URL: $referrerUrl');
  52        
  53        // Parse the referrer string (e.g., utm_source=referral&utm_content=HAMDY7K2)
  54        final uri = Uri.parse('http://localhost?$referrerUrl');
  55        final utmContent = uri.queryParameters['utm_content'];
  56        
  57        if (utmContent != null && utmContent.isNotEmpty) {
  58          _storeReferralCode(utmContent);
  59        }
  60      }
  61    } catch (e) {
  62      debugPrint('Failed to get install referrer: $e');
  63    }
  64  }
  65
  66  static void _handleDeepLink(Uri uri) {
  67    try {
  68      // Check if user is already authenticated (token exists)
  69      final existingToken = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'auth_token');
  70      if (existingToken != null && existingToken.toString().isNotEmpty) {
  71        debugPrint('User is already authenticated. Ignoring referral deep link.');
  72        return;
  73      }
  74
  75      // Check if we already have a referral code
  76      final existingCode = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'referral_code');
  77      if (existingCode != null && existingCode.toString().isNotEmpty) {
  78        debugPrint('Referral code already exists locally. Preserving existing code: $existingCode');
  79        return;
  80      }
  81
  82      // Handle https://haderedu.com/r/HAMDY7K2
  83      if (uri.host == 'haderedu.com' && uri.pathSegments.isNotEmpty) {
  84        if (uri.pathSegments[0] == 'r' && uri.pathSegments.length > 1) {
  85          final referralCode = uri.pathSegments[1];
  86          if (referralCode.isNotEmpty) {
  87            _storeReferralCode(referralCode);
  88          }
  89        }
  90      }
  91    } catch (e) {
  92      debugPrint('Error handling deep link: $e');
  93    }
  94  }
  95
  96  static void _storeReferralCode(String code) {
  97    // Only store if we don't have one
  98    final existingCode = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'referral_code');
  99    if (existingCode == null || existingCode.toString().isEmpty) {
 100      CacheHelper.saveData(key: 'referral_code', value: code);
 101      debugPrint('Referral code stored locally: $code');
 102    }
 103  }
 104
 105  static void dispose() {
 106    _linkSubscription?.cancel();
 107  }
 108}

  23  final formattedDate =
  24      "${date.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-"
  25      "${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-"
  26      "${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}";
  27
  28  final formattedTime =
  29      "${date.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:"
  30      "${date.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}";
  31
  32  return "$formattedDate || $formattedTime";
  33}

   1import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_endpoints.dart';
   2
   3class ImageHelper {
   4  /// Builds a robust image URL by prepending the base URL and handling common subfolders.
   5  /// It covers cases where the backend returns relative paths like 'avatars/xxx.jpg'
   6  /// and ensures Laravel's '/storage/' prefix is added if likely needed.
   7  static String? getFullImageUrl(String? path) {
   8    if (path == null || path.trim().isEmpty) return null;
   9
  10    final trimmedPath = path.trim();
  11
  12    // 1. If it's already a full URL, just ensure it's HTTPS if needed
  13    if (trimmedPath.startsWith('http')) {
  14      if (trimmedPath.startsWith('http://') && baseUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
  15        return trimmedPath.replaceFirst('http://', 'https://');
  16      }
  17      return trimmedPath;
  18    }
  19
  20    // 2. Prepare the base and relative path
  21    final base = baseUrl.endsWith('/')
  22        ? baseUrl.substring(0, baseUrl.length - 1)
  23        : baseUrl;
  24
  25    String relativePath = trimmedPath.startsWith('/')
  26        ? trimmedPath.substring(1)
  27        : trimmedPath;
  28
  29    // 3. Heuristics for common subfolders that usually live under /storage/
  30    // We check if it doesn't already have storage/ or public/
  31    final List<String> storageFolders = [
  32      'avatars',
  33      'profiles',
  34      'patients',
  35      'doctors',
  36      'facilities',
  37      'medications',
  38      'prescriptions',
  39    ];
  40
  41    bool needsStoragePrefix = true;
  42    if (relativePath.startsWith('storage/') ||
  43        relativePath.startsWith('public/')) {
  44      needsStoragePrefix = false;
  45    } else {
  46      // Check if it starts with any common storage folder
  47      bool isMatch = false;
  48      for (var folder in storageFolders) {
  49        if (relativePath.startsWith('$folder/')) {
  50          isMatch = true;
  51          break;
  52        }
  53      }
  54      if (!isMatch) {
  55        // If it doesn't match a known folder, we still might need storage/
  56        // but we'll be more conservative.
  57        // Let's assume for now that if it's relative, it needs storage/
  58        // UNLESS the path starts with something like 'api/'
  59        if (relativePath.startsWith('api/')) {
  60          needsStoragePrefix = false;
  61        }
  62      }
  63    }
  64
  65    if (needsStoragePrefix) {
  66      relativePath = 'storage/$relativePath';
  67    }
  68
  69    return '$base/$relativePath';
  70  }
  71}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'dart:math' as math;
   3
   4class DiscreteCircle extends StatefulWidget {
   5  final double size;
   6  final Color color;
   7  final Color secondCircleColor;
   8  final Color thirdCircleColor;
   9
  10  const DiscreteCircle({
  11    super.key,
  12    required this.color,
  13    required this.size,
  14    required this.secondCircleColor,
  15    required this.thirdCircleColor,
  16  });
  17
  18  @override
  19  State<DiscreteCircle> createState() => _DiscreteCircleState();
  20}
  21
  22class _DiscreteCircleState extends State<DiscreteCircle>
  23    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  24  late AnimationController _controller;
  25
  26  @override
  27  void initState() {
  28    super.initState();
  29    _controller = AnimationController(
  30      vsync: this,
  31      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 2000),
  32    )..repeat();
  33  }
  34
  35  @override
  36  void dispose() {
  37    _controller.dispose();
  38    super.dispose();
  39  }
  40
  41  // دالة بديلة للمكتبة الخارجية لعمل حسابات القيم بناءً على الوقت والمنحنى
  42  double _evalDouble({
  43    double from = 0.0,
  44    required double to,
  45    required double begin,
  46    required double end,
  47    Curve curve = Curves.linear,
  48  }) {
  49    final interval = Interval(begin, end, curve: curve);
  50    final progress = interval.transform(_controller.value);
  51    return from + (to - from) * progress;
  52  }
  53
  54  @override
  55  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  56    final double size = widget.size;
  57    final double strokeWidth = size / 8;
  58
  59    return AnimatedBuilder(
  60      animation: _controller,
  61      builder: (context, child) {
  62        final bool isFirstHalf = _controller.value <= 0.5;
  63        final bool isSecondHalf = _controller.value >= 0.5;
  64
  65        return SizedBox(
  66          width: size,
  67          height: size,
  68          child: Stack(
  69            children: <Widget>[
  70              // الدائرة الثالثة
  71              if (isSecondHalf)
  72                Transform.rotate(
  73                  angle: _evalDouble(
  74                    to: 2 * math.pi,
  75                    begin: 0.68,
  76                    end: 0.95,
  77                    curve: Curves.easeOut,
  78                  ),
  79                  child: _Arc(
  80                    color: widget.thirdCircleColor,
  81                    strokeWidth: strokeWidth,
  82                    startAngle: -math.pi / 2,
  83                    sweepAngle: _evalDouble(
  84                      from: math.pi / 2,
  85                      to: math.pi / (size * size),
  86                      begin: 0.7,
  87                      end: 0.95,
  88                      curve: Curves.easeOutSine,
  89                    ),
  90                  ),
  91                ),
  92
  93              // الدائرة الثانية
  94              if (isSecondHalf)
  95                _Arc(
  96                  color: widget.secondCircleColor,
  97                  strokeWidth: strokeWidth,
  98                  startAngle: -math.pi / 2,
  99                  sweepAngle: _evalDouble(
 100                    from: -2 * math.pi,
 101                    to: math.pi / (size * size),
 102                    begin: 0.6,
 103                    end: 0.95,
 104                    curve: Curves.easeOutSine,
 105                  ),
 106                ),
 107
 108              // الدائرة الأساسية (النصف الأول من الحركة)
 109              if (isFirstHalf)
 110                Transform.rotate(
 111                  angle: _evalDouble(
 112                    to: math.pi * 0.06,
 113                    begin: 0.48,
 114                    end: 0.5,
 115                  ),
 116                  child: _Arc(
 117                    color: widget.color,
 118                    strokeWidth: strokeWidth,
 119                    startAngle: -math.pi / 2,
 120                    sweepAngle: _evalDouble(
 121                      from: math.pi / (size * size),
 122                      to: 1.94 * math.pi,
 123                      begin: 0.05,
 124                      end: 0.48,
 125                      curve: Curves.easeOutSine,
 126                    ),
 127                  ),
 128                ),
 129
 130              // الدائرة الأساسية (النصف الثاني من الحركة)
 131              if (isSecondHalf)
 132                _Arc(
 133                  color: widget.color,
 134                  strokeWidth: strokeWidth,
 135                  startAngle: -math.pi / 2,
 136                  sweepAngle: _evalDouble(
 137                    from: -1.94 * math.pi,
 138                    to: math.pi / (size * size),
 139                    begin: 0.5,
 140                    end: 0.95,
 141                    curve: Curves.easeOutSine,
 142                  ),
 143                ),
 144            ],
 145          ),
 146        );
 147      },
 148    );
 149  }
 150}
 151
 152// ==========================================
 153// Private Helper Widgets for Drawing (Standalone)
 154// ==========================================
 155class _Arc extends StatelessWidget {
 156  final Color color;
 157  final double strokeWidth;
 158  final double startAngle;
 159  final double sweepAngle;
 160
 161  const _Arc({
 162    required this.color,
 163    required this.strokeWidth,
 164    required this.startAngle,
 165    required this.sweepAngle,
 166  });
 167
 168  @override
 169  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 170    return CustomPaint(
 171      size: Size.infinite,
 172      painter: _ArcPainter(
 173        color: color,
 174        strokeWidth: strokeWidth,
 175        startAngle: startAngle,
 176        sweepAngle: sweepAngle,
 177      ),
 178    );
 179  }
 180}
 181
 182class _ArcPainter extends CustomPainter {
 183  final Color color;
 184  final double strokeWidth;
 185  final double startAngle;
 186  final double sweepAngle;
 187
 188  _ArcPainter({
 189    required this.color,
 190    required this.strokeWidth,
 191    required this.startAngle,
 192    required this.sweepAngle,
 193  });
 194
 195  @override
 196  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
 197    final center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
 198    final radius = (math.min(size.width, size.height) - strokeWidth) / 2;
 199    final rect = Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius);
 200
 201    final paint = Paint()
 202      ..color = color
 203      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
 204      ..strokeWidth = strokeWidth
 205      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
 206
 207    canvas.drawArc(rect, startAngle, sweepAngle, false, paint);
 208  }
 209
 210  @override
 211  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _ArcPainter oldDelegate) {
 212    return oldDelegate.color != color ||
 213        oldDelegate.strokeWidth != strokeWidth ||
 214        oldDelegate.startAngle != startAngle ||
 215        oldDelegate.sweepAngle != sweepAngle;
 216  }
 217}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/primary/circle_indecator.dart';
   3
   4class ConditionalBuilder extends StatelessWidget {
   5  final bool loadingState;
   6  final bool errorState;
   7  final bool emptyState;
   8
   9  final WidgetBuilder successBuilder;
  10  final WidgetBuilder? loadingBuilder;
  11  final WidgetBuilder? errorBuilder;
  12  final WidgetBuilder? emptyBuilder;
  13
  14  const ConditionalBuilder({
  15    super.key,
  16    required this.loadingState,
  17    this.errorState = false,
  18    this.emptyState = false,
  19    required this.successBuilder,
  20    this.loadingBuilder,
  21    this.errorBuilder,
  22    this.emptyBuilder,
  23  });
  24
  25  @override
  26  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  27    if (loadingState) {
  28      return loadingBuilder?.call(context) ??
  29          const Center(child: DiscreteCircle(
  30                          size: 60,
  31                          color:Color(0xFFD61F69),
  32                          secondCircleColor:Color(0xFFE2AD3B),
  33                          thirdCircleColor:Color(0xFF0E7A5E)
  34                        ),);
  35    }
  36
  37    if (errorState) {
  38      return errorBuilder?.call(context) ?? const SizedBox.shrink();
  39    }
  40
  41    if (emptyState) {
  42      return emptyBuilder?.call(context) ?? const SizedBox.shrink();
  43    }
  44
  45    return successBuilder(context);
  46  }
  47}

   5class PrimaryElevatedButton extends StatelessWidget {
   6  final String text;
   7  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
   8  final bool isLoading;
   9  final double height;
  10  final double radius;
  11  final Color? backgroundColor;
  12  final TextStyle? textStyle;
  13  final Widget? icon;
  14  final double? width;
  15final BorderSide? borderSide;
  16
  17  const PrimaryElevatedButton({
  18    super.key,
  19    required this.text,
  20    required this.onPressed,
  21    this.isLoading = false,
  22    this.height = 52,
  23    this.radius = 24,
  24    this.backgroundColor,
  25    this.textStyle,
  26    this.icon,
  27    this.width,
  28    this.borderSide,
  29  });
  30
  31  @override
  32  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  33    return SizedBox(
  34      width: width ?? double.infinity,
  35      height: height,
  36      child: icon == null
  37          ? ElevatedButton(
  38              onPressed: isLoading ? null : onPressed,
  39              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
  40                backgroundColor: backgroundColor ?? ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  41                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
  42                elevation: 0,
  43                shadowColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
  44                animationDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
  45                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
  46                  horizontal: 20,
  47                  vertical: 14,
  48                ),
  49               shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
  50  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
  51  side: borderSide ?? BorderSide.none,
  52),
  53              ),
  54              child: PrimaryElevatedButtonLabel(
  55                isLoading: isLoading,
  56                text: text,
  57                textStyle: textStyle,
  58              ),
  59            )
  60          : ElevatedButton.icon(
  61              onPressed: isLoading ? null : onPressed,
  62              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
  63                backgroundColor: backgroundColor ?? ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  64                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
  65                elevation: 0,
  66                shadowColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
  67                animationDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
  68                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
  69                  horizontal: 20,
  70                  vertical: 14,
  71                ),
  72                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
  73  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
  74  side: borderSide ?? BorderSide.none,
  75),
  76              ),
  77              icon: icon!,
  78              label: PrimaryElevatedButtonLabel(
  79                isLoading: isLoading,
  80                text: text,
  81                textStyle: textStyle,
  82              ),
  83            ),
  84    );
  85  }
  86}

   2import 'package:moean/core/theme/colors.dart';

   9class PrimaryTextField extends StatefulWidget {
  10  final TextEditingController controller;
  11  final String? label;
  12  final String hint;
  13  final bool isPassword;
  14  final String? Function(String?)? validator;
  15  final Widget? prefixIcon;
  16  final Widget? suffixIcon;
  17  final TextInputType keyboardType;
  18  final TextInputAction textInputAction;
  19  final bool enabled;
  20  final Color? fillColor;
  21  final Color? textColor;
  22  final Color? hintColor;
  23  final bool readOnly;
  24  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  25  final ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
  26  final FocusNode? focusNode;
  27  final ValueChanged<String>? onFieldSubmitted;
  28  final int maxLines;
  29  final List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters;
  30  final TextDirection? textDirection;
  31  final TextAlign textAlign;
  32  final BoxConstraints? prefixIconConstraints;
  33  final BoxConstraints? suffixIconConstraints;
  34  final int? maxLength;
  35
  36  const PrimaryTextField({
  37    super.key,
  38    required this.controller,
  39    this.label,
  40    required this.hint,
  41    this.isPassword = false,
  42    this.validator,
  43    this.prefixIcon,
  44    this.suffixIcon,
  45    this.keyboardType = TextInputType.text,
  46    this.textInputAction = TextInputAction.next,
  47    this.enabled = true,
  48    this.fillColor,
  49    this.textColor,
  50    this.hintColor,
  51    this.readOnly = false,
  52    this.onTap,
  53    this.onChanged,
  54    this.focusNode,
  55    this.onFieldSubmitted,
  56    this.maxLines = 1,
  57    this.inputFormatters,
  58    this.textDirection,
  59    this.textAlign = TextAlign.start,
  60    this.prefixIconConstraints,
  61    this.suffixIconConstraints,
  62    this.maxLength,
  63  });
  64
  65  @override
  66  State<PrimaryTextField> createState() => _PrimaryTextFieldState();
  67}
  68
  69class _PrimaryTextFieldState extends State<PrimaryTextField> {
  70  late FocusNode _focusNode;
  71  late bool _ownsFocusNode;
  72
  73  @override
  74  void initState() {
  75    super.initState();
  76    _focusNode = widget.focusNode ?? FocusNode();
  77    _ownsFocusNode = widget.focusNode == null;
  78    _focusNode.addListener(_onFocusChange);
  79  }
  80
  81  @override
  82  void didUpdateWidget(covariant PrimaryTextField oldWidget) {
  83    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
  84
  85    if (oldWidget.focusNode != widget.focusNode) {
  86      _focusNode.removeListener(_onFocusChange);
  87      if (_ownsFocusNode) {
  88        _focusNode.dispose();
  89      }
  90
  91      _focusNode = widget.focusNode ?? FocusNode();
  92      _ownsFocusNode = widget.focusNode == null;
  93      _focusNode.addListener(_onFocusChange);
  94    }
  95  }
  96
  97  void _onFocusChange() {
  98    if (mounted) {
  99      setState(() {});
 100    }
 101  }
 102
 103  @override
 104  void dispose() {
 105    _focusNode.removeListener(_onFocusChange);
 106    if (_ownsFocusNode) {
 107      _focusNode.dispose();
 108    }
 109    super.dispose();
 110  }
 111
 112  @override
 113Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 114  return BlocBuilder<ThemeCubit, ThemeState>(
 115    builder: (context, state) {
 116      return TextFormField(
 117        controller: widget.controller,
 118        focusNode: _focusNode,
 119        obscureText: widget.isPassword,
 120        validator: widget.validator,
 121        keyboardType: widget.keyboardType,
 122        textInputAction: widget.textInputAction,
 123        inputFormatters: widget.inputFormatters,
 124        textDirection: widget.textDirection,
 125        textAlign: widget.textAlign,
 126        maxLength: widget.maxLength,
 127        maxLines: widget.maxLines,
 128        style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
 129          color: widget.textColor ?? ColorsManager.textPrimary,
 130        ),
 131        enabled: widget.enabled,
 132        readOnly: widget.readOnly,
 133        onTap: widget.onTap,
 134        onChanged: widget.onChanged,
 135        onFieldSubmitted: widget.onFieldSubmitted,
 136        decoration: InputDecoration(
 137          // تفعيل الخلفية هنا بدلاً من الـ Container
 138          filled: true,
 139          fillColor: widget.fillColor ?? ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
 140          counterText: widget.maxLength != null ? '' : null,
 141          labelText: widget.label,
 142          labelStyle: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
 143            color: widget.textColor ?? ColorsManager.textSecondary,
 144          ),
 145          hintText: widget.hint,
 146          hintStyle: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
 147            color: widget.hintColor ?? ColorsManager.textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
 148          ),
 149          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
 150            horizontal: 20,
 151            vertical: 16,
 152          ),
 153          prefixIcon: widget.prefixIcon,
 154          prefixIconConstraints: widget.prefixIconConstraints,
 155          prefixIconColor: widget.textColor ?? ColorsManager.textSecondary,
 156          suffixIcon: widget.suffixIcon,
 157          suffixIconConstraints: widget.suffixIconConstraints,
 158          suffixIconColor: widget.textColor ?? ColorsManager.textSecondary,
 159          
 160          // هنا نقوم بتعريف الحدود لكل الحالات وسيقوم فلاتر بمعالجة حجم الخطأ تلقائياً
 161          border: OutlineInputBorder(
 162            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
 163            borderSide: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
 164          ),
 165          enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
 166            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
 167            borderSide: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
 168          ),
 169          focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
 170            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
 171            borderSide: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.themeActiveAccent),
 172          ),
 173          errorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
 174            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
 175            borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red), // لون الحقل عند الخطأ
 176          ),
 177          focusedErrorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
 178            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
 179            borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red, width: 2),
 180          ),
 181        ),
 182      );
 183    },
 184  );
 185}
 186}

  10class UpgradePromptBottomSheet extends StatelessWidget {
  11  final String message;
  12  final bool isQuotaExceeded;
  13
  14  const UpgradePromptBottomSheet({
  15    super.key,
  16    required this.message,
  17    required this.isQuotaExceeded,
  18  });
  19
  20  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, {required String message, required bool isQuotaExceeded}) {
  21    return showModalBottomSheet(
  22      context: context,
  23      isScrollControlled: true,
  24      backgroundColor: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
  25      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
  26        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
  27      ),
  28      builder: (context) => UpgradePromptBottomSheet(
  29        message: message,
  30        isQuotaExceeded: isQuotaExceeded,
  31      ),
  32    );
  33  }
  34
  35  @override
  36  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  37    return Padding(
  38      padding: EdgeInsets.only(
  39        left: 20,
  40        right: 20,
  41        top: 32,
  42        bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom + 20,
  43      ),
  44      child: Column(
  45        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
  46        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
  47        children: [
  48          Icon(
  49            isQuotaExceeded ? Icons.hourglass_empty_rounded : Icons.workspace_premium_rounded,
  50            size: 64,
  51            color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  52          ),
  53          verticalSpace16,
  54          Text(
  55            isQuotaExceeded ? 'نفد الرصيد!' : 'ترقية الحساب المطلوبة',
  56            style: TextStylesManager.bold20.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText),
  57            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
  58          ),
  59          verticalSpace8,
  60          Text(
  61            message,
  62            style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.secondaryText),
  63            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
  64          ),
  65          verticalSpace24,
  66          Container(
  67            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
  68            decoration: BoxDecoration(
  69              color: ColorsManager.primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
  70              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
  71            ),
  72            child: Column(
  73              children: [
  74                _buildBenefit('وصول غير محدود لكل المزايا'),
  75                verticalSpace8,
  76                _buildBenefit('أولوية الدعم الفني والمساعدة'),
  77                verticalSpace8,
  78                _buildBenefit('إعداد الدروس بنقرة واحدة'),
  79              ],
  80            ),
  81          ),
  82          verticalSpace32,
  83          PrimaryElevatedButton(
  84            text: 'عرض باقات الاشتراك',
  85            onPressed: () {
  86              Navigator.pop(context);
  87              context.push(Routes.checkout);
  88            },
  89            width: double.infinity,
  90          ),
  91          verticalSpace16,
  92          TextButton(
  93            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
  94            child: Text(
  95              'لاحقاً',
  96              style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.secondaryText),
  97            ),
  98          ),
  99        ],
 100      ),
 101    );
 102  }
 103
 104  Widget _buildBenefit(String text) {
 105    return Row(

 111            text,

 113          ),
 114        ),
 115      ],
 116    );

  10ThemeCubit get themeCubit => sl<ThemeCubit>();
  11
  12class ThemeCubit extends Cubit<ThemeState> {
  13  ThemeCubit() : super(ThemeInitialState());
  14  static ThemeCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  15
  16  void init({bool isDark = false}) {
  17    _isDarkMode = isDark;
  18  }
  19
  20  bool _isDarkMode = false;
  21
  22  bool get isDarkMode => _isDarkMode;
  23
  24  void changeTheme({bool? fromShared}) {
  25    _isDarkMode = fromShared ?? !_isDarkMode;
  26    CacheHelper.saveData(key: 'isDark', value: _isDarkMode);
  27    emit(ThemeChangeThemeState());
  28  }
  29
  30  bool _isArabicLang = false;
  31  TranslationModel? _translationModel;
  32
  33  bool get isArabicLang => _isArabicLang;
  34
  35  TranslationModel? get translationModel => _translationModel;
  36
  37  Future<void> changeLanguage() async {
  38    try {
  39      emit(ThemeLanguageLoadingState());
  40
  41      final newIsArabic = !_isArabicLang;
  42      final String translations = await rootBundle.loadString(
  43        'assets/translations/${newIsArabic ? 'ar' : 'en'}.json',
  44      );
  45
  46      final model = TranslationModel.fromJson(json.decode(translations));
  47      _isArabicLang = newIsArabic;
