   1import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
   2
   3/// Formatter to normalize Saudi phone numbers in real-time.
   4/// - Converts Arabic-Indic and Eastern-Arabic numerals to English ASCII digits.
   5/// - Strips whitespace, hyphens, and any non-digit characters.
   6/// - Normalizes international prefixes (+966, 00966, 966) if pasted.
   7/// - Enforces maximum length of 10 digits (e.g. 05XXXXXXXX).
   8class SaudiPhoneInputFormatter extends TextInputFormatter {
   9  @override
  10  TextEditingValue formatEditUpdate(
  11    TextEditingValue oldValue,
  12    TextEditingValue newValue,
  13  ) {
  14    if (newValue.text.isEmpty) {
  15      return newValue;
  16    }
  17
  18    final normalized = normalizePhoneNumber(newValue.text);
  19    final truncated =
  20        normalized.length > 10 ? normalized.substring(0, 10) : normalized;
  21
  22    // Calculate cursor position after formatting
  23    int newOffset = truncated.length;
  24    if (newValue.selection.end <= newValue.text.length) {
  25      final textBeforeCursor =
  26          newValue.text.substring(0, newValue.selection.end);
  27      final normalizedBefore = normalizePhoneNumber(textBeforeCursor);
  28      newOffset = normalizedBefore.length.clamp(0, truncated.length);
  29    }
  30
  31    return TextEditingValue(
  32      text: truncated,
  33      selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: newOffset),
  34    );
  35  }
  36
  37  /// Utility method to convert Arabic numerals and strip invalid chars
  38  static String normalizePhoneNumber(String input) {
  39    if (input.isEmpty) return input;
  40
  41    // Arabic-Indic & Eastern-Arabic digits mapping
  42    const arabicDigits = ['٠', '١', '٢', '٣', '٤', '٥', '٦', '٧', '٨', '٩'];
  43    const easternArabicDigits = ['۰', '۱', '۲', '۳', '۴', '۵', '۶', '۷', '۸', '۹'];
  44
  45    String normalized = input;
  46    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  47      normalized = normalized.replaceAll(arabicDigits[i], i.toString());
  48      normalized = normalized.replaceAll(easternArabicDigits[i], i.toString());
  49    }
  50
  51    // Strip all non-digit characters (spaces, dashes, parentheses, +, etc.)
  52    normalized = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\D'), '');
  53
  54    // Handle country codes (+966 / 00966 / 966)
  55    if (normalized.startsWith('00966')) {
  56      normalized = normalized.substring(5);
  57      if (!normalized.startsWith('0')) {
  58        normalized = '0$normalized';
  59      }
  60    } else if (normalized.startsWith('966')) {
  61      normalized = normalized.substring(3);
  62      if (!normalized.startsWith('0')) {
  63        normalized = '0$normalized';
  64      }
  65    }
  66
  67    return normalized;
  68  }
  69}

   1import 'dart:typed_data';
   2import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   3import 'package:screenshot/screenshot.dart';
   4import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
   5import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
   6import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
   7import 'package:moean/core/theme/text_styles.dart';
   8import 'package:moean/core/theme/colors.dart';
   9
  10class PdfExportHelper {
  11  static Future<void> exportWidgetsToPdfPages({
  12    required BuildContext context,
  13    required List<Widget> pages,
  14    required String title,
  15  }) async {
  16    showDialog(
  17      context: context,
  18      barrierDismissible: false,
  19      builder: (_) => const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
  20    );
  21
  22    try {
  23      final screenshotController = ScreenshotController();
  24      final pdf = pw.Document();
  25
  26      for (var pageWidget in pages) {
  27        final fullWidget = Directionality(
  28          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
  29          child: Theme(
  30            data: Theme.of(context),
  31            child: Material(
  32              color: ColorsManager.background,
  33              child: Padding(
  34                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
  35                child: pageWidget,
  36              ),
  37            ),
  38          ),
  39        );
  40
  41        final Uint8List imageBytes = await screenshotController.captureFromWidget(
  42          fullWidget,
  43          context: context,
  44          delay: const Duration(milliseconds: 100),
  45          pixelRatio: 2.0,
  46        );
  47
  48        final image = pw.MemoryImage(imageBytes);
  49        pdf.addPage(
  50          pw.Page(
  51            pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
  52            build: (pw.Context context) {
  53              return pw.Center(
  54                child: pw.Image(image, fit: pw.BoxFit.contain),
  55              );
  56            },
  57          ),
  58        );
  59      }
  60
  61      if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
  62
  63      await Printing.layoutPdf(
  64        onLayout: (PdfPageFormat format) async => pdf.save(),
  65        name: '$title.pdf',
  66      );
  67    } catch (e) {
  68      if (context.mounted) {
  69        Navigator.pop(context);
  70        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  71          SnackBar(content: Text('حدث خطأ أثناء التصدير: $e'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
  72        );
  73      }
  74    }
  75  }
  76}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2
   3/// A [CustomPainter] that draws a uniform dot-grid pattern.
   4/// Used as a decorative background element across multiple screens.
   5class DotGridPainter extends CustomPainter {
   6  final Color color;
   7  final double spacing;
   8  final double dotRadius;
   9
  10  const DotGridPainter({
  11    required this.color,
  12    this.spacing = 16.0,
  13    this.dotRadius = 2.0,
  14  });
  15
  16  @override
  17  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
  18    final paint = Paint()
  19      ..color = color
  20      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;
  21
  22    for (double x = 0; x < size.width; x += spacing) {
  23      for (double y = 0; y < size.height; y += spacing) {
  24        canvas.drawCircle(Offset(x, y), dotRadius, paint);
  25      }
  26    }
  27  }
  28
  29  @override
  30  bool shouldRepaint(covariant DotGridPainter oldDelegate) {
  31    return oldDelegate.color != color ||
  32        oldDelegate.spacing != spacing ||
  33        oldDelegate.dotRadius != dotRadius;
  34  }
  35}

   2import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/di/injections.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/services/madrasati_session_service.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/core/widgets/session_expired_dialog.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/main.dart';
   7
   8/// A transparent widget that sits at the top of the widget tree (inside
   9/// [MaterialApp.builder]) and listens globally for Madrasati session expiry.
  10///
  11/// When [MadrasatiSessionService.onSessionExpired] fires it shows
  12/// [SessionExpiredDialog] via the [navigatorKey], ensuring the dialog
  13/// appears regardless of which screen the user is currently on.
  14class SessionMonitorWrapper extends StatefulWidget {
  15  final Widget child;
  16
  17  const SessionMonitorWrapper({super.key, required this.child});
  18
  19  @override
  20  State<SessionMonitorWrapper> createState() => _SessionMonitorWrapperState();
  21}
  22
  23class _SessionMonitorWrapperState extends State<SessionMonitorWrapper> {
  24  StreamSubscription<void>? _subscription;
  25  bool _dialogShowing = false;
  26
  27  @override
  28  void initState() {
  29    super.initState();
  30    _subscribe();
  31  }
  32
  33  void _subscribe() {
  34    try {
  35      _subscription =
  36          sl<MadrasatiSessionService>().onSessionExpired.listen((_) {
  37        _showExpiredDialog();
  38      });
  39    } catch (e) {
  40      debugPrint('SessionMonitorWrapper: could not subscribe: $e');
  41    }
  42  }
  43
  44  Future<void> _showExpiredDialog() async {
  45    if (_dialogShowing) return; // Prevent stacking multiple dialogs
  46    _dialogShowing = true;
  47
  48    final context = navigatorKey.currentContext;
  49    if (context == null) {
  50      _dialogShowing = false;
  51      return;
  52    }
  53
  54    debugPrint('🔔 SessionMonitorWrapper: showing session expired dialog');
  55
  56    await SessionExpiredDialog.show(context);
  57
  58    _dialogShowing = false;
  59  }
  60
  61  @override
  62  void dispose() {
  63    _subscription?.cancel();
  64    super.dispose();
  65  }
  66
  67  @override
  68  Widget build(BuildContext context) => widget.child;
  69}

   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/models/login_request.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';

   9class AccountSuspendedCubit extends Cubit<AccountSuspendedState> {
  10  static AccountSuspendedCubit get(BuildContext context) =>
  11      BlocProvider.of<AccountSuspendedCubit>(context);
  12
  13  final GlobalKey<FormState> formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  14  final TextEditingController subjectController = TextEditingController(
  15    text: 'طلب مراجعة وفك تعليق الحساب',
  16  );
  17  final TextEditingController messageController = TextEditingController();
  18
  19  AccountSuspendedCubit() : super(AccountSuspendedInitialState()) {
  20    try {
  21      subjectController.text = appTranslation().get('account_suspended_subject_default');
  22    } catch (_) {}
  23  }
  24
  25  String selectedType = 'technical_support';
  26  List<dynamic> contactTypes = [
  27    {'value': 'technical_support', 'label': 'دعم فني'},
  28    {'value': 'billing', 'label': 'الفوترة والاشتراكات'},
  29    {'value': 'feature_request', 'label': 'اقتراح ميزة'},
  30    {'value': 'general', 'label': 'استفسار عام'},
  31    {'value': 'other', 'label': 'أخرى'},
  32  ];
  33
  34  Future<void> loadContactTypes() async {
  35    final result = await ApiService.getContactTypes();
  36    if (isClosed) return;
  37    result.fold(
  38      (_) {},
  39      (data) {
  40        if (data['types'] is List && (data['types'] as List).isNotEmpty) {
  41          contactTypes = data['types'] as List;
  42          if (!isClosed) {
  43            emit(AccountSuspendedTypesLoadedState(types: contactTypes));
  44          }
  45        }
  46      },
  47    );
  48  }
  49
  50  void selectType(String type) {
  51    selectedType = type;
  52    emit(AccountSuspendedTypeSelectedState(selectedType: type));
  53  }
  54
  55  Future<void> checkStatus({String? email, String? password}) async {
  56    if (!isClosed) emit(AccountSuspendedCheckingState());
  57
  58    if (email != null && email.isNotEmpty && password != null && password.isNotEmpty) {
  59      final result = await ApiService.loginUser(
  60        LoginRequest(email: email, password: password),
  61      );
  62      if (isClosed) return;
  63
  64      result.fold(
  65        (error) {
  66          if (!isClosed) {
  67            final isSuspended = error.contains('account_suspended') ||
  68                error.contains('تعليق') ||
  69                error.contains('موقوف');
  70            if (isSuspended) {
  71              emit(
  72                AccountSuspendedStillSuspendedState(
  73                  message: appTranslation().get('account_suspended_still_suspended'),
  74                ),
  75              );
  76            } else {
  77              emit(AccountSuspendedStillSuspendedState(message: error));
  78            }
  79          }
  80        },
  81        (response) {
  82          if (!isClosed) {
  83            if (response.user.isActive) {
  84              emit(AccountSuspendedActiveState());
  85            } else {
  86              emit(
  87                AccountSuspendedStillSuspendedState(
  88                  message: appTranslation().get('account_suspended_still_suspended'),
  89                ),
  90              );
  91            }
  92          }
  93        },
  94      );
  95      return;
  96    }
  97
  98    final meResult = await ApiService.getMe();
  99    if (isClosed) return;
 100
 101    meResult.fold(
 102      (error) {
 103        if (!isClosed) {
 104          emit(
 105            AccountSuspendedStillSuspendedState(
 106              message: appTranslation().get('account_suspended_still_suspended'),
 107            ),
 108          );
 109        }
 110      },
 111      (user) {
 112        if (!isClosed) {
 113          if (user.isActive) {
 114            emit(AccountSuspendedActiveState());
 115          } else {
 116            emit(
 117              AccountSuspendedStillSuspendedState(
 118                message: appTranslation().get('account_suspended_still_suspended'),
 119              ),
 120            );
 121          }
 122        }
 123      },
 124    );
 125  }
 126
 127  Future<void> submitReviewTicket({
 128    String? email,
 129    String? name,
 130    String? phone,
 131  }) async {
 132    if (!(formKey.currentState?.validate() ?? false)) return;
 133
 134    if (!isClosed) emit(AccountSuspendedTicketSubmittingState());
 135
 136    final subject = subjectController.text.trim();
 137    final messageDetails = messageController.text.trim();
 138    final combinedMessage = subject.isNotEmpty
 139        ? '$subject\n$messageDetails'
 140        : messageDetails;
 141
 142    final result = await ApiService.submitContactRequest(
 143      name: (name != null && name.isNotEmpty) ? name : 'مستخدم معلق',
 144      email: (email != null && email.isNotEmpty) ? email : 'suspended@user.com',
 145      phone: phone,
 146      type: selectedType,
 147      message: combinedMessage,
 148    );
 149
 150    if (isClosed) return;
 151
 152    result.fold(
 153      (error) {
 154        if (!isClosed) emit(AccountSuspendedTicketErrorState(message: error));
 155      },
 156      (_) {
 157        messageController.clear();
 158        if (!isClosed) {
 159          emit(
 160            AccountSuspendedTicketSuccessState(
 161              message: appTranslation().get('account_suspended_ticket_sent_success'),
 162            ),
 163          );
 164        }
 165      },
 166    );
 167  }
 168
 169  Future<void> launchWhatsApp(String phone) async {
 170    final cleanPhone = phone.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '');
 171    final formattedPhone = cleanPhone.startsWith('0')
 172        ? '966${cleanPhone.substring(1)}'
 173        : cleanPhone;
 174    final uri = Uri.parse('https://wa.me/$formattedPhone');
 175    if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
 176      await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
 177    }
 178  }
 179
 180  Future<void> launchEmail(String email, {String? subject, String? body}) async {
 181    final defaultSubject = 'طلب مراجعة وفك تعليق الحساب';
 182    final uri = Uri(
 183      scheme: 'mailto',
 184      path: email,
 185      query: 'subject=${Uri.encodeComponent(subject ?? defaultSubject)}',
 186    );
 187    try {
 188      final launched = await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
 189      if (!launched) {
 190        await launchUrl(uri);
 191      }
 192    } catch (_) {
 193      try {
 194        await launchUrl(uri);
 195      } catch (_) {}
 196    }
 197  }
 198
 199  Future<void> launchPhone(String phone) async {
 200    final uri = Uri(scheme: 'tel', path: phone);
 201    if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
 202      await launchUrl(uri);
 203    }
 204  }
 205
 206  @override
 207  Future<void> close() {
 208    subjectController.dispose();
 209    messageController.dispose();
 210    return super.close();
 211  }
 212}

  15class AccountSuspendedScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  16  final String? email;
  17  final String? password;
  18  final String? name;
  19  final String? phone;
  20
  21  const AccountSuspendedScreen({
  22    super.key,
  23    this.email,
  24    this.password,
  25    this.name,
  26    this.phone,
  27  });
  28
  29  @override
  30  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  31    return BlocProvider(
  32      create: (_) => AccountSuspendedCubit()..loadContactTypes(),
  33      child: BlocListener<AccountSuspendedCubit, AccountSuspendedState>(
  34        listener: _onStateChanged,
  35        child: Scaffold(
  36          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.background,
  37          appBar: AppBar(
  38            backgroundColor: ColorsManager.background,
  39            elevation: 0,
  40            leading: IconButton(
  41              icon: Icon(
  42                Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded,
  43                color: ColorsManager.textPrimary,
  44                size: 20,
  45              ),
  46              onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
  47            ),
  48          ),
  49          body: SafeArea(
  50            child: SingleChildScrollView(
  51              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 12),
  52              child: Column(
  53                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
  54                children: [
  55                  SuspendedNoticeCardWidget(
  56                    email: email,
  57                    password: password,
  58                  ),
  59                  verticalSpace16,
  60                  const SuspendedWhatsappCardWidget(),
  61                  verticalSpace16,
  62                  const SuspendedEmailCardWidget(),
  63                  verticalSpace16,
  64                  const SuspendedWorkingHoursCardWidget(),
  65                  verticalSpace16,
  66                  SuspendedTicketFormCardWidget(
  67                    email: email,
  68                    name: name,
  69                    phone: phone,
  70                  ),
  71                  verticalSpace32,
  72                ],
  73              ),
  74            ),
  75          ),
  76        ),
  77      ),
  78    );
  79  }
  80
  81  void _onStateChanged(BuildContext context, AccountSuspendedState state) {
  82    if (state is AccountSuspendedActiveState) {
  83      context.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(Routes.home, (route) => false);
  84    } else if (state is AccountSuspendedStillSuspendedState) {
  85      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  86        SnackBar(
  87          content: Text(state.message),
  88          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  89        ),
  90      );
  91    } else if (state is AccountSuspendedTicketSuccessState) {
  92      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  93        SnackBar(
  94          content: Text(state.message),
  95          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.successColor,
  96        ),
  97      );
  98    } else if (state is AccountSuspendedTicketErrorState) {
  99      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 100        SnackBar(
 101          content: Text(state.message),
 102          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 103        ),
 104      );
 105    }
 106  }
 107}

   7
   8class SuspendedTicketTypeDropdownWidget extends StatelessWidget {
   9  const SuspendedTicketTypeDropdownWidget({super.key});
  10
  11  @override
  12  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  13    return BlocBuilder<AccountSuspendedCubit, AccountSuspendedState>(
  14      buildWhen: (previous, current) =>
  15          current is AccountSuspendedTypesLoadedState ||
  16          current is AccountSuspendedTypeSelectedState,
  17      builder: (context, state) {
  18        final cubit = AccountSuspendedCubit.get(context);
  19
  20        final items = cubit.contactTypes.map<DropdownMenuItem<String>>((type) {
  21          final val = (type is Map ? type['value'] : type.toString()).toString();
  22          final lbl = (type is Map ? type['label'] : type.toString()).toString();
  23          return DropdownMenuItem<String>(
  24            value: val,
  25            child: Text(
  26              lbl,
  27              style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
  28                color: ColorsManager.textPrimary,
  29              ),
  30            ),
  31          );
  32        }).toList();
  33
  34        final isValidSelection =
  35            cubit.contactTypes.any((t) => (t is Map ? t['value'] : t.toString()).toString() == cubit.selectedType);
  36        final value = isValidSelection ? cubit.selectedType : (items.isNotEmpty ? items.first.value : null);
  37
  38        return Container(
  39          decoration: BoxDecoration(
  40            color: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
  41            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  42            border: Border.all(
  43              color: ColorsManager.borderColor,
  44            ),
  45          ),
  46          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 4),
  47          child: DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
  48            child: DropdownButton<String>(
  49              isExpanded: true,
  50              value: value,
  51              icon: const Icon(
  52                Icons.keyboard_arrow_down_rounded,
  53                color: ColorsManager.textSecondaryDark,
  54              ),
  55              dropdownColor: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
  56              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
  57              items: items,
  58              onChanged: (newVal) {
  59                if (newVal != null) {
  60                  cubit.selectType(newVal);
  61                }
  62              },
  63            ),
  64          ),
  65        );
  66      },
  67    );
  68  }
  69}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

   5
   6class AdminContactCubit extends Cubit<AdminContactState> {
   7  AdminContactCubit() : super(AdminContactInitial());
   8
   9  static AdminContactCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  10
  11  Map<String, dynamic>? stats;
  12  List<dynamic> tickets = [];
  13
  14  Future<void> getStats() async {
  15    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactStatsLoading());
  16
  17    final result = await ApiService.getAdminContactStats();
  18    if (isClosed) return;
  19    result.fold(
  20      (error) {
  21        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactStatsError(error));
  22      },
  23      (data) {
  24        stats = data;
  25        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactStatsLoaded(data));
  26      },
  27    );
  28  }
  29
  30  Future<void> getTickets({String? status, String? type, String? search}) async {
  31    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketsLoading());
  32
  33    final result = await ApiService.getAdminContactTickets(
  34      status: status,
  35      type: type,
  36      search: search,
  37    );
  38    if (isClosed) return;
  39    
  40    result.fold(
  41      (error) {
  42        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketsError(error));
  43      },
  44      (data) {
  45        tickets = data['data'] ?? [];
  46        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketsLoaded(tickets));
  47      },
  48    );
  49  }
  50
  51  Map<String, dynamic>? currentTicket;
  52
  53  Future<void> getTicketDetails(int id) async {
  54    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketDetailsLoading());
  55
  56    final result = await ApiService.getAdminContactTicketDetails(id: id);
  57    if (isClosed) return;
  58    result.fold(
  59      (error) {
  60        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketDetailsError(error));
  61      },
  62      (data) {
  63        currentTicket = data;
  64        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketDetailsLoaded(data));
  65      },
  66    );
  67  }
  68
  69  Future<void> updateTicket({required int id, String? status, String? adminNotes}) async {
  70    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketUpdateLoading());
  71
  72    final result = await ApiService.updateAdminContactTicket(
  73      id: id,
  74      status: status,
  75      adminNotes: adminNotes,
  76    );
  77    if (isClosed) return;
  78
  79    result.fold(
  80      (error) {
  81        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketUpdateError(error));
  82      },
  83      (data) {
  84        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketUpdateSuccess(data['message'] ?? 'تم التحديث بنجاح'));
  85        getTicketDetails(id);
  86      },
  87    );
  88  }
  89
  90  Future<void> replyToTicket({required int id, required String body}) async {
  91    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketReplyLoading());
  92
  93    final result = await ApiService.replyAdminContactTicket(
  94      id: id,
  95      body: body,
  96    );
  97    if (isClosed) return;
  98
  99    result.fold(
 100      (error) {
 101        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketReplyError(error));
 102      },
 103      (data) {
 104        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketReplySuccess(data['message'] ?? 'تم إرسال الرد بنجاح'));
 105        getTicketDetails(id);
 106      },
 107    );
 108  }
 109
 110  Future<void> deleteTicket(int id) async {
 111    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketDeleteLoading());
 112
 113    final result = await ApiService.deleteAdminContactTicket(id: id);
 114    if (isClosed) return;
 115    
 116    result.fold(
 117      (error) {
 118        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketDeleteError(error));
 119      },
 120      (_) {
 121        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminContactTicketDeleteSuccess());
 122      },
 123    );
 124  }
 125}

  45          elevation: 0,
  46          leading: IconButton(
  47            icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back, color: ColorsManager.mainText),
  48            onPressed: () => context.pop(true), // pass true to refresh list if needed
  49          ),

  60            } else if (state is AdminContactTicketUpdateError) {

  63              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(state.message, style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.white)), backgroundColor: Colors.green));
  64            } else if (state is AdminContactTicketReplyError) {
  65              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(state.error, style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.white)), backgroundColor: Colors.red));
  66            } else if (state is AdminContactTicketDeleteSuccess) {
  67              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(appTranslation().get('ticket_deleted'), style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.white)), backgroundColor: Colors.green));
  68              context.pop(true);

  71            }
  72          },
  73          buildWhen: (previous, current) => current is AdminContactTicketDetailsLoading || current is AdminContactTicketDetailsLoaded || current is AdminContactTicketDetailsError,
  74          builder: (context, state) {
  75            if (state is AdminContactTicketDetailsLoading || AdminContactCubit.get(context).currentTicket == null) {
  76              return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
  77            } else if (state is AdminContactTicketDetailsError) {

  81            final ticket = AdminContactCubit.get(context).currentTicket!;

  18      buildWhen: (previous, current) => current is AdminContactTicketsLoading || current is AdminContactTicketsLoaded || current is AdminContactTicketsError,

 342  String _formatDate(String? dateStr) {
 343    if (dateStr == null) return '';
 344    final dt = DateTime.tryParse(dateStr);
 345    if (dt == null) return '';
 346    return '${dt.day} ${_getMonthName(dt.month)} ${dt.year}';
 347  }
 348
 349  String _formatDateWithTime(String? dateStr) {
 350    if (dateStr == null) return '';
 351    final dt = DateTime.tryParse(dateStr);
 352    if (dt == null) return '';
 353    final amPm = dt.hour >= 12 ? 'م' : 'ص';
 354    final hour = dt.hour > 12 ? dt.hour - 12 : (dt.hour == 0 ? 12 : dt.hour);
 355    final minute = dt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
 356    return '${dt.day} ${_getMonthName(dt.month)} ${dt.year} $hour:$minute $amPm';
 357  }
 358
 359  String _getMonthName(int month) {
 360    const months = [
 361      '', 'يناير', 'فبراير', 'مارس', 'أبريل', 'مايو', 'يونيو',
 362      'يوليو', 'أغسطس', 'سبتمبر', 'أكتوبر', 'نوفمبر', 'ديسمبر'
 363    ];
 364    if (month >= 1 && month <= 12) return months[month];
 365    return month.toString();
 366  }
 367}

   1import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_endpoints.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/dio_helper.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/admin/exams/data/models/admin_exam_models.dart';
   4
   5abstract class AdminExamRemoteDataSource {
   6  Future<AdminQuestionPaginationModel> getPendingQuestions({
   7    int page = 1,
   8    String? type,
   9    String? difficulty,
  10    int? lessonId,
  11  });
  12
  13  Future<AdminQuestionModel> reviewQuestion({
  14    required int questionId,
  15    required String decision,
  16    String? rejectionReason,
  17  });
  18}
  19
  20class AdminExamRemoteDataSourceImpl implements AdminExamRemoteDataSource {
  21  AdminExamRemoteDataSourceImpl();
  22
  23  @override
  24  Future<AdminQuestionPaginationModel> getPendingQuestions({
  25    int page = 1,
  26    String? type,
  27    String? difficulty,
  28    int? lessonId,
  29  }) async {
  30    final queryParameters = <String, dynamic>{
  31      'page': page,
  32    };
  33    if (type != null) queryParameters['type'] = type;
  34    if (difficulty != null) queryParameters['difficulty'] = difficulty;
  35    if (lessonId != null) queryParameters['lesson_id'] = lessonId;
  36
  37    final response = await DioHelper.getData(
  38      url: adminPendingQuestionsApi,
  39      query: queryParameters,
  40    );
  41
  42    return response.fold(
  43      (error) => throw Exception(error),
  44      (data) => AdminQuestionPaginationModel.fromJson(data.data),
  45    );
  46  }
  47
  48  @override
  49  Future<AdminQuestionModel> reviewQuestion({
  50    required int questionId,
  51    required String decision,
  52    String? rejectionReason,
  53  }) async {
  54    final response = await DioHelper.patchData(
  55      url: adminReviewQuestionApi(questionId),
  56      data: {
  57        'decision': decision,
  58        if (rejectionReason != null) 'rejection_reason': rejectionReason,
  59      },
  60    );
  61
  62    return response.fold(
  63      (error) => throw Exception(error),
  64      (data) => AdminQuestionModel.fromJson(data.data['question']),
  65    );
  66  }
  67}

  37  factory AdminQuestionModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  38    final type = json['type'] as String? ?? '';
  39    dynamic parsedOptions;
  40

  42      parsedOptions = MatchingOptionsModel.fromJson(json['options'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {});
  43    } else if (type == 'mcq') {
  44      parsedOptions = (json['options'] as List<dynamic>?)?.map((e) => e.toString()).toList() ?? [];
  45    } else {
  46      parsedOptions = json['options'];
  47    }
  48
  49    return AdminQuestionModel(
  50      id: json['id'] as int? ?? 0,
  51      lessonId: json['lesson_id'] as int? ?? 0,
  52      type: type,
  53      questionText: json['question_text'] as String? ?? '',
  54      options: parsedOptions,
  55      correctAnswer: json['correct_answer'] as String? ?? '',
  56      source: json['source'] as String? ?? '',
  57      usageCount: json['usage_count'] as int? ?? 0,
  58      questionOrder: json['question_order'] as int? ?? 0,
  59      points: (json['points'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
  60      reviewStatus: json['review_status'] as String? ?? '',
  61      difficulty: json['difficulty'] as String? ?? '',
  62      creator: json['creator'] != null ? CreatorModel.fromJson(json['creator'] as Map<String, dynamic>) : null,
  63    );

   1import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/features/admin/exams/domain/entities/admin_exam_entities.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/admin/exams/domain/usecases/get_pending_questions_usecase.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/features/admin/exams/domain/usecases/review_question_usecase.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/admin/exams/presentation/cubit/admin_exams_state.dart';
   6
   7class AdminExamsCubit extends Cubit<AdminExamsState> {
   8  final GetPendingQuestionsUseCase getPendingQuestionsUseCase;
   9  final ReviewQuestionUseCase reviewQuestionUseCase;
  10
  11  AdminExamsCubit({
  12    required this.getPendingQuestionsUseCase,
  13    required this.reviewQuestionUseCase,
  14  }) : super(AdminExamsInitial());
  15
  16  AdminQuestionPaginationEntity? currentPagination;
  17  final List<AdminQuestionEntity> _questions = [];
  18
  19  Future<void> fetchPendingQuestions({
  20    int page = 1,
  21    String? type,
  22    String? difficulty,
  23    int? lessonId,
  24  }) async {
  25    if (page == 1) {
  26      if (!isClosed) emit(AdminExamsLoading());
  27      _questions.clear();
  28      currentPagination = null;
  29    }
  30
  31    final result = await getPendingQuestionsUseCase(
  32      page: page,
  33      type: type,
  34      difficulty: difficulty,
  35      lessonId: lessonId,
  36    );
  37    if (isClosed) return;
  38
  39    result.fold(
  40      (failure) {
  41        if (page == 1) {
  42          if (!isClosed) emit(AdminExamsError(failure.message));
  43        }
  44      },
  45      (pagination) {
  46        currentPagination = pagination;
  47        if (page == 1) {
  48          _questions.addAll(pagination.data);
  49        } else {
  50          _questions.addAll(pagination.data);
  51        }
  52        
  53        // We replace the pagination data with our accumulated list so the UI gets all items
  54        final updatedPagination = AdminQuestionPaginationEntity(
  55          currentPage: pagination.currentPage,
  56          lastPage: pagination.lastPage,
  57          perPage: pagination.perPage,
  58          total: pagination.total,
  59          data: List.from(_questions),
  60        );
  61        currentPagination = updatedPagination;
  62        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminExamsLoaded(updatedPagination));
  63      },
  64    );
  65  }
  66
  67  Future<void> reviewQuestion(int questionId, String decision, [String? rejectionReason]) async {
  68    final currentState = state;
  69    
  70    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminExamReviewLoading(questionId));
  71
  72    final result = await reviewQuestionUseCase(
  73      questionId: questionId,
  74      decision: decision,
  75      rejectionReason: rejectionReason,
  76    );
  77    if (isClosed) return;
  78
  79    result.fold(
  80      (failure) {
  81        if (!isClosed) {
  82          emit(AdminExamReviewError(failure.message));
  83          if (currentState is AdminExamsLoaded) {
  84            emit(currentState);
  85          } else if (currentPagination != null) {
  86            final updatedPagination = AdminQuestionPaginationEntity(
  87              currentPage: currentPagination!.currentPage,
  88              lastPage: currentPagination!.lastPage,
  89              perPage: currentPagination!.perPage,
  90              total: currentPagination!.total,
  91              data: List.from(_questions),
  92            );
  93            currentPagination = updatedPagination;
  94            emit(AdminExamsLoaded(updatedPagination));
  95          }
  96        }
  97      },
  98      (updatedQuestion) {
  99        final index = _questions.indexWhere((q) => q.id == questionId);
 100        if (index != -1) {
 101          _questions[index] = updatedQuestion;
 102        }
 103        if (!isClosed) {
 104          emit(AdminExamReviewSuccess(updatedQuestion));
 105          
 106          if (currentPagination != null) {
 107            final updatedPagination = AdminQuestionPaginationEntity(
 108              currentPage: currentPagination!.currentPage,
 109              lastPage: currentPagination!.lastPage,
 110              perPage: currentPagination!.perPage,
 111              total: currentPagination!.total,
 112              data: List.from(_questions),
 113            );
 114            currentPagination = updatedPagination;
 115            emit(AdminExamsLoaded(updatedPagination));
 116          }
 117        }
 118      },
 119    );
 120  }
 121}

 297  Widget _buildOptionsView(AdminQuestionEntity question) {
 298    if (question.type == 'mcq' && question.options is List) {
 299      final options = question.options as List;
 300      return Column(
 301        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 302        children: options.map((option) {
 303          return Padding(
 304            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8.0),
 305            child: Row(
 306              children: [
 307                const Icon(Icons.radio_button_unchecked, size: 16, color: Colors.grey),
 308                horizontalSpace8,
 309                Expanded(
 310                  child: Text(
 311                    option.toString(),
 312                    style: TextStylesManager.regular14,
 313                  ),
 314                ),
 315              ],
 316            ),
 317          );
 318        }).toList(),
 319      );
 320    } else if (question.type == 'matching' && question.options != null) {
 321      try {
 322        final columnA = (question.options.columnA as List);
 323        final columnB = (question.options.columnB as List);
 324        return Row(
 325          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 326          children: [
 327            Expanded(
 328              child: Column(
 329                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 330                children: columnA.map((e) => Text("• $e")).toList(),
 331              ),
 332            ),
 333            horizontalSpace16,
 334            Expanded(
 335              child: Column(
 336                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 337                children: columnB.map((e) => Text("• $e")).toList(),
 338              ),
 339            ),
 340          ],
 341        );
 342      } catch (e) {
 343        return const SizedBox();
 344      }
 345    }
 346    return const SizedBox();
 347  }

 349  String _getQuestionTypeName(String type) {
 350    switch (type.toLowerCase()) {
 351      case 'mcq': return 'اختيار من متعدد';
 352      case 'matching': return 'مزاوجة';
 353      case 'true_false': return 'صح وخطأ';
 354      case 'fill_blank':
 355      case 'fill_in_the_blank': return 'أكمل الفراغ';
 356      default: return type;
 357    }
 358  }
 359
 360  String _getDifficultyName(String difficulty) {
 361    switch (difficulty.toLowerCase()) {
 362      case 'easy': return 'سهل';
 363      case 'medium': return 'متوسط';
 364      case 'hard': return 'صعب';
 365      default: return difficulty;
 366    }
 367  }

   1import 'package:dartz/dartz.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_endpoints.dart';

   4import 'package:moean/features/payment/data/models/payment_model.dart';
   5
   6class AdminPaymentsRepository {
   7  Future<Either<String, Map<String, dynamic>>> getPayments({
   8    String? filter,
   9    String? search,
  10    int? page,
  11  }) async {
  12    try {
  13      final Map<String, dynamic> queryParameters = {};
  14      if (filter != null && filter.isNotEmpty && filter != 'all') {
  15        queryParameters['filter'] = filter;
  16      }
  17      if (search != null && search.isNotEmpty) {
  18        queryParameters['search'] = search;
  19      }
  20      if (page != null) {
  21        queryParameters['page'] = page;
  22      }
  23
  24      final responseEither = await DioHelper.getData(
  25        url: adminPaymentsApi,
  26        query: queryParameters,
  27      );
  28
  29      return responseEither.fold(
  30        (error) => Left(error),
  31        (response) {
  32          final List<dynamic> dataList = response.data['data'];
  33          final List<PaymentModel> payments = dataList
  34              .map((json) => PaymentModel.fromJson(json as Map<String, dynamic>))
  35              .toList();
  36
  37          final meta = response.data['meta'];
  38          final int lastPage = meta != null ? meta['last_page'] as int : 1;
  39
  40          return Right({
  41            'payments': payments,
  42            'lastPage': lastPage,
  43          });
  44        },
  45      );
  46    } catch (e) {
  47      return Left(e.toString());
  48    }
  49  }
  50
  51  Future<Either<String, String>> approvePayment(int paymentId) async {
  52    try {
  53      final responseEither = await DioHelper.postData(
  54        url: '$adminPaymentsApi/$paymentId/approve',
  55        data: {},
  56      );
  57      return responseEither.fold(
  58        (error) => Left(error),
  59        (response) => Right(response.data['message'] ?? 'Payment approved successfully'),
  60      );
  61    } catch (e) {
  62      return Left(e.toString());
  63    }
  64  }
  65
  66  Future<Either<String, String>> rejectPayment(int paymentId) async {
  67    try {
  68      final responseEither = await DioHelper.postData(
  69        url: '$adminPaymentsApi/$paymentId/reject',
  70        data: {},
  71      );
  72      return responseEither.fold(
  73        (error) => Left(error),
  74        (response) => Right(response.data['message'] ?? 'Payment rejected successfully'),
  75      );
  76    } catch (e) {
  77      return Left(e.toString());
  78    }
  79  }
  80}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/admin/payments/data/repositories/admin_payments_repository.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/features/admin/payments/presentation/cubit/admin_payments_state.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/payment/data/models/payment_model.dart';
   6
   7class AdminPaymentsCubit extends Cubit<AdminPaymentsState> {
   8  final AdminPaymentsRepository repository;
   9
  10  AdminPaymentsCubit(this.repository) : super(AdminPaymentsInitial());
  11
  12  static AdminPaymentsCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of<AdminPaymentsCubit>(context);
  13
  14  List<PaymentModel> paymentsList = [];
  15  int currentPage = 1;
  16  int lastPage = 1;
  17  String currentFilter = 'all';
  18  String currentSearch = '';
  19  bool hasMoreData = true;
  20
  21  Future<void> getPayments({
  22    bool loadMore = false,
  23    String? filter,
  24    String? search,
  25  }) async {
  26    if (loadMore) {
  27      if (!hasMoreData) return;
  28      currentPage++;
  29    } else {
  30      currentPage = 1;
  31      paymentsList.clear();
  32      hasMoreData = true;
  33      if (filter != null) currentFilter = filter;
  34      if (search != null) currentSearch = search;
  35    }
  36
  37    if (!isClosed) emit(GetAdminPaymentsLoadingState());
  38
  39    final result = await repository.getPayments(
  40      page: currentPage,
  41      filter: currentFilter,
  42      search: currentSearch,
  43    );
  44    if (isClosed) return;
  45
  46    result.fold(
  47      (failureMessage) {
  48        if (!isClosed) emit(GetAdminPaymentsErrorState(failureMessage));
  49      },
  50      (data) {
  51        final List<PaymentModel> newPayments = data['payments'];
  52        lastPage = data['lastPage'];
  53        
  54        if (newPayments.isEmpty || currentPage >= lastPage) {
  55          hasMoreData = false;
  56        }
  57
  58        if (loadMore) {
  59          paymentsList.addAll(newPayments);
  60        } else {
  61          paymentsList = newPayments;
  62        }
  63
  64        if (!isClosed) emit(GetAdminPaymentsSuccessState());
  65      },
  66    );
  67  }
  68
  69  void approvePayment(int paymentId) async {
  70    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPaymentActionLoadingState());
  71    
  72    final result = await repository.approvePayment(paymentId);
  73    if (isClosed) return;
  74    
  75    result.fold(
  76      (failureMessage) {
  77        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPaymentActionErrorState(failureMessage));
  78      },
  79      (message) {
  80        // Find and update the payment status locally
  81        final index = paymentsList.indexWhere((p) => p.id == paymentId);
  82        if (index != -1) {
  83          final p = paymentsList[index];
  84          paymentsList[index] = PaymentModel(
  85            id: p.id,
  86            orderId: p.orderId,
  87            paymentMethod: p.paymentMethod,
  88            amount: p.amount,
  89            currency: p.currency,
  90            status: 'paid',
  91            gateway: p.gateway,
  92            moyasarPaymentId: p.moyasarPaymentId,
  93            paidAt: p.paidAt,
  94            verifiedAt: p.verifiedAt,
  95            receiptPath: p.receiptPath,
  96            receiptUrl: p.receiptUrl,
  97            createdAt: p.createdAt,
  98            order: p.order,
  99            user: p.user,
 100          );
 101        }
 102        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPaymentActionSuccessState(message));
 103      },
 104    );
 105  }
 106
 107  void rejectPayment(int paymentId) async {
 108    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPaymentActionLoadingState());
 109    
 110    final result = await repository.rejectPayment(paymentId);
 111    if (isClosed) return;
 112    
 113    result.fold(
 114      (failureMessage) {
 115        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPaymentActionErrorState(failureMessage));
 116      },
 117      (message) {
 118        // Find and update the payment status locally
 119        final index = paymentsList.indexWhere((p) => p.id == paymentId);
 120        if (index != -1) {
 121          final p = paymentsList[index];
 122          paymentsList[index] = PaymentModel(
 123            id: p.id,
 124            orderId: p.orderId,
 125            paymentMethod: p.paymentMethod,
 126            amount: p.amount,
 127            currency: p.currency,
 128            status: 'rejected',
 129            gateway: p.gateway,
 130            moyasarPaymentId: p.moyasarPaymentId,
 131            paidAt: p.paidAt,
 132            verifiedAt: p.verifiedAt,
 133            receiptPath: p.receiptPath,
 134            receiptUrl: p.receiptUrl,
 135            createdAt: p.createdAt,
 136            order: p.order,
 137            user: p.user,
 138          );
 139        }
 140        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPaymentActionSuccessState(message));
 141      },
 142    );
 143  }
 144}

   9class AdminPaymentsTableWidget extends StatelessWidget {

  13  const AdminPaymentsTableWidget({

  15    required this.payments,

  17  });
  18
  19  Color _getStatusColor(String status) {
  20    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
  21      case 'paid':
  22        return Colors.green;
  23      case 'failed':
  24      case 'rejected':
  25      case 'cancelled':
  26        return Colors.red;
  27      case 'pending':
  28      case 'processing':
  29      case 'waiting_verification':
  30        return Colors.orange;
  31      default:
  32        return Colors.grey;
  33    }
  34  }
  35
  36  String _getMethodText(String method) {
  37    if (method == 'manual_bank_transfer' || method == 'manual') {
  38      return appTranslation().get('payment_method_manual');
  39    } else if (method == 'moyasar') {
  40      return 'Moyasar';
  41    } else if (method == 'myfatoorah') {
  42      return 'MyFatoorah';
  43    }
  44    return method.isEmpty ? '-' : method;
  45  }

   1import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/constants.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/admin/promo/data/models/admin_promo_models.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/features/admin/promo/presentation/cubit/admin_promo_state.dart';
   7
   8class AdminPromoCubit extends Cubit<AdminPromoState> {
   9  AdminPromoCubit() : super(AdminPromoInitial());
  10
  11  static AdminPromoCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  12
  13  AdminReferralStatsModel? stats;
  14  List<AdminPromoCodeModel> promoCodes = [];
  15
  16  Future<void> loadAll() async {
  17    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoLoading());
  18    final statsResult = await ApiService.getAdminReferralStats();
  19    final promoResult = await ApiService.getAdminPromoCodes();
  20    if (isClosed) return;
  21
  22    statsResult.fold(
  23      (error) {
  24        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoError(error));
  25      },
  26      (statsData) {
  27        promoResult.fold(
  28          (error) {
  29            if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoError(error));
  30          },
  31          (promoData) {
  32            stats = AdminReferralStatsModel.fromJson(statsData);
  33            final list = promoData['data'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];
  34            promoCodes = list
  35                .map((e) => AdminPromoCodeModel.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
  36                .toList();
  37            if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoLoaded(stats: stats!, promoCodes: promoCodes));
  38          },
  39        );
  40      },
  41    );
  42  }
  43
  44  Future<void> createPromoCode(Map<String, dynamic> data) async {
  45    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoCreating());
  46    final result = await ApiService.createAdminPromoCode(data);
  47    if (isClosed) return;
  48    result.fold(
  49      (error) {
  50        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoActionError(error));
  51      },
  52      (_) {
  53        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoActionSuccess(appTranslation().get('admin_promo_success_create')));
  54        loadAll();
  55      },
  56    );
  57  }
  58
  59  Future<void> togglePromoCode(AdminPromoCodeModel promo) async {
  60    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoActionLoading());
  61    final result = promo.isActive
  62        ? await ApiService.deactivateAdminPromoCode(promo.id)
  63        : await ApiService.activateAdminPromoCode(promo.id);
  64    if (isClosed) return;
  65
  66    result.fold(
  67      (error) {
  68        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoActionError(error));
  69      },
  70      (_) {
  71        final msg = promo.isActive
  72            ? appTranslation().get('admin_promo_success_deactivate')
  73            : appTranslation().get('admin_promo_success_activate');
  74        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoActionSuccess(msg));
  75        loadAll();
  76      },
  77    );
  78  }
  79
  80  Future<void> deletePromoCode(int id) async {
  81    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoActionLoading());
  82    final result = await ApiService.deleteAdminPromoCode(id);
  83    if (isClosed) return;
  84    result.fold(
  85      (error) {
  86        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoActionError(error));
  87      },
  88      (_) {
  89        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminPromoActionSuccess(appTranslation().get('admin_promo_success_delete')));
  90        loadAll();
  91      },
  92    );
  93  }
  94}

  58                ),

  60            ],
  61          ),
  62          actions: [

  64            IconButton(

  66              onPressed: () => AdminPromoCubit.get(context).loadAll(),
  67            ),
  68            // Back home
  69            Padding(
  70              padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 12.0),
  71              child: ElevatedButton.icon(
  72                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(

  74                  foregroundColor: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  75                  elevation: 0,
  76                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
  77                  minimumSize: Size.zero,
  78                  tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
  79                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
  80                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
  81                  ),
  82                ),
  83                onPressed: () => context.pop(),
  84                icon: const Icon(Icons.home_rounded, size: 18),
  85                label: Text(
  86                  appTranslation().get('home'),
  87                  style: TextStylesManager.medium14.copyWith(
  88                    color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  89                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
  90                  ),
  91                ),
  92              ),
  93            ),
  94          ],
  95        ),
  96        floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
  97          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  98          onPressed: () => _showCreateDialog(context),
  99          icon: const Icon(Icons.add_rounded, color: Colors.white),
 100          label: Text(
 101            appTranslation().get('admin_promo_create_btn'),
 102            style:
 103                TextStylesManager.medium14.copyWith(color: Colors.white),
 104          ),
 105        ),
 106        body: SafeArea(
 107          child: BlocConsumer<AdminPromoCubit, AdminPromoState>(
 108            listenWhen: (_, s) =>
 109                s is AdminPromoActionSuccess || s is AdminPromoActionError,
 110            listener: (context, state) {
 111              if (state is AdminPromoActionSuccess) {
 112                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
 113                  content: Text(state.message, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
 114                  backgroundColor: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 115                  behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
 116                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
 117                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
 118                ));
 119                Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true)
 120                    .popUntil((_) => true);
 121              } else if (state is AdminPromoActionError) {
 122                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
 123                  content: Text(state.error, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
 124                  backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 125                  behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
 126                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
 127                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
 128                ));
 129              }
 130            },
 131            buildWhen: (_, s) =>
 132                s is AdminPromoLoading ||
 133                s is AdminPromoLoaded ||
 134                s is AdminPromoError ||
 135                s is AdminPromoActionLoading,
 136            builder: (context, state) {
 137              final cubit = AdminPromoCubit.get(context);
 138              return ConditionalBuilder(
 139                loadingState: state is AdminPromoLoading || state is AdminPromoActionLoading,
 140                errorState: state is AdminPromoError,
 141                emptyState: false,
 142                errorBuilder: (_) => Center(
 143                  child: Column(
 144                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 145                    children: [
 146                      Icon(Icons.cloud_off_outlined,
 147                          size: 48,
 148                          color: ColorsManager.textSecondary
 149                              .withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
 150                      verticalSpace12,
 151                      Text((state as AdminPromoError).error,
 152                          style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
 153                              color: ColorsManager.textSecondary),
 154                          textAlign: TextAlign.center),
 155                      verticalSpace16,
 156                      TextButton.icon(
 157                        onPressed: () => cubit.loadAll(),
 158                        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
 159                        label: Text(appTranslation().get('admin_promo_refresh')),
 160                      ),
 161                    ],
 162                  ),
 163                ),
 164                successBuilder: (_) => AdminPromoBodyWidget(
 165                  stats: cubit.stats!,
 166                  promoCodes: cubit.promoCodes,
 167                ),
 168              );
 169            },
 170          ),
 171        ),
 172      ),
 173    );
 174  }

  11class AdminPromoCreateDialog extends StatefulWidget {

  13
  14  @override
  15  State<AdminPromoCreateDialog> createState() => _AdminPromoCreateDialogState();
  16}
  17
  18class _AdminPromoCreateDialogState extends State<AdminPromoCreateDialog> {
  19  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  20  late final TextEditingController _codeCtrl;
  21  late final TextEditingController _nameCtrl;
  22  late final TextEditingController _valueCtrl;
  23  late final TextEditingController _maxUseCtrl;
  24  String _discountType = 'percentage';
  25  String _userTarget = 'all';
  26
  27  @override
  28  void initState() {
  29    super.initState();
  30    _codeCtrl = TextEditingController();
  31    _nameCtrl = TextEditingController();
  32    _valueCtrl = TextEditingController();
  33    _maxUseCtrl = TextEditingController();
  34  }
  35
  36  @override
  37  void dispose() {
  38    _codeCtrl.dispose();
  39    _nameCtrl.dispose();
  40    _valueCtrl.dispose();
  41    _maxUseCtrl.dispose();
  42    super.dispose();
  43  }
  44
  45  void _submit(BuildContext context) {
  46    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
  47    AdminPromoCubit.get(context).createPromoCode({
  48      'code': _codeCtrl.text.trim().toUpperCase(),
  49      'name': _nameCtrl.text.trim(),
  50      'discount_type': _discountType,
  51      'discount_value': double.tryParse(_valueCtrl.text) ?? 0,
  52      'max_redemptions': int.tryParse(_maxUseCtrl.text),
  53      'max_redemptions_per_user': 1,
  54      'is_active': true,
  55      'user_target': _userTarget,
  56    });
  57  }
  58
  59  Widget _buildDropdown({
  60    required String label,
  61    required String value,
  62    required List<DropdownMenuItem<String>> items,
  63    required void Function(String?) onChanged,
  64  }) {
  65    return Column(
  66      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  67      children: [
  68        if (label.isNotEmpty) ...[
  69          Text(
  70            label,
  71            style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
  72              color: ColorsManager.textSecondary,
  73            ),
  74          ),
  75          verticalSpace4,
  76        ],
  77        DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
  78          isExpanded: true,
  79          initialValue: value,
  80          icon: const Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_down_rounded),
  81          decoration: InputDecoration(
  82            filled: true,
  83            fillColor: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
  84            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 16),
  85            border: OutlineInputBorder(
  86              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  87              borderSide: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
  88            ),
  89            enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
  90              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  91              borderSide: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
  92            ),
  93            focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
  94              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  95              borderSide: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.themeActiveAccent),
  96            ),
  97          ),
  98          items: items,
  99          onChanged: onChanged,
 100        ),
 101      ],
 102    );
 103  }
 104
 105  @override
 106  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 107    return Directionality(
 108      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
 109      child: Dialog(
 110        backgroundColor: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,

 112        child: SingleChildScrollView(

 119              children: [
 120                // Header
 121                Row(

 125                      appTranslation().get('admin_promo_create_title'),
 126                      style: TextStylesManager.bold18.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.primaryColor),
 127                    ),
 128                    IconButton(
 129                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: Colors.grey),
 130                      onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
 131                    ),
 132                  ],
 133                ),
 134                verticalSpace20,
 135                
 136                // Code
 137                PrimaryTextField(
 138                  controller: _codeCtrl,
 139                  hint: appTranslation().get('admin_promo_form_code_hint'),
 140                  label: 'رمز الكود (Code)',

 143                verticalSpace12,
 144                
 145                // Name
 146                PrimaryTextField(

 148                  hint: 'مثال: خصم العودة للمدارس',

 150                  validator: (v) => (v == null || v.isEmpty) ? 'مطلوب' : null,
 151                ),
 152                verticalSpace12,
 153                
 154                // Type
 155                _buildDropdown(
 156                  label: 'نوع الخصم',
 157                  value: _discountType,
 158                  items: const [
 159                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'percentage', child: Text('نسبة مئوية (%)')),
 160                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'fixed_amount', child: Text('مبلغ ثابت')),
 161                  ],
 162                  onChanged: (val) {
 163                    if (val != null) setState(() => _discountType = val);
 164                  },
 165                ),
 166                verticalSpace12,
 167                
 168                // Value
 169                PrimaryTextField(
 170                  controller: _valueCtrl,
 171                  hint: '15',
 172                  label: 'قيمة الخصم',
 173                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
 174                  validator: (v) => (v == null || v.isEmpty) ? 'مطلوب' : null,
 175                ),
 176                verticalSpace12,
 177
 178                // Target
 179                _buildDropdown(

 184                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'existing_users', child: Text('المستخدمين المشتركين فقط', overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)),
 185                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'new_users', child: Text('المستخدمين الجدد فقط', overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)),
 186                  ],

 192                
 193                // Max Use
 194                PrimaryTextField(

 201
 202                // Action Buttons
 203                BlocBuilder<AdminPromoCubit, AdminPromoState>(
 204                  buildWhen: (_, s) =>

 213                              backgroundColor: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 214                              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
 215                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
 216                              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
 217                            ),
 218                            onPressed: isLoading ? null : () => _submit(context),
 219                            child: isLoading
 220                                ? const SizedBox(
 221                                    width: 20, height: 20,
 222                                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.white, strokeWidth: 2),
 223                                  )
 224                                : Text('حفظ', style: TextStylesManager.bold14),
 225                          ),
 226                        ),
 227                        horizontalSpace12,
 228                        Expanded(
 229                          child: OutlinedButton(
 230                            style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
 231                              foregroundColor: ColorsManager.textPrimary,
 232                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
 233                              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
 234                              side: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
 235                            ),
 236                            onPressed: isLoading ? null : () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
 237                            child: Text('إلغاء', style: TextStylesManager.bold14),
 238                          ),
 239                        ),
 240                      ],
 241                    );
 242                  },
 243                ),
 244              ],
 245            ),
 246          ),
 247        ),

   9class AdminPromoTableRowWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  10  final AdminPromoCodeModel promo;
  11  final VoidCallback onDelete;
  12
  13  const AdminPromoTableRowWidget({
  14    super.key,
  15    required this.promo,
  16    required this.onDelete,
  17  });
  18
  19  String _targetLabel(String target) {
  20    switch (target) {
  21      case 'new_users':
  22        return appTranslation().get('admin_promo_target_new');
  23      case 'existing_users':
  24        return appTranslation().get('admin_promo_target_existing');
  25      default:
  26        return appTranslation().get('admin_promo_target_all');
  27    }
  28  }
  29
  30  String _valueDisplay(AdminPromoCodeModel p) {
  31    final valueStr = p.discountValue.truncateToDouble() == p.discountValue
  32        ? p.discountValue.toInt().toString()
  33        : p.discountValue.toStringAsFixed(2);
  34    return p.discountType == 'percentage'
  35        ? '$valueStr%'
  36        : '$valueStr ر.س';
  37  }
  38
  39  @override
  40  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  41    return Container(
  42      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
  43      decoration: BoxDecoration(
  44        color: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
  45        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
  46        border: Border.all(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
  47      ),
  48      child: Column(
  49        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  50        children: [
  51          // Row 1: Code + Name on start, Status badge + Actions on end
  52          Row(
  53            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
  54            children: [
  55              // Code + Name
  56              Expanded(

  29      if (status != null && status.isNotEmpty) 'status': status,
  30    };

   7class AdminTeachersCubit extends Cubit<AdminTeachersState> {
   8  AdminTeachersCubit() : super(AdminTeachersInitial());
   9
  10  static AdminTeachersCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  11
  12  AdminTeacherPaginationModel? paginationModel;
  13  List<AdminTeacherModel> teachersList = [];
  14  List<AdminTeacherSubscriptionModel> subscriptionsList = [];
  15
  16  String? searchQuery;
  17  String? statusFilter;
  18  int currentPage = 1;
  19  bool isLastPage = false;
  20  int perPage = 20;
  21
  22  TextEditingController searchController = TextEditingController();
  23
  24  void getSubscriptions() async {
  25    final result = await AdminTeachersRepository.getSubscriptions();
  26    if (isClosed) return;
  27    result.fold(
  28      (error) {}, // Handle error if needed
  29      (data) {
  30        subscriptionsList = data;
  31        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminTeacherFilterChangedState()); // Trigger a rebuild to update dialogs
  32      },
  33    );
  34  }
  35
  36  void getTeachers({bool loadMore = false}) async {
  37    if (subscriptionsList.isEmpty) getSubscriptions();
  38    if (loadMore) {
  39      if (isLastPage) return;
  40      currentPage++;
  41    } else {
  42      currentPage = 1;
  43      teachersList.clear();
  44      if (!isClosed) emit(GetTeachersLoadingState());
  45    }
  46
  47    final result = await AdminTeachersRepository.getTeachers(
  48      page: currentPage,
  49      perPage: perPage,
  50      search: searchQuery,
  51      status: statusFilter,
  52    );
  53    if (isClosed) return;
  54
  55    result.fold(
  56      (error) {
  57        if (!isClosed) emit(GetTeachersErrorState(error));
  58      },
  59      (data) {
  60        paginationModel = data;
  61        if (loadMore) {
  62          teachersList.addAll(data.data);
  63        } else {
  64          teachersList = List.from(data.data);
  65        }
  66        isLastPage = data.currentPage >= data.lastPage;
  67        if (!isClosed) emit(GetTeachersSuccessState(data));
  68      },
  69    );
  70  }
  71
  72  void onSearchChanged(String value) {
  73    searchQuery = value.trim();
  74    if (searchQuery!.isEmpty) {
  75      searchQuery = null;
  76    }
  77    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminTeacherFilterChangedState());
  78    getTeachers();
  79  }
  80
  81  void onStatusFilterChanged(String? value) {
  82    statusFilter = value;
  83    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminTeacherFilterChangedState());
  84    getTeachers();
  85  }
  86
  87  Future<void> addTeacher({
  88    required String name,
  89    required String email,
  90    required String phone,
  91    required String password,
  92    required int subscriptionId,
  93  }) async {
  94    if (!isClosed) emit(AdminTeacherActionLoadingState());
  95    final result = await AdminTeachersRepository.createTeacher(
  96      name: name,
  97      email: email,
  98      phone: phone,
  99      password: password,
 100      subscriptionId: subscriptionId,
 101    );
 102    if (isClosed) return;
 103
 104    result.fold(
 105      (error) {
 106        if (!isClosed) emit(AdminTeacherActionErrorState(error));

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/theme/colors.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/theme/text_styles.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/constants.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/spacing.dart';
   7import 'package:moean/features/admin/teachers/presentation/cubit/admin_teachers_cubit.dart';
   8import 'package:moean/features/admin/teachers/presentation/cubit/admin_teachers_state.dart';
   9
  10class AdminStatsCardsWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  11  const AdminStatsCardsWidget({super.key});
  12
  13  @override
  14  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  15    return BlocBuilder<AdminTeachersCubit, AdminTeachersState>(
  16      builder: (context, state) {
  17        final cubit = AdminTeachersCubit.get(context);
  18        final total = cubit.paginationModel?.total ?? 0;
  19        
  20        // Since we don't have a dedicated stats API, we'll calculate from loaded data 
  21        // or display the total for the first card as an example.
  22        final activeCount = cubit.teachersList.where((t) => t.active).length;
  23        final suspendedCount = cubit.teachersList.where((t) => !t.active).length;
  24        final subscribedCount = cubit.teachersList.where((t) => t.subscription?.slug != 'free').length;
  25
  26        return LayoutBuilder(
  27          builder: (context, constraints) {
  28            final isMobile = constraints.maxWidth < 600;
  29            return GridView.count(
  30              crossAxisCount: isMobile ? 2 : 4,
  31              shrinkWrap: true,
  32              physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
  33              crossAxisSpacing: 12,
  34              mainAxisSpacing: 12,
  35              childAspectRatio: isMobile ? 1.8 : 2.5,
  36              children: [
  37                _buildStatCard(
  38                  title: appTranslation().get('admin_total_teachers'),
  39                  count: total,
  40                  icon: Icons.people_outline,
  41                  color: Colors.red,
  42                  bgColor: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
  43                ),
  44                _buildStatCard(
  45                  title: appTranslation().get('admin_active_teachers'),
  46                  count: activeCount,
  47                  icon: Icons.person_outline,
  48                  color: Colors.purple,
  49                  bgColor: Colors.purple.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
  50                ),
  51                _buildStatCard(
  52                  title: appTranslation().get('admin_suspended_accounts'),
  53                  count: suspendedCount,
  54                  icon: Icons.person_off_outlined,
  55                  color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  56                  bgColor: ColorsManager.primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
  57                ),
  58                _buildStatCard(
  59                  title: appTranslation().get('admin_subscribed_plans'),
  60                  count: subscribedCount,
  61                  icon: Icons.bolt_outlined,
  62                  color: Colors.green,
  63                  bgColor: Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
  64                ),
  65              ],
  66            );
  67          },
  68        );
  69      },
  70    );
  71  }
  72
  73  Widget _buildStatCard({
  74    required String title,
  75    required int count,
  76    required IconData icon,
  77    required Color color,
  78    required Color bgColor,
  79  }) {
  80    return Container(
  81      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
  82      decoration: BoxDecoration(
  83        color: bgColor,
  84        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
  85        border: Border.all(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
  86      ),
  87      child: Row(
  88        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
  89        children: [
  90          Expanded(
  91            child: Column(
  92              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  93              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
  94              children: [
  95                Text(
  96                  count.toString(),
  97                  style: TextStylesManager.bold20.copyWith(color: color),
  98                ),
  99                verticalSpace4,
 100                Text(
 101                  title,
 102                  style: TextStylesManager.medium12.copyWith(color: color, height: 1.2),
 103                  maxLines: 2,
 104                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
 105                ),
 106              ],
 107            ),
 108          ),
 109          horizontalSpace4,
 110          Icon(icon, color: color, size: 26),
 111        ],
 112      ),
 113    );
 114  }
 115}

 418        title: Text(actionStr),
 419        content: Text('هل أنت متأكد أنك تريد $actionStr ${teacher.user.name}؟'),

 423            child: Text(appTranslation().get('cancel')),

 431            child: Text(actionStr),
 432          ),
 433        ],
 434      );
 435    },
 436  );
 437}
