 349  Widget _buildPlanAndExpiryCell(BuildContext context, AdminTeacherModel teacher, double width) {
 350    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
 351
 352    final isSubscribedActive = teacher.isSubscribed && !teacher.isExpired && !teacher.isFreePlan;
 353    final isTrialActive = teacher.isInTrial && !teacher.isExpired;
 354    final isTrialEnded = teacher.isTrialExpired || (teacher.isExpired && !teacher.isSubscribed);
 355    final isSubscribedExpired = teacher.isSubscribed && teacher.isExpired;
 356    final isFree = teacher.isFreePlan && !isTrialActive && !isTrialEnded && !isSubscribedActive && !isSubscribedExpired && teacher.effectiveEndsAt == null;
 357
 358    return SizedBox(
 359      width: width,
 360      child: Padding(
 361        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4.0, vertical: 2.0),
 362        child: Column(
 363          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
 364          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
 365          children: [
 366            // Top Pill Badge
 367            _buildTopPillBadge(
 368              context,
 369              teacher,
 370              isSubscribedActive: isSubscribedActive,
 371              isTrialActive: isTrialActive,
 372              isTrialEnded: isTrialEnded,
 373              isSubscribedExpired: isSubscribedExpired,
 374              isFree: isFree,
 375              isDark: isDark,
 376            ),
 377            const SizedBox(height: 4),
 378            // Bottom Details
 379            _buildExpiryDetails(
 380              context,
 381              teacher,
 382              isSubscribedActive: isSubscribedActive,
 383              isTrialActive: isTrialActive,
 384              isTrialEnded: isTrialEnded,
 385              isSubscribedExpired: isSubscribedExpired,
 386              isFree: isFree,
 387              isDark: isDark,
 388            ),
 389          ],
 390        ),
 391      ),
 392    );
 393  }
 394
 395  Widget _buildTopPillBadge(
 396    BuildContext context,
 397    AdminTeacherModel teacher, {
 398    required bool isSubscribedActive,
 399    required bool isTrialActive,
 400    required bool isTrialEnded,
 401    required bool isSubscribedExpired,
 402    required bool isFree,
 403    required bool isDark,
 404  }) {
 405    if (isTrialActive) {
 406      final bg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF451A03) : const Color(0xFFFFFBEB);
 407      final border = isDark ? const Color(0xFFD97706) : const Color(0xFFFDE68A);
 408      final text = isDark ? const Color(0xFFFBBF24) : const Color(0xFFB45309);
 409
 410      return Container(
 411        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 2.5),
 412        decoration: BoxDecoration(
 413          color: bg,
 414          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
 415          border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1),
 416        ),
 417        child: Row(
 418          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 419          children: [
 420            Text(
 421              'تجربة مجانية',
 422              style: TextStyle(
 423                fontSize: 10.5,
 424                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
 425                color: text,
 426                height: 1.1,
 427              ),
 428            ),
 429            const SizedBox(width: 4),
 430            Icon(Icons.access_time_outlined, size: 12.5, color: text),
 431          ],
 432        ),
 433      );
 434    }
 435
 436    if (isTrialEnded || isSubscribedExpired) {
 437      final bg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF450A0A) : const Color(0xFFFEF2F2);
 438      final border = isDark ? const Color(0xFFDC2626) : const Color(0xFFFECACA);
 439      final text = isDark ? const Color(0xFFF87171) : const Color(0xFFDC2626);
 440
 441      return Container(
 442        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 2),
 443        decoration: BoxDecoration(
 444          color: bg,
 445          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
 446          border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1),
 447        ),
 448        child: Row(
 449          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 450          children: [
 451            Column(
 452              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 453              children: [
 454                Text(
 455                  isTrialEnded ? 'انتهت' : 'انتهى',
 456                  style: TextStyle(
 457                    fontSize: 9.5,
 458                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
 459                    color: text,
 460                    height: 1.1,
 461                  ),
 462                ),
 463                Text(
 464                  isTrialEnded ? 'التجربة' : 'الاشتراك',
 465                  style: TextStyle(
 466                    fontSize: 9.5,
 467                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
 468                    color: text,
 469                    height: 1.1,
 470                  ),
 471                ),
 472              ],
 473            ),
 474            const SizedBox(width: 4),
 475            Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, size: 13, color: text),
 476          ],
 477        ),
 478      );
 479    }
 480
 481    if (isSubscribedActive) {
 482      final bg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF042F2E) : const Color(0xFFE0F2F1);
 483      final border = isDark ? const Color(0xFF0D9488) : const Color(0xFF99F6E4);
 484      final text = isDark ? const Color(0xFF2DD4BF) : const Color(0xFF0F766E);
 485      final planName = teacher.subscription?.name ?? 'فصل دراسي واحد';
 486
 487      final words = planName.trim().split(' ');
 488      Widget titleWidget;
 489      if (words.length >= 3) {
 490        titleWidget = Column(
 491          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 492          children: [
 493            Text(
 494              '${words[0]} ${words[1]}',
 495              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: text, height: 1.1),
 496            ),
 497            Text(
 498              words.sublist(2).join(' '),
 499              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: text, height: 1.1),
 500            ),
 501          ],
 502        );
 503      } else if (words.length == 2) {
 504        titleWidget = Column(
 505          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 506          children: [
 507            Text(
 508              words[0],
 509              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: text, height: 1.1),
 510            ),
 511            Text(
 512              words[1],
 513              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: text, height: 1.1),
 514            ),
 515          ],
 516        );
 517      } else {
 518        titleWidget = Text(
 519          planName,
 520          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: text, height: 1.1),
 521        );
 522      }
 523
 524      return Container(
 525        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 2),
 526        decoration: BoxDecoration(
 527          color: bg,
 528          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
 529          border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1),
 530        ),
 531        child: Row(
 532          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 533          children: [
 534            titleWidget,
 535            const SizedBox(width: 4),
 536            Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, size: 14, color: text),
 537          ],
 538        ),
 539      );
 540    }
 541

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
   3import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/certificates/data/models/certificate_template_model.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/features/certificates/domain/entities/certificate_data.dart';
   7import 'package:moean/features/certificates/presentation/widgets/certificate_preview_widget.dart';
   8import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
   9import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;

  12
  13part 'certificate_state.dart';
  14
  15class CertificateCubit extends Cubit<CertificateState> {
  16  CertificateCubit() : super(CertificateInitial()) {
  17    _addControllerListeners();
  18  }
  19
  20  static CertificateCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  21
  22  final TextEditingController studentNamesController = TextEditingController();
  23  final TextEditingController schoolNameController = TextEditingController();
  24  final TextEditingController classNameController = TextEditingController();
  25  final TextEditingController directorNameController = TextEditingController();
  26  final TextEditingController teacherNameController = TextEditingController();
  27  final TextEditingController certTextController = TextEditingController();
  28
  29  int selectedTemplate = 0;
  30  String selectedGender = 'male';
  31  DateTime selectedDate = DateTime.now();
  32
  33  Future<void> loadTeacherProfile() async {
  34    if (!isClosed) emit(CertificateLoading());
  35    final result = await ApiService.getProfile();
  36    if (isClosed) return;
  37    result.fold(
  38      (_) {
  39        if (!isClosed) emit(const CertificateLoaded());
  40      },
  41      (profile) {
  42        teacherNameController.text = profile.user.name;
  43        if (!isClosed) emit(const CertificateLoaded());
  44      },
  45    );
  46  }
  47
  48  void selectTemplate(int index) {
  49    selectedTemplate = index;
  50    if (!isClosed) emit(CertificateTemplateSelected(index));
  51  }
  52
  53  void selectGender(String gender) {
  54    selectedGender = gender;
  55    if (!isClosed) emit(CertificateGenderChanged(gender));
  56  }
  57
  58  void selectDate(DateTime date) {
  59    selectedDate = date;
  60    if (!isClosed) emit(CertificateDateChanged(date));
  61  }
  62
  63  void selectReadyText(String text) {
  64    certTextController.text = text;
  65    if (!isClosed) emit(CertificateReadyTextSelected(text));
  66  }
  67
  68  List<String> get studentNames => studentNamesController.text
  69      .split('\n')
  70      .map((e) => e.trim())
  71      .where((e) => e.isNotEmpty)
  72      .toList();
  73
  74  Future<void> generatePdf(BuildContext context) async {
  75    if (studentNames.isEmpty) {
  76      if (!isClosed) emit(const CertificateError('no_students'));
  77      return;
  78    }
  79    if (!isClosed) emit(CertificateGenerating());
  80    try {
  81      await Printing.layoutPdf(
  82        onLayout: (_) => _buildPdfBytes(context),
  83        name: 'certificates',
  84        format: PdfPageFormat.a4,
  85      );
  86      if (!isClosed) emit(const CertificateLoaded());
  87    } catch (e) {
  88      if (!isClosed) emit(CertificateError(e.toString()));
  89    }
  90  }
  91
  92  Future<Uint8List> _buildPdfBytes(BuildContext context) async {
  93    final doc = pw.Document();
  94    final template = CertificateTemplateModel.all[selectedTemplate];
  95    final formattedDate =
  96        '${selectedDate.year}-${selectedDate.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${selectedDate.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  97
  98    final screenshotController = ScreenshotController();
  99
 100    for (final name in studentNames) {
 101      final data = CertificateData(
 102        studentName: name,
 103        schoolName: schoolNameController.text,
 104        className: classNameController.text,
 105        teacherName: teacherNameController.text,
 106        principalName: directorNameController.text,
 107        certDate: formattedDate,
 108        certText: certTextController.text,
 109        gender: selectedGender,
 110      );
 111
 112      final widget = Directionality(
 113        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
 114        child: Material(
 115          color: Colors.white,
 116          child: RotatedBox(
 117            quarterTurns: 1,
 118            child: CertificatePreviewWidget(
 119              template: template,
 120              data: data,
 121              availableWidth: 1080.0,
 122            ),
 123          ),
 124        ),
 125      );
 126
 127      // Render image at 1.5 pixel ratio for high print quality
 128      final imageBytes = await screenshotController.captureFromWidget(
 129        widget,
 130        delay: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
 131        pixelRatio: 1.5,
 132        context: context,
 133        targetSize: const Size(1080.0 / 1.414, 1080.0),
 134      );
 135
 136      final pdfImage = pw.MemoryImage(imageBytes);
 137
 138      doc.addPage(
 139        pw.Page(
 140          pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
 141          margin: pw.EdgeInsets.zero,
 142          build: (context) {
 143            return pw.FullPage(
 144              ignoreMargins: true,
 145              child: pw.Image(pdfImage, fit: pw.BoxFit.fill),
 146            );
 147          },
 148        ),
 149      );
 150    }
 151    
 152    return doc.save();
 153  }
 154
 155  // ── Listeners ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 156
 157  void _addControllerListeners() {
 158    studentNamesController.addListener(_onPreviewChange);
 159    schoolNameController.addListener(_onPreviewChange);
 160    classNameController.addListener(_onPreviewChange);
 161    directorNameController.addListener(_onPreviewChange);
 162    teacherNameController.addListener(_onPreviewChange);
 163    certTextController.addListener(_onPreviewChange);
 164  }
 165
 166  void _removeControllerListeners() {
 167    studentNamesController.removeListener(_onPreviewChange);
 168    schoolNameController.removeListener(_onPreviewChange);
 169    classNameController.removeListener(_onPreviewChange);
 170    directorNameController.removeListener(_onPreviewChange);
 171    teacherNameController.removeListener(_onPreviewChange);
 172    certTextController.removeListener(_onPreviewChange);
 173  }
 174
 175  void _onPreviewChange() {
 176    if (!isClosed) emit(const CertificatePreviewUpdated());
 177  }
 178
 179  // ── Preview data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 180
 181  /// Builds a [CertificateData] snapshot from the current form state for the
 182  /// live certificate preview. Shows placeholder text when fields are empty.
 183  CertificateData buildPreviewData() {
 184    final names = studentNames;
 185    final date = selectedDate;
 186    final formattedDate =
 187        '${date.year}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
 188
 189    return CertificateData(
 190      studentName: names.isNotEmpty ? names.first : 'اسم الطالب',
 191      schoolName: schoolNameController.text.isNotEmpty
 192          ? schoolNameController.text
 193          : 'مدرسة حضّر النموذجية',
 194      className: classNameController.text.isNotEmpty
 195          ? classNameController.text
 196          : 'الصف الأول المتوسط',
 197      teacherName: teacherNameController.text.isNotEmpty
 198          ? teacherNameController.text
 199          : 'اسم المعلم',
 200      principalName: directorNameController.text.isNotEmpty
 201          ? directorNameController.text
 202          : 'اسم المدير',
 203      certDate: formattedDate,
 204      certText: certTextController.text.isNotEmpty
 205          ? certTextController.text
 206          : 'لتفوقه الدراسي وسمو أخلاقه، ونتمنى له دوام التفوق والنجاح بإذن الله.',
 207      gender: selectedGender,
 208    );
 209  }
 210
 211  // ── Lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 212
 213  @override
 214  Future<void> close() {
 215    _removeControllerListeners();
 216    studentNamesController.dispose();
 217    schoolNameController.dispose();
 218    classNameController.dispose();
 219    directorNameController.dispose();
 220    teacherNameController.dispose();
 221    certTextController.dispose();
 222    return super.close();
 223  }

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2
   3/// Repeating radial dot pattern matching the React `Pattern` component:
   4/// `radial-gradient(circle_at_20px_20px, #000 2px, transparent 0)`
   5/// repeated at 42px × 42px intervals, opacity 0.08.
   6class CertificateDotPatternWidget extends StatelessWidget {
   7  const CertificateDotPatternWidget({super.key});
   8
   9  @override
  10  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  11    return Positioned.fill(
  12      child: CustomPaint(
  13        painter: _DotPatternPainter(),
  14      ),
  15    );
  16  }
  17}
  18
  19class _DotPatternPainter extends CustomPainter {
  20  const _DotPatternPainter();
  21
  22  @override
  23  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
  24    final paint = Paint()
  25      ..color = Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.08)
  26      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;
  27
  28    const spacing = 42.0;
  29    const dotRadius = 2.0;
  30
  31    for (double x = spacing * 0.5; x < size.width + spacing; x += spacing) {
  32      for (double y = spacing * 0.5; y < size.height + spacing; y += spacing) {
  33        canvas.drawCircle(Offset(x, y), dotRadius, paint);
  34      }
  35    }
  36  }
  37
  38  @override
  39  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
  40}

   5/// A 128×96 white rounded box that shows either an image asset or a text
   6/// fallback — matching the React `LogoSlot` component exactly.
   7///
   8/// Container spec: `h-24 w-32 rounded-3xl bg-white/95 p-2 shadow-xl ring-1 ring-black/5`
   9/// All dimensions are at the 1080-base scale.
  10class CertificateLogoSlotWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  11  final String assetPath;
  12  final double imageWidth;
  13  final double imageHeight;
  14  final String fallbackLine1;
  15  final String fallbackLine2;
  16  final CertificateTemplateModel template;
  17
  18  const CertificateLogoSlotWidget({
  19    super.key,
  20    required this.assetPath,
  21    required this.imageWidth,
  22    required this.imageHeight,
  23    required this.fallbackLine1,
  24    required this.fallbackLine2,
  25    required this.template,
  26  });
  27
  28  @override
  29  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  30    return Container(
  31      width: 128,
  32      height: 96,
  33      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
  34      decoration: BoxDecoration(
  35        color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.95),
  36        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  37        boxShadow: [
  38          BoxShadow(
  39            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.14),
  40            blurRadius: 28,
  41            offset: const Offset(0, 12),
  42          ),
  43        ],
  44        border: Border.all(
  45          color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
  46        ),
  47      ),
  48      alignment: Alignment.center,
  49      child: Image.asset(
  50        assetPath,
  51        width: imageWidth,
  52        height: imageHeight,
  53        fit: BoxFit.contain,
  54        errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) => Text(

  11/// The preview section shown between the template grid and the generate button.
  12///
  13/// It wraps [CertificatePreviewWidget] in a [BlocBuilder] so the preview
  14/// instantly rebuilds whenever the user changes:
  15///   - template, gender, date, ready-text (cubit states)
  16///   - any text field (CertificatePreviewUpdated emitted by controller listeners)
  17class CertificatePreviewSectionWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  18  const CertificatePreviewSectionWidget({super.key});
  19
  20  @override
  21  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  22    return BlocBuilder<CertificateCubit, CertificateState>(
  23      buildWhen: (prev, curr) =>
  24          curr is CertificateTemplateSelected ||
  25          curr is CertificateGenderChanged ||
  26          curr is CertificateDateChanged ||
  27          curr is CertificateReadyTextSelected ||
  28          curr is CertificatePreviewUpdated ||
  29          curr is CertificateLoaded,
  30      builder: (context, state) {
  31        final cubit = CertificateCubit.get(context);
  32        final template = CertificateTemplateModel.all[cubit.selectedTemplate];
  33        final data = cubit.buildPreviewData();
  34
  35        return Column(
  36          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  37          children: [
  38            // ── Section header ──────────────────────────────────────────
  39            _PreviewHeaderWidget(template: template, cubit: cubit),
  40            verticalSpace12,
  41
  42            // ── Horizontally scrollable certificate canvas ──────────────
  43            // The inner [CertificatePreviewWidget] enforces a minimum
  44            // display width of 680 px, so narrow phones can scroll.
  45            LayoutBuilder(
  46              builder: (context, constraints) {
  47                return Container(
  48                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
  49                    color: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
  50                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
  51                    border: Border.all(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
  52                    boxShadow: [
  53                      BoxShadow(
  54                        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
  55                        blurRadius: 20,
  56                        offset: const Offset(0, 6),
  57                      ),
  58                    ],
  59                  ),
  60                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
  61                  child: ClipRRect(
  62                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
  63                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
  64                      scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
  65                      child: CertificatePreviewWidget(
  66                        availableWidth: constraints.maxWidth - 20, // adjust for padding
  67                        template: template,
  68                        data: data,
  69                      ),
  70                    ),
  71                  ),
  72                );
  73              },
  74            ),
  75          ],
  76        );
  77      },
  78    );
  79  }
  80}

   1import 'dart:math' as math;
   2
   3import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   4import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/certificates/data/models/certificate_template_model.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/features/certificates/domain/entities/certificate_data.dart';
   7import 'package:moean/features/certificates/presentation/widgets/certificate_bg_widget.dart';
   8import 'package:moean/features/certificates/presentation/widgets/certificate_logo_slot_widget.dart';
   9import 'package:moean/features/certificates/presentation/widgets/certificate_signature_widget.dart';
  10
  11/// Full-fidelity live certificate preview.
  12///
  13/// Matches the React `CertificatePreview` component pixel-for-pixel:
  14///   - aspect ratio 1.414 : 1  (A4 landscape)
  15///   - built internally at 1080 × 763.5 px (React base size)
  16///   - scaled via [Transform.scale] to fit the available width
  17///   - minimum display width 680 px with horizontal scroll support
  18///
  19/// The parent must wrap this widget in a [SingleChildScrollView] with
  20/// `scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal` to allow the minimum width on narrow
  21/// screens.
  22class CertificatePreviewWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  23  final CertificateTemplateModel template;
  24  final CertificateData data;
  25  final double availableWidth;
  26
  27  const CertificatePreviewWidget({
  28    super.key,
  29    required this.template,
  30    required this.data,
  31    required this.availableWidth,
  32  });
  33
  34  // ── Geometry constants (all in React / 1080-base pixels) ──────────────
  35  static const double _baseWidth = 1080.0;
  36  static const double _baseHeight = _baseWidth / 1.414; // ≈ 763.5 px
  37
  38  /// Minimum display width (px) before the preview becomes horizontally
  39  /// scrollable. Chosen so text remains legible at the resulting scale.
  40  static const double _minDisplayWidth = 680.0;
  41
  42  @override
  43  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  44    final displayWidth = math.max(availableWidth, _minDisplayWidth);
  45    final scale = displayWidth / _baseWidth;
  46    final displayHeight = _baseHeight * scale;
  47
  48    return SizedBox(
  49      width: displayWidth,
  50      height: displayHeight,
  51      child: FittedBox(
  52        fit: BoxFit.contain,
  53        alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
  54        child: SizedBox(
  55          width: _baseWidth,
  56          height: _baseHeight,
  57          child: ClipRect(
  58            child: _CertificateCanvas(
  59              template: template,
  60              data: data,
  61            ),
  62          ),
  63        ),
  64      ),
  65    );
  66  }
  67}
  68
  69// ── Canvas (built at 1080×763.5 base) ─────────────────────────────────────
  70
  71class _CertificateCanvas extends StatelessWidget {
  72  final CertificateTemplateModel template;
  73  final CertificateData data;
  74
  75  const _CertificateCanvas({
  76    required this.template,
  77    required this.data,
  78  });
  79
  80  @override
  81  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  82    return Stack(
  83      clipBehavior: Clip.hardEdge,
  84      children: [
  85        // ── Layer 0: Template background ──────────────────────────────
  86        Positioned.fill(
  87          child: CertificateBgWidget(template: template),
  88        ),
  89
  90        // ── Layer 1: Content (z-10 in React) ──────────────────────────
  91        Positioned.fill(
  92          child: Directionality(
  93            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
  94            child: Padding(
  95              // px-20 py-12 → horizontal 80px, vertical 48px
  96              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
  97                horizontal: 80,
  98                vertical: 48,
  99              ),
 100              child: FittedBox(
 101                fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
 102                child: SizedBox(
 103                  width: 920, // 1080 (baseWidth) - 160 (horizontal padding)
 104                  child: Column(
 105                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
 106                    children: [
 107                      _LogoRow(template: template),
 108                      const SizedBox(height: 32),
 109                      _TitleBlock(template: template, data: data),
 110                      const SizedBox(height: 32),
 111                      _StudentRow(template: template, data: data),
 112                      const SizedBox(height: 40),
 113                      _ReasonText(data: data),
 114                      const SizedBox(height: 24),
 115                      _FooterRow(template: template, data: data),
 116                    ],
 117                  ),
 118                ),
 119              ),
 120            ),
 121          ),
 122        ),
 123      ],
 124    );
 125  }
 126}

   5/// Template selector card with a pixel-matched mini thumbnail.
   6///
   7/// The thumbnail replicates the React `TemplateThumbnail` component:
   8/// ```
   9/// Soft-bg base
  10/// Top gradient header  (h-12 of h-28 container ≈ 43%)
  11/// Two white/85% logo-box rects in the top corners
  12/// Two content-line placeholders in the center
  13/// Accent-colored strip bottom-left, dark-colored strip bottom-right
  14/// modernCorner: extra colored squares at corners
  15/// ```
  16class CertificateTemplateCardWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  17  final CertificateTemplateModel template;
  18  final bool isSelected;
  19  final VoidCallback onTap;
  20
  21  const CertificateTemplateCardWidget({
  22    super.key,
  23    required this.template,
  24    required this.isSelected,
  25    required this.onTap,
  26  });
  27
  28  @override
  29  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  30    return GestureDetector(
  31      onTap: onTap,
  32      child: AnimatedContainer(
  33        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
  34        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
  35        decoration: BoxDecoration(
  36          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
  37          border: Border.all(
  38            color: isSelected
  39                ? ColorsManager.primaryColor
  40                : ColorsManager.borderColor,

  45                  BoxShadow(
  46                    color: ColorsManager.primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.22),

  50                ]
  51              : [

  53                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.04),

  55                    offset: const Offset(0, 2),

  58        ),
  59        child: ClipRRect(
  60          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(isSelected ? 14 : 15),
  61          child: Column(
  62            children: [
  63              // Thumbnail takes most of the card height
  64              Expanded(
  65                child: _TemplateThumbnail(template: template),
  66              ),
  67              // Label row at the bottom
  68              Container(
  69                color: Colors.white,
  70                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
  71                  horizontal: 10,
  72                  vertical: 7,
  73                ),
  74                child: Row(

 100                      Container(

 124/// Mini thumbnail matching the React TemplateThumbnail:
 125/// ```
 126/// <div relative h-28 overflow-hidden style={{background: soft}}>
 127///   <div absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-12 gradient(accent→dark) />
 128///   <div absolute left-4  top-4 h-6 w-10 rounded-lg bg-white/85 />  ← logo box L
 129///   <div absolute right-4 top-4 h-6 w-10 rounded-lg bg-white/85 />  ← logo box R
 130///   <div absolute left-1/2 top-14  h-2.5 w-36 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-slate-300 />
 131///   <div absolute left-1/2 top-19  h-2   w-24 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-slate-200 />
 132///   <div absolute bottom-0 left-0  h-8 w-32 rounded-tr-[42px] accent/72 />
 133///   <div absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-8 w-32 rounded-tl-[42px] dark/72  />
 134///   {modernCorner: 2 extra colored squares at top-left and bottom-right}
 135/// </div>
 136/// ```
 137/// All px values are Tailwind 1-unit=4px: h-12=48, h-8=32, w-10=40, w-32=128,
 138/// h-6=24, h-2.5=10, h-2=8, w-36=144, w-24=96, top-14=56, top-19=76, left-4=16.
 139class _TemplateThumbnail extends StatelessWidget {
 140  final CertificateTemplateModel template;
 141
 142  const _TemplateThumbnail({required this.template});
 143
 144  bool get _isRoyalGold =>
 145      template.style == CertificateTemplateStyle.royalGold;
 146
 147  bool get _isModernCorner =>
 148      template.style == CertificateTemplateStyle.modernCorner;
 149
 150  @override
 151  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 152    return LayoutBuilder(
 153      builder: (context, constraints) {
 154        final w = constraints.maxWidth;
 155
 156        // Scale factor from the React 200px-wide thumbnail reference
 157        final s = w / 200.0;
 158
 159        return ClipRect(
 160          child: Stack(
 161            clipBehavior: Clip.hardEdge,
 162            children: [
 163              // ── Base background ──────────────────────────────────────
 164              Positioned.fill(
 165                child: Container(color: template.bgColor),
 166              ),
 167
 168              // ── Top gradient header  h-12 (48px) ────────────────────
 169              Positioned(
 170                left: 0,
 171                right: 0,
 172                top: 0,
 173                child: Container(
 174                  height: 48 * s,
 175                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 176                    gradient: LinearGradient(
 177                      begin: Alignment.centerLeft,
 178                      end: Alignment.centerRight,
 179                      colors: _isRoyalGold
 180                          ? [
 181                              template.darkColor,
 182                              const Color(0xFF4A3416),
 183                              template.primaryColor,
 184                            ]
 185                          : [template.primaryColor, template.darkColor],
 186                    ),
 187                  ),
 188                ),
 189              ),
 190
 191              // ── Logo box left  left-4(16) top-4(16) h-6(24) w-10(40) ──
 192              Positioned(
 193                left: 16 * s,
 194                top: 16 * s,
 195                child: Container(
 196                  width: 40 * s,
 197                  height: 24 * s,
 198                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 199                    color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
 200                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6 * s),
 201                  ),
 202                ),
 203              ),
 204
 205              // ── Logo box right  right-4(16) top-4(16) h-6(24) w-10(40) ──
 206              Positioned(
 207                right: 16 * s,
 208                top: 16 * s,
 209                child: Container(
 210                  width: 40 * s,
 211                  height: 24 * s,
 212                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 213                    color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
 214                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6 * s),
 215                  ),
 216                ),
 217              ),
 218
 219              // ── Title line placeholder  top-14(56) h-2.5(10) w-36(144) ──
 220              Positioned(
 221                left: w / 2 - 72 * s,
 222                top: 56 * s,
 223                child: Container(
 224                  width: 144 * s,
 225                  height: 10 * s,
 226                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 227                    color: const Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
 228                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(5 * s),
 229                  ),
 230                ),
 231              ),
 232
 233              // ── Sub-line placeholder  top-19(76) h-2(8) w-24(96) ───
 234              Positioned(
 235                left: w / 2 - 48 * s,
 236                top: 76 * s,
 237                child: Container(
 238                  width: 96 * s,
 239                  height: 8 * s,
 240                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 241                    color: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
 242                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4 * s),
 243                  ),
 244                ),
 245              ),
 246
 247              // ── Bottom-left accent strip  h-8(32) w-32(128) rounded-tr-[42px] ──
 248              Positioned(
 249                left: 0,
 250                bottom: 0,
 251                child: Container(
 252                  width: 128 * s,
 253                  height: 32 * s,
 254                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 255                    color: template.primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.72),
 256                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
 257                      topRight: Radius.circular(42 * s),
 258                    ),
 259                  ),
 260                ),
 261              ),
 262
 263              // ── Bottom-right dark strip  h-8(32) w-32(128) rounded-tl-[42px] ──
 264              Positioned(
 265                right: 0,
 266                bottom: 0,
 267                child: Container(
 268                  width: 128 * s,
 269                  height: 32 * s,
 270                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 271                    color: template.darkColor.withValues(alpha: 0.72),
 272                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
 273                      topLeft: Radius.circular(42 * s),
 274                    ),
 275                  ),
 276                ),
 277              ),
 278
 279              // ── modernCorner: extra colored squares ──────────────────
 280              if (_isModernCorner) ...[
 281                // top-left pink  h-14(56) w-14(56)
 282                Positioned(
 283                  left: 0,
 284                  top: 0,
 285                  child: Container(
 286                    width: 56 * s,
 287                    height: 56 * s,
 288                    color: const Color(0xFFF4436C),
 289                  ),
 290                ),
 291                // bottom-right blue  h-14(56) w-14(56)
 292                Positioned(
 293                  right: 0,
 294                  bottom: 0,
 295                  child: Container(
 296                    width: 56 * s,
 297                    height: 56 * s,
 298                    color: const Color(0xFF2377B8),
 299                  ),
 300                ),
 301              ],
 302            ],
 303          ),
 304        );
 305      },
 306    );
 307  }
 308}

   3/// Template 5 — "زوايا حديثة" (Modern Corner)
   4///
   5/// React reference:
   6/// ```
   7/// <div absolute inset-0 bg-white />
   8/// <div absolute left-0  top-0    h-64 w-52 bg-[#F4436C] style={{clipPath:"polygon(0 0,100% 0,0 100%)"}} />
   9/// <div absolute right-0 top-0    h-64 w-52 bg-[#FFC857] style={{clipPath:"polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 100%)"}} />
  10/// <div absolute left-0  bottom-0 h-56 w-52 bg-[#0E9F86] style={{clipPath:"polygon(0 0,0 100%,100% 100%)"}} />
  11/// <div absolute right-0 bottom-0 h-56 w-52 bg-[#2377B8] style={{clipPath:"polygon(100% 0,0 100%,100% 100%)"}} />
  12/// ```
  13/// Tailwind: h-64 = 256px, h-56 = 224px, w-52 = 208px.
  14///
  15/// ClipPath polygons map as follows to Flutter CustomClipper(Path):
  16///   `polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%)` → top-left right triangle
  17///   `polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%)` → top-right right triangle
  18///   `polygon(0 0, 0 100%, 100% 100%)` → bottom-left right triangle
  19///   `polygon(100% 0, 0 100%, 100% 100%)` → bottom-right right triangle
  20class CertBgModernCorner extends StatelessWidget {
  21  const CertBgModernCorner({super.key});
  22
  23  @override
  24  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  25    return Stack(
  26      children: [
  27        // ── White base ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  28        Positioned.fill(child: Container(color: Colors.white)),
  29
  30        // ── Top-left pink triangle  h-64(256) w-52(208) ────────────────
  31        Positioned(
  32          left: 0,
  33          top: 0,
  34          child: ClipPath(
  35            clipper: const _TopLeftTriangleClipper(),
  36            child: Container(
  37              width: 208,
  38              height: 256,
  39              color: const Color(0xFFF4436C),
  40            ),
  41          ),
  42        ),
  43
  44        // ── Top-right yellow/gold triangle  h-64(256) w-52(208) ────────
  45        Positioned(
  46          right: 0,
  47          top: 0,
  48          child: ClipPath(
  49            clipper: const _TopRightTriangleClipper(),
  50            child: Container(
  51              width: 208,
  52              height: 256,
  53              color: const Color(0xFFFFC857),
  54            ),
  55          ),
  56        ),
  57
  58        // ── Bottom-left green triangle  h-56(224) w-52(208) ────────────
  59        Positioned(
  60          left: 0,
  61          bottom: 0,
  62          child: ClipPath(
  63            clipper: const _BottomLeftTriangleClipper(),
  64            child: Container(
  65              width: 208,
  66              height: 224,
  67              color: const Color(0xFF0E9F86),
  68            ),
  69          ),
  70        ),
  71
  72        // ── Bottom-right blue triangle  h-56(224) w-52(208) ────────────
  73        Positioned(
  74          right: 0,
  75          bottom: 0,
  76          child: ClipPath(
  77            clipper: const _BottomRightTriangleClipper(),
  78            child: Container(
  79              width: 208,
  80              height: 224,
  81              color: const Color(0xFF2377B8),
  82            ),
  83          ),
  84        ),
  85      ],
  86    );
  87  }
  88}
  89
  90// ── Clip path implementations ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  91
  92/// polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%) — top-left right triangle
  93class _TopLeftTriangleClipper extends CustomClipper<Path> {
  94  const _TopLeftTriangleClipper();
  95
  96  @override
  97  Path getClip(Size size) => Path()
  98    ..lineTo(size.width, 0)
  99    ..lineTo(0, size.height)
 100    ..close();
 101
 102  @override
 103  bool shouldReclip(covariant CustomClipper<Path> _) => false;
 104}
 105
 106/// polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%) — top-right right triangle
 107class _TopRightTriangleClipper extends CustomClipper<Path> {
 108  const _TopRightTriangleClipper();
 109
 110  @override
 111  Path getClip(Size size) => Path()
 112    ..moveTo(0, 0)
 113    ..lineTo(size.width, 0)
 114    ..lineTo(size.width, size.height)
 115    ..close();
 116
 117  @override
 118  bool shouldReclip(covariant CustomClipper<Path> _) => false;
 119}
 120
 121/// polygon(0 0, 0 100%, 100% 100%) — bottom-left right triangle
 122class _BottomLeftTriangleClipper extends CustomClipper<Path> {
 123  const _BottomLeftTriangleClipper();
 124
 125  @override
 126  Path getClip(Size size) => Path()
 127    ..lineTo(0, size.height)
 128    ..lineTo(size.width, size.height)
 129    ..close();
 130
 131  @override
 132  bool shouldReclip(covariant CustomClipper<Path> _) => false;
 133}
 134
 135/// polygon(100% 0, 0 100%, 100% 100%) — bottom-right right triangle
 136class _BottomRightTriangleClipper extends CustomClipper<Path> {
 137  const _BottomRightTriangleClipper();
 138
 139  @override
 140  Path getClip(Size size) => Path()
 141    ..moveTo(size.width, 0)
 142    ..lineTo(0, size.height)
 143    ..lineTo(size.width, size.height)
 144    ..close();
 145
 146  @override
 147  bool shouldReclip(covariant CustomClipper<Path> _) => false;
 148}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/features/certificates/data/models/certificate_template_model.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/certificates/presentation/widgets/certificate_dot_pattern_widget.dart';
   4
   5/// Template 1 — "رسمي سعودي" (National Ribbon)
   6///
   7/// React reference:
   8/// ```
   9/// <div absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-[215px] bg-gradient-to-br from-accent to-dark />
  10/// <div absolute inset-x-[-6%] top-[132px] h-[120px] rounded-[0_0_50%_50%] bg-white />
  11/// <div absolute inset-x-14 top-[236px] h-px bg-accent/25 />
  12/// <Pattern />
  13/// ```
  14/// All coordinates assume the 1080-base width; the parent scales via Transform.scale.
  15class CertBgNationalRibbon extends StatelessWidget {
  16  final CertificateTemplateModel template;
  17
  18  const CertBgNationalRibbon({super.key, required this.template});
  19
  20  @override
  21  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  22    // The React cert is 1080×763.5. The arch is absolutely wider (-6% = -64.8px each side).
  23    // We hard-code the 1080-base arithmetic and let the parent Transform.scale handle display.
  24    const certWidth = 1080.0;
  25    const overdraw = certWidth * 0.06; // 64.8px
  26
  27    return Stack(
  28      clipBehavior: Clip.none,
  29      children: [
  30        // ── Base background ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  31        Positioned.fill(
  32          child: Container(color: Colors.white),
  33        ),
  34
  35        // ── Gradient header band  h-[215px] bg-gradient-to-br ──────────
  36        Positioned(
  37          left: 0,
  38          right: 0,
  39          top: 0,
  40          child: Container(
  41            height: 215,
  42            decoration: BoxDecoration(
  43              gradient: LinearGradient(
  44                begin: Alignment.topLeft,
  45                end: Alignment.bottomRight,
  46                colors: [template.primaryColor, template.darkColor],
  47              ),
  48            ),
  49          ),
  50        ),
  51
  52        // ── White curved arch  top-[132px] h-[120px] rounded-[0_0_50%_50%] ──
  53        // Extends -6% beyond each side to create the elliptical curve at the bottom.
  54        Positioned(
  55          top: 132,
  56          left: -overdraw,
  57          right: -overdraw,
  58          child: LayoutBuilder(
  59            builder: (_, constraints) {
  60              final w = certWidth + overdraw * 2; // 1209.6
  61              return Container(
  62                height: 120,
  63                decoration: BoxDecoration(
  64                  color: Colors.white,
  65                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
  66                    bottomLeft: Radius.elliptical(w / 2, 120),
  67                    bottomRight: Radius.elliptical(w / 2, 120),
  68                  ),
  69                ),
  70              );
  71            },
  72          ),
  73        ),
  74
  75        // ── Thin horizontal divider  inset-x-14 top-[236px] h-px accent/25 ──
  76        Positioned(
  77          left: 56, // inset-x-14 = 14*4 = 56px
  78          right: 56,
  79          top: 236,
  80          child: Container(
  81            height: 1,
  82            color: template.primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.25),
  83          ),
  84        ),
  85
  86        // ── Repeating dot pattern ──────────────────────────────────────
  87        const CertificateDotPatternWidget(),
  88      ],
  89    );
  90  }
  91}

  11/// <div absolute inset-x-20 top-12 h-28 rounded-b-[100px] border-b-[12px] border-gold />
  12/// <div absolute inset-10 rounded-[42px] border-[3px] border-gold/75 />
  13/// <Pattern />
  14/// ```
  15/// Tailwind:
  16///   h-36 = 144px,  inset-x-20 = 80px,  top-12 = 48px,  h-28 = 112px,
  17///   rounded-b-[100px] = 100px bottom radius only,  border-b-[12px] = 12px bottom border only,
  18///   inset-10 = 40px.
  19class CertBgRoyalGold extends StatelessWidget {
  20  final CertificateTemplateModel template;
  21
  22  const CertBgRoyalGold({super.key, required this.template});
  23
  24  static const Color _midBrown = Color(0xFF3B2F1E);
  25
  26  @override
  27  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  28    final dark = template.darkColor;
  29    final gold = template.goldColor;
  30
  31    return Stack(
  32      children: [
  33        // ── Base soft background ────────────────────────────────────────
  34        Positioned.fill(
  35          child: Container(color: template.bgColor),
  36        ),
  37
  38        // ── Dark header  h-36 gradient from-dark via-midBrown to-dark ──
  39        // `bg-gradient-to-l from-dark via-#3B2F1E to-dark` (symmetric)
  40        Positioned(
  41          left: 0,
  42          right: 0,
  43          top: 0,
  44          child: Container(
  45            height: 144, // h-36
  46            decoration: BoxDecoration(
  47              gradient: LinearGradient(
  48                begin: Alignment.centerRight,
  49                end: Alignment.centerLeft,
  50                colors: [dark, _midBrown, dark],
  51                stops: const [0.0, 0.5, 1.0],
  52              ),
  53            ),
  54          ),
  55        ),
  56
  57        // ── Gold arc  inset-x-20 top-12 h-28 rounded-b-[100px] border-b-[12px] gold ──
  58        // Only the bottom border and bottom border-radius is drawn — creating a
  59        // "U-shaped" gold arc that peeks below the dark header.
  60        Positioned(
  61          left: 80, // inset-x-20 = 80px
  62          right: 80,
  63          top: 48, // top-12 = 48px
  64          child: Container(
  65            height: 112, // h-28
  66            decoration: BoxDecoration(
  67              borderRadius: const BorderRadius.only(
  68                bottomLeft: Radius.circular(100),
  69                bottomRight: Radius.circular(100),
  70              ),
  71              border: Border(
  72                bottom: BorderSide(color: gold, width: 12),
  73              ),
  74            ),
  75          ),
  76        ),
  77
  78        // ── Gold full frame  inset-10 rounded-[42px] border-[3px] gold/75 ──
  79        Positioned(
  80          left: 40, // inset-10 = 40px
  81          right: 40,
  82          top: 40,
  83          bottom: 40,
  84          child: Container(

   5class ContactCubit extends Cubit<ContactState> {
   6  ContactCubit() : super(ContactInitial());
   7
   8  static ContactCubit get(context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
   9
  10  List<dynamic> types = [];
  11  List<dynamic> myTickets = [];
  12
  13  Future<void> getContactTypes() async {
  14    if (!isClosed) emit(ContactTypesLoading());
  15
  16    final result = await ApiService.getContactTypes();
  17    if (isClosed) return;
  18    result.fold(
  19      (error) {
  20        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactTypesError(error));
  21      },
  22      (data) {
  23        types = data['types'] ?? [];
  24        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactTypesLoaded(types));
  25      },
  26    );
  27  }
  28
  29  Future<void> submitContactRequest({
  30    required String name,
  31    required String email,
  32    String? phone,
  33    required String type,
  34    required String message,
  35  }) async {
  36    if (!isClosed) emit(ContactSubmitLoading());
  37
  38    final result = await ApiService.submitContactRequest(
  39      name: name,
  40      email: email,
  41      phone: phone,
  42      type: type,
  43      message: message,
  44    );
  45    if (isClosed) return;
  46
  47    result.fold(
  48      (error) {
  49        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactSubmitError(error));
  50      },
  51      (data) {
  52        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactSubmitSuccess(data['message'] ?? 'تم إرسال طلبك بنجاح.'));
  53      },
  54    );
  55  }
  56
  57  Future<void> getMyTickets() async {
  58    if (!isClosed) emit(ContactMyTicketsLoading());
  59
  60    final result = await ApiService.getMyContactTickets();
  61    if (isClosed) return;
  62    result.fold(
  63      (error) {
  64        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactMyTicketsError(error));
  65      },
  66      (data) {
  67        myTickets = data['data'] ?? [];
  68        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactMyTicketsLoaded(myTickets));
  69      },
  70    );
  71  }
  72
  73  Map<String, dynamic>? currentTicket;
  74
  75  Future<void> getTicketDetails(int id) async {
  76    if (!isClosed) emit(ContactTicketDetailsLoading());
  77
  78    final result = await ApiService.getMyContactTicketDetails(id: id);
  79    if (isClosed) return;
  80    result.fold(
  81      (error) {
  82        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactTicketDetailsError(error));
  83      },
  84      (data) {
  85        currentTicket = data['ticket'] ?? data;
  86        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactTicketDetailsLoaded());
  87      },
  88    );
  89  }
  90
  91  Future<void> replyToTicket({required int id, required String body}) async {
  92    if (!isClosed) emit(ContactTicketReplyLoading());
  93
  94    final result = await ApiService.replyContactTicket(id: id, body: body);
  95    if (isClosed) return;
  96    result.fold(
  97      (error) {
  98        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactTicketReplyError(error));
  99      },
 100      (data) {
 101        if (!isClosed) emit(ContactTicketReplySuccess(data['message'] ?? 'تم إرسال الرد بنجاح'));
 102        // Refresh ticket details to get the new reply
 103        getTicketDetails(id);
 104      },
 105    );
 106  }
 107}

  11import 'package:moean/features/contact/presentation/cubit/contact_state.dart';
  12
  13class MyTicketsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  14  const MyTicketsScreen({super.key});
  15
  16  @override
  17  State<MyTicketsScreen> createState() => _MyTicketsScreenState();
  18}
  19
  20class _MyTicketsScreenState extends State<MyTicketsScreen> {
  21  @override
  22  void initState() {
  23    super.initState();
  24    ContactCubit.get(context).getMyTickets();
  25  }
  26
  27  @override
  28  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  29    return BlocBuilder<ContactCubit, ContactState>(
  30      buildWhen: (previous, current) => current is ContactMyTicketsLoading || current is ContactMyTicketsLoaded || current is ContactMyTicketsError,
  31      builder: (context, state) {
  32        return Directionality(
  33          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
  34          child: Scaffold(
  35            backgroundColor: ColorsManager.background,
  36            appBar: AppBar(
  37              backgroundColor: ColorsManager.background,
  38              elevation: 0,
  39              centerTitle: true,
  40              title: Text(
  41                appTranslation().get('my_requests_conversations'),
  42                style: TextStylesManager.bold18.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText),
  43              ),
  44              leading: IconButton(
  45                icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios, color: ColorsManager.mainText),
  46                onPressed: () => context.pop(),
  47              ),
  48              actions: [
  49                IconButton(
  50                  icon:  Icon(Icons.refresh, color: ColorsManager.primaryColor),
  51                  onPressed: () => ContactCubit.get(context).getMyTickets(),
  52                ),
  53              ],
  54            ),
  55            body: SafeArea(
  56              child: Padding(
  57                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24.0, vertical: 16),
  58                child: Column(
  59                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
  60                  children: [
  61                    Expanded(
  62                      child: _buildTicketsList(state),
  63                    ),
  64                    verticalSpace16,
  65                    PrimaryElevatedButton(
  66                      text: appTranslation().get('new_request'),
  67                      onPressed: () {
  68                        Navigator.pushNamed(context, Routes.createTicket).then((_) {
  69                          if (context.mounted) {
  70                            ContactCubit.get(context).getMyTickets();
  71                          }
  72                        });
  73                      },
  74                    ),
  75                  ],
  76                ),
  77              ),
  78            ),
  79          ),
  80        );
  81      },
  82    );
  83  }
  84
  85  Widget _buildTicketsList(ContactState state) {
  86    if (state is ContactMyTicketsLoading) {
  87      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
  88    } else if (state is ContactMyTicketsError) {
  89      return Center(child: Text(state.error, style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: Colors.red)));
  90    } else if (state is ContactMyTicketsLoaded) {
  91      final tickets = state.tickets;
  92      if (tickets.isEmpty) {
  93        return Center(
  94          child: Text(
  95            appTranslation().get('no_tickets'),
  96            style: TextStylesManager.bold16.copyWith(color: Colors.grey),
  97          ),
  98        );
  99      }
 100      return ListView.separated(
 101        itemCount: tickets.length,
 102        separatorBuilder: (context, index) => verticalSpace16,
 103        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
 104          final ticket = tickets[index];
 105          return TeacherTicketItemWidget(ticket: ticket);
 106        },
 107      );
 108    }
 109    return const SizedBox.shrink();
 110  }
 111}

 113class TeacherTicketItemWidget extends StatelessWidget {
 114  final dynamic ticket;
 115
 116  const TeacherTicketItemWidget({super.key, required this.ticket});
 117
 118  @override
 119  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 120    final status = ticket['status'] ?? 'pending';
 121    final statusLabel = ticket['status_label'] ?? appTranslation().get('pending');
 122    final typeLabel = ticket['type_label'] ?? '';
 123    final message = ticket['message'] ?? '';
 124    final repliesCount = ticket['replies_count'] ?? 0;
 125    final createdAt = ticket['created_at'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(ticket['created_at']) : null;
 126    final ticketId = ticket['id'] != null ? '#${ticket['id']}' : '';
 127
 128    Color statusColor;
 129    switch (status) {
 130      case 'resolved':
 131        statusColor = Colors.green;
 132        break;
 133      case 'in_progress':
 134        statusColor = Colors.blue;
 135        break;
 136      case 'pending':
 137        statusColor = Colors.orange;
 138        break;
 139      default:
 140        statusColor = Colors.grey;
 141    }
 142
 143    return InkWell(
 144      onTap: () {
 145        Navigator.pushNamed(context, Routes.ticketDetails, arguments: {'id': ticket['id']}).then((_) {
 146          if (context.mounted) {
 147            ContactCubit.get(context).getMyTickets();
 148          }
 149        });
 150      },
 151      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
 152      child: Container(
 153        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
 154        decoration: BoxDecoration(
 155          color: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
 156          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
 157          border: Border.all(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
 158        ),
 159        child: Column(
 160          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 161          children: [
 162            Row(
 163              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
 164              children: [
 165                Expanded(
 166                  child: Text(
 167                    message,
 168                    maxLines: 1,
 169                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
 170                    style: TextStylesManager.bold16.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText),
 171                  ),
 172                ),
 173                horizontalSpace8,
 174                Container(
 175                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
 176                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 177                    color: statusColor.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
 178                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
 179                    border: Border.all(color: statusColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
 180                  ),
 181                  child: Row(
 182                    children: [
 183                      Icon(Icons.info_outline, size: 14, color: statusColor),
 184                      horizontalSpace6,
 185                      Text(
 186                        statusLabel,
 187                        style: TextStylesManager.bold12.copyWith(color: statusColor),
 188                      ),
 189                    ],
 190                  ),
 191                ),
 192              ],
 193            ),
 194            verticalSpace4,
 195            Text(
 196              '$ticketId • $repliesCount ${appTranslation().get('replies') ?? 'رد'}',
 197              style: TextStylesManager.regular12.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.secondaryText),
 198            ),
 199            verticalSpace12,
 200            Row(
 201              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
 202              children: [
 203                Container(
 204                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
 205                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 206                    color: ColorsManager.isDark ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.05) : Colors.grey.shade100,
 207                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),

  24  void didChangeDependencies() {
  25    super.didChangeDependencies();

  69              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(state.error, style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.white)), backgroundColor: Colors.red));
  70            }
  71          },
  72          buildWhen: (previous, current) => current is ContactTicketDetailsLoading || current is ContactTicketDetailsLoaded || current is ContactTicketDetailsError,
  73          builder: (context, state) {
  74            if (state is ContactTicketDetailsLoading || ContactCubit.get(context).currentTicket == null) {
  75              return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
  76            } else if (state is ContactTicketDetailsError) {
  77              return Center(child: Text(state.error, style: TextStylesManager.bold16.copyWith(color: Colors.red)));
  78            }
  79
  80            final ticket = ContactCubit.get(context).currentTicket!;
  81            return Padding(
  82              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
  83              child: SingleChildScrollView(
  84                child: Center(
  85                  child: ConstrainedBox(
  86                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 800),
  87                    child: TicketChatHistory(ticket: ticket),
  88                  ),
  89                ),
  90              ),
  91            );
  92          },
  93        ),
  94      ),

 340  String _formatDateDetails(String? dateStr) {
 341    if (dateStr == null) return '9 يوليو 2026';
 342    final dt = DateTime.tryParse(dateStr);
 343    if (dt == null) return '9 يوليو 2026';
 344    const months = [
 345      '', 'يناير', 'فبراير', 'مارس', 'أبريل', 'مايو', 'يونيو',
 346      'يوليو', 'أغسطس', 'سبتمبر', 'أكتوبر', 'نوفمبر', 'ديسمبر'
 347    ];
 348    return '${dt.day} ${months[dt.month]} ${dt.year}';
 349  }
 350
 351  String _formatDateShort(String? dateStr) {
 352    if (dateStr == null) return 'يوليو / 10:02 AM ص';
 353    final dt = DateTime.tryParse(dateStr);
 354    if (dt == null) return 'يوليو / 10:02 AM ص';
 355    
 356    final amPm = dt.hour >= 12 ? 'PM م' : 'AM ص';
 357    final hour = dt.hour > 12 ? dt.hour - 12 : (dt.hour == 0 ? 12 : dt.hour);
 358    final minute = dt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
 359    
 360    const months = [
 361      '', 'يناير', 'فبراير', 'مارس', 'أبريل', 'مايو', 'يونيو',
 362      'يوليو', 'أغسطس', 'سبتمبر', 'أكتوبر', 'نوفمبر', 'ديسمبر'
 363    ];
 364    
 365    return '${dt.day} ${months[dt.month]} / $hour:$minute $amPm';
 366  }
 367}

  12  Future<Either<String, List<CurriculumPlanModel>>> getPlans({

  90
  91  /// GET /api/curriculum/books?subject_id=|grade_id=
  92  Future<Either<String, List<CurriculumBookModel>>> getBooks({
  93    int? subjectId,
  94    int? gradeId,
  95  }) async {
  96    final query = <String, dynamic>{};
  97    if (subjectId != null) query['subject_id'] = subjectId;
  98    if (gradeId != null) query['grade_id'] = gradeId;
  99
 100    final response = await DioHelper.getData(url: curriculumBooksApi, query: query);
 101    return response.fold(
 102      (error) => Left(error),
 103      (res) {
 104        try {
 105          final data = res.data;
 106          final list = (data['data'] ?? data) as List<dynamic>;
 107          
 108          List<CurriculumBookModel> books = [];
 109          for (var item in list) {
 110            if (item is Map<String, dynamic>) {
 111              // If the item has a 'books' array, it means the response is grouped by subject
 112              if (item.containsKey('books') && item['books'] is List) {
 113                final subjectName = item['subject_name'] ?? item['name'] ?? '';
 114                for (var bookJson in item['books']) {
 115                  final b = bookJson as Map<String, dynamic>;
 116                  // Inject the subject name into the book json so the model parses it
 117                  b['subject_name'] = subjectName;
 118                  books.add(CurriculumBookModel.fromJson(b));
 119                }
 120              } else {
 121                // Otherwise, it's a flat list of books
 122                books.add(CurriculumBookModel.fromJson(item));
 123              }
 124            }
 125          }
 126          
 127          return Right(books);
 128        } catch (e) {
 129          return Left(e.toString());
 130        }
 131      },
 132    );
 133  }

  35      (download) =>
  36          emit(CurriculumBooksDownloadReady(download: download, books: _books)),

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/curriculum/data/models/curriculum_distribution_models.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/features/curriculum/data/repositories/curriculum_repository.dart';
   5
   6part 'curriculum_distribution_state.dart';
   7
   8class CurriculumDistributionCubit
   9    extends Cubit<CurriculumDistributionState> {
  10  static CurriculumDistributionCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  11
  12  CurriculumDistributionCubit() : super(CurriculumDistributionInitial());
  13
  14  final _repo = CurriculumRepository();
  15
  16  // Retained for cross-call context
  17  int? selectedSubjectId;
  18  int? selectedSemester;
  19  int? selectedPlanId;
  20
  21  // ── Load plans for a subject/semester ──────────────────────────────────────
  22  Future<void> loadPlans({int? subjectId, int? semester}) async {
  23    selectedSubjectId = subjectId;
  24    selectedSemester = semester;
  25    emit(CurriculumDistributionLoading());
  26
  27    final result = await _repo.getPlans(subjectId: subjectId, semester: semester);
  28    result.fold(
  29      (error) => emit(CurriculumDistributionError(message: error)),
  30      (plans) {
  31        emit(CurriculumDistributionPlansLoaded(plans: plans));
  32        // Auto-load the first plan's detail right away
  33        if (plans.isNotEmpty) loadPlanDetail(plans.first.id);
  34      },
  35    );
  36  }
  37
  38  // ── Load full timeline for a plan ──────────────────────────────────────────
  39  Future<void> loadPlanDetail(int planId, {String? region}) async {
  40    selectedPlanId = planId;
  41    emit(CurriculumDistributionLoading());
  42
  43    final detailResult = await _repo.getPlanDetail(planId, region: region);
  44    detailResult.fold(
  45      (error) => emit(CurriculumDistributionError(message: error)),
  46      (detail) async {
  47        CurriculumProgressModel? progress;
  48        if (selectedSubjectId != null && selectedSemester != null) {
  49          final progResult = await _repo.getProgress(
  50            subjectId: selectedSubjectId!,
  51            semester: selectedSemester!,
  52          );
  53          progResult.fold((_) {}, (p) => progress = p);
  54        }
  55        if (!isClosed) {
  56          emit(CurriculumDistributionDetailLoaded(
  57            detail: detail,
  58            progress: progress,
  59          ));
  60        }
  61      },
  62    );
  63  }
  64
  65  // ── Bulk-prepare a whole week ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  66  Future<void> prepareWeek(int weekId) async {
  67    if (selectedPlanId == null) return;
  68
  69    // Keep current detail/progress visible while preparing
  70    final current = state;
  71    CurriculumPlanDetailModel? currentDetail;
  72    CurriculumProgressModel? currentProgress;
  73    if (current is CurriculumDistributionDetailLoaded) {
  74      currentDetail = current.detail;
  75      currentProgress = current.progress;
  76    }
  77    if (currentDetail != null) {
  78      emit(CurriculumDistributionPreparing(
  79        detail: currentDetail,
  80        progress: currentProgress,
  81      ));
  82    }
  83
  84    final result = await _repo.prepareWeek(
  85      planId: selectedPlanId!,
  86      weekId: weekId,
  87    );
  88    result.fold(
  89      (error) => emit(CurriculumDistributionError(message: error)),
  90      (data) => emit(CurriculumDistributionPrepareSuccess(
  91        detail: currentDetail!,
  92        progress: currentProgress,
  93        result: data,
  94      )),
  95    );
  96  }
  97}

 152              selectedRegion: _selectedRegion,
 153              onRegionChanged: _onRegionChanged,
 154            ),

 156              child: BlocConsumer<CurriculumDistributionCubit, CurriculumDistributionState>(
 157                listener: (context, state) {
 158                  if (state is CurriculumDistributionPrepareSuccess) {
 159                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 160                      const SnackBar(
 161                        content: Text('✅ تم تحضير الأسبوع بنجاح'),
 162                        backgroundColor: Colors.green,
 163                      ),
 164                    );
 165                  }
 166                  if (state is CurriculumDistributionError) {
 167                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 168                      SnackBar(
 169                        content: Text(state.message),
 170                        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
 171                      ),
 172                    );
 173                  }
 174                },
 175                builder: (context, state) {
 176                  if (_selectedSubject == null) {
 177                    return Center(
 178                      child: Text(
 179                        'الرجاء اختيار المادة لعرض الكتب والتوزيع',
 180                        style: TextStylesManager.medium14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.secondaryText),
 181                      ),
 182                    );
 183                  }
 184
 185                  if (state is CurriculumDistributionLoading ||
 186                      state is CurriculumDistributionInitial ||
 187                      state is CurriculumDistributionPlansLoaded) {
 188                    return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
 189                  }
 190
 191                  CurriculumPlanDetailModel? detail;
 192                  CurriculumProgressModel? progress;
 193                  bool isPreparing = false;
 194
 195                  if (state is CurriculumDistributionDetailLoaded) {
 196                    detail = state.detail;
 197                    progress = state.progress;
 198                  } else if (state is CurriculumDistributionPreparing) {
 199                    detail = state.detail;
 200                    progress = state.progress;
 201                    isPreparing = true;
 202                  } else if (state is CurriculumDistributionPrepareSuccess) {
 203                    detail = state.detail;
 204                    progress = state.progress;
 205                  } else if (state is CurriculumDistributionError) {
 206                    return CurriculumErrorView(
 207                      message: state.message,
 208                      onRetry: () => CurriculumDistributionCubit.get(context).loadPlans(
 209                        subjectId: _selectedSubject!.id,
 210                        semester: _selectedSemester,
 211                      ),
 212                    );
 213                  }
 214
 215                  if (detail == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
 216
 217                  return Stack(
 218                    children: [
 219                      WeeksGrid(
 220                        detail: detail,
 221                        progress: progress,
 222                        onPrepareTap: (weekId) {}, // Disabled as per user request
 223                      ),
 224                      if (isPreparing)

 226                          child: ColoredBox(
 227                            color: Color(0x44000000),
 228                            child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
 229                          ),
 230                        ),
 231                    ],
 232                  );
 233                },
 234              ),
 235            ),
 236          ],

 238      ),
