  17class CurriculumDistributionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  18  const CurriculumDistributionScreen({super.key});
  19
  20  @override
  21  State<CurriculumDistributionScreen> createState() =>
  22      _CurriculumDistributionScreenState();
  23}
  24
  25class _CurriculumDistributionScreenState
  26    extends State<CurriculumDistributionScreen> {
  27  // Stage / Grade / Subject tree
  28  List<CurriculumStageModel> _stages = [];
  29  List<CurriculumGradeModel> _grades = [];
  30  List<CurriculumSubjectModel> _subjects = [];
  31
  32  CurriculumStageModel? _selectedStage;
  33  CurriculumGradeModel? _selectedGrade;
  34  CurriculumSubjectModel? _selectedSubject;
  35  int _selectedSemester = 1;
  36
  37  bool _loadingStages = true;
  38  String? _pickerError;
  39
  40  // Region switcher
  41  String _selectedRegion = 'general'; // 'general' | 'west'
  42
  43  @override
  44  void initState() {
  45    super.initState();
  46    _loadStages();
  47  }
  48
  49  Future<void> _loadStages() async {
  50    setState(() {
  51      _loadingStages = true;
  52      _pickerError = null;
  53    });
  54    final result = await ApiService.getSubjects();
  55    if (!mounted) return;
  56    result.fold(
  57      (failure) => setState(() {
  58        _loadingStages = false;
  59        _pickerError = failure.toString();
  60      }),
  61      (stages) => setState(() {
  62        _stages = stages;
  63        _loadingStages = false;
  64      }),
  65    );
  66  }
  67
  68  void _onStageSelected(CurriculumStageModel stage) {
  69    setState(() {
  70      _selectedStage = stage;
  71      _selectedGrade = null;
  72      _selectedSubject = null;
  73      _grades = stage.grades;
  74      _subjects = [];
  75    });
  76  }
  77
  78  void _onGradeSelected(CurriculumGradeModel grade) {
  79    setState(() {
  80      _selectedGrade = grade;
  81      _selectedSubject = null;
  82      _subjects = grade.subjects;
  83    });
  84  }
  85
  86  void _onSubjectSelected(CurriculumSubjectModel subject) {
  87    setState(() => _selectedSubject = subject);
  88    CurriculumDistributionCubit.get(context).loadPlans(
  89          subjectId: subject.id,
  90          semester: _selectedSemester,
  91        );
  92    CurriculumBooksCubit.get(context).loadBooks(subjectId: subject.id);
  93  }
  94
  95  void _onSemesterChanged(int s) {
  96    setState(() => _selectedSemester = s);
  97    if (_selectedSubject != null) {
  98      CurriculumDistributionCubit.get(context).loadPlans(
  99            subjectId: _selectedSubject!.id,
 100            semester: s,
 101          );
 102    }
 103  }
 104
 105  void _onRegionChanged(String region) {
 106    setState(() => _selectedRegion = region);
 107    final cubit = CurriculumDistributionCubit.get(context);
 108    if (cubit.selectedPlanId != null) {
 109      cubit.loadPlanDetail(
 110        cubit.selectedPlanId!,
 111        region: region == 'west' ? 'west' : null,
 112      );
 113    }
 114  }
 115
 116  @override
 117  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 118    return Directionality(
 119      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
 120      child: Scaffold(
 121        backgroundColor: ColorsManager.background,
 122        appBar: AppBar(
 123          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.background,
 124          elevation: 0,
 125          title: Text(
 126            'توزيع المناهج',
 127            style: TextStylesManager.bold16.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText),
 128          ),
 129          centerTitle: true,
 130          leading: IconButton(
 131            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
 132            icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded, size: 20),
 133            color: ColorsManager.mainText,
 134          ),
 135        ),
 136        body: Column(
 137          children: [
 138            // ── Subject Picker ─────────────────────────────────────────────
 139            SubjectPickerSection(
 140              stages: _stages,
 141              grades: _grades,
 142              subjects: _subjects,
 143              selectedStage: _selectedStage,
 144              selectedGrade: _selectedGrade,
 145              selectedSubject: _selectedSubject,
 146              selectedSemester: _selectedSemester,
 147              loading: _loadingStages,
 148              error: _pickerError,
 149              onStageSelected: _onStageSelected,
 150              onGradeSelected: _onGradeSelected,
 151              onSubjectSelected: _onSubjectSelected,
 152              onSemesterChanged: _onSemesterChanged,
 153            ),
 154            // ── Books Section ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 155            if (_selectedSubject != null)
 156              const InlineBooksSection(),
 157            // ── Region & Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────
 158            RegionLegendRow(
 159              selectedRegion: _selectedRegion,
 160              onRegionChanged: _onRegionChanged,
 161            ),
 162            // ── Main content ───────────────────────────────────────────────
 163            Expanded(
 164              child: BlocConsumer<CurriculumDistributionCubit,
 165                  CurriculumDistributionState>(
 166                listener: (context, state) {
 167                  if (state is CurriculumDistributionPrepareSuccess) {
 168                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 169                      const SnackBar(
 170                        content: Text('✅ تم تحضير الأسبوع بنجاح'),
 171                        backgroundColor: Colors.green,
 172                      ),
 173                    );
 174                  }
 175                  if (state is CurriculumDistributionError) {
 176                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 177                      SnackBar(
 178                        content: Text(state.message),
 179                        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
 180                      ),
 181                    );
 182                  }
 183                },
 184                builder: (context, state) {
 185                  if (_selectedSubject == null) {
 186                    return EmptyPickerView();
 187                  }
 188
 189                  if (state is CurriculumDistributionLoading ||
 190                      state is CurriculumDistributionInitial ||
 191                      state is CurriculumDistributionPlansLoaded) {
 192                    return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
 193                  }
 194
 195                  CurriculumPlanDetailModel? detail;
 196                  CurriculumProgressModel? progress;
 197                  bool isPreparing = false;
 198
 199                  if (state is CurriculumDistributionDetailLoaded) {
 200                    detail = state.detail;
 201                    progress = state.progress;
 202                  } else if (state is CurriculumDistributionPreparing) {
 203                    detail = state.detail;
 204                    progress = state.progress;
 205                    isPreparing = true;
 206                  } else if (state is CurriculumDistributionPrepareSuccess) {
 207                    detail = state.detail;
 208                    progress = state.progress;
 209                  } else if (state is CurriculumDistributionError) {
 210                    return CurriculumErrorView(
 211                      message: state.message,
 212                      onRetry: () =>
 213                          CurriculumDistributionCubit.get(context).loadPlans(
 214                                subjectId: _selectedSubject!.id,
 215                                semester: _selectedSemester,
 216                              ),
 217                    );
 218                  }
 219
 220                  if (detail == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
 221
 222                  return Stack(
 223                    children: [
 224                      WeeksGrid(
 225                        detail: detail,
 226                        progress: progress,
 227                        onPrepareTap: (weekId) => CurriculumDistributionCubit.get(context).prepareWeek(weekId),
 228                      ),
 229                      if (isPreparing)
 230                        const Positioned.fill(
 231                          child: ColoredBox(
 232                            color: Color(0x44000000),
 233                            child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
 234                          ),
 235                        ),
 236                    ],
 237                  );
 238                },
 239              ),
 240            ),
 241          ],
 242        ),
 243      ),
 244    );
 245  }
 246}

 116                                  Text('تحميل', style: TextStylesManager.bold12.copyWith(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 10)),
 117                                ],
 118                              ),
 119                      ),
 120                    ),
 121                  ],
 122                ),
 123              );
 124            }).toList(),
 125          ),
 126        );
 127      },
 128    );
 129  }

 131
 132Future<void> _openDownloadUrl(BuildContext context, String url) async {
 133  final uri = Uri.tryParse(url);
 134  if (uri != null && await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
 135    await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
 136  } else {
 137    if (context.mounted) {
 138      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 139        const SnackBar(
 140          content: Text('تعذّر فتح رابط التحميل'),
 141          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
 142        ),
 143      );
 144    }
 145  }
 146}

 138  void _showPicker<T>(
 139    BuildContext context, {
 140    required String title,
 141    required List<T> items,
 142    required String Function(T) getName,
 143    required void Function(T) onSelect,

 148        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
 149      ),
 150      builder: (_) => Directionality(
 151        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
 152        child: Column(
 153          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 154          children: [
 155            const SizedBox(height: 12),
 156            Container(
 157              width: 40,
 158              height: 4,
 159              decoration: BoxDecoration(
 160                color: Colors.grey.shade300,
 161                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
 162              ),
 163            ),
 164            const SizedBox(height: 12),
 165            Text(title, style: TextStylesManager.bold16),
 166            const SizedBox(height: 8),
 167            const Divider(),
 168            Flexible(
 169              child: ListView.separated(
 170                shrinkWrap: true,
 171                itemCount: items.length,
 172                separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const Divider(height: 1),
 173                itemBuilder: (_, i) => ListTile(
 174                  title: Text(getName(items[i]),
 175                      style: TextStylesManager.regular14),
 176                  onTap: () {
 177                    Navigator.pop(context);
 178                    onSelect(items[i]);
 179                  },
 180                ),
 181              ),
 182            ),
 183            const SizedBox(height: 16),
 184          ],
 185        ),
 186      ),
 187    );
 188  }
 189}

   7import 'export_pdf_card.dart';
   8
   9class WeeksGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  10  final CurriculumPlanDetailModel detail;
  11  final CurriculumProgressModel? progress;
  12  final void Function(int weekId) onPrepareTap;
  13
  14  const WeeksGrid({
  15    super.key,
  16    required this.detail,
  17    this.progress,
  18    required this.onPrepareTap,
  19  });
  20
  21  @override
  22  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  23    return CustomScrollView(
  24      slivers: [
  25        if (progress != null)
  26          SliverToBoxAdapter(child: ProgressBar(progress: progress!)),
  27        SliverPadding(
  28          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
  29          sliver: SliverGrid(
  30            gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
  31              crossAxisCount: 2,
  32              mainAxisSpacing: 10,
  33              crossAxisSpacing: 10,
  34              childAspectRatio: 0.82,
  35            ),
  36            delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
  37              (_, i) => WeekCard(
  38                week: detail.weeks[i],
  39                onPrepareTap: onPrepareTap,
  40              ),
  41              childCount: detail.weeks.length,
  42            ),
  43          ),
  44        ),
  45        SliverToBoxAdapter(
  46          child: ExportPdfCard(
  47            onExport: (school, teacher, manager) async {
  48              await PdfExportHelper.exportWidgetsToPdfPages(
  49                context: context,
  50                title: 'توزيع_المناهج_${detail.plan.subjectName}',
  51                pages: _buildPdfPages(detail, school, teacher, manager),
  52              );
  53            },
  54          ),
  55        ),
  56        const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 40)),
  57      ],
  58    );
  59  }
  60
  61  List<Widget> _buildPdfPages(
  62    CurriculumPlanDetailModel detail,
  63    String school,
  64    String teacher,
  65    String manager,
  66  ) {
  67    final List<Widget> pages = [];
  68    const int itemsPerPage = 6;
  69
  70    for (int i = 0; i < detail.weeks.length; i += itemsPerPage) {
  71      final int end = (i + itemsPerPage < detail.weeks.length)
  72          ? i + itemsPerPage
  73          : detail.weeks.length;
  74      final weekSubset = detail.weeks.sublist(i, end);
  75
  76      pages.add(
  77        Container(
  78          color: ColorsManager.background,
  79          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
  80          child: Column(
  81            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
  82            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
  83            children: [
  84              Row(
  85                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
  86                children: [
  87                  if (school.isNotEmpty)
  88                    Text('المدرسة: $school',
  89                        style: TextStylesManager.bold14
  90                            .copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText)),
  91                  if (teacher.isNotEmpty)
  92                    Text('المعلم: $teacher',
  93                        style: TextStylesManager.bold14
  94                            .copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText)),
  95                  if (manager.isNotEmpty)
  96                    Text('المدير: $manager',
  97                        style: TextStylesManager.bold14
  98                            .copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText)),
  99                ],
 100              ),
 101              const SizedBox(height: 20),
 102              Text(
 103                'توزيع منهج ${detail.plan.subjectName} - ${detail.plan.gradeName}',
 104                style: TextStylesManager.bold16
 105                    .copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText),
 106                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
 107              ),
 108              verticalSpace16,
 109              Wrap(
 110                spacing: 10,
 111                runSpacing: 10,
 112                alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
 113                children: weekSubset.map((week) {
 114                  return SizedBox(
 115                    width: 160,
 116                    height: 220,
 117                    child: WeekCard(week: week, onPrepareTap: (_) {}),
 118                  );
 119                }).toList(),
 120              ),
 121            ],
 122          ),
 123        ),
 124      );
 125    }
 126    return pages;
 127  }
 128}

 130class ProgressBar extends StatelessWidget {
 131  final CurriculumProgressModel progress;
 132  const ProgressBar({super.key, required this.progress});
 133
 134  @override
 135  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 136    final Color statusColor = progress.status == 'ahead'
 137        ? Colors.green
 138        : progress.status == 'behind'
 139            ? Colors.red
 140            : ColorsManager.primaryColor;
 141    final String statusLabel = progress.status == 'ahead'
 142        ? 'متقدم بـ ${progress.weeksAheadOrBehind} أسبوع'
 143        : progress.status == 'behind'
 144            ? 'متأخر بـ ${progress.weeksAheadOrBehind} أسبوع'
 145            : 'على المسار الصحيح';
 146
 147    return Container(
 148      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 0),
 149      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
 150      decoration: BoxDecoration(
 151        color: statusColor.withOpacity(0.08),
 152        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
 153        border: Border.all(color: statusColor.withOpacity(0.3)),
 154      ),
 155      child: Row(
 156        children: [
 157          Icon(
 158            progress.status == 'ahead'
 159                ? Icons.trending_up
 160                : progress.status == 'behind'
 161                    ? Icons.trending_down
 162                    : Icons.check_circle_outline,
 163            color: statusColor,
 164            size: 20,
 165          ),
 166          const SizedBox(width: 8),
 167          Text(statusLabel,
 168              style:
 169                  TextStylesManager.bold12.copyWith(color: statusColor)),
 170          const Spacer(),
 171          Text('${progress.completedWeeks}/${progress.totalWeeks} أسبوع',
 172              style: TextStylesManager.regular12
 173                  .copyWith(color: ColorsManager.secondaryText)),
 174        ],
 175      ),
 176    );
 177  }
 178}

  32class QuestionModel extends QuestionEntity {
  33  QuestionModel({
  34    required super.id,
  35    required super.lessonId,
  36    required super.type,
  37    required super.questionText,
  38    required super.options,
  39    required super.correctAnswer,
  40    required super.source,
  41    required super.usageCount,
  42    required super.questionOrder,
  43    required super.points,
  44    super.reviewStatus,
  45    super.rejectionReason,
  46  });
  47
  48  factory QuestionModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  49    final type = json['type'] as String? ?? '';
  50    dynamic parsedOptions;
  51
  52    if (type == 'matching') {
  53      parsedOptions = MatchingOptionsModel.fromJson(json['options'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {});
  54    } else if (type == 'mcq') {
  55      parsedOptions = (json['options'] as List<dynamic>?)?.map((e) => e.toString()).toList() ?? [];
  56    } else {
  57      parsedOptions = json['options'];
  58    }
  59
  60    return QuestionModel(
  61      id: json['id'] as int? ?? 0,
  62      lessonId: json['lesson_id'] as int? ?? 0,
  63      type: type,
  64      questionText: json['question_text'] as String? ?? '',
  65      options: parsedOptions,
  66      correctAnswer: json['correct_answer'] as String? ?? '',
  67      source: json['source'] as String? ?? '',
  68      usageCount: json['usage_count'] as int? ?? 0,
  69      questionOrder: json['question_order'] as int? ?? 0,
  70      points: (json['points'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
  71      reviewStatus: json['review_status'] as String? ?? '',
  72      rejectionReason: json['rejection_reason'] as String?,
  73    );

   9class ExamRepositoryImpl implements ExamRepository {
  10  @override
  11  Future<Either<Failure, ExamEntity>> generateExam({
  12    required String title,
  13    required String grade,
  14    required String subject,
  15    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> lessons,
  16  }) async {
  17    final request = GenerateExamRequest(
  18      title: title,
  19      grade: grade,
  20      subject: subject,
  21      lessons: lessons.map((e) => LessonRequest(
  22        lessonId: e['lesson_id'] as int? ?? 0,
  23        lessonName: e['lesson_name'] as String? ?? '',
  24        selectedQuestionIds: e['selected_question_ids'] != null ? List<int>.from(e['selected_question_ids']) : null,
  25        requestedCounts: RequestedCounts(
  26          mcq: e['requested_counts']?['mcq'] ?? 0,
  27          trueFalse: e['requested_counts']?['true_false'] ?? 0,
  28          fillBlank: e['requested_counts']?['fill_blank'] ?? 0,
  29          essay: e['requested_counts']?['essay'] ?? 0,
  30          matching: e['requested_counts']?['matching'] ?? 0,
  31        ),
  32      )).toList(),
  33    );
  34
  35    final result = await ApiService.generateExam(request.toJson());
  36
  37    return result.fold(
  38      (errorString) => Left(_parseApiError(errorString)),
  39      (data) {
  40        if (data['success'] == true && data['exam'] != null) {
  41          try {
  42            final examModel = ExamModel.fromJson(data['exam']);
  43            return Right(examModel);
  44          } catch (e) {
  45            return Left(ServerFailure('Failed to parse generated exam: $e'));
  46          }
  47        } else {
  48          return Left(AiGenerationFailure(data['message']?.toString() ?? 'AI Generation Failed'));
  49        }
  50      },
  51    );
  52  }
  53

  55  Future<Either<Failure, ExamEntity>> getExam(int id) async {

  57
  58    return result.fold(
  59      (errorString) => Left(_parseApiError(errorString)),
  60      (data) {
  61        if (data['success'] == true && data['exam'] != null) {
  62          try {
  63            final examModel = ExamModel.fromJson(data['exam']);
  64            return Right(examModel);
  65          } catch (e) {
  66            return Left(ServerFailure('Failed to parse exam: $e'));
  67          }
  68        } else {
  69          return const Left(NotFoundFailure('Exam not found'));
  70        }
  71      },
  72    );
  73  }

  79        questionId: e['question_id'] as int? ?? 0,
  80        points: (e['points'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
  81      )).toList(),

  83
  84    final result = await ApiService.updateExamPoints(id, request.toJson());
  85
  86    return result.fold(
  87      (errorString) => Left(_parseApiError(errorString)),
  88      (data) {
  89        if (data['success'] == true && data['exam'] != null) {
  90          try {

  92            return Right(examModel);

  95          }
  96        } else {
  97          return const Left(ValidationFailure('Failed to update points', {}));

 183  @override
 184  Future<Either<Failure, ExamEntity>> addManualQuestion(Map<String, dynamic> request) async {
 185    final result = await ApiService.addManualQuestion(request);
 186
 187    return result.fold(
 188      (errorString) => Left(_parseApiError(errorString)),
 189      (data) {
 190        if (data['success'] == true && data['exam'] != null) {
 191          try {
 192            final examModel = ExamModel.fromJson(data['exam']);
 193            return Right(examModel);
 194          } catch (e) {
 195            return Left(ServerFailure('Failed to parse exam: $e'));
 196          }
 197        } else {
 198          return const Left(ValidationFailure('Failed to add question', {}));
 199        }
 200      },
 201    );
 202  }
 203
 204  Failure _parseApiError(String errorString) {
 205    if (errorString.startsWith('__402__:')) {
 206      final parts = errorString.split(':');
 207      final code = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : 'quota_exceeded';
 208      final msg = parts.length > 2 ? parts.sublist(2).join(':') : 'ترقية الحساب المطلوبة';
 209      return PaymentRequiredFailure(msg, code: code);
 210    }
 211    if (errorString.toLowerCase().contains('unauthenticated') || errorString.contains('401')) {
 212      return const UnauthorizedFailure('Unauthenticated');
 213    }
 214    if (errorString.contains('403')) {
 215      return const ForbiddenFailure('Access Denied');
 216    }
 217    if (errorString.contains('404')) {
 218      return const NotFoundFailure('Not Found');
 219    }
 220    if (errorString.contains('409')) {
 221      return const ExamLockedFailure('Exam is no longer a draft');
 222    }
 223    if (errorString.contains('422')) {
 224      return ValidationFailure(errorString, {});
 225    }
 226    if (errorString.contains('502')) {
 227      return const AiGenerationFailure('حدث خطأ أثناء انشاء الأسئلة، الرجاء المحاولة مرة أخرى لاحقاً');
 228    }
 229    if (errorString.contains('503') || errorString.contains('504') || errorString.contains('timeout')) {
 230      return const TimeoutFailure('Service unavailable or timed out');
 231    }
 232    return ServerFailure(errorString);
 233  }
 234

 255    return result.fold(

  14  static bool isEnglishText(String text) {
  15    if (text.trim().isEmpty) return false;
  16
  17    int englishCount = 0;
  18    int arabicCount = 0;
  19
  20    for (final rune in text.runes) {
  21      if ((rune >= 0x0041 && rune <= 0x005A) || (rune >= 0x0061 && rune <= 0x007A)) {
  22        englishCount++;
  23      } else if (rune >= 0x0600 && rune <= 0x06FF) {
  24        arabicCount++;
  25      }
  26    }
  27
  28    return englishCount > arabicCount;
  29  }

 198  static pw.Widget _buildQuestion(
 199      QuestionEntity q, pw.TextStyle regular, pw.TextStyle bold, bool showAnswers) {
 200    final isEnglish = isEnglishText(q.questionText);
 201    final textDir = isEnglish ? pw.TextDirection.ltr : pw.TextDirection.rtl;
 202
 203    return pw.Directionality(
 204      textDirection: textDir,
 205      child: pw.Padding(

 214                pw.SizedBox(width: 4),
 215                pw.Expanded(
 216                  child: pw.Text(q.questionText, style: bold, textDirection: textDir),
 217                ),
 218                pw.SizedBox(width: 8),
 219                pw.Text(
 220                  isEnglish ? '[${q.points} point${q.points > 1 ? "s" : ""}]' : '[${q.points} درجة]',
 221                  style: regular.copyWith(color: PdfColors.grey700, fontSize: 10),
 222                  textDirection: textDir,
 223                ),
 224              ],
 225            ),
 226            pw.SizedBox(height: 10),
 227            _buildQuestionOptions(q, regular, bold, showAnswers, isEnglish),
 228            if (showAnswers && q.type != 'matching' && q.type != 'mcq') ...[
 229              pw.SizedBox(height: 10),
 230              pw.Text(
 231                isEnglish ? 'Answer: ${q.correctAnswer}' : 'الإجابة: ${q.correctAnswer}',
 232                style: bold.copyWith(color: PdfColors.green700),
 233                textDirection: textDir,
 234              ),
 235            ]
 236          ],
 237        ),
 238      ),
 239    );
 240  }
 241
 242  static pw.Widget _buildQuestionOptions(
 243      QuestionEntity q, pw.TextStyle regular, pw.TextStyle bold, bool showAnswers, bool isEnglish) {
 244    final textDir = isEnglish ? pw.TextDirection.ltr : pw.TextDirection.rtl;
 245
 246    if (q.type == 'mcq') {
 247      final options = List<String>.from(q.options ?? []);
 248      return pw.Column(
 249        crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 250        children: options.map((opt) {
 251          final isCorrect = opt == q.correctAnswer;
 252          return pw.Padding(
 253            padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 4),
 254            child: pw.Row(
 255              crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.center,
 256              children: [
 257                pw.Container(
 258                  width: 12,
 259                  height: 12,
 260                  decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
 261                    shape: pw.BoxShape.circle,
 262                    border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey),
 263                    color: (showAnswers && isCorrect) ? PdfColors.green700 : null,
 264                  ),
 265                ),
 266                pw.SizedBox(width: 8),
 267                pw.Expanded(
 268                  child: pw.Text(
 269                    opt,
 270                    style: (showAnswers && isCorrect)
 271                        ? bold.copyWith(color: PdfColors.green700)
 272                        : regular,
 273                    textDirection: textDir,
 274                  ),
 275                ),
 276              ],
 277            ),
 278          );
 279        }).toList(),
 280      );
 281    } else if (q.type == 'true_false') {
 282      final isTrueCorrect = showAnswers && (q.correctAnswer == 'صح' || q.correctAnswer.toLowerCase() == 'true');
 283      final isFalseCorrect = showAnswers && (q.correctAnswer == 'خطأ' || q.correctAnswer.toLowerCase() == 'false');
 284
 285      return pw.Row(
 286        mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceEvenly,
 287        children: [
 288          pw.Row(
 289            children: [
 290              pw.Container(
 291                width: 12,
 292                height: 12,
 293                decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
 294                  shape: pw.BoxShape.circle,
 295                  border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey),
 296                  color: isTrueCorrect ? PdfColors.green700 : null,
 297                ),
 298              ),
 299              pw.SizedBox(width: 8),
 300              pw.Text(isEnglish ? 'True' : 'صح', style: regular, textDirection: textDir),
 301            ],
 302          ),
 303          pw.Row(
 304            children: [
 305              pw.Container(
 306                width: 12,
 307                height: 12,
 308                decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
 309                  shape: pw.BoxShape.circle,
 310                  border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey),
 311                  color: isFalseCorrect ? PdfColors.green700 : null,
 312                ),
 313              ),
 314              pw.SizedBox(width: 8),
 315              pw.Text(isEnglish ? 'False' : 'خطأ', style: regular, textDirection: textDir),
 316            ],
 317          ),
 318        ],
 319      );
 320    } else if (q.type == 'matching') {
 321      List<String> columnA = [];
 322      List<String> columnB = [];
 323      
 324      if (q.options is MatchingOptionsModel) {
 325        columnA = (q.options as MatchingOptionsModel).columnA;
 326        columnB = (q.options as MatchingOptionsModel).columnB;
 327      } else if (q.options is Map) {
 328        columnA = List<String>.from(q.options['column_a'] ?? []);
 329        columnB = List<String>.from(q.options['column_b'] ?? []);
 330      }
 331
 332      return pw.Row(
 333        crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 334        children: [
 335          pw.Expanded(
 336            child: pw.Column(
 337              crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 338              children: columnA.map((a) => pw.Padding(
 339                padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
 340                child: pw.Text('• $a', style: regular, textDirection: textDir),
 341              )).toList(),
 342            ),
 343          ),
 344          pw.SizedBox(width: 20),
 345          pw.Expanded(
 346            child: pw.Column(
 347              crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 348              children: columnB.map((b) => pw.Padding(
 349                padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
 350                child: pw.Text('• $b', style: regular, textDirection: textDir),
 351              )).toList(),
 352            ),
 353          ),
 354        ],
 355      );
 356    } else if (q.type == 'essay') {
 357      return pw.Container(
 358        height: 60,
 359        width: double.infinity,
 360        decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
 361          border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
 362          borderRadius: const pw.BorderRadius.all(pw.Radius.circular(8)),
 363        ),
 364      );
 365    }
 366    return pw.SizedBox();
 367  }
 368}

   1import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   3
   4abstract class BankQuestionsState {}
   5
   6class BankQuestionsInitial extends BankQuestionsState {}
   7
   8class BankQuestionsLoading extends BankQuestionsState {}
   9
  10class BankQuestionsError extends BankQuestionsState {
  11  final String message;
  12  BankQuestionsError(this.message);
  13}
  14
  15class BankQuestionsUpdated extends BankQuestionsState {
  16  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> questions;
  17  final List<int> selectedQuestionIds;
  18  final Map<int, List<int>> allSelectedQuestionIds;
  19  final int currentPage;
  20  final int lastPage;
  21  final bool hasMore;
  22  final String? selectedType;
  23  
  24  BankQuestionsUpdated({
  25    required this.questions,
  26    required this.selectedQuestionIds,
  27    required this.allSelectedQuestionIds,
  28    required this.currentPage,
  29    required this.lastPage,
  30    required this.hasMore,
  31    this.selectedType,
  32  });
  33}
  34
  35class BankQuestionsCubit extends Cubit<BankQuestionsState> {
  36  BankQuestionsCubit() : super(BankQuestionsInitial());
  37
  38  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _allQuestions = [];
  39  final Map<int, List<int>> _allSelectedQuestionIds = {};
  40  int _currentLessonId = -1;
  41  int _currentPage = 1;
  42  int _lastPage = 1;
  43  bool _isLoadingMore = false;
  44  String? _selectedType;
  45
  46  void setFilter(String? type) {
  47    if (_selectedType == type) return;
  48    _selectedType = type;
  49    if (_currentLessonId != -1) {
  50      _currentPage = 1;
  51      _allQuestions = [];
  52      if (!isClosed) emit(BankQuestionsLoading());
  53      loadQuestionsForLesson(_currentLessonId, refresh: true);
  54    }
  55  }
  56
  57  Future<void> loadQuestionsForLesson(int lessonId, {bool refresh = false}) async {
  58    if (refresh || _currentLessonId != lessonId) {
  59      _currentLessonId = lessonId;
  60      _currentPage = 1;
  61      _allQuestions = [];
  62      // Do not clear _allSelectedQuestionIds to keep selection across lessons
  63      if (!isClosed) emit(BankQuestionsLoading());
  64    } else if (_currentPage >= _lastPage || _isLoadingMore) {
  65      return;
  66    } else {
  67      _currentPage++;
  68      _isLoadingMore = true;
  69      // Emit state to show loading more if needed, but here we just update state silently
  70    }
  71
  72    final result = await ApiService.getLessonQuestions(
  73      lessonId: _currentLessonId,
  74      type: _selectedType,
  75      page: _currentPage,
  76    );
  77
  78    if (isClosed) return;
  79
  80    result.fold(
  81      (error) {
  82        if (_currentPage == 1) {
  83          if (!isClosed) emit(BankQuestionsError(error.toString()));
  84        } else {
  85          _currentPage--;
  86          _isLoadingMore = false;
  87        }
  88      },
  89      (data) {
  90        final List<dynamic> questionsData = data['data'] ?? [];
  91        final meta = data['meta'] ?? {};
  92        
  93        _lastPage = meta['last_page'] ?? 1;
  94        
  95        for (var q in questionsData) {
  96          _allQuestions.add({
  97            'id': q['id'],
  98            'type': q['type'],
  99            'difficulty': q['difficulty'],
 100            'question_text': q['question_text'],
 101            'options': q['options'],
 102            'correct_answer': q['correct_answer'],
 103          });
 104        }
 105        
 106        _isLoadingMore = false;
 107        _emitState();
 108      },
 109    );
 110  }
 111
 112  void toggleQuestion(int questionId) {
 113    if (_currentLessonId == -1) return;
 114    _allSelectedQuestionIds[_currentLessonId] ??= [];
 115    
 116    if (_allSelectedQuestionIds[_currentLessonId]!.contains(questionId)) {
 117      _allSelectedQuestionIds[_currentLessonId]!.remove(questionId);
 118    } else {
 119      _allSelectedQuestionIds[_currentLessonId]!.add(questionId);
 120    }
 121    _emitState();
 122  }
 123
 124  void selectAll() {
 125    if (_currentLessonId == -1) return;
 126    _allSelectedQuestionIds[_currentLessonId] ??= [];
 127    
 128    for (var q in _allQuestions) {
 129      if (!_allSelectedQuestionIds[_currentLessonId]!.contains(q['id'])) {
 130        _allSelectedQuestionIds[_currentLessonId]!.add(q['id']);
 131      }
 132    }
 133    _emitState();
 134  }
 135
 136  void clearSelection() {
 137    if (_currentLessonId == -1) return;
 138    _allSelectedQuestionIds[_currentLessonId]?.clear();
 139    _emitState();
 140  }
 141
 142  void _emitState() {
 143    if (isClosed) return;
 144    final selectedForCurrent = _allSelectedQuestionIds[_currentLessonId] ?? [];
 145    emit(BankQuestionsUpdated(
 146      questions: List.from(_allQuestions),
 147      selectedQuestionIds: List.from(selectedForCurrent),
 148      allSelectedQuestionIds: Map.from(_allSelectedQuestionIds),
 149      currentPage: _currentPage,
 150      lastPage: _lastPage,
 151      hasMore: _currentPage < _lastPage,
 152      selectedType: _selectedType,
 153    ));
 154  }
 155  
 156  Map<int, List<int>> get allSelectedQuestionIds => Map.from(_allSelectedQuestionIds);
 157}

   1import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/features/exam_generation/domain/entities/exam_entities.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/exam_generation/domain/usecases/get_my_questions_usecase.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/features/exam_generation/domain/usecases/update_custom_question_usecase.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/exam_generation/presentation/cubit/custom_questions_state.dart';
   6
   7class CustomQuestionsCubit extends Cubit<CustomQuestionsState> {
   8  final GetMyQuestionsUseCase _getMyQuestionsUseCase;
   9  final UpdateCustomQuestionUseCase _updateCustomQuestionUseCase;
  10
  11  int _currentPage = 1;
  12  bool _isLastPage = false;
  13  String _selectedStatus = 'all';
  14  String _searchQuery = '';
  15  QuestionPaginationEntity? _currentPagination;
  16
  17  CustomQuestionsCubit(
  18    this._getMyQuestionsUseCase,
  19    this._updateCustomQuestionUseCase,
  20  ) : super(CustomQuestionsInitial());
  21
  22  static CustomQuestionsCubit get(context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  23
  24  Future<void> fetchQuestions({bool isRefresh = false}) async {
  25    if (isRefresh) {
  26      _currentPage = 1;
  27      _isLastPage = false;
  28      _currentPagination = null;
  29      emit(CustomQuestionsLoading());
  30    } else {
  31      if (_isLastPage || state is CustomQuestionsLoading) return;
  32      emit(CustomQuestionsLoading(isPagination: true));
  33    }
  34
  35    String? statusFilter = _selectedStatus == 'all' ? null : _selectedStatus;
  36    String? searchFilter = _searchQuery.isEmpty ? null : _searchQuery;
  37
  38    final result = await _getMyQuestionsUseCase.execute(
  39      page: _currentPage,
  40      reviewStatus: statusFilter,
  41      search: searchFilter,
  42    );
  43
  44    result.fold(
  45      (failure) {
  46        if (_currentPagination != null) {
  47          emit(CustomQuestionsLoaded(
  48            questions: _currentPagination!,
  49            selectedStatus: _selectedStatus,
  50            searchQuery: _searchQuery,
  51          ));
  52        } else {
  53          emit(CustomQuestionsError(failure.message));
  54        }
  55      },
  56      (pagination) {
  57        _isLastPage = pagination.currentPage >= pagination.lastPage;
  58        
  59        if (isRefresh || _currentPagination == null) {
  60          _currentPagination = pagination;
  61        } else {
  62          final currentQuestions = List<QuestionEntity>.from(_currentPagination!.data);
  63          currentQuestions.addAll(pagination.data);
  64          _currentPagination = QuestionPaginationEntity(
  65            currentPage: pagination.currentPage,
  66            lastPage: pagination.lastPage,
  67            perPage: pagination.perPage,
  68            total: pagination.total,
  69            data: currentQuestions,
  70          );
  71        }
  72        
  73        if (!_isLastPage) {
  74          _currentPage++;
  75        }
  76
  77        emit(CustomQuestionsLoaded(
  78          questions: _currentPagination!,
  79          selectedStatus: _selectedStatus,
  80          searchQuery: _searchQuery,
  81        ));
  82      },
  83    );
  84  }
  85
  86  void changeStatus(String status) {
  87    _selectedStatus = status;
  88    fetchQuestions(isRefresh: true);
  89  }
  90
  91  void searchQuestions(String query) {
  92    _searchQuery = query;
  93    fetchQuestions(isRefresh: true);
  94  }
  95
  96  Future<void> updateQuestion(int questionId, Map<String, dynamic> data) async {
  97    emit(CustomQuestionActionLoading());
  98    
  99    final result = await _updateCustomQuestionUseCase.execute(questionId, data);
 100    
 101    result.fold(
 102      (failure) {
 103        emit(CustomQuestionActionError(failure.message));
 104        if (_currentPagination != null) {
 105          emit(CustomQuestionsLoaded(
 106            questions: _currentPagination!,
 107            selectedStatus: _selectedStatus,
 108            searchQuery: _searchQuery,
 109          ));
 110        }
 111      },
 112      (updatedQuestion) {
 113        emit(CustomQuestionActionSuccess('تم تحديث السؤال بنجاح'));
 114        
 115        if (_currentPagination != null) {
 116          final updatedList = _currentPagination!.data.map((q) {
 117            return q.id == questionId ? updatedQuestion : q;
 118          }).toList();
 119          
 120          _currentPagination = QuestionPaginationEntity(
 121            currentPage: _currentPagination!.currentPage,
 122            lastPage: _currentPagination!.lastPage,
 123            perPage: _currentPagination!.perPage,
 124            total: _currentPagination!.total,
 125            data: updatedList,
 126          );
 127          
 128          emit(CustomQuestionsLoaded(
 129            questions: _currentPagination!,
 130            selectedStatus: _selectedStatus,
 131            searchQuery: _searchQuery,
 132          ));
 133        } else {
 134          fetchQuestions(isRefresh: true);
 135        }
 136      },
 137    );
 138  }
 139}

   1import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

   3import 'package:moean/features/exam_generation/data/models/curriculum_models.dart';
   4
   5enum GenerationSource {
   6  aiOnly,
   7  mixed,
   8}
   9abstract class ExamInfoState {}
  10
  11class ExamInfoInitial extends ExamInfoState {}
  12
  13class ExamInfoLoading extends ExamInfoState {}
  14
  15class ExamInfoError extends ExamInfoState {
  16  final String message;
  17  ExamInfoError(this.message);
  18}
  19
  20class ExamInfoUpdated extends ExamInfoState {
  21  final CurriculumStageModel? selectedStage;
  22  final String? selectedSemester;
  23  final String? selectedTrack;
  24  final CurriculumGradeModel? selectedGrade;
  25  final CurriculumSubjectModel? selectedSubject;
  26  final String? unitName;
  27  final String? examTitle;
  28  final List<CurriculumStageModel> stages;
  29  final String difficulty;
  30  final GenerationSource generationSource;
  31  final Map<int, List<int>> selectedBankQuestionIds;
  32  final List<String> availableUnits;
  33  final bool isUnitsLoading;
  34
  35  ExamInfoUpdated({
  36    required this.selectedStage,
  37    required this.selectedSemester,
  38    required this.selectedTrack,
  39    required this.selectedGrade,
  40    required this.selectedSubject,
  41    this.unitName,
  42    this.examTitle,
  43    required this.stages,
  44    required this.difficulty,
  45    required this.generationSource,
  46    required this.selectedBankQuestionIds,
  47    required this.availableUnits,
  48    required this.isUnitsLoading,
  49  });
  50}
  51
  52class ExamInfoCubit extends Cubit<ExamInfoState> {
  53  ExamInfoCubit() : super(ExamInfoInitial()) {
  54    _loadSubjects();
  55  }
  56
  57  CurriculumStageModel? selectedStage;
  58  String? selectedSemester;
  59  String? selectedTrack;
  60  CurriculumGradeModel? selectedGrade;
  61  CurriculumSubjectModel? selectedSubject;
  62  String? unitName;
  63  String? examTitle;
  64  
  65  String difficulty = 'medium';
  66  GenerationSource generationSource = GenerationSource.aiOnly;
  67  final Map<int, List<int>> selectedBankQuestionIds = {};
  68  
  69  List<CurriculumStageModel> stages = [];
  70  List<String> availableUnits = [];
  71  bool isUnitsLoading = false;
  72
  73  List<String> get availableTracks {
  74    if (selectedStage == null) return [];
  75    return selectedStage!.grades
  76        .map((g) => g.track)
  77        .whereType<String>()
  78        .where((t) => t.isNotEmpty)
  79        .toSet()
  80        .toList();
  81  }
  82
  83  List<CurriculumGradeModel> get availableGrades {
  84    if (selectedStage == null) return [];
  85    if (availableTracks.isNotEmpty) {
  86      if (selectedTrack == null) return [];
  87      return selectedStage!.grades.where((g) => g.track == selectedTrack).toList();
  88    }
  89    return selectedStage!.grades;
  90  }
  91
  92  Future<void> _loadSubjects() async {
  93    if (!isClosed) emit(ExamInfoLoading());
  94    final endpoint = '/subjects';
  95    
  96    // --- Console Print ---
  97    print('========== API CALL ==========');
  98    print('ENDPOINT: $endpoint');
  99    print('METHOD: GET');
 100    print('BODY: {}');
 101    print('==============================');
 102    // ---------------------
 103
 104    final result = await ApiService.getSubjects();
 105    if (isClosed) return;
 106    result.fold(
 107      (dynamic failure) {
 108        if (!isClosed) emit(ExamInfoError(failure?.message ?? 'Unknown error'));
 109      },
 110      (data) {
 111        stages = data;
 112        _emitUpdated();
 113      },
 114    );
 115  }
 116
 117  void retry() {
 118    _loadSubjects();
 119  }
 120
 121  void updateInfo({
 122    CurriculumStageModel? stage,
 123    String? semester,
 124    String? track,
 125    CurriculumGradeModel? grade,
 126    CurriculumSubjectModel? subject,
 127    String? unitName,
 128    String? examTitle,
 129    String? difficulty,
 130  }) {
 131    if (stage != null) {
 132      selectedStage = stage;
 133      selectedSemester = null;
 134      selectedTrack = null;
 135      selectedGrade = null;
 136      selectedSubject = null;
 137      this.unitName = null;
 138      this.examTitle = null;
 139    }
 140    if (semester != null) {
 141      selectedSemester = semester;
 142    }
 143    if (track != null) {
 144      selectedTrack = track;
 145      selectedGrade = null;
 146      selectedSubject = null;
 147      this.unitName = null;
 148      this.examTitle = null;
 149    }
 150    if (grade != null) {
 151      selectedGrade = grade;
 152      selectedSubject = null;
 153      this.unitName = null;
 154      this.examTitle = null;
 155    }
 156    if (subject != null) {
 157      selectedSubject = subject;
 158      this.unitName = null;
 159      this.examTitle = null;
 160      _loadUnitsForSubject(subject.id);
 161    }
 162    if (unitName != null) {
 163      this.unitName = unitName;
 164    }
 165    if (examTitle != null) {
 166      this.examTitle = examTitle;
 167    }
 168    if (difficulty != null) {
 169      this.difficulty = difficulty;
 170    }
 171
 172    _emitUpdated();
 173  }
 174
 175  Future<void> _loadUnitsForSubject(int subjectId) async {
 176    isUnitsLoading = true;
 177    availableUnits = [];
 178    final endpoint = '/subjects/$subjectId/lessons';
 179    
 180    // --- Console Print ---
 181    print('========== API CALL ==========');
 182    print('ENDPOINT: $endpoint');
 183    print('METHOD: GET');
 184    print('BODY: {}');
 185    print('==============================');
 186    // ---------------------
 187
 188    _emitUpdated();
 189
 190    final result = await ApiService.getSubjectLessons(subjectId);
 191    if (isClosed) return;
 192    
 193    isUnitsLoading = false;
 194    result.fold(
 195      (failure) {
 196        _emitUpdated();
 197      },
 198      (data) {
 199        final units = data.chapters
 200            .where((c) => selectedSemester == null || c.semester == selectedSemester)
 201            .map((c) => (c.unitName != null && c.unitName!.isNotEmpty) ? c.unitName! : c.title)
 202            .where((u) => u.isNotEmpty)
 203            .toSet()
 204            .toList();
 205        availableUnits = units;
 206        _emitUpdated();
 207      }
 208    );
 209  }
 210
 211  void updateSelectedBankQuestions(Map<int, List<int>> questionIdsMap) {
 212    selectedBankQuestionIds.clear();
 213    selectedBankQuestionIds.addAll(questionIdsMap);
 214    _emitUpdated();
 215  }
 216
 217  void updateGenerationSource(GenerationSource source) {
 218    generationSource = source;
 219    _emitUpdated();
 220  }
 221
 222  void _emitUpdated() {
 223    if (!isClosed) {
 224      emit(ExamInfoUpdated(
 225        selectedStage: selectedStage,
 226        selectedSemester: selectedSemester,
 227        selectedTrack: selectedTrack,
 228        selectedGrade: selectedGrade,
 229        selectedSubject: selectedSubject,
 230        unitName: unitName,
 231        examTitle: examTitle,
 232        stages: stages,
 233        difficulty: difficulty,
 234        generationSource: generationSource,
 235        selectedBankQuestionIds: Map.from(selectedBankQuestionIds),
 236        availableUnits: availableUnits,
 237        isUnitsLoading: isUnitsLoading,
 238      ));
 239    }
 240  }
 241
 242  bool get isValid =>

 246    selectedGrade != null && 
 247    selectedSubject != null && 
 248    difficulty.isNotEmpty;

   8abstract class ExamPreviewState {}

  10class ExamPreviewInitial extends ExamPreviewState {}
  11
  12class ExamPreviewLoading extends ExamPreviewState {}
  13
  14class ExamPreviewLoaded extends ExamPreviewState {
  15  final ExamEntity exam;
  16  final bool isTeacherMode;
  17  final bool showAnswers;
  18  
  19  // Local changes for provisional calculation before saving
  20  final Map<int, double> pendingPointsChanges;
  21
  22  ExamPreviewLoaded({
  23    required this.exam,
  24    this.isTeacherMode = true,
  25    this.showAnswers = true,
  26    this.pendingPointsChanges = const {},
  27  });
  28  
  29  double get provisionalTotalPoints {
  30    double total = 0.0;
  31    for (var q in exam.questions) {
  32      if (pendingPointsChanges.containsKey(q.id)) {
  33        total += pendingPointsChanges[q.id]!;
  34      } else {
  35        total += q.points;
  36      }
  37    }
  38    return total;
  39  }
  40
  41  ExamPreviewLoaded copyWith({
  42    ExamEntity? exam,
  43    bool? isTeacherMode,
  44    bool? showAnswers,
  45    Map<int, double>? pendingPointsChanges,
  46  }) {
  47    return ExamPreviewLoaded(
  48      exam: exam ?? this.exam,
  49      isTeacherMode: isTeacherMode ?? this.isTeacherMode,
  50      showAnswers: showAnswers ?? this.showAnswers,
  51      pendingPointsChanges: pendingPointsChanges ?? this.pendingPointsChanges,
  52    );
  53  }
  54}
  55
  56class ExamPreviewError extends ExamPreviewState {
  57  final String message;
  58  ExamPreviewError(this.message);
  59}
  60
  61class ExamPreviewPaymentRequired extends ExamPreviewState {
  62  final String message;
  63  final String code;
  64  final ExamPreviewLoaded loadedState; // So we can revert safely
  65  ExamPreviewPaymentRequired(this.message, this.code, this.loadedState);
  66}
  67
  68class ExamPreviewSaving extends ExamPreviewLoaded {
  69  ExamPreviewSaving(ExamPreviewLoaded state) : super(
  70    exam: state.exam,
  71    isTeacherMode: state.isTeacherMode,
  72    showAnswers: state.showAnswers,
  73    pendingPointsChanges: state.pendingPointsChanges,
  74  );
  75}
  76
  77class ExamPreviewCubit extends Cubit<ExamPreviewState> {
  78  final GetExamUseCase getExamUseCase;
  79  final UpdateQuestionPointsUseCase updateQuestionPointsUseCase;
  80  final ExamRepository examRepository;
  81
  82  ExamPreviewCubit({
  83    required this.getExamUseCase,
  84    required this.updateQuestionPointsUseCase,
  85    required this.examRepository,
  86  }) : super(ExamPreviewInitial());
  87
  88  Future<void> loadExam(int id) async {
  89    if (!isClosed) emit(ExamPreviewLoading());
  90
  91    final result = await getExamUseCase.execute(id);
  92    if (isClosed) return;
  93
  94    result.fold(
  95      (failure) {
  96        if (!isClosed) emit(ExamPreviewError(failure.message));
  97      },
  98      (exam) {
  99        if (!isClosed) emit(ExamPreviewLoaded(exam: exam));
 100      },
 101    );
 102  }
 103
 104  void toggleMode(bool isTeacher) {
 105    if (state is ExamPreviewLoaded) {
 106      final current = state as ExamPreviewLoaded;
 107      if (!isClosed) {
 108        emit(ExamPreviewLoaded(
 109          exam: current.exam,
 110          isTeacherMode: isTeacher,
 111          showAnswers: current.showAnswers,
 112          pendingPointsChanges: current.pendingPointsChanges,
 113        ));
 114      }
 115    }
 116  }
 117
 118  void toggleAnswers(bool show) {
 119    if (state is ExamPreviewLoaded) {
 120      final current = state as ExamPreviewLoaded;
 121      if (!isClosed) {
 122        emit(ExamPreviewLoaded(
 123          exam: current.exam,
 124          isTeacherMode: current.isTeacherMode,
 125          showAnswers: show,
 126          pendingPointsChanges: current.pendingPointsChanges,
 127        ));
 128      }
 129    }
 130  }
 131
 132  void updatePendingPoints(int questionId, double points) {
 133    if (state is ExamPreviewLoaded) {
 134      final currentState = state as ExamPreviewLoaded;
 135      final newPending = Map<int, double>.from(currentState.pendingPointsChanges);
 136      newPending[questionId] = points;
 137      
 138      if (!isClosed) {
 139        emit(currentState.copyWith(
 140          pendingPointsChanges: newPending,
 141        ));
 142      }
 143    }
 144  }
 145
 146  Future<void> addManualQuestion(Map<String, dynamic> request) async {
 147    if (state is ExamPreviewLoaded) {
 148      final loadedState = state as ExamPreviewLoaded;
 149      if (!isClosed) emit(ExamPreviewSaving(loadedState));
 150
 151      final result = await examRepository.addManualQuestion(request);
 152      if (isClosed) return;
 153
 154      result.fold(
 155        (failure) {
 156          if (!isClosed) {
 157            if (failure is PaymentRequiredFailure) {
 158              emit(ExamPreviewPaymentRequired(failure.message, failure.code, loadedState));
 159            } else {
 160              emit(ExamPreviewError(failure.message));
 161            }
 162            // Restore previous state
 163            emit(loadedState);
 164          }
 165        },
 166        (updatedExam) {
 167          if (!isClosed) {
 168            emit(ExamPreviewLoaded(
 169              exam: updatedExam,
 170              isTeacherMode: loadedState.isTeacherMode,
 171              showAnswers: loadedState.showAnswers,
 172              pendingPointsChanges: const {},
 173            ));
 174          }
 175        },
 176      );
 177    }
 178  }
 179
 180  Future<void> savePoints() async {
 181    if (state is! ExamPreviewLoaded) return;
 182    
 183    final current = state as ExamPreviewLoaded;
 184    if (current.pendingPointsChanges.isEmpty) return; // nothing to save
 185
 186    final examId = current.exam.id;
 187    
 188    // Prepare the list of questions to update
 189    final updates = current.pendingPointsChanges.entries.map((e) {
 190      return {
 191        'question_id': e.key,
 192        'points': e.value,
 193      };
 194    }).toList();
 195
 196    if (!isClosed) emit(ExamPreviewSaving(current));
 197
 198    final result = await updateQuestionPointsUseCase.execute(examId, updates);
 199    if (isClosed) return;
 200
 201    result.fold(
 202      (failure) {
 203        if (!isClosed) {
 204          emit(ExamPreviewError(failure.message));
 205          // Reload exam after failure to reset UI to actual backend state
 206          loadExam(examId);
 207        }
 208      },
 209      (exam) {
 210        if (!isClosed) emit(ExamPreviewLoaded(exam: exam, pendingPointsChanges: const {})); // Clear pending on success
 211      },
 212    );
 213  }
 214}

  24  final String code;

  27
  28class GenerateExamCubit extends Cubit<GenerateExamState> {
  29  final GenerateExamUseCase generateExamUseCase;
  30
  31  GenerateExamCubit(this.generateExamUseCase) : super(GenerateExamInitial());
  32
  33  Future<void> generate({
  34    String? title,
  35    required String grade,
  36    required String subject,
  37    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> lessons,
  38    required Map<int, RequestedCountsEntity> counts,
  39    Map<int, List<int>>? selectedQuestionIds,
  40  }) async {
  41    if (!isClosed) emit(GenerateExamLoading());
  42
  43    // Map the selected lessons with their respective requested counts to match the API contract
  44    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> requestedLessons = [];
  45    for (final lesson in lessons) {
  46      final id = lesson['id'] as int;
  47      final requestedCounts = counts[id];
  48      final selectedIds = selectedQuestionIds?[id] ?? [];
  49      
  50      if (requestedCounts != null || selectedIds.isNotEmpty) {
  51        requestedLessons.add({
  52          'lesson_id': id,
  53          'lesson_name': lesson['name'],
  54          if (selectedIds.isNotEmpty) 'selected_question_ids': selectedIds,
  55          'requested_counts': {
  56            'mcq': requestedCounts?.mcq ?? 0,
  57            'true_false': requestedCounts?.trueFalse ?? 0,
  58            'fill_blank': requestedCounts?.fillBlank ?? 0,
  59            'essay': requestedCounts?.essay ?? 0,
  60            'matching': requestedCounts?.matching ?? 0,
  61          }
  62        });
  63      }
  64    }
  65
  66    final result = await generateExamUseCase.execute(
  67      title: title ?? '', // Title will be auto-generated by the backend if empty
  68      grade: grade,
  69      subject: subject,
  70      lessons: requestedLessons,
  71    );
  72
  73    if (isClosed) return;
  74
  75    result.fold(
  76      (failure) {
  77        if (!isClosed) {
  78          if (failure is PaymentRequiredFailure) {
  79            emit(GenerateExamPaymentRequired(failure.message, failure.code));
  80          } else {
  81            emit(GenerateExamError(failure.message));
  82          }
  83        }
  84      },
  85      (exam) {
  86        if (!isClosed) emit(GenerateExamSuccess(exam));
  87      },
  88    );

  90}

   1import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

   4
   5abstract class LessonSelectionState {}
   6
   7class LessonSelectionInitial extends LessonSelectionState {}
   8
   9class LessonSelectionLoading extends LessonSelectionState {}
  10
  11class LessonSelectionError extends LessonSelectionState {
  12  final String message;
  13  LessonSelectionError(this.message);
  14}
  15
  16class LessonSelectionUpdated extends LessonSelectionState {
  17  final SubjectDetailsModel? subjectDetails;
  18  final List<CurriculumChapterModel> filteredChapters;
  19  final List<CurriculumLessonModel> selectedLessons;
  20  final String searchQuery;
  21  final List<String> availableSemesters;
  22  final String? selectedSemester;
  23
  24  LessonSelectionUpdated({
  25    required this.subjectDetails,
  26    required this.filteredChapters,
  27    required this.selectedLessons,
  28    required this.searchQuery,
  29    required this.availableSemesters,
  30    required this.selectedSemester,
  31  });
  32}
  33
  34class LessonSelectionCubit extends Cubit<LessonSelectionState> {
  35  LessonSelectionCubit() : super(LessonSelectionInitial());
  36
  37  SubjectDetailsModel? _subjectDetails;
  38  final List<CurriculumLessonModel> _selectedLessons = [];
  39  String _searchQuery = '';
  40  int? _currentSubjectId;
  41  String? _selectedSemester;
  42  String? _selectedUnitName;
  43
  44  Future<void> loadLessonsForSubjectId(int subjectId, {String? unitName}) async {
  45    _selectedUnitName = unitName;
  46    if (_currentSubjectId == subjectId && _subjectDetails != null) {
  47      _emitState();
  48      return; // Already loaded
  49    }
  50
  51    _currentSubjectId = subjectId;
  52    if (!isClosed) emit(LessonSelectionLoading());
  53
  54    final result = await ApiService.getSubjectLessons(subjectId);
  55    if (isClosed) return;
  56    
  57    result.fold(
  58      (dynamic failure) {
  59        if (!isClosed) emit(LessonSelectionError(failure?.message ?? 'Unknown error'));
  60      },
  61      (details) {
  62        _subjectDetails = details;
  63        
  64        // Remove selected lessons that are no longer in this subject
  65        final allLessonsIds = details.chapters.expand((c) => c.lessons).map((l) => l.id).toSet();
  66        _selectedLessons.removeWhere((selected) => !allLessonsIds.contains(selected.id));
  67        
  68        _emitState();
  69      },
  70    );
  71  }
  72
  73  void selectSemester(String? semester) {
  74    _selectedSemester = semester;
  75    _emitState();
  76  }
  77
  78  void retry() {
  79    if (_currentSubjectId != null) {
  80      loadLessonsForSubjectId(_currentSubjectId!, unitName: _selectedUnitName);
  81    }
  82  }
  83
  84  void search(String query) {
  85    _searchQuery = query.toLowerCase();
  86    _emitState();
  87  }
  88
  89  String _normalizeArabic(String text) {
  90    return text
  91        .replaceAll('أ', 'ا')
  92        .replaceAll('إ', 'ا')
  93        .replaceAll('آ', 'ا')
  94        .replaceAll('ة', 'ه');
  95  }
  96
  97  void toggleLesson(CurriculumLessonModel lesson) {
  98    if (_selectedLessons.any((l) => l.id == lesson.id)) {
  99      _selectedLessons.removeWhere((l) => l.id == lesson.id);
 100    } else {
 101      _selectedLessons.add(lesson);
 102    }
 103    _emitState();
 104  }
 105
 106  void removeLesson(int lessonId) {
 107    _selectedLessons.removeWhere((l) => l.id == lessonId);
 108    _emitState();
 109  }
 110
 111  void _emitState() {
 112    final normalizedQuery = _normalizeArabic(_searchQuery);
 113    
 114    List<CurriculumChapterModel> filtered = [];
 115    if (_subjectDetails != null) {
 116      for (var chapter in _subjectDetails!.chapters) {
 117        if (_selectedSemester != null && chapter.semester != _selectedSemester) {
 118          continue;
 119        }
 120
 121        if (_selectedUnitName != null && _selectedUnitName!.isNotEmpty) {
 122          final chapterUnitName = (chapter.unitName != null && chapter.unitName!.isNotEmpty) ? chapter.unitName! : chapter.title;
 123          if (chapterUnitName != _selectedUnitName) {
 124            continue;
 125          }
 126        }
 127        
 128        final matchingLessons = chapter.lessons.where((l) {
 129          final name = l.title.toLowerCase();
 130          final normalizedName = _normalizeArabic(name);
 131          return normalizedName.contains(normalizedQuery);
 132        }).toList();
 133        
 134        if (matchingLessons.isNotEmpty) {
 135          filtered.add(CurriculumChapterModel(
 136            chapterId: chapter.chapterId,
 137            title: chapter.title,
 138            semester: chapter.semester,
 139            unitId: chapter.unitId,
 140            unitName: chapter.unitName,
 141            lessons: matchingLessons,
 142          ));
 143        }
 144      }
 145    }
 146
 147    emit(LessonSelectionUpdated(
 148      subjectDetails: _subjectDetails,
 149      filteredChapters: filtered,
 150      selectedLessons: List.from(_selectedLessons),
 151      searchQuery: _searchQuery,
 152      availableSemesters: _subjectDetails?.chapters.map((c) => c.semester).toSet().toList() ?? [],
 153      selectedSemester: _selectedSemester,
 154    ));
 155  }
 156  
 157  List<CurriculumLessonModel> get selectedLessons => _selectedLessons;
 158  bool get hasSelection => _selectedLessons.isNotEmpty;
 159}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

   6
   7class ManualExamCubit extends Cubit<ManualExamState> {
   8  final AddManualQuestionUseCase addManualQuestionUseCase;
   9
  10  String selectedQuestionType = 'mcq';
  11  int? selectedLessonId;
  12  
  13  final TextEditingController gradeController = TextEditingController(text: '1');
  14  final TextEditingController questionTextController = TextEditingController();
  15  final TextEditingController correctAnswerController = TextEditingController();
  16  
  17  List<TextEditingController> optionsControllers = [
  18    TextEditingController(), TextEditingController(), TextEditingController(), TextEditingController()
  19  ];
  20  
  21  List<TextEditingController> columnAControllers = [TextEditingController(), TextEditingController()];
  22  List<TextEditingController> columnBControllers = [TextEditingController(), TextEditingController()];
  23
  24  ManualExamCubit(this.addManualQuestionUseCase) : super(ManualExamInitial());
  25
  26  static ManualExamCubit get(context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  27
  28  void changeQuestionType(String type) {
  29    selectedQuestionType = type;
  30    emit(ManualExamFormUpdated());
  31  }
  32
  33  void updateGrade(String newGrade) {}
  34
  35  void updateLesson(int lessonId) {
  36    selectedLessonId = lessonId;
  37    emit(ManualExamFormUpdated());
  38  }
  39
  40  void addOption() {
  41    optionsControllers.add(TextEditingController());
  42    emit(ManualExamFormUpdated());
  43  }
  44
  45  void removeOption(int index) {
  46    if (optionsControllers.length > 2) {
  47      optionsControllers[index].dispose();
  48      optionsControllers.removeAt(index);
  49      emit(ManualExamFormUpdated());
  50    }
  51  }
  52
  53  void addMatchingItem() {
  54    columnAControllers.add(TextEditingController());
  55    columnBControllers.add(TextEditingController());
  56    emit(ManualExamFormUpdated());
  57  }
  58
  59  void removeMatchingItem(int index) {
  60    if (columnAControllers.length > 2) {
  61      columnAControllers[index].dispose();
  62      columnBControllers[index].dispose();
  63      columnAControllers.removeAt(index);
  64      columnBControllers.removeAt(index);
  65      emit(ManualExamFormUpdated());
  66    }
  67  }
  68
  69  Future<void> submitQuestion(int examId) async {
  70    final questionText = questionTextController.text;
  71    if (selectedLessonId == null || questionText.trim().isEmpty) {
  72      emit(ManualExamError('Please fill all required fields'));
  73      return;
  74    }
  75
  76    if (!isClosed) emit(ManualExamLoading());
  77
  78    final request = <String, dynamic>{
  79      'exam_id': examId,
  80      'lesson_id': selectedLessonId,
  81      'type': selectedQuestionType,
  82      'question_text': questionText.trim(),
  83      'points': double.tryParse(gradeController.text) ?? 1.0,
  84    };
  85
  86    final correctAnswer = correctAnswerController.text.trim();
  87
  88    if (selectedQuestionType == 'mcq') {
  89      final validOptions = optionsControllers.map((c) => c.text.trim()).where((o) => o.isNotEmpty).toList();
  90      if (validOptions.length < 2) {
  91        if (!isClosed) emit(ManualExamError('MCQ requires at least 2 options'));
  92        return;
  93      }
  94      if (!validOptions.contains(correctAnswer)) {
  95         if (!isClosed) emit(ManualExamError('Correct answer must match one of the options'));
  96         return;
  97      }
  98      request['options'] = validOptions;
  99      request['correct_answer'] = correctAnswer;
 100    } else if (selectedQuestionType == 'matching') {
 101      final validColA = columnAControllers.map((c) => c.text.trim()).where((o) => o.isNotEmpty).toList();
 102      final validColB = columnBControllers.map((c) => c.text.trim()).where((o) => o.isNotEmpty).toList();
 103      if (validColA.isEmpty || validColB.isEmpty) {
 104        if (!isClosed) emit(ManualExamError('Matching columns cannot be empty'));
 105        return;
 106      }
 107      request['options'] = {
 108        'column_a': validColA,
 109        'column_b': validColB,
 110      };
 111      request['correct_answer'] = correctAnswer;
 112    } else {
 113      // True/False, Essay, Fill Blank
 114      request['correct_answer'] = correctAnswer;
 115    }
 116
 117    final result = await addManualQuestionUseCase(request);
 118    if (isClosed) return;
 119
 120    result.fold(
 121      (failure) {
 122        if (!isClosed) {
 123          if (failure is PaymentRequiredFailure) {
 124            emit(ManualExamPaymentRequired(failure.message, failure.code));
 125          } else {
 126            emit(ManualExamError(failure.message));
 127          }
 128        }
 129      },
 130      (exam) {
 131        if (!isClosed) emit(ManualExamSuccess('Question added successfully'));
 132      },
 133    );
 134  }
 135
 136  @override
 137  Future<void> close() {
 138    gradeController.dispose();
 139    questionTextController.dispose();
 140    correctAnswerController.dispose();
 141    for (var c in optionsControllers) { c.dispose(); }
 142    for (var c in columnAControllers) { c.dispose(); }
 143    for (var c in columnBControllers) { c.dispose(); }
 144    return super.close();
 145  }
 146}

  13  int _currentPage = 1;

  15  MyExamsCubit(this._examRepository) : super(MyExamsInitial());
  16
  17  static MyExamsCubit get(context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  18
  19  void fetchExams({bool isRefresh = false}) async {
  20    if (isRefresh) {
  21      _currentPage = 1;
  22    }
  23
  24    if (_currentPage == 1) {
  25      if (!isClosed) emit(MyExamsLoading());
  26    }
  27
  28    String? statusQuery;
  29    if (_currentTab == 'draft') {
  30      statusQuery = 'draft';
  31    } else if (_currentTab == 'published') {
  32      statusQuery = 'published';
  33    }
  34
  35    final result = await _examRepository.getMyExams(
  36      page: _currentPage,
  37      perPage: 20,
  38      status: statusQuery,
  39      search: _searchQuery.isNotEmpty ? _searchQuery : null,
  40    );
  41
  42    if (isClosed) return;
  43
  44    result.fold(
  45      (failure) {
  46        if (!isClosed) emit(MyExamsError(failure.message));
  47      },
  48      (examsPagination) {
  49        if (!isClosed) {
  50          emit(MyExamsLoaded(
  51            exams: examsPagination,
  52            selectedTab: _currentTab,
  53            searchQuery: _searchQuery,
  54          ));
  55        }
  56      },
  57    );
  58  }
  59
  60  void changeTab(String tab) {
  61    if (_currentTab == tab) return;
  62    _currentTab = tab;
  63    _currentPage = 1;
  64    fetchExams();
  65  }
  66
  67  void searchExams(String query) {
  68    if (_searchQuery == query) return;
  69    
  70    if (_debounce?.isActive ?? false) _debounce?.cancel();
  71    
  72    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), () {
  73      if (isClosed) return;
  74      _searchQuery = query;
  75      _currentPage = 1;
  76      fetchExams();
  77    });
  78  }
  79
  80  Future<void> publishExam(int examId) async {
  81    final currentState = state;
  82    if (currentState is! MyExamsLoaded) return;
  83    
  84    if (!isClosed) emit(MyExamsActionLoading(action: 'publish', examId: examId));
  85    
  86    final result = await _examRepository.publishExam(examId);
  87
  88    if (isClosed) return;
  89    
  90    result.fold(
  91      (failure) {
  92        if (!isClosed) {
  93          emit(MyExamsActionError(failure.message));
  94          // Re-emit loaded state so UI recovers
  95          emit(currentState);
  96        }
  97      },
  98      (exam) {
  99        if (!isClosed) {
 100          emit(MyExamsActionSuccess('تم نشر الاختبار بنجاح'));
 101          fetchExams(isRefresh: true);
 102        }
 103      },
 104    );
 105  }
 106
 107  Future<void> deleteExam(int examId) async {
 108    final currentState = state;
 109    if (currentState is! MyExamsLoaded) return;
 110    
 111    if (!isClosed) emit(MyExamsActionLoading(action: 'delete', examId: examId));
 112    
 113    final result = await _examRepository.deleteExam(examId);
 114
 115    if (isClosed) return;
 116    
 117    result.fold(
 118      (failure) {
 119        if (!isClosed) {
 120          emit(MyExamsActionError(failure.message));
 121          // Re-emit loaded state so UI recovers
 122          emit(currentState);
 123        }
 124      },
 125      (_) {
 126        if (!isClosed) {
 127          emit(MyExamsActionSuccess('تم حذف الاختبار بنجاح'));
 128          fetchExams(isRefresh: true);
 129        }
 130      },
 131    );
 132  }
 133  
 134  @override
 135  Future<void> close() {
 136    _debounce?.cancel();
 137    return super.close();
 138  }
 139}

   1import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/features/exam_generation/domain/entities/exam_entities.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/exam_generation/data/models/curriculum_models.dart';
   4
   5abstract class QuestionCountState {}
   6
   7class QuestionCountInitial extends QuestionCountState {}
   8
   9class QuestionCountUpdated extends QuestionCountState {
  10  final Map<int, RequestedCountsEntity> counts;
  11  final int totalQuestions;
  12  final int totalLessons;
  13
  14  QuestionCountUpdated({
  15    required this.counts,
  16    required this.totalQuestions,
  17    required this.totalLessons,
  18  });
  19}
  20
  21class QuestionCountCubit extends Cubit<QuestionCountState> {
  22  QuestionCountCubit() : super(QuestionCountInitial());
  23
  24  // Store counts efficiently
  25  final Map<int, RequestedCountsEntity> _counts = {};
  26
  27  void initForLessons(List<CurriculumLessonModel> selectedLessons) {
  28    // Retain old counts for lessons still selected, initialize new ones to 0
  29    final newCounts = <int, RequestedCountsEntity>{};
  30    for (final lesson in selectedLessons) {
  31      final int id = lesson.id;
  32      if (_counts.containsKey(id)) {
  33        newCounts[id] = _counts[id]!;
  34      } else {
  35        newCounts[id] = const RequestedCountsEntity(mcq: 0, trueFalse: 0, fillBlank: 0, essay: 0, matching: 0);
  36      }
  37    }
  38    _counts.clear();
  39    _counts.addAll(newCounts);
  40    _emitState();
  41  }
  42
  43  void updateCount(int lessonId, String type, int delta) {
  44    if (!_counts.containsKey(lessonId)) return;
  45    final current = _counts[lessonId]!;
  46    
  47    int newMcq = current.mcq;
  48    int newTrueFalse = current.trueFalse;
  49    int newFillBlank = current.fillBlank;
  50    int newEssay = current.essay;
  51    int newMatching = current.matching;
  52
  53    switch (type) {
  54      case 'mcq':
  55        newMcq = (newMcq + delta).clamp(0, 100);
  56        break;
  57      case 'true_false':
  58        newTrueFalse = (newTrueFalse + delta).clamp(0, 100);
  59        break;
  60      case 'fill_blank':
  61        newFillBlank = (newFillBlank + delta).clamp(0, 100);
  62        break;
  63      case 'essay':
  64        newEssay = (newEssay + delta).clamp(0, 100);
  65        break;
  66      case 'matching':
  67        newMatching = (newMatching + delta).clamp(0, 100);
  68        break;
  69    }
  70
  71    _counts[lessonId] = RequestedCountsEntity(
  72      mcq: newMcq,
  73      trueFalse: newTrueFalse,
  74      fillBlank: newFillBlank,
  75      essay: newEssay,
  76      matching: newMatching,
  77    );
  78
  79    _emitState();
  80  }
  81
  82  void _emitState() {
  83    int total = 0;
  84    for (final count in _counts.values) {
  85      total += count.total;
  86    }
  87    emit(QuestionCountUpdated(
  88      counts: Map.from(_counts),
  89      totalQuestions: total,
  90      totalLessons: _counts.length,
  91    ));
  92  }
  93  
  94  Map<int, RequestedCountsEntity> get counts => _counts;
  95  
  96  int get totalRequestedQuestions {
  97    int total = 0;
  98    for (final count in _counts.values) {
  99      total += count.total;
 100    }
 101    return total;
 102  }
 103}

  23class _CustomQuestionsScreenState extends State<CustomQuestionsScreen> {
  24  final ScrollController _scrollController = ScrollController();
  25  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();

  27  @override

  30    context.read<CustomQuestionsCubit>().fetchQuestions(isRefresh: true);
  31    _scrollController.addListener(_onScroll);
  32  }
  33
  34  void _onScroll() {
  35    if (_scrollController.position.pixels >= _scrollController.position.maxScrollExtent - 200) {
  36      context.read<CustomQuestionsCubit>().fetchQuestions();
  37    }
  38  }
  39
  40  @override
  41  void dispose() {
  42    _scrollController.dispose();
  43    _searchController.dispose();

  47  @override
  48  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  49    return Scaffold(
  50      backgroundColor: ColorsManager.background,
