  56          appTranslation().get('my_custom_questions'),
  57          style: TextStylesManager.bold18,
  58        ),
  59        leading: IconButton(
  60          icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios, color: ColorsManager.mainText),
  61          onPressed: () => context.pop(),
  62        ),
  63      ),
  64      body: Directionality(
  65        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
  66        child: BlocConsumer<CustomQuestionsCubit, CustomQuestionsState>(
  67          listener: (context, state) {
  68            if (state is CustomQuestionActionSuccess) {
  69              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  70                SnackBar(content: Text(state.message), backgroundColor: Colors.green),
  71              );
  72            } else if (state is CustomQuestionActionError) {
  73              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  74                SnackBar(content: Text(state.message), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
  75              );
  76            } else if (state is CustomQuestionsError) {
  77              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  78                SnackBar(content: Text(state.message), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
  79              );
  80            }
  81          },
  82          builder: (context, state) {
  83            bool isLoading = state is CustomQuestionsLoading && !state.isPagination;
  84            bool isPaginationLoading = state is CustomQuestionsLoading && state.isPagination;
  85            QuestionPaginationEntity? paginationEntity;
  86            String selectedStatus = 'all';
  87
  88            if (state is CustomQuestionsLoaded) {
  89              paginationEntity = state.questions;
  90              selectedStatus = state.selectedStatus;
  91            }
  92
  93            return Padding(
  94              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
  95              child: Column(
  96                children: [
  97                  _buildHeaderFilters(context, selectedStatus),
  98                  verticalSpace16,
  99                  Expanded(
 100                    child: ConditionalBuilder(
 101                      loadingState: isLoading,
 102                      emptyState: paginationEntity?.data.isEmpty ?? true,
 103                      emptyBuilder: (context) => Center(
 104                        child: Text(
 105                          appTranslation().get('no_questions_found'),
 106                          style: TextStylesManager.bold16.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.placeholder),
 107                        ),
 108                      ),
 109                      successBuilder: (context) => ListView.separated(
 110                        controller: _scrollController,
 111                        itemCount: (paginationEntity?.data.length ?? 0) + (isPaginationLoading ? 1 : 0),
 112                        separatorBuilder: (_, __) => verticalSpace16,
 113                        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
 114                          if (index == paginationEntity?.data.length) {
 115                            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
 116                          }
 117                          final question = paginationEntity!.data[index];
 118                          return _buildQuestionItem(context, question);
 119                        },
 120                      ),
 121                    ),
 122                  ),
 123                ],
 124              ),
 125            );
 126          },
 127        ),

 162  Widget _buildFilterChip(BuildContext context, String statusKey, String label, String selectedStatus) {
 163    final isSelected = selectedStatus == statusKey;
 164    
 165    Color statusColor;
 166    switch (statusKey) {
 167      case 'approved':
 168        statusColor = Colors.green;
 169        break;
 170      case 'rejected':
 171        statusColor = Colors.red;
 172        break;
 173      case 'pending':
 174        statusColor = Colors.orange;
 175        break;
 176      case 'all':
 177      default:
 178        statusColor = ColorsManager.primaryColor;
 179        break;
 180    }
 181
 182    return GestureDetector(
 183      onTap: () {
 184        context.read<CustomQuestionsCubit>().changeStatus(statusKey);
 185      },
 186      child: Container(
 187        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
 188        decoration: BoxDecoration(
 189          color: isSelected ? ColorsManager.background : statusColor.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
 190          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
 191          border: Border.all(
 192            color: isSelected ? statusColor : Colors.transparent,
 193          ),
 194        ),
 195        child: Text(
 196          label,
 197          style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(
 198            color: statusColor,
 199          ),
 200        ),
 201      ),
 202    );
 203  }

 205  Widget _buildQuestionItem(BuildContext context, QuestionEntity question) {
 206    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
 207    
 208    Color statusColor;
 209    String statusText;
 210    
 211    switch (question.reviewStatus) {
 212      case 'approved':
 213        statusColor = Colors.green;
 214        statusText = appTranslation().get('approved');
 215        break;
 216      case 'rejected':
 217        statusColor = Colors.red;
 218        statusText = appTranslation().get('rejected');
 219        break;
 220      case 'pending':
 221      default:
 222        statusColor = Colors.orange;
 223        statusText = appTranslation().get('pending');
 224        break;
 225    }
 226
 227    List<String> parsedOptions = [];
 228    if (question.options is List) {
 229      parsedOptions = (question.options as List).map((e) => e.toString()).toList();
 230    } else if (question.options is String) {
 231      try {
 232        final decoded = jsonDecode(question.options as String);
 233        if (decoded is List) {
 234          parsedOptions = decoded.map((e) => e.toString()).toList();
 235        }
 236      } catch (e) {
 237        // Ignored
 238      }

 255            children: [

 271              if (question.reviewStatus != 'approved')

 284                          style: TextStylesManager.bold12.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.white),

 288                      ],

 292              else

 294            ],

 296          verticalSpace16,
 297          Row(

 299            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 300            children: [

 302                child: Text(
 303                  question.questionText,
 304                  style: TextStylesManager.bold16,
 305                  textAlign: TextAlign.right,

 308              horizontalSpace12,
 309              Row(
 310                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 311                children: [
 312                  Container(
 313                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
 314                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
 315                      color: statusColor.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
 316                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
 317                      border: Border.all(color: statusColor.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
 318                    ),
 319                    child: Row(
 320                      children: [
 321                        if (question.reviewStatus == 'approved') ...[
 322                          Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline, color: statusColor, size: 16),
 323                          horizontalSpace4,
 324                        ],

 327                          style: TextStylesManager.bold12.copyWith(color: statusColor),
 328                        ),
 329                      ],
 330                    ),
 331                  ),

 333                  Text(

 335                    style: TextStylesManager.bold12.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mutedDark),
 336                  ),

 342            verticalSpace12,

 371              return Container(

 399                style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: const Color(0xFFF57F17)),

 408            textAlign: TextAlign.right,
 409          ),
 410        ],

 412    );
 413  }
 414
 415  String _getQuestionTypeLabel(String type) {
 416    switch (type) {
 417      case 'mcq': return 'اختيار من متعدد';
 418      case 'true_false': return 'صح وخطأ';
 419      case 'essay': return 'مقالي';
 420      case 'fill_blank': return 'أكمل الفراغ';
 421      case 'matching': return 'مزاوجة';
 422      default: return type;
 423    }
 424  }
 425
 426  String _getOptionPrefix(int index) {
 427    const prefixes = ['أ', 'ب', 'ج', 'د', 'هـ', 'و'];
 428    if (index < prefixes.length) {
 429      return prefixes[index];
 430    }
 431    return '${index + 1}';
 432  }
 433
 434  void _showEditQuestionSheet(BuildContext context, QuestionEntity question) {
 435    final TextEditingController textController = TextEditingController(text: question.questionText);
 436    final TextEditingController correctAnswerController = TextEditingController(text: question.correctAnswer);
 437
 438    showModalBottomSheet(
 439      context: context,
 440      isScrollControlled: true,
 441      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
 442        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
 443      ),
 444      builder: (ctx) {
 445        return Padding(
 446          padding: EdgeInsets.only(
 447            bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom,
 448            left: 24,
 449            right: 24,
 450            top: 24,
 451          ),
 452          child: Column(
 453            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 454            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 455            children: [
 456              Text(
 457                appTranslation().get('edit_question'),
 458                style: TextStylesManager.bold18,
 459              ),
 460              verticalSpace16,
 461              PrimaryTextField(
 462                controller: textController,
 463                hint: appTranslation().get('question_text'),
 464                maxLines: 3,
 465              ),
 466              verticalSpace16,
 467              PrimaryTextField(
 468                controller: correctAnswerController,
 469                hint: appTranslation().get('correct_answer'),
 470              ),
 471              verticalSpace24,
 472              PrimaryElevatedButton(
 473                text: appTranslation().get('save'),
 474                onPressed: () {
 475                  final data = {
 476                    'question_text': textController.text.trim(),
 477                    'correct_answer': correctAnswerController.text.trim(),
 478                  };
 479                  context.read<CustomQuestionsCubit>().updateQuestion(question.id, data);
 480                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
 481                },
 482              ),
 483              verticalSpace24,
 484            ],
 485          ),
 486        );
 487      },
 488    );
 489  }

 413  Widget _buildChipsSelection<T>({

 449                  displayText,
 450                  style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(
 451                    color: isSelected ? Colors.white : ColorsManager.mainText,
 452                  ),
 453                ),
 454              ),
 455            );
 456          }).toList(),
 457        ),
 458      ],

 228  Widget _buildQuestionCard(BuildContext context, QuestionEntity q, ExamPreviewLoaded state) {

 263                      },

 265                  else
 266                    Text(
 267                      isEnglish ? '${q.points} point${q.points > 1 ? "s" : ""}' : '${q.points} درجة',
 268                      style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.primaryColor),
 269                    ),
 270                ],
 271              ),
 272              verticalSpace12,
 273              _buildQuestionOptions(q, state.showAnswers, isEnglish),
 274              if (state.isTeacherMode && state.showAnswers && q.type != 'matching' && q.type != 'mcq') ...[
 275                verticalSpace12,
 276                Container(

 278                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 279                    color: ColorsManager.successColor.withValues(alpha:0.1),
 280                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
 281                  ),
 282                  child: Row(
 283                    children: [
 284                      const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: ColorsManager.successColor, size: 16),
 285                      horizontalSpace8,
 286                      Expanded(
 287                        child: Text(
 288                          isEnglish ? 'Answer: ${q.correctAnswer}' : 'الإجابة: ${q.correctAnswer}',
 289                          style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.successColor),
 290                          textDirection: textDir,
 291                        ),
 292                      ),
 293                    ],
 294                  ),
 295                ),
 296              ]
 297            ],
 298          ),
 299        ),
 300      ),
 301    );
 302  }

 304  Widget _buildQuestionOptions(QuestionEntity q, bool showAnswers, bool isEnglish) {
 305    final textDir = isEnglish ? TextDirection.ltr : TextDirection.rtl;
 306
 307    if (q.type == 'mcq') {
 308      final options = List<String>.from(q.options ?? []);
 309      return Column(
 310        children: options.map((opt) {
 311          final isCorrect = opt == q.correctAnswer;
 312          return RadioGroup<String>(
 313            groupValue: showAnswers && isCorrect ? opt : null,
 314            onChanged: (_) {},
 315            child: RadioListTile<String>(
 316              value: opt,
 317              activeColor: ColorsManager.successColor,
 318              title: Text(
 319                opt,
 320                style: showAnswers && isCorrect
 321                    ? TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(
 322                        color: ColorsManager.successColor,
 323                      )
 324                    : TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
 325                        color: ColorsManager.mainText,
 326                      ),
 327                textDirection: textDir,
 328              ),
 329            ),
 330          );
 331        }).toList(),
 332      );
 333    } else if (q.type == 'true_false') {
 334      final isTrueCorrect = showAnswers && (q.correctAnswer == 'صح' || q.correctAnswer.toLowerCase() == 'true');
 335      final isFalseCorrect = showAnswers && (q.correctAnswer == 'خطأ' || q.correctAnswer.toLowerCase() == 'false');
 336
 337      return Row(
 338        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceEvenly,
 339        children: [
 340          Row(
 341            children: [
 342              Radio<String>(
 343                value: 'صح',
 344                groupValue: isTrueCorrect ? 'صح' : null,
 345                activeColor: ColorsManager.successColor,
 346                onChanged: (_) {},
 347              ),
 348              Text(isEnglish ? 'True' : 'صح', style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText)),
 349            ],
 350          ),
 351          Row(
 352            children: [
 353              Radio<String>(
 354                value: 'خطأ',
 355                groupValue: isFalseCorrect ? 'خطأ' : null,
 356                activeColor: ColorsManager.successColor,
 357                onChanged: (_) {},
 358              ),
 359              Text(isEnglish ? 'False' : 'خطأ', style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText)),
 360            ],
 361          ),
 362        ],
 363      );
 364    } else if (q.type == 'matching') {
 365      List<String> columnA = [];
 366      List<String> columnB = [];
 367      
 368      if (q.options is MatchingOptionsModel) {
 369        columnA = (q.options as MatchingOptionsModel).columnA;
 370        columnB = (q.options as MatchingOptionsModel).columnB;
 371      } else if (q.options is Map) {
 372        columnA = List<String>.from(q.options['column_a'] ?? []);
 373        columnB = List<String>.from(q.options['column_b'] ?? []);
 374      }
 375
 376      return Row(
 377        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 378        children: [
 379          Expanded(
 380            child: Column(
 381              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 382              children: columnA.map((a) => Padding(
 383                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
 384                child: Text(a, textDirection: textDir, style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText)),
 385              )).toList(),
 386            ),
 387          ),
 388          const SizedBox(width: 16),
 389          Expanded(
 390            child: Column(
 391              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 392              children: columnB.map((b) => Padding(
 393                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
 394                child: Text(b, textDirection: textDir, style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText)),
 395              )).toList(),
 396            ),
 397          ),
 398        ],
 399      );
 400    } else if (q.type == 'essay') {
 401      return Container(
 402        height: 100,
 403        width: double.infinity,
 404        decoration: BoxDecoration(
 405          color: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
 406          border: Border.all(color: ColorsManager.borderLightGray),
 407          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
 408        ),
 409      );
 410    }
 411    return const SizedBox.shrink();
 412  }

 421  @override
 422  State<_PointsEditor> createState() => _PointsEditorState();
 423}
 424
 425class _PointsEditorState extends State<_PointsEditor> {
 426  late TextEditingController _controller;
 427
 428  @override
 429  void initState() {
 430    super.initState();
 431    _controller = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialPoints.toString());
 432  }
 433
 434  @override
 435  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _PointsEditor oldWidget) {
 436    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
 437    if (oldWidget.initialPoints != widget.initialPoints) {
 438      if (double.tryParse(_controller.text) != widget.initialPoints) {
 439        _controller.text = widget.initialPoints.toString();
 440      }
 441    }
 442  }
 443
 444  @override
 445  void dispose() {
 446    _controller.dispose();
 447    super.dispose();
 448  }
 449
 450  void _increment() {
 451    double current = double.tryParse(_controller.text) ?? widget.initialPoints;
 452    current += 1.0;
 453    _controller.text = current.toString();
 454    widget.onChanged(current);
 455  }
 456
 457  void _decrement() {
 458    double current = double.tryParse(_controller.text) ?? widget.initialPoints;
 459    if (current >= 1.0) {
 460      current -= 1.0;
 461      _controller.text = current.toString();
 462      widget.onChanged(current);
 463    } else if (current > 0) {
 464      current = 0.0;
 465      _controller.text = current.toString();
 466      widget.onChanged(current);
 467    }
 468  }
 469
 470  @override
 471  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 472    return Row(
 473      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
 474      children: [
 475        IconButton(
 476          icon: Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline, size: 24, color: ColorsManager.primaryColor),
 477          onPressed: _increment,
 478          padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
 479          constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
 480        ),
 481        const SizedBox(width: 8),
 482        SizedBox(
 483          width: 80,
 484          child: PrimaryTextField(
 485            controller: _controller,
 486            hint: 'الدرجة',
 487            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
 488            onChanged: (val) {
 489              final parsed = double.tryParse(val);
 490              if (parsed != null && parsed >= 0) {
 491                widget.onChanged(parsed);
 492              }
 493            },
 494          ),
 495        ),
 496        const SizedBox(width: 8),
 497        IconButton(
 498          icon: Icon(Icons.remove_circle_outline, size: 24, color: ColorsManager.primaryColor),
 499          onPressed: _decrement,
 500          padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
 501          constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
 502        ),
 503      ],
 504    );
 505  }
 506}

 196  Widget _buildTableHeader(double c1, double c2, double c3, double c4, double c5, double c6) {
 197    final isDark = ColorsManager.isDark;
 198    final headerColor = isDark ? ColorsManager.backgroundDark : Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.1);
 199
 200    return Container(
 201      height: 50,
 202      decoration: BoxDecoration(
 203        color: headerColor,
 204        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.only(topLeft: Radius.circular(16), topRight: Radius.circular(16)),
 205        border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.borderLightGray)),
 206      ),
 207      child: Row(
 208        children: [
 209          _buildHeaderCell(appTranslation().get('title'), c1),
 210          _buildHeaderCell(appTranslation().get('status'), c2, alignCenter: true),
 211          _buildHeaderCell(appTranslation().get('questions_count'), c3, alignCenter: true),
 212          _buildHeaderCell(appTranslation().get('grade'), c4, alignCenter: true),
 213          _buildHeaderCell(appTranslation().get('last_update'), c5, alignCenter: true),
 214          _buildHeaderCell(appTranslation().get('actions'), c6, alignCenter: true),
 215        ],
 216      ),
 217    );
 218  }
 219
 220  Widget _buildHeaderCell(String text, double width, {bool alignCenter = false}) {
 221    return SizedBox(
 222      width: width,
 223      child: Padding(
 224        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16.0),
 225        child: Align(
 226          alignment: alignCenter ? Alignment.center : AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
 227          child: Text(text, style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: ColorsManager.mainText)),
 228        ),
 229      ),
 230    );
 231  }
 232
 233  void _confirmDelete(BuildContext context, int examId) {
 234    showDialog(
 235      context: context,
 236      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
 237        title: Text(appTranslation().get('confirm_delete'), style: TextStylesManager.bold16),
 238        content: Text(appTranslation().get('delete_exam_msg'), style: TextStylesManager.medium14),
 239        actions: [
 240          TextButton(
 241            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
 242            child: Text(appTranslation().get('cancel'), style: TextStylesManager.medium14),
 243          ),
 244          TextButton(
 245            onPressed: () {
 246              Navigator.pop(ctx);
 247              context.read<MyExamsCubit>().deleteExam(examId);
 248            },
 249            child: Text(appTranslation().get('delete'), style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(color: Colors.red)),
 250          ),
 251        ],
 252      ),
 253    );
 254  }
 255
 256  void _navigateToExamPreview(BuildContext context, int examId) async {
 257    // Show loading
 258    showDialog(context: context, barrierDismissible: false, builder: (_) => Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: ColorsManager.primaryColor)));
 259    
 260    // Fetch full exam details to pass to ExamPreviewScreen
 261    final getExamUseCase = sl<GetExamUseCase>();
 262    final result = await getExamUseCase.execute(examId);
 263    
 264    if (context.mounted) {
 265      Navigator.pop(context); // Close loading
 266      
 267      result.fold(
 268        (failure) {
 269          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(failure.message), backgroundColor: Colors.red));
 270        },
 271        (exam) {
 272          Navigator.pushNamed(context, Routes.examGenerationPreview, arguments: exam).then((_) {
 273            if (context.mounted) {
 274              context.read<MyExamsCubit>().fetchExams(isRefresh: true);
 275            }
 276          });
 277        },
 278      );
 279    }
 280  }

   9  final int examId;

  13  const AddManualQuestionDialog({

  17    required this.onSubmit,

  20  @override
  21  State<AddManualQuestionDialog> createState() => _AddManualQuestionDialogState();
  22}
  23
  24class _AddManualQuestionDialogState extends State<AddManualQuestionDialog> {
  25  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  26  String _selectedType = 'mcq';
  27  int? _selectedLessonId;
  28  final TextEditingController _pointsController = TextEditingController(text: '1');
  29  final TextEditingController _questionTextController = TextEditingController();
  30  final TextEditingController _optionsController = TextEditingController();
  31  final TextEditingController _columnAController = TextEditingController();
  32  final TextEditingController _columnBController = TextEditingController();
  33  final TextEditingController _correctAnswerController = TextEditingController();
  34
  35  final Map<String, String> _questionTypes = {
  36    'mcq': 'اختيار من متعدد',
  37    'true_false': 'صح أو خطأ',
  38    'fill_blank': 'أكمل الفراغ',
  39    'essay': 'مقالي',
  40    'matching': 'مطابقة',
  41  };
  42
  43  @override
  44  void initState() {
  45    super.initState();
  46    if (widget.availableLessonIds.isNotEmpty) {
  47      _selectedLessonId = widget.availableLessonIds.first;
  48    }
  49  }
  50
  51  @override
  52  void dispose() {
  53    _pointsController.dispose();
  54    _questionTextController.dispose();
  55    _optionsController.dispose();
  56    _columnAController.dispose();
  57    _columnBController.dispose();
  58    _correctAnswerController.dispose();
  59    super.dispose();
  60  }
  61
  62  void _submit() {
  63    if (_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
  64      if (_selectedLessonId == null) {
  65        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('الرجاء اختيار الدرس')));
  66        return;
  67      }
  68
  69      final request = <String, dynamic>{
  70        'exam_id': widget.examId,
  71        'lesson_id': _selectedLessonId,
  72        'type': _selectedType,
  73        'difficulty': 'medium',
  74        'points': double.tryParse(_pointsController.text) ?? 1.0,
  75        'question_text': _questionTextController.text,
  76      };
  77
  78      if (_selectedType == 'mcq') {
  79        final options = _optionsController.text.split('\n').map((e) => e.trim()).where((e) => e.isNotEmpty).toList();
  80        if (options.length < 2) {
  81          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('الرجاء إدخال خيارين على الأقل')));
  82          return;
  83        }
  84        request['options'] = options;
  85        request['correct_answer'] = _correctAnswerController.text;
  86      } else if (_selectedType == 'true_false') {
  87        request['correct_answer'] = _correctAnswerController.text; // Expected "صح" or "خطأ"
  88      } else if (_selectedType == 'fill_blank') {
  89        request['correct_answer'] = _correctAnswerController.text;
  90      } else if (_selectedType == 'essay') {
  91        request['correct_answer'] = _correctAnswerController.text;
  92      } else if (_selectedType == 'matching') {
  93        final columnALines = _columnAController.text.split('\n').map((e) => e.trim()).where((e) => e.isNotEmpty).toList();
  94        final columnBLines = _columnBController.text.split('\n').map((e) => e.trim()).where((e) => e.isNotEmpty).toList();
  95        
  96        request['options'] = {
  97          'column_a': columnALines,
  98          'column_b': columnBLines,
  99        };
 100        request['correct_answer'] = _correctAnswerController.text;
 101      }
 102
 103      widget.onSubmit(request);
 104      context.pop();
 105    }
 106  }

 199  String _formatDate(String dateStr) {
 200    if (dateStr.isEmpty) return '';
 201    try {
 202      final date = DateTime.parse(dateStr);
 203      return '${date.year}/${date.month}/${date.day}';
 204    } catch (_) {
 205      return dateStr;
 206    }

   1import 'dart:async';
   2import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   3import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/constants.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/features/forgot_password/presentation/cubit/forgot_password_state.dart';
   7
   8class ForgotPasswordCubit extends Cubit<ForgotPasswordState> {
   9  ForgotPasswordCubit() : super(const ForgotPasswordInitialState());
  10
  11  static ForgotPasswordCubit get(BuildContext context) =>
  12      BlocProvider.of(context);
  13
  14  final GlobalKey<FormState> formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  15  final TextEditingController emailController = TextEditingController();
  16
  17  int cooldownSeconds = 0;
  18  Timer? _cooldownTimer;
  19  bool isSent = false;
  20  bool isLoading = false;
  21
  22  void startCooldown([int seconds = 60]) {
  23    cooldownSeconds = seconds;
  24    _cooldownTimer?.cancel();
  25    if (!isClosed) {
  26      emit(ForgotPasswordCooldownTickState(cooldownSeconds: cooldownSeconds));
  27    }
  28    _cooldownTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
  29      if (cooldownSeconds <= 1) {
  30        timer.cancel();
  31        cooldownSeconds = 0;
  32        if (!isClosed) {
  33          emit(const ForgotPasswordCooldownTickState(cooldownSeconds: 0));
  34        }
  35      } else {
  36        cooldownSeconds--;
  37        if (!isClosed) {
  38          emit(ForgotPasswordCooldownTickState(
  39              cooldownSeconds: cooldownSeconds));
  40        }
  41      }
  42    });
  43  }
  44
  45  Future<void> sendResetLink() async {
  46    if (formKey.currentState != null && !formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
  47      return;
  48    }
  49    if (emailController.text.trim().isEmpty) return;
  50    if (isLoading || cooldownSeconds > 0) return;
  51
  52    isLoading = true;
  53    if (!isClosed) emit(const ForgotPasswordLoadingState());
  54
  55    try {
  56      final result =
  57          await ApiService.forgotPassword(emailController.text.trim());
  58      if (isClosed) return;
  59
  60      result.fold(
  61        (error) {
  62          isLoading = false;
  63          if (!isClosed) emit(ForgotPasswordErrorState(message: error));
  64        },
  65        (data) {
  66          isLoading = false;
  67          isSent = true;
  68          startCooldown(60);
  69          final message = data['message'] as String? ??
  70              appTranslation().get('forgot_password_sent_title');
  71          if (!isClosed) {
  72            emit(ForgotPasswordSentSuccessState(message: message));
  73          }
  74        },
  75      );
  76    } catch (e) {
  77      isLoading = false;
  78      if (!isClosed) emit(ForgotPasswordErrorState(message: e.toString()));
  79    }
  80  }
  81
  82  @override
  83  Future<void> close() {
  84    _cooldownTimer?.cancel();
  85    emailController.dispose();
  86    return super.close();
  87  }
  88}

  24  bool obscurePassword = true;
  25  bool obscureConfirmPassword = true;
  26  bool isLoading = false;
  27  bool isSuccess = false;
  28
  29  void togglePasswordVisibility() {
  30    obscurePassword = !obscurePassword;
  31    if (!isClosed) {
  32      emit(ResetPasswordObscureToggledState(
  33        obscurePassword: obscurePassword,
  34        obscureConfirmPassword: obscureConfirmPassword,
  35      ));
  36    }
  37  }
  38
  39  void toggleConfirmPasswordVisibility() {
  40    obscureConfirmPassword = !obscureConfirmPassword;
  41    if (!isClosed) {
  42      emit(ResetPasswordObscureToggledState(
  43        obscurePassword: obscurePassword,
  44        obscureConfirmPassword: obscureConfirmPassword,
  45      ));
  46    }
  47  }
  48
  49  Future<void> resetPassword() async {
  50    if (!(formKey.currentState?.validate() ?? false)) return;
  51    if (isLoading) return;
  52
  53    isLoading = true;
  54    if (!isClosed) emit(const ResetPasswordLoadingState());
  55
  56    try {
  57      final result = await ApiService.resetPassword(
  58        email: email,
  59        token: token,
  60        password: passwordController.text,
  61        passwordConfirmation: confirmPasswordController.text,
  62      );
  63      if (isClosed) return;
  64
  65      result.fold(
  66        (error) {
  67          isLoading = false;
  68          if (!isClosed) emit(ResetPasswordErrorState(message: error));
  69        },
  70        (data) {
  71          isLoading = false;
  72          isSuccess = true;
  73          final message = data['message'] as String? ??
  74              appTranslation().get('reset_password_success_title');
  75          if (!isClosed) {
  76            emit(ResetPasswordSuccessState(message: message));
  77          }
  78        },
  79      );
  80    } catch (e) {
  81      isLoading = false;
  82      if (!isClosed) emit(ResetPasswordErrorState(message: e.toString()));
  83    }
  84  }
  85
  86  @override
  87  Future<void> close() {
  88    passwordController.dispose();
  89    confirmPasswordController.dispose();
  90    return super.close();
  91  }
  92}

  10part 'extension_install_state.dart';
  11
  12/// Quetta Browser Android package identifier.
  13const String _quettaPackageName = 'net.quetta.browser';
  14
  15/// Haddher Chrome Web Store URL.
  16const String _extensionUrl =
  17    'https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/khpdbfpnnjimoeffjecnfpiokemdlabn';
  18
  19/// Madrasati website URL.
  20const String _madrasatiUrl = 'https://schools.madrasati.sa/';
  21
  22/// Play Store URL for Quetta Browser.
  23const String _quettaPlayStoreUrl =
  24    'https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=$_quettaPackageName';
  25
  26class ExtensionInstallCubit extends Cubit<ExtensionInstallState>
  27    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  28  ExtensionInstallCubit() : super(const ExtensionInstallReady(isQuettaInstalled: false)) {
  29    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
  30    _checkQuettaStatus();
  31  }
  32
  33  static ExtensionInstallCubit get(BuildContext context) =>
  34      BlocProvider.of(context);
  35
  36  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  37  // Lifecycle observer
  38  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  39
  40  /// Called by Flutter whenever the app lifecycle changes.
  41  /// On [AppLifecycleState.resumed] we check if Quetta was just installed
  42  /// so the UI can dynamically update the "Copy Link" to "Open in Quetta".
  43  @override
  44  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
  45    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
  46      _checkQuettaStatus();
  47    }
  48  }
  49
  50  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  51  // Package check (reliable)
  52  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  53
  54  Future<void> _checkQuettaStatus() async {
  55    if (Platform.isIOS) {
  56      if (!isClosed) emit(const ExtensionInstallIosNotSupported(isQuettaInstalled: false));
  57      return;
  58    }
  59
  60    try {
  61      final AndroidIntent checkIntent = const AndroidIntent(
  62        action: 'android.intent.action.MAIN',
  63        category: 'android.intent.category.LAUNCHER',
  64        package: _quettaPackageName,
  65      );
  66      final bool isInstalled = await checkIntent.canResolveActivity() ?? false;
  67      if (!isClosed) emit(ExtensionInstallReady(isQuettaInstalled: isInstalled));
  68    } catch (_) {
  69      if (!isClosed) emit(const ExtensionInstallReady(isQuettaInstalled: false));
  70    }
  71  }
  72
  73  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  74  // Public API
  75  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  76
  77  /// Step 1: Open Play Store for Quetta Browser.
  78  Future<void> downloadQuetta() async {
  79    try {
  80      final AndroidIntent intent = const AndroidIntent(
  81        action: 'action_view',
  82        data: 'market://details?id=$_quettaPackageName',
  83        package: 'com.android.vending',
  84        flags: <int>[Flag.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK],
  85      );
  86
  87      final bool canResolve = await intent.canResolveActivity() ?? false;
  88      if (canResolve) {
  89        await intent.launch();
  90      } else {
  91        // Fallback to https web URL if Play Store app is missing
  92        final Uri webUri = Uri.parse(_quettaPlayStoreUrl);
  93        if (await canLaunchUrl(webUri)) {
  94          await launchUrl(webUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
  95        } else {
  96          if (!isClosed) {
  97            emit(ExtensionInstallError(
  98              message: 'Could not open Play Store',
  99              isQuettaInstalled: state.isQuettaInstalled,
 100            ));
 101          }
 102        }
 103      }
 104    } catch (_) {
 105      if (!isClosed) {
 106        emit(ExtensionInstallError(
 107          message: 'Could not open Play Store',
 108          isQuettaInstalled: state.isQuettaInstalled,
 109        ));
 110      }
 111    }
 112  }
 113
 114  /// Step 2 (Option A): Copy extension link to clipboard.
 115  Future<void> copyExtensionLink() async {
 116    await Clipboard.setData(const ClipboardData(text: _extensionUrl));
 117  }
 118
 119  /// Step 2 (Option B): Launch the extension URL inside Quetta explicitly.
 120  Future<void> openExtensionInQuetta() async {
 121    try {
 122      final AndroidIntent intent = const AndroidIntent(
 123        action: 'action_view',
 124        data: _extensionUrl,
 125        package: _quettaPackageName,
 126        flags: <int>[Flag.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK],
 127      );
 128      await intent.launch();
 129    } catch (_) {
 130      if (!isClosed) {
 131        emit(ExtensionInstallError(
 132          message: 'Could not launch Quetta',
 133          isQuettaInstalled: state.isQuettaInstalled,
 134        ));
 135      }
 136    }
 137  }
 138
 139  /// Step 3: Open Madrasati website inside Quetta browser.
 140  Future<void> openMadrasatiInQuetta() async {
 141    try {
 142      final AndroidIntent intent = const AndroidIntent(
 143        action: 'action_view',
 144        data: _madrasatiUrl,
 145        package: _quettaPackageName,
 146        flags: <int>[Flag.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK],
 147      );
 148      await intent.launch();
 149    } catch (_) {
 150      if (!isClosed) {
 151        emit(ExtensionInstallError(
 152          message: 'Could not launch Quetta',
 153          isQuettaInstalled: state.isQuettaInstalled,
 154        ));
 155      }
 156    }
 157  }
 158
 159  @override
 160  Future<void> close() {
 161    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
 162    return super.close();
 163  }
 164}

   3abstract class ExtensionInstallState {
   4  final bool isQuettaInstalled;
   5  const ExtensionInstallState({this.isQuettaInstalled = false});
   6}
   7
   8/// Default state tracking whether Quetta is installed.
   9class ExtensionInstallReady extends ExtensionInstallState {
  10  const ExtensionInstallReady({required super.isQuettaInstalled});
  11}
  12
  13/// Running on iOS — show the "desktop-only" dialog.
  14class ExtensionInstallIosNotSupported extends ExtensionInstallState {
  15  const ExtensionInstallIosNotSupported({super.isQuettaInstalled});
  16}
  17
  18/// Unexpected error during the flow.
  19class ExtensionInstallError extends ExtensionInstallState {
  20  final String message;
  21  const ExtensionInstallError({
  22    required this.message,
  23    required super.isQuettaInstalled,
  24  });
  25}

   9class HomeCubit extends Cubit<HomeState> {
  10  HomeCubit() : super(HomeInitial());
  11
  12  static HomeCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  13
  14  int selectedCategoryIndex = 0;
  15  final TextEditingController searchController = TextEditingController();
  16
  17  bool isAdmin = false;
  18  bool isLoadingRole = true;
  19
  20  void onSearchChanged(String query) {
  21    if (!isClosed) emit(HomeSearchChanged(query: query));
  22  }
  23
  24  void onCategorySelected(int index) {
  25    selectedCategoryIndex = index;
  26    if (!isClosed) emit(HomeCategoryChanged(selectedIndex: index));
  27  }
  28
  29  Future<void> checkRole() async {
  30    if (token != null && token!.isNotEmpty) {
  31      final cachedIsAdmin = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'isAdmin');
  32      final cachedToken = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'admin_token');
  33      if (cachedIsAdmin != null && cachedIsAdmin is bool && cachedToken == token) {
  34        isAdmin = cachedIsAdmin;
  35        isLoadingRole = false;
  36        if (!isClosed) emit(HomeRoleChecked(isAdmin: isAdmin));
  37        return;
  38      }
  39
  40      final result = await ApiService.getProfile();
  41      if (isClosed) return;
  42      result.fold(
  43        (error) {
  44          isLoadingRole = false;
  45          if (!isClosed) emit(HomeRoleChecked(isAdmin: isAdmin)); // emit with current/default
  46        },
  47        (profile) {
  48          final admin = profile.role == 'admin' || profile.user.email == 'admin@moeen.sa';
  49          CacheHelper.saveData(key: 'isAdmin', value: admin);
  50          CacheHelper.saveData(key: 'admin_token', value: token);
  51          isAdmin = admin;
  52          isLoadingRole = false;
  53          if (!isClosed) emit(HomeRoleChecked(isAdmin: isAdmin));
  54        },
  55      );
  56    } else {
  57      isLoadingRole = false;
  58      if (!isClosed) emit(HomeRoleChecked(isAdmin: false));
  59    }
  60  }
  61
  62  @override
  63  Future<void> close() {
  64    searchController.dispose();
  65    return super.close();
  66  }
  67}

 109    final schoolId     = savedSession?.schoolId;
 110
 111    debugPrint('📂 Saved credentials:');
 112    debugPrint('   schoolId     : ${schoolId ?? '❌ null'}');
 113    debugPrint('   refreshToken : ${refreshToken != null && refreshToken.isNotEmpty ? '✅ "${refreshToken.substring(0, refreshToken.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null or empty'}');
 114
 115    // ── Step 2: لو مفيش session محفوظة → دايلوج لازم تعمل connect ──────
 116    if (refreshToken == null || refreshToken.isEmpty ||
 117        schoolId == null || schoolId.isEmpty) {
 118      debugPrint('⚠️ [DEBUG] No local session — showing SessionExpiredDialog (must re-connect)');
 119      debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
 120      setState(() => _loading = false);
 121      if (mounted) SessionExpiredDialog.show(context);
 122      return;
 123    }
 124
 125    // ── Step 3: في session → نادى /refresh-session ──────────────────────
 126    try {
 127      debugPrint('📡 [DEBUG] POST $refreshMadrasatiSessionApi');
 128      final response = await DioHelper.postData(
 129        url: refreshMadrasatiSessionApi,
 130        data: {
 131          'refresh_token': refreshToken,
 132          'madrasati_school_id': schoolId,
 133        },
 134      );
 135
 136      response.fold(
 137        // ─── Left: خطأ من DioHelper ──────────────────────────────────
 138        (error) {
 139          debugPrint('💥 [DEBUG] Request failed (LEFT): $error');
 140          debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
 141
 142          // نفرّق: خطأ شبكة (انقطاع) vs خطأ مصادقة (session منتهية)
 143          final errLow = error.toLowerCase();
 144          final isNetworkError = errLow.contains('socket') ||
 145              errLow.contains('connection') ||
 146              errLow.contains('timeout') ||
 147              errLow.contains('network') ||
 148              errLow.contains('unreachable') ||
 149              errLow.contains('reset');
 150
 151          if (isNetworkError) {
 152            // ✋ انقطع الإنترنت — مش نبوّع الدايلوج
 153            debugPrint('📵 [DEBUG] Network error detected — NOT showing dialog');
 154            if (mounted) {
 155              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 156                const SnackBar(
 157                  content: Text('📵 تحقق من اتصال الإنترنت وحاول مجدداً'),
 158                  backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
 159                  duration: Duration(seconds: 4),
 160                ),
 161              );
 162            }
 163          } else {
 164            // ❌ خطأ مصادقة — لازم يعمل connect من أول
 165            debugPrint('🔐 [DEBUG] Auth error — showing SessionExpiredDialog');
 166            if (mounted) SessionExpiredDialog.show(context);
 167          }
 168        },
 169
 170        // ─── Right: جه رد من الباك ────────────────────────────────────
 171        (res) async {
 172          debugPrint('');
 173          debugPrint('┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐');
 174          debugPrint('│   📦 /refresh-session RESPONSE — Full Breakdown          │');
 175          debugPrint('├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤');
 176          debugPrint('│ HTTP statusCode : ${res.statusCode}');
 177          debugPrint('├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤');
 178          debugPrint('│ [top-level]');
 179          debugPrint('│   success  : ${res.data['success']}');
 180          debugPrint('│   message  : ${res.data['message']}');
 181          debugPrint('├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤');
 182          debugPrint('│ [data] object:');
 183
 184          final dataObj = res.data['data'];
 185          if (dataObj == null) {
 186            debugPrint('│   ⚠️  data is NULL — backend returned no data object');
 187          } else {
 188            final d = dataObj as Map;
 189            final cookie = d['session_cookie'] as String?;
 190            debugPrint('│   session_cookie    : ${cookie != null ? '✅ "${cookie.substring(0, cookie.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null'}');
 191            final newRT = d['new_refresh_token'] as String?;
 192            debugPrint('│   new_refresh_token : ${newRT != null ? '✅ "${newRT.substring(0, newRT.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null — old token reused'}');
 193            final rt = d['refresh_token'] as String?;
 194            debugPrint('│   refresh_token     : ${rt != null ? '✅ "${rt.substring(0, rt.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null'}');
 195            final exp = d['expires_at'];
 196            debugPrint('│   expires_at        : ${exp ?? '❌ null'}');
 197            final known = {'session_cookie', 'new_refresh_token', 'refresh_token', 'expires_at'};
 198            final extras = d.keys.where((k) => !known.contains(k)).toList();
 199            if (extras.isNotEmpty) debugPrint('│   [extra fields] : $extras');
 200          }
 201          debugPrint('└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘');
 202          debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
 203
 204          final success = res.data['success'] == true;
 205          final message = res.data['message'] as String? ?? '';
 206
 207          if (success) {
 208            // ✅ نجحت — نحفظ الجلسة الجديدة
 209            final d = res.data['data'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
 210            if (d != null) {
 211              final newCookie  = d['session_cookie']    as String?;
 212              final newRT      = (d['new_refresh_token'] ?? d['refresh_token']) as String?;
 213              final expiresRaw = d['expires_at']         as String?;
 214              final expiry     = expiresRaw != null
 215                  ? DateTime.tryParse(expiresRaw.replaceAll(' ', 'T'))
 216                  : DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30));
 217
 218              if (newCookie != null && newCookie.isNotEmpty) {
 219                await sl<SecureStorageHelper>().saveMadrasatiSession(
 220                  MadrasatiSessionData(
 221                    sessionCookie: newCookie,
 222                    schoolId: schoolId,
 223                    expiresAt: expiry,
 224                    refreshToken: newRT ?? refreshToken,
 225                  ),
 226                );
 227                debugPrint('💾 [DEBUG] New session saved to SecureStorage ✅');
 228              }
 229            }
 230            if (mounted) {
 231              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 232                SnackBar(
 233                  content: Text('✅ تم تجديد الجلسة: $message'),
 234                  backgroundColor: Colors.green,
 235                  duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
 236                ),
 237              );
 238            }
 239          } else {
 240            // ❌ الباك رفض — لازم يعمل connect من أول
 241            debugPrint('🔐 [DEBUG] success=false — showing SessionExpiredDialog');
 242            if (mounted) SessionExpiredDialog.show(context);
 243          }
 244        },
 245      );
 246    } catch (e, st) {
 247      // خطأ غير متوقع — نفرّق شبكة من غيره
 248      final isNetworkError = e.toString().toLowerCase().contains('socket') ||
 249          e.toString().toLowerCase().contains('connection') ||
 250          e.toString().toLowerCase().contains('timeout');
 251      debugPrint('💥 [DEBUG] Exception: $e');
 252      debugPrint('   StackTrace: $st');
 253      debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
 254      if (mounted) {
 255        if (isNetworkError) {
 256          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 257            const SnackBar(
 258              content: Text('📵 تحقق من اتصال الإنترنت وحاول مجدداً'),
 259              backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
 260              duration: Duration(seconds: 4),
 261            ),
 262          );
 263        } else {
 264          SessionExpiredDialog.show(context);
 265        }
 266      }
 267    } finally {
 268      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
 269    }
 270  }
 271
 272  @override
 273  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 274    return Container(
 275      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
 276      decoration: BoxDecoration(
 277        border: Border.all(color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.5), width: 1.5),
 278        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
 279        color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
 280      ),
 281      child: Material(
 282        color: Colors.transparent,
 283        child: InkWell(
 284          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
 285          onTap: _loading ? null : _triggerRefresh,
 286          child: Padding(
 287            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12, horizontal: 16),
 288            child: _loading
 289                ? const Center(
 290                    child: SizedBox(
 291                      height: 20,
 292                      width: 20,
 293                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
 294                        strokeWidth: 2,
 295                        color: Colors.red,
 296                      ),
 297                    ),
 298                  )
 299                : Row(
 300                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
 301                    children: [
 302                      const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded,
 303                          color: Colors.red, size: 20),
 304                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
 305                      Text(
 306                        'DEBUG — اختبار تجديد جلسة مدرستي',
 307                        style: TextStyle(
 308                          color: Colors.red.shade700,
 309                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
 310                          fontSize: 13,
 311                        ),
 312                      ),
 313                    ],
 314                  ),
 315          ),
 316        ),
 317      ),
 318    );
 319  }
 320}

  12
  13class ChoseApp extends StatefulWidget {
  14  const ChoseApp({super.key});
  15
  16  @override
  17  State<ChoseApp> createState() => _ChoseAppState();
  18}
  19
  20class _ChoseAppState extends State<ChoseApp>
  21    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  22  // ── Local selection state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  23  // 0 = Browser Extension (active), 1 = Mobile App (coming soon / disabled)
  24  int _selected = 0;
  25
  26  // ── Animation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  27  late final AnimationController _controller;
  28
  29  // Stagger config: 4 items → header, card1, card2, button
  30  static const int _itemCount = 5;
  31  static const double _itemDuration = 0.60; // fraction of total per item
  32  static const double _stagger = 0.14;      // fraction offset between items
  33
  34  late final List<Animation<Offset>> _slides;
  35  late final List<Animation<double>> _fades;
  36
  37  @override
  38  void initState() {
  39    super.initState();
  40
  41    _controller = AnimationController(
  42      vsync: this,
  43      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 750),
  44    );
  45
  46    _slides = List.generate(_itemCount, (i) {
  47      final start = (i * _stagger).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  48      final end = (start + _itemDuration).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  49      return Tween<Offset>(
  50        begin: const Offset(0, 0.18),
  51        end: Offset.zero,
  52      ).animate(CurvedAnimation(
  53        parent: _controller,
  54        curve: Interval(start, end, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
  55      ));
  56    });
  57
  58    _fades = List.generate(_itemCount, (i) {
  59      final start = (i * _stagger).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  60      final end = (start + _itemDuration * 0.85).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  61      return Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(CurvedAnimation(
  62        parent: _controller,
  63        curve: Interval(start, end, curve: Curves.easeOut),
  64      ));
  65    });
  66
  67    _controller.forward();
  68  }
  69
  70  @override
  71  void dispose() {
  72    _controller.dispose();
  73    super.dispose();
  74  }
  75
  76  // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  77  Widget _animated(int index, Widget child) {
  78    return SlideTransition(
  79      position: _slides[index],
  80      child: FadeTransition(
  81        opacity: _fades[index],
  82        child: child,
  83      ),
  84    );
  85  }
  86
  87  void _onContinue() {
  88    if (_selected == 0) {
  89      Navigator.pushNamed(context, Routes.addextention);
  90    }
  91  }
  92

 184class _SubscriptionButtonState extends State<_SubscriptionButton> {
 185  @override
 186  void initState() {
 187    super.initState();
 188    final cubit = sl<SubscriptionCubit>();
 189    if (cubit.currentSubscription == null && cubit.lastError == null) {
 190      cubit.fetchCurrentSubscription();
 191    }
 192  }
 193
 194  @override
 195  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 196    return BlocBuilder<SubscriptionCubit, dynamic>(
 197      bloc: sl<SubscriptionCubit>(),
 198      builder: (context, state) {
 199        final current = sl<SubscriptionCubit>().currentSubscription;
 200        final teacher = sl<ProfileCubit>().profileModel?.teacher;
 201
 202        final bool isSubscribed = current?.isSubscribed ?? teacher?.isSubscribed ?? false;
 203        final bool isInTrial = current?.isInTrial ?? teacher?.isInTrial ?? false;
 204        final DateTime? trialEndsAt = current?.trialEndsAt ?? teacher?.trialEndsAt;
 205        final DateTime? subscriptionEndsAt = current?.subscriptionEndsAt ?? teacher?.subscriptionEndsAt;
 206        final DateTime? effectiveEndsAt = isSubscribed
 207            ? subscriptionEndsAt
 208            : (isInTrial ? trialEndsAt : (subscriptionEndsAt ?? trialEndsAt));
 209
 210        int daysRemaining = 0;
 211        if (effectiveEndsAt != null) {
 212          final now = DateTime.now();
 213          if (effectiveEndsAt.isAfter(now)) {
 214            daysRemaining = (effectiveEndsAt.difference(now).inHours / 24).ceil();
 215          }
 216        } else {
 217          daysRemaining = current?.trialDaysRemaining ?? teacher?.trialDaysRemaining ?? 0;
 218        }
 219
 220        final bool isExpired;
 221        if (isSubscribed) {
 222          isExpired = subscriptionEndsAt != null && subscriptionEndsAt.isBefore(DateTime.now());
 223        } else if (isInTrial) {
 224          isExpired = (trialEndsAt != null && trialEndsAt.isBefore(DateTime.now())) || daysRemaining <= 0;
 225        } else {
 226          isExpired = true;
 227        }
 228
 229        Color buttonColor;
 230        String buttonText;
 231        IconData buttonIcon;
 232
 233        if (isSubscribed && !isExpired) {
 234          // Subscribed & Active
 235          buttonColor = const Color(0xFF0E7A5E);
 236          buttonText = 'اشتراك نشط';
 237          buttonIcon = Icons.verified_user_outlined;
 238        } else if (isExpired) {
 239          // Expired
 240          buttonColor = const Color(0xFFDC2626);
 241          buttonText = 'انتهى الاشتراك';
 242          buttonIcon = Icons.lock_clock_outlined;
 243        } else if (isInTrial) {
 244          // Trial Active
 245          if (daysRemaining <= 3) {
 246            buttonColor = const Color(0xFFF97316); // Warning Orange
 247            buttonText = daysRemaining <= 1 ? 'آخر يوم تجربة' : 'متبقي $daysRemaining أيام';
 248            buttonIcon = Icons.hourglass_top_rounded;
 249          } else {
 250            buttonColor = const Color(0xFFD97706); // Amber Gold
 251            buttonText = 'تجربة مجانية';
 252            buttonIcon = Icons.auto_awesome;
 253          }
 254        } else {
 255          // Default fallback
 256          buttonColor = const Color(0xFF0E7A5E);
 257          buttonText = 'الاشتراك';
 258          buttonIcon = Icons.workspace_premium_outlined;
 259        }
 260
 261        return Padding(
 262          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8.0),
 263          child: PrimaryElevatedButton(
 264            icon: Icon(
 265              buttonIcon,
 266              size: 18,
 267              color: ColorsManager.white,
 268            ),
 269            text: buttonText,
 270            backgroundColor: buttonColor,
 271            textStyle: TextStylesManager.bold13.copyWith(
 272              color: ColorsManager.white,
 273            ),
 274            onPressed: () => SubscriptionStatusDialog.show(context),
 275            width: 140,
 276            height: 42,
 277            radius: 24,
 278          ),
 279        );
 280      },
 281    );
 282  }
 283}

  11class LayoutCubit extends Cubit<LayoutState> {
  12  LayoutCubit() : super(LayoutInitial());
  13
  14  static LayoutCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of<LayoutCubit>(context);
  15
  16  int currentIndex = 1;
  17  final GlobalKey<CurvedNavigationBarState> bottomNavigationKey = GlobalKey();
  18
  19  List<Widget> screens = [
  20    const ProfileScreen(),
  21    const HomeScreen(),
  22    const SettingsScreen(),
  23  ];
  24
  25  void changeBottomNav(int index, BuildContext context) {
  26    if (index == 0 || index == 2) {
  27      if (token == null || token!.isEmpty) {
  28        // Not logged in, prevent navigation to Profile or Settings
  29        bottomNavigationKey.currentState?.setPage(currentIndex);
  30        Navigator.pushNamed(context, Routes.login);
  31        return;
  32      }
  33    }
  34    currentIndex = index;
  35    emit(LayoutChangeBottomNavState());
  36  }
  37}

  16class MainLayoutScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  17  const MainLayoutScreen({super.key});
  18
  19  @override
  20  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  21    return BlocProvider(
  22      create: (context) => LayoutCubit(),
  23      child: BlocBuilder<LayoutCubit, LayoutState>(
  24        builder: (context, state) {
  25          var cubit = LayoutCubit.get(context);
  26
  27          // Get the bottom system inset (navigation bar / gesture bar height)
  28          final double bottomPadding =
  29              MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom;
  30
  31          return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
  32            value: const SystemUiOverlayStyle(
  33              statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
  34              systemNavigationBarColor: Colors.transparent,
  35              systemNavigationBarDividerColor: Colors.transparent,
  36            ),
  37            child: Scaffold(
  38              // Allow the body to extend behind the bottom nav bar
  39              extendBody: true,
  40              body: BlocBuilder<SubscriptionCubit, SubscriptionState>(
  41                bloc: sl<SubscriptionCubit>(),
  42                builder: (context, subState) {
  43                  final bool showBanner =
  44                      TrialBannerWidget.isBannerVisible(subState);
  45                  return Column(
  46                    children: [
  47                      BlocBuilder<ProfileCubit, ProfileState>(
  48                        bloc: sl<ProfileCubit>(),
  49                        builder: (context, profState) {
  50                          final user = sl<ProfileCubit>().profileModel?.user;
  51                          if (user == null || user.isEmailVerified) {
  52                            return const SizedBox.shrink();
  53                          }
  54                          return EmailVerificationBanner(
  55                            isEmailVerified: user.isEmailVerified,
  56                            email: user.email,
  57                          );
  58                        },
  59                      ),
  60                      const TrialBannerWidget(),
  61                      Expanded(
  62                        child: MediaQuery.removePadding(
  63                          context: context,

  65                          child: IndexedStack(
  66                            index: cubit.currentIndex,
  67                            children: cubit.screens,
  68                          ),
  69                        ),
  70                      ),
  71                    ],
  72                  );
  73                },
  74              ),
  75              bottomNavigationBar: Padding(
  76                // Push the nav bar above the system navigation area
  77                padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: bottomPadding),
  78                child: CurvedNavigationBar(
  79                  key: cubit.bottomNavigationKey,
  80                  index: cubit.currentIndex,
  81                  height: 60.0,
  82                  items: <Widget>[

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/login/presentation/cubit/login_state.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/main.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/core/models/login_request.dart';
   7import 'package:moean/core/models/madrasati_session_data.dart';
   8import 'package:moean/core/network/local/secure_storage_helper.dart';
   9import 'package:moean/core/services/madrasati_session_service.dart';
  10import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/constants.dart';
  11import 'package:moean/core/di/injections.dart';
  12import 'package:moean/features/payment/presentation/cubit/subscription_cubit.dart';
  13import 'package:moean/features/profile/presentation/cubit/profile_cubit.dart';
  14import 'package:moean/core/models/profile_model.dart';
  15
  16LoginCubit get loginCubit => LoginCubit.get(navigatorKey.currentContext!);
  17
  18class LoginCubit extends Cubit<LoginState> {
  19  LoginCubit() : super(LoginInitialState());
  20
  21  static LoginCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  22
  23  final TextEditingController emailController = TextEditingController();
  24  final TextEditingController passwordController = TextEditingController();
  25  final GlobalKey<FormState> formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  26
  27  bool isPasswordVisible = false;
  28  bool rememberMe = false;
  29
  30  void togglePasswordVisibility() {
  31    isPasswordVisible = !isPasswordVisible;
  32    emit(LoginPasswordVisibilityChangedState());
  33  }
  34
  35  void toggleRememberMe() {
  36    rememberMe = !rememberMe;
  37    emit(LoginRememberMeChangedState());
  38  }
  39
  40  Future<void> login() async {
  41    if (!(formKey.currentState?.validate() ?? false)) return;
  42    if (!isClosed) emit(LoginLoadingState());
  43
  44    final request = LoginRequest(
  45      email: emailController.text.trim(),
  46      password: passwordController.text,
  47    );
  48
  49    final result = await ApiService.loginUser(request);
  50    if (isClosed) return;
  51
  52    result.fold(
  53      (error) {
  54        if (!isClosed) {
  55          if (error.contains('account_suspended') ||
  56              error.contains('__403__') ||
  57              error.contains('تعليق') ||
  58              error.contains('موقوف')) {
  59            emit(LoginAccountSuspendedState(
  60              email: emailController.text.trim(),
  61              password: passwordController.text,
  62              message: error.replaceFirst('__403__:account_suspended:', ''),
  63            ));
  64          } else {
  65            emit(LoginErrorState(message: error));
  66          }
  67        }
  68      },
  69      (response) async {
  70        if (!response.user.isActive) {
  71          if (!isClosed) {
  72            emit(LoginAccountSuspendedState(
  73              email: response.user.email,
  74              userName: response.user.name,
  75            ));
  76          }
  77          return;
  78        }
  79
  80        // Save token securely (replaces CacheHelper for sensitive data)
  81        await sl<SecureStorageHelper>().saveToken(response.token);
  82        token = response.token;
  83
  84        // If already connected to Madrasati, persist school_id locally
  85        // so HeadlessRefresh can use it when session expires
  86        if (response.madrasatiConnected &&
  87            response.madrasatiSchoolId != null &&
  88            response.madrasatiSchoolId!.isNotEmpty) {
  89          await sl<SecureStorageHelper>().saveMadrasatiSession(
  90            MadrasatiSessionData(
  91              sessionCookie: '', // cookies managed by WebView internally
  92              schoolId: response.madrasatiSchoolId!,
  93              expiresAt: null,
  94            ),
  95          );
  96          sl<MadrasatiSessionService>().notifySessionActive();
  97        }
  98
  99        if (response.teacher != null) {
 100          sl<ProfileCubit>().profileModel = ProfileModel(
 101            user: response.user,
 102            madrasatiConnected: response.madrasatiConnected,
 103            teacher: response.teacher,
 104            subscriptionName: response.teacher?.subscription?.name,
 105            aiQuotaRemaining: response.teacher?.aiQuotaRemaining,
 106          );
 107        }
 108
 109        // Refresh subscription & profile state in background
 110        sl<SubscriptionCubit>().fetchCurrentSubscription(forceRefresh: true);
 111        sl<ProfileCubit>().fetchProfile(forceRefresh: true);
 112
 113        if (!isClosed) {
 114          emit(LoginSuccessState(
 115            madrasatiConnected: response.madrasatiConnected,
 116            userEmail: response.user.email,
 117          ));
 118        }
 119      },
 120    );
 121  }
 122
 123  @override
 124  Future<void> close() {
 125    emailController.dispose();
 126    passwordController.dispose();
 127    return super.close();
 128  }
 129}

   3import 'package:moean/core/di/injections.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/models/madrasati_session_data.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/core/network/local/secure_storage_helper.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_endpoints.dart';

   9
  10abstract class MadrasatiState {}
  11
  12class MadrasatiInitialState extends MadrasatiState {}
  13
  14class MadrasatiLoadingState extends MadrasatiState {}
  15
  16class MadrasatiSuccessState extends MadrasatiState {
  17  final String message;
  18  MadrasatiSuccessState(this.message);
  19}
  20
  21class MadrasatiErrorState extends MadrasatiState {
  22  final String message;
  23  MadrasatiErrorState(this.message);
  24}
  25
  26class MadrasatiCubit extends Cubit<MadrasatiState> {
  27  MadrasatiCubit() : super(MadrasatiInitialState());
  28
  29  static MadrasatiCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  30
  31  /// Connects the app to Madrasati by sending the session cookie.
  32  ///
  33  /// [sessionCookie] - The `.AspNetCore.Cookies` session string extracted
  34  ///   from the webview after the initial manual login.
  35  /// [madrasatiSchoolId] - The school's unique ID.
  36  /// [expiresAt] - Session expiry datetime string.
  37  /// [refreshToken] - The Microsoft OAuth refresh_token returned by the backend
  38  ///   after connecting. Used by [MadrasatiSessionInterceptor] to silently
  39  ///   refresh the session in the background when it expires.
  40  Future<void> connectMadrasati({
  41    required String sessionCookie,
  42    required String madrasatiSchoolId,
  43    required String expiresAt,
  44    String? refreshToken,
  45  }) async {
  46    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  47    debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  48    debugPrint('🚀 [MadrasatiCubit] connectMadrasati() ── START');
  49    debugPrint('   schoolId   : $madrasatiSchoolId');
  50    debugPrint('   expiresAt  : $expiresAt');
  51    debugPrint('   refreshToken (from caller): ${refreshToken != null ? '✅ "${refreshToken.substring(0, refreshToken.length.clamp(0, 20))}…"' : '❌ null'}');
  52    debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  53
  54    if (!isClosed) emit(MadrasatiLoadingState());
  55    debugPrint('🔄 [MadrasatiCubit] State → MadrasatiLoadingState');
  56
  57    try {
  58      debugPrint('📡 [MadrasatiCubit] Sending POST to: $connectMadrasatiApi');
  59      final response = await DioHelper.postData(
  60        url: connectMadrasatiApi,
  61        data: {
  62          'session_cookie': sessionCookie,
  63          'madrasati_school_id': madrasatiSchoolId,
  64          'expires_at': expiresAt,
  65        },
  66      );
  67
  68      if (isClosed) return;
  69
  70      response.fold(
  71        (error) {
  72          debugPrint('💥 [MadrasatiCubit] API returned LEFT (error): $error');
  73          debugPrint('❌ [MadrasatiCubit] State → MadrasatiErrorState');
  74          if (!isClosed) emit(MadrasatiErrorState(error));
  75
  76        },
  77
  78        (res) async {
  79          debugPrint('📥 [MadrasatiCubit] API returned RIGHT (success path)');
  80          debugPrint('   statusCode : $res.statusCode');
  81          debugPrint('   statusCode : $res');
  82
  83
  84          // ── طباعة كل حقل بيرجع من الباك بالاسم ──────────────────────────
  85          debugPrint('');
  86          debugPrint('┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐');
  87          debugPrint('│         📦 BACKEND RESPONSE — Full Breakdown         │');
  88          debugPrint('├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤');
  89          debugPrint('│ [top-level]                                          │');
  90          debugPrint('│   success  : ${res.data['success']}');
  91          debugPrint('│   message  : ${res.data['message']}');
  92          debugPrint('├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤');
  93          debugPrint('│ [data] object:                                       │');
  94
  95          final dataObj = res.data['data'];
  96          debugPrint('│   data     : ${dataObj != null ? '✅ present' : '❌ null'}');
  97          if (dataObj == null) {
  98            debugPrint('│   ⚠️  data is NULL — backend did not return a data object');
  99          } else {
 100            // session_cookie — الكوكي الجديد
 101            final backendCookie = dataObj['session_cookie'] as String?;
 102            debugPrint('│   session_cookie    : ${backendCookie != null ? '✅ "${backendCookie.substring(0, backendCookie.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null'}');
 103
 104            // refresh_token — الاسم الأول المحتمل
 105            final rt1 = dataObj['refresh_token'] as String?;
 106            debugPrint('│   refresh_token     : ${rt1 != null ? '✅ "${rt1.substring(0, rt1.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null'}');
 107
 108            // new_refresh_token — الاسم الثاني المحتمل (مذكور ف خطة refresh-session)
 109            final rt2 = dataObj['new_refresh_token'] as String?;
 110            debugPrint('│   new_refresh_token : ${rt2 != null ? '✅ "${rt2.substring(0, rt2.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null'}');
 111            
 112            // expires_at — وقت انتهاء الجلسة الجديدة
 113            final backendExpiry = dataObj['expires_at'];
 114            debugPrint('│   expires_at        : ${backendExpiry ?? '❌ null'}');
 115
 116            // أي حقول تانية موجودة مش متوقعة
 117            final knownKeys = {'session_cookie', 'refresh_token', 'new_refresh_token', 'expires_at'};
 118            final extraKeys = (dataObj as Map).keys.where((k) => !knownKeys.contains(k)).toList();
 119            if (extraKeys.isNotEmpty) {
 120              debugPrint('│   [extra fields]    : $extraKeys');
 121            }
 122          }
 123          debugPrint('└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘');
 124          debugPrint('');
 125
 126          final success = res.data['success'] ?? false;
 127          final message =
 128              res.data['message'] as String? ?? 'Connected successfully';
 129
 130          if (success) {
 131            // ── Extract refresh_token from API response (if available) ────
 132            // The backend may return a refresh_token in the connect response,
 133            // or it can be passed in from the caller (e.g., WebView login flow).
 134            // Per integration plan: connect endpoint → 'refresh_token'
 135            //                       refresh endpoint → 'new_refresh_token'
 136            final apiRefreshToken =
 137                (res.data['data']?['refresh_token'] ??
 138                 res.data['data']?['new_refresh_token']) as String?;
 139
 140            debugPrint('');
 141            debugPrint('🔑 [MadrasatiCubit] refresh_token trace:');
 142            debugPrint('   ├─ From API  response : ${apiRefreshToken != null ? '✅ "${apiRefreshToken.substring(0, apiRefreshToken.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null (not in API response)'}');
 143            debugPrint('   ├─ From caller (param): ${refreshToken != null ? '✅ "${refreshToken.substring(0, refreshToken.length.clamp(0, 30))}…"' : '❌ null (not passed by caller)'}');
 144
 145            final tokenToSave = apiRefreshToken ?? refreshToken;
 146            debugPrint('   └─ Final token to save: ${tokenToSave != null ? '✅ will be saved 🔐' : '⚠️  NO TOKEN — session refresh will NOT work!'}');
 147            debugPrint('');
 148
 149            // ── Save session securely ─────────────────────────────────────
 150            final expiry = DateTime.tryParse(expiresAt.replaceAll(' ', 'T'));
 151            debugPrint('💾 [MadrasatiCubit] Saving session to SecureStorage…');
 152            await sl<SecureStorageHelper>().saveMadrasatiSession(
 153              MadrasatiSessionData(
 154                sessionCookie: sessionCookie,
 155                schoolId: madrasatiSchoolId,
 156                expiresAt: expiry,
 157                refreshToken: tokenToSave,
 158              ),
 159            );
 160            debugPrint('   Session saved ✅  (expiresAt parsed: $expiry)');
 161
 162            // ── Notify session service that session is now active ─────────
 163            debugPrint('🔔 [MadrasatiCubit] Notifying MadrasatiSessionService…');
 164            sl<MadrasatiSessionService>().notifySessionActive();
 165            debugPrint('   notifySessionActive() called ✅');
 166
 167            debugPrint('✅ [MadrasatiCubit] State → MadrasatiSuccessState("$message")');
 168            if (!isClosed) emit(MadrasatiSuccessState(message));
 169          } else {
 170            debugPrint('❌ [MadrasatiCubit] success=false → State → MadrasatiErrorState("$message")');
 171            if (!isClosed) emit(MadrasatiErrorState(message));
 172          }
 173        },
 174      );
 175    } catch (e, st) {
 176      debugPrint('💥 [MadrasatiCubit] Exception caught: $e');
 177      debugPrint('   StackTrace: $st');
 178      debugPrint('❌ [MadrasatiCubit] State → MadrasatiErrorState');
 179      if (!isClosed) emit(MadrasatiErrorState(e.toString()));
 180    }
 181
 182    debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
 183    debugPrint('🏁 [MadrasatiCubit] connectMadrasati() ── END');
 184    debugPrint('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
 185  }
 186}
