  13class MicrosoftLoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  14  const MicrosoftLoginScreen({super.key});
  15
  16  @override
  17  State<MicrosoftLoginScreen> createState() => _MicrosoftLoginScreenState();
  18}
  19
  20class _MicrosoftLoginScreenState extends State<MicrosoftLoginScreen>
  21    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  22  // ── Mobile WebView fields ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  23  final GlobalKey webViewKey = GlobalKey();
  24  InAppWebViewController? webViewController;
  25  double progress = 0;
  26  final String _madrasatiLoginUrl = 'https://schools.madrasati.sa/';
  27  bool _isConnecting = false;
  28
  29  // ── Web manual-entry fields ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  30  int _webStep = 0; // 0 = intro, 1 = waiting, 2 = enter cookie
  31  final TextEditingController _cookieCtrl = TextEditingController();
  32  final TextEditingController _schoolIdCtrl = TextEditingController();
  33  bool _cookieObscured = true;
  34  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  35
  36  // Animations
  37  late final AnimationController _fadeCtrl;
  38  late final Animation<double> _fadeAnim;
  39
  40  @override
  41  void initState() {
  42    super.initState();
  43    _fadeCtrl = AnimationController(
  44        vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400));
  45    _fadeAnim = CurvedAnimation(parent: _fadeCtrl, curve: Curves.easeIn);
  46    _fadeCtrl.forward();
  47  }
  48
  49  @override
  50  void dispose() {
  51    _cookieCtrl.dispose();
  52    _schoolIdCtrl.dispose();
  53    _fadeCtrl.dispose();
  54    super.dispose();
  55  }
  56
  57  // ── School-ID extractor (mobile) ───────────────────────────────────────────
  58  String _extractSchoolId(WebUri url) {
  59    final uri = Uri.tryParse(url.toString());
  60    if (uri == null) return '';
  61    final fromQuery = uri.queryParameters['schoolId'] ??
  62        uri.queryParameters['school_id'] ??
  63        uri.queryParameters['SchoolId'];
  64    if (fromQuery != null && fromQuery.isNotEmpty) return fromQuery;
  65    for (final segment in uri.pathSegments) {
  66      if (segment.length == 32 &&
  67          RegExp(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$').hasMatch(segment)) {
  68        return segment;
  69      }
  70    }
  71    return '';
  72  }
  73
  74  // ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  75  String _buildExpiresAt() {
  76    final exp = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30));
  77    return '${exp.year}-${exp.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
  78        '${exp.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} '
  79        '${exp.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
  80        '${exp.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:00';
  81  }
  82
  83  void _goToStep(int step) {
  84    _fadeCtrl.reverse().then((_) {
  85      setState(() => _webStep = step);
  86      _fadeCtrl.forward();
  87    });
  88  }

 107              centerTitle: true,

 109            body: SafeArea(

 111                  ? _buildWebBody(context, state)
 112                  : _buildMobileBody(context, state),

 115        },
 116      ),
 117    );

 119
 120  void _blocListener(BuildContext context, MadrasatiState state) {
 121    if (state is MadrasatiSuccessState) {
 122      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
 123        content: Text(state.message),
 124        backgroundColor: ColorsManager.successColor,

 126      context.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(Routes.schedule, (r) => false);
 127    } else if (state is MadrasatiErrorState) {
 128      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
 129        content: Text(state.message),

 131      ));
 132      setState(() => _isConnecting = false);

 136  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 137  //  MOBILE – InAppWebView (unchanged logic)
 138  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 139  Widget _buildMobileBody(BuildContext context, MadrasatiState state) {
 140    return Stack(
 141      children: [
 142        Column(
 143          children: [
 144            if (progress < 1.0)
 145              LinearProgressIndicator(
 146                value: progress,
 147                color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 148                backgroundColor:
 149                    ColorsManager.primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
 150              ),
 151            Expanded(
 152              child: InAppWebView(
 153                key: webViewKey,
 154                initialUrlRequest:
 155                    URLRequest(url: WebUri(_madrasatiLoginUrl)),
 156                initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(
 157                  javaScriptEnabled: true,
 158                  domStorageEnabled: true,
 159                  databaseEnabled: true,
 160                  transparentBackground: true,
 161                  safeBrowsingEnabled: false,
 162                ),
 163                onWebViewCreated: (controller) {
 164                  webViewController = controller;
 165                  debugPrint('WebView Created');
 166                },
 167                onLoadStart: (controller, url) {
 168                  debugPrint('LOAD START – URL: $url');
 169                },
 170                onLoadStop: (controller, url) async {
 171                  setState(() => progress = 1.0);
 172                  final urlStr = url?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
 173                  final isInsideMadrasati = urlStr.contains('teacher') ||
 174                      urlStr.contains('schoolschedule') ||
 175                      urlStr.contains('schoolmanagment');
 176                  if (!isInsideMadrasati || _isConnecting) {
 177                    debugPrint('Waiting for login… URL: $urlStr');
 178                    return;
 179                  }
 180                  setState(() => _isConnecting = true);
 181                  debugPrint('🎉 Login Detected! Extracting cookies…');
 182                  final cookieManager = CookieManager.instance();
 183                  final madrasatiCookies = await cookieManager.getCookies(
 184                      url: WebUri('https://schools.madrasati.sa/'));
 185                  final msCookies = await cookieManager.getCookies(
 186                      url: WebUri('https://login.microsoftonline.com/'));
 187                  final allCookies = [...madrasatiCookies, ...msCookies];
 188                  final sessionCookieStr =
 189                      allCookies.map((c) => '${c.name}=${c.value}').join('; ');
 190                  final schoolId = _extractSchoolId(url!);
 191                  // ignore: use_build_context_synchronously
 192                  MadrasatiCubit.get(context).connectMadrasati(
 193                    sessionCookie: sessionCookieStr,
 194                    madrasatiSchoolId: schoolId,
 195                    expiresAt: _buildExpiresAt(),
 196                  );
 197                },
 198                onReceivedError: (controller, request, error) {
 199                  debugPrint('WEBVIEW ERROR – ${error.description}');
 200                },
 201                onReceivedHttpError: (controller, request, response) {
 202                  debugPrint('HTTP ERROR – ${response.statusCode}');
 203                },
 204                onUpdateVisitedHistory: (controller, url, isReload) {
 205                  debugPrint('VISITED URL: $url');
 206                },
 207                onTitleChanged: (controller, title) {
 208                  debugPrint('PAGE TITLE: $title');
 209                },
 210                onProgressChanged: (controller, p) {
 211                  setState(() => progress = p / 100);
 212                },
 213              ),
 214            ),
 215          ],
 216        ),
 217        if (state is MadrasatiLoadingState)
 218          Container(
 219            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
 220            child: const Center(
 221              child: DiscreteCircle(
 222                size: 60,
 223                color: Color(0xFFD61F69),
 224                secondCircleColor: Color(0xFFE2AD3B),
 225                thirdCircleColor: Color(0xFF0E7A5E),
 226              ),
 227            ),
 228          ),
 229      ],
 230    );
 231  }

 233  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 234  //  WEB – step-by-step manual cookie flow

 342  // ── Step indicator ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 343  Widget _buildStepIndicator() {
 344    const steps = ['فتح الموقع', 'تسجيل الدخول', 'ربط الحساب'];
 345    return Row(
 346      children: List.generate(steps.length * 2 - 1, (i) {
 347        if (i.isOdd) {
 348          return Expanded(
 349            child: Container(
 350              height: 2,
 351              color: i ~/ 2 < _webStep
 352                  ? ColorsManager.primaryColor
 353                  : ColorsManager.primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
 354            ),
 355          );
 356        }
 357        final stepIdx = i ~/ 2;
 358        final done = stepIdx < _webStep;
 359        final active = stepIdx == _webStep;
 360        return Column(
 361          children: [
 362            AnimatedContainer(
 363              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
 364              width: 36,
 365              height: 36,
 366              decoration: BoxDecoration(
 367                shape: BoxShape.circle,
 368                color: done || active
 369                    ? ColorsManager.primaryColor
 370                    : ColorsManager.primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
 371                border: Border.all(
 372                  color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 373                  width: active ? 2.5 : 0,
 374                ),
 375              ),
 376              child: Center(
 377                child: done
 378                    ? const Icon(Icons.check_rounded,
 379                        color: Colors.white, size: 18)
 380                    : Text(
 381                        '${stepIdx + 1}',
 382                        style: TextStyle(
 383                          color: active
 384                              ? Colors.white
 385                              : ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 386                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
 387                          fontSize: 14,
 388                        ),
 389                      ),
 390              ),
 391            ),
 392            const SizedBox(height: 6),
 393            Text(
 394              steps[stepIdx],
 395              style: TextStyle(
 396                fontSize: 11,
 397                fontWeight:
 398                    active ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
 399                color: active
 400                    ? ColorsManager.primaryColor
 401                    : ColorsManager.textPrimary.withValues(alpha: 0.55),
 402              ),
 403            ),
 404          ],
 405        );
 406      }),
 407    );
 408  }

  10
  11class LoginActionButtonsWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  12  const LoginActionButtonsWidget({super.key});
  13
  14  @override
  15  State<LoginActionButtonsWidget> createState() => _LoginActionButtonsWidgetState();
  16}
  17
  18class _LoginActionButtonsWidgetState extends State<LoginActionButtonsWidget> {
  19  final RoundedLoadingButtonController _btnController = RoundedLoadingButtonController();
  20
  21  @override
  22  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  23    final cubit = LoginCubit.get(context);
  24
  25    return Column(
  26      children: [
  27        BlocListener<LoginCubit, LoginState>(
  28          listenWhen: (prev, curr) =>
  29              curr is LoginLoadingState ||
  30              curr is LoginSuccessState ||
  31              curr is LoginErrorState ||
  32              curr is LoginInitialState,
  33          listener: (context, state) {
  34            if (state is LoginSuccessState) {
  35              _btnController.success();
  36            } else if (state is LoginErrorState) {
  37              _btnController.error();
  38              Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1), () {
  39                if (mounted) {
  40                  _btnController.reset();
  41                }
  42              });
  43            } else if (state is LoginInitialState) {
  44              _btnController.reset();
  45            }
  46          },
  47          child: RoundedLoadingButton(
  48            controller: _btnController,
  49            onPressed: () {
  50              cubit.login();

   1import 'package:moean/features/payment/data/models/subscription_plan_model.dart';
   2
   3class SubscriptionCurrentModel {
   4  final SubscriptionPlanModel? plan;
   5  final bool isInTrial;
   6  final bool isSubscribed;
   7  final DateTime? trialEndsAt;
   8  final DateTime? subscriptionEndsAt;
   9  final int trialDaysRemaining;
  10  final SubscriptionUsageModel usage;
  11
  12  SubscriptionCurrentModel({
  13    this.plan,
  14    required this.isInTrial,
  15    required this.isSubscribed,
  16    this.trialEndsAt,
  17    this.subscriptionEndsAt,
  18    required this.trialDaysRemaining,
  19    required this.usage,
  20  });
  21
  22  factory SubscriptionCurrentModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  23    return SubscriptionCurrentModel(
  24      plan: json['plan'] != null ? SubscriptionPlanModel.fromJson(json['plan']) : null,
  25      isInTrial: json['is_in_trial'] as bool? ?? false,
  26      isSubscribed: json['is_subscribed'] as bool? ?? false,
  27      trialEndsAt: json['trial_ends_at'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['trial_ends_at']) : null,
  28      subscriptionEndsAt: json['subscription_ends_at'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['subscription_ends_at']) : null,
  29      trialDaysRemaining: json['trial_days_remaining'] as int? ?? 0,
  30      usage: SubscriptionUsageModel.fromJson(
  31        json['usage'] is Map<String, dynamic> ? json['usage'] as Map<String, dynamic> : {},
  32      ),
  33    );
  34  }
  35
  36  /// تاريخ انتهاء الصلاحية الفعلي (سواء للاشتراك المدفوع أو التجربة)
  37  DateTime? get effectiveEndsAt => isSubscribed ? subscriptionEndsAt : trialEndsAt;
  38
  39  int get dynamicTrialDaysRemaining => dynamicDaysRemaining;
  40
  41  /// حساب الأيام المتبقية ديناميكياً
  42  int get dynamicDaysRemaining {
  43    final endsAt = effectiveEndsAt;
  44    if (endsAt == null) return 0;
  45    final now = DateTime.now();
  46    if (endsAt.isBefore(now)) return 0;
  47    return (endsAt.difference(now).inHours / 24).ceil();
  48  }
  49
  50  bool get isLastTrialDay => isInTrial && dynamicTrialDaysRemaining <= 1;
  51
  52  bool get isSubscriptionExpired {
  53    if (isSubscribed && subscriptionEndsAt != null) {
  54      return subscriptionEndsAt!.isBefore(DateTime.now());
  55    }
  56    return false;
  57  }
  58
  59  /// هل انتهت الصلاحية تماماً؟
  60  bool get isExpired {
  61    if (isSubscribed) {
  62      return subscriptionEndsAt != null && subscriptionEndsAt!.isBefore(DateTime.now());
  63    }
  64    return !isInTrial || dynamicTrialDaysRemaining <= 0;
  65  }
  66
  67  /// عنوان الخطة الحالي
  68  String get planTitle {
  69    if (isSubscribed) return plan?.name ?? 'اشتراك مدفوع';
  70    if (isInTrial) return 'تجربة مجانية (7 أيام)';
  71    return 'انتهت التجربة';
  72  }
  73
  74  /// نص موعد الانتهاء
  75  String get expirationSubtitle {
  76    final endsAt = effectiveEndsAt;
  77    if (endsAt == null) return 'بدون تاريخ انتهاء';
  78    final formattedDate = "${endsAt.year}/${endsAt.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${endsAt.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}";
  79    
  80    if (isSubscribed) {
  81      return 'ينتهي في $formattedDate (متبقي $dynamicDaysRemaining يوم)';
  82    }
  83    if (isInTrial) {
  84      return 'تنتهي في $formattedDate (متبقي $dynamicDaysRemaining ${dynamicDaysRemaining == 1 ? "يوم" : "أيام"})';
  85    }
  86    return 'انتهت الصلاحية في $formattedDate';
  87  }
  88}
  89
  90class SubscriptionUsageModel {
  91  final int aiUsedThisMonth;
  92  final int lessonsPreparedToday;
  93  final int aiRemaining;
  94  final int lessonsRemainingToday;
  95
  96  SubscriptionUsageModel({
  97    required this.aiUsedThisMonth,
  98    required this.lessonsPreparedToday,
  99    required this.aiRemaining,
 100    required this.lessonsRemainingToday,
 101  });
 102
 103  factory SubscriptionUsageModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
 104    return SubscriptionUsageModel(
 105      aiUsedThisMonth: json['ai_used_this_month'] as int? ?? 0,
 106      lessonsPreparedToday: json['lessons_prepared_today'] as int? ?? 0,
 107      aiRemaining: json['ai_remaining'] as int? ?? 0,
 108      lessonsRemainingToday: json['lessons_remaining_today'] as int? ?? 0,
 109    );
 110  }
 111}

  11class PaymentCubit extends Cubit<PaymentState> {
  12  PaymentCubit() : super(PaymentInitial());
  13
  14  static PaymentCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  15
  16  List<SubscriptionPlanModel> plans = [];
  17  OrderModel? currentOrder;
  18  Map<String, dynamic>? bankInfo;
  19  List<PaymentModel> paymentHistory = [];
  20  int selectedPlanIndex = 0;
  21  int selectedMethodIndex = 0;
  22  String? appliedPromoCode;
  23  Map<String, dynamic>? promoValidation;
  24
  25  Future<void> loadPlans() async {
  26    if (!isClosed) emit(PlansLoading());
  27    final result = await ApiService.getSubscriptions();
  28    if (isClosed) return;
  29    result.fold(
  30      (error) {
  31        if (!isClosed) emit(PlansError(error));
  32      },
  33      (data) {
  34        plans = data
  35            .map((e) =>
  36                SubscriptionPlanModel.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
  37            .where((p) => double.tryParse(p.price) != null &&
  38                double.parse(p.price) > 0 && double.parse(p.price) != 1)
  39            .toList();
  40        if (!isClosed) emit(PlansLoaded(plans));
  41      },
  42    );
  43  }
  44
  45  void selectPlan(int index) {
  46    selectedPlanIndex = index;
  47    if (!isClosed) emit(PlansLoaded(plans));
  48  }
  49
  50  void selectMethod(int index) {
  51    selectedMethodIndex = index;
  52    if (!isClosed) emit(PlansLoaded(plans));
  53  }
  54
  55  Future<void> createOrder() async {
  56    if (plans.isEmpty) return;
  57    if (!isClosed) emit(OrderCreating());
  58    final serviceId = plans[selectedPlanIndex].id;
  59    final result = await ApiService.createOrder(
  60      serviceId,
  61      promoCode: appliedPromoCode,
  62    );
  63    if (isClosed) return;
  64    result.fold(
  65      (error) {
  66        if (!isClosed) emit(OrderError(error));
  67      },
  68      (data) {
  69        currentOrder = OrderModel.fromJson(
  70            data['order'] as Map<String, dynamic>);
  71        if (!isClosed) emit(OrderCreated(currentOrder!));
  72      },
  73    );
  74  }
  75
  76  Future<void> validatePromo(String code) async {
  77    if (plans.isEmpty || code.trim().isEmpty) return;
  78    final planSlug = plans[selectedPlanIndex].slug;
  79    if (!isClosed) emit(PromoValidating());
  80    final result = await ApiService.validatePromoCode(
  81      code: code.trim(),
  82      planSlug: planSlug,
  83    );
  84    if (isClosed) return;
  85    result.fold(
  86      (error) {
  87        appliedPromoCode = null;
  88        promoValidation = null;
  89        if (!isClosed) emit(PromoError(error));
  90      },
  91      (data) {
  92        appliedPromoCode = code.trim();
  93        promoValidation = data;
  94        if (!isClosed) emit(PromoValidated(data));
  95      },
  96    );
  97  }
  98
  99  void clearPromo() {
 100    appliedPromoCode = null;
 101    promoValidation = null;
 102    if (!isClosed) emit(PromoCleared());
 103  }
 104
 105  Future<void> loadBankInfo() async {
 106    if (!isClosed) emit(BankInfoLoading());
 107    final result = await ApiService.getBankTransferInfo();
 108    if (isClosed) return;
 109    result.fold(
 110      (error) {
 111        if (!isClosed) emit(BankInfoError(error));
 112      },
 113      (data) {
 114        bankInfo = data;
 115        if (!isClosed) emit(BankInfoLoaded(data));
 116      },
 117    );
 118  }
 119
 120  // Moyasar Flow
 121  Future<void> getMoyasarConfig(int orderId) async {

 123    final result = await ApiService.getOrderCheckout(orderId);

 130        if (!isClosed) emit(MoyasarConfigLoaded(data));

 134
 135  // MyFatoorah Flow
 136  Future<void> initMyfatoorahPayment(int orderId) async {
 137    if (!isClosed) emit(MyfatoorahSessionLoading());
 138    final result = await ApiService.createMyfatoorahSession(orderId);
 139    if (isClosed) return;
 140    result.fold(
 141      (error) {
 142        if (!isClosed) emit(MyfatoorahSessionError(error));
 143      },
 144      (data) {
 145        if (!isClosed) emit(MyfatoorahSessionLoaded(data));
 146      },
 147    );
 148  }
 149
 150  Future<void> executeMyfatoorahPayment(int orderId, String sessionId) async {
 151    if (!isClosed) emit(MyfatoorahExecuteLoading());
 152    final result = await ApiService.executeMyfatoorahPayment(orderId: orderId, sessionId: sessionId);
 153    if (isClosed) return;
 154    result.fold(
 155      (error) {
 156        if (!isClosed) emit(MyfatoorahExecuteError(error));
 157      },
 158      (data) {
 159        sl<SubscriptionCubit>().fetchCurrentSubscription();
 160        if (!isClosed) emit(MyfatoorahExecuteLoaded(data));
 161      },
 162    );
 163  }
 164
 165  Future<void> verifyMyfatoorahPayment(String paymentKey) async {
 166    if (!isClosed) emit(PaymentVerifying());
 167    final result = await ApiService.verifyMyfatoorahPayment(
 168      key: paymentKey,
 169    );
 170    if (isClosed) return;
 171    result.fold(
 172      (error) {
 173        if (!isClosed) emit(PaymentVerifyError(error));
 174      },
 175      (data) {
 176        final payment = PaymentModel.fromJson(
 177            data['payment'] as Map<String, dynamic>);
 178        
 179        // Refresh subscription state globally
 180        sl<SubscriptionCubit>().fetchCurrentSubscription();
 181        
 182        if (!isClosed) emit(PaymentVerified(payment));
 183      },
 184    );
 185  }
 186
 187  Future<void> verifyPayment(String paymentId, {int? orderId}) async {
 188    if (!isClosed) emit(PaymentVerifying());
 189    
 190    // إذا كان لدينا orderId، نقوم بحفظ المرجع أولاً (حسب المستند)
 191    if (orderId != null) {
 192      await ApiService.savePaymentReference(
 193        orderId: orderId,
 194        moyasarPaymentId: paymentId,
 195      );
 196    }
 197
 198    final result = await ApiService.verifyPayment(paymentId);
 199    if (isClosed) return;
 200    result.fold(
 201      (error) {
 202        if (!isClosed) emit(PaymentVerifyError(error));
 203      },
 204      (data) {
 205        final payment = PaymentModel.fromJson(
 206            data['payment'] as Map<String, dynamic>);
 207        
 208        // Refresh subscription state globally
 209        sl<SubscriptionCubit>().fetchCurrentSubscription();
 210        
 211        if (!isClosed) emit(PaymentVerified(payment));
 212      },
 213    );
 214  }
 215
 216  Future<void> uploadReceiptForOrder({
 217    required int orderId,
 218    required String filePath,
 219    required String fileName,
 220  }) async {
 221    if (!isClosed) emit(ReceiptUploading());
 222    final result = await ApiService.uploadManualReceipt(

 226    );
 227    if (isClosed) return;
 228    result.fold(
 229      (error) {
 230        if (!isClosed) emit(ReceiptUploadError(error));
 231      },
 232      (data) {
 233        final payment = PaymentModel.fromJson(
 234            data['payment'] as Map<String, dynamic>);
 235        if (!isClosed) emit(ReceiptUploaded(payment));
 236      },
 237    );
 238  }
 239
 240  Future<void> loadHistory() async {
 241    if (!isClosed) emit(HistoryLoading());
 242    final result = await ApiService.getPaymentHistory();
 243    if (isClosed) return;
 244    result.fold(
 245      (error) {
 246        if (!isClosed) emit(HistoryError(error));
 247      },
 248      (data) {
 249        final list = (data['data'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [])
 250            .map((e) =>
 251                PaymentModel.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
 252            .toList();
 253        paymentHistory = list;
 254        if (!isClosed) emit(HistoryLoaded(list));
 255      },
 256    );
 257  }
 258}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/constants.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/payment/presentation/cubit/subscription_state.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/features/payment/data/models/subscription_current_model.dart';
   7
   8class SubscriptionCubit extends Cubit<SubscriptionState> {
   9  SubscriptionCubit() : super(SubscriptionInitial());
  10
  11  static SubscriptionCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  12
  13  SubscriptionCurrentModel? currentSubscription;
  14  String? lastError;
  15  bool _isLoading = false;
  16
  17  Future<void> fetchCurrentSubscription({bool forceRefresh = false}) async {
  18    if (token == null || token!.isEmpty) return;
  19    if (_isLoading) return;
  20
  21    if (!forceRefresh && (currentSubscription != null || lastError != null)) {
  22      if (currentSubscription != null && state is! SubscriptionLoaded) {
  23        if (!isClosed) emit(SubscriptionLoaded(currentSubscription!));
  24      } else if (lastError != null && state is! SubscriptionError) {
  25        if (!isClosed) emit(SubscriptionError(lastError!));
  26      }
  27      return;
  28    }
  29
  30    _isLoading = true;
  31    if (currentSubscription == null && lastError == null && !isClosed) {
  32      emit(SubscriptionLoading());
  33    }
  34
  35    final result = await ApiService.getCurrentSubscription();
  36    _isLoading = false;
  37    if (isClosed) return;
  38
  39    result.fold(
  40      (error) {
  41        lastError = error;
  42        if (!isClosed) emit(SubscriptionError(error));
  43      },
  44      (data) {
  45        lastError = null;
  46        final current = SubscriptionCurrentModel.fromJson(data);
  47        currentSubscription = current;
  48        if (!isClosed) emit(SubscriptionLoaded(current));
  49      },
  50    );
  51  }
  52
  53  void clearData() {
  54    currentSubscription = null;
  55    lastError = null;
  56    _isLoading = false;
  57    if (!isClosed) emit(SubscriptionInitial());
  58  }
  59
  60  Future<void> upgradeSubscription({required String planSlug, String? promoCode}) async {
  61    if (!isClosed) emit(SubscriptionUpgradeLoading());
  62    final result = await ApiService.upgradeSubscription(planSlug: planSlug, promoCode: promoCode);
  63    if (isClosed) return;
  64    result.fold(
  65      (error) {
  66        if (!isClosed) emit(SubscriptionUpgradeError(error));
  67      },
  68      (data) {
  69        if (!isClosed) emit(SubscriptionUpgradeSuccess(data['message'] ?? 'تم الترقية بنجاح'));
  70        fetchCurrentSubscription(forceRefresh: true); // Refresh after upgrade
  71      },
  72    );
  73  }
  74}

  23class _CheckoutScreenState extends State<CheckoutScreen> {

  25  void initState() {

  31  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

  46             
  47            ),

  57                listener: (context, state) {
  58                  if (state is OrderError) {
  59                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(

  64                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(

  66                      ),
  67                    );
  68                  } else if (state is OrderCreated) {
  69                    final cubit = PaymentCubit.get(context);
  70                    if (cubit.selectedMethodIndex == 0) {
  71                      context.push<Map<String, dynamic>>(
  72                        Routes.myfatoorahPayment,
  73                        arguments: {
  74                          'orderId': state.order.id,
  75                          'amount': state.order.amount,

  77                      );
  78                    } else {
  79                      context.push<Map<String, dynamic>>(
  80                        Routes.bankTransfer,
  81                        arguments: {

  83                          'amount': state.order.amount,
  84                          'planName': state.order.service?.name ?? '',
  85                        },
  86                      );
  87                    }
  88                  }
  89                },
  90                buildWhen: (_, s) =>
  91                    s is PlansLoading ||
  92                    s is PlansLoaded ||
  93                    s is PlansError ||
  94                    s is OrderCreating ||
  95                    s is OrderCreated ||
  96                    s is OrderError ||
  97                    s is PromoValidating ||
  98                    s is PromoValidated ||
  99                    s is PromoError ||
 100                    s is PromoCleared,
 101                builder: (context, state) {
 102                  final cubit = PaymentCubit.get(context);
 103                  return ConditionalBuilder(
 104                    loadingState: state is PlansLoading,
 105                    errorState: state is PlansError,
 106                    emptyState: state is PlansLoaded && cubit.plans.isEmpty,
 107                    errorBuilder: (_) => Center(
 108                      child: Text(
 109                        (state as PlansError).error,
 110                        style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
 111                            color: ColorsManager.errorColor),
 112                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
 113                      ),
 114                    ),
 115                    emptyBuilder: (_) => Center(
 116                      child: Text(
 117                        appTranslation().get('pay_no_plans'),
 118                        style: TextStylesManager.regular14,
 119                      ),
 120                    ),
 121                    successBuilder: (_) =>
 122                        _CheckoutBody(isSubmitting: state is OrderCreating),
 123                  );
 124                },
 125              ),
 126            ),
 127          ],
 128        ),
 129      ),
 130    );
 131  }

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/theme/colors.dart';

   5import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/primary/primary_elevated_button.dart';

  10import 'package:moean/features/payment/presentation/cubit/payment_state.dart';
  11import 'package:moean/features/payment/presentation/widgets/visa_card_display.dart';
  12import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/secrets.dart';
  13import 'package:myfatoorah_flutter/myfatoorah_flutter.dart';
  14
  15class MyfatoorahPaymentScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  16  const MyfatoorahPaymentScreen({super.key});
  17
  18  @override
  19  State<MyfatoorahPaymentScreen> createState() => _MyfatoorahPaymentScreenState();
  20}
  21
  22class _MyfatoorahPaymentScreenState extends State<MyfatoorahPaymentScreen> {
  23  late String _amount;
  24  late int _orderId;
  25  String? _sessionId;
  26  
  27  late MFCardPaymentView mfCardView;
  28  bool _isProcessing = false;
  29  
  30  @override
  31  void initState() {
  32    super.initState();
  33    MFSDK.init(Secrets.myfatoorahApiKey, MFCountry.SAUDIARABIA, MFEnvironment.LIVE);
  34    
  35    // تصميم حقول MyFatoorah المدمجة بأفضل شكل ممكن
  36    MFCardViewStyle cardViewStyle = MFCardViewStyle();
  37    cardViewStyle.cardHeight = 300;
  38    cardViewStyle.hideCardIcons = false;
  39    
  40    // ستايل الحقول
  41    cardViewStyle.input?.inputMargin = 12;
  42    
  43    // ستايل العناوين
  44    cardViewStyle.label?.display = true;
  45    cardViewStyle.label?.fontWeight = MFFontWeight.Bold;
  46    
  47    mfCardView = MFCardPaymentView(cardViewStyle: cardViewStyle);
  48  }
  49  
  50  bool _isInitialized = false;
  51
  52  @override
  53  void didChangeDependencies() {
  54    super.didChangeDependencies();
  55    if (!_isInitialized) {
  56      _isInitialized = true;
  57      final args = ModalRoute.of(context)?.settings.arguments as Map<String, dynamic>?;
  58      _amount = args?['amount'] as String? ?? '0';
  59      _orderId = args?['orderId'] as int? ?? 0;
  60      
  61      PaymentCubit.get(context).initMyfatoorahPayment(_orderId);
  62    }
  63  }
  64
  65  void _setupMyfatoorahSDK(String sessionId, String portalHost) {
  66    _sessionId = sessionId;
  67    final initiateSessionResponse = MFInitiateSessionResponse(
  68      sessionId: sessionId,
  69      countryCode: MFCountry.SAUDIARABIA,
  70    );
  71    
  72    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), () {
  73      if (mounted) {
  74        mfCardView.load(initiateSessionResponse, null);
  75      }
  76    });
  77  }
  78
  79  void _executePayment() {
  80    if (_sessionId != null) {
  81       setState(() { _isProcessing = true; });
  82       final invoiceAmount = double.tryParse(_amount) ?? 0.0;
  83       final executeRequest = MFExecutePaymentRequest(
  84          invoiceValue: invoiceAmount,
  85          sessionId: _sessionId,
  86       );
  87       
  88       mfCardView.pay(executeRequest, MFLanguage.ARABIC, (String invoiceId) {
  89          // Callback
  90       }).then((response) {
  91          if (!mounted) return;
  92          setState(() { _isProcessing = false; });
  93          if (response.invoiceStatus == "Paid") {
  94             final paymentKey = (response.invoiceTransactions != null && response.invoiceTransactions!.isNotEmpty)
  95                 ? (response.invoiceTransactions!.first.paymentId ?? response.invoiceId?.toString() ?? "")
  96                 : (response.invoiceId?.toString() ?? "");
  97             PaymentCubit.get(context).verifyMyfatoorahPayment(paymentKey);
  98          } else {
  99             ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 100               const SnackBar(content: Text("فشلت عملية الدفع")),
 101             );
 102          }
 103       }).catchError((error) {
 104          if (!mounted) return;
 105          setState(() { _isProcessing = false; });
 106          String errorMsg = error.toString();
 107          if (error is MFError) {
 108             errorMsg = error.message ?? errorMsg;
 109          }
 110          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(errorMsg)));
 111       });
 112    }
 113  }
 114
 115  @override
 116  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 117    return BlocConsumer<PaymentCubit, PaymentState>(
 118      listenWhen: (_, s) =>
 119          s is MyfatoorahSessionLoaded ||
 120          s is MyfatoorahSessionError ||
 121          s is MyfatoorahExecuteLoaded ||
 122          s is MyfatoorahExecuteError ||
 123          s is PaymentVerified ||
 124          s is PaymentVerifyError,
 125      listener: (context, state) {
 126        if (state is MyfatoorahSessionError) {
 127          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 128            SnackBar(content: Text(state.error), backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor),
 129          );
 130        } else if (state is PaymentVerifyError) {
 131          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 132            SnackBar(content: Text(state.error), backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor),
 133          );
 134        } else if (state is MyfatoorahSessionLoaded) {
 135          final session = state.session['session'];
 136          if (session != null) {
 137             setState(() {
 138                if (session['amount'] != null) {
 139                  _amount = session['amount'].toString();
 140                }
 141                if (session['order_id'] != null) {
 142                  _orderId = session['order_id'] is int 
 143                      ? session['order_id'] as int 
 144                      : (int.tryParse(session['order_id'].toString()) ?? _orderId);
 145                }
 146                _setupMyfatoorahSDK(session['session_id'], session['portal_host']);
 147             });
 148          }
 149        } else if (state is PaymentVerified) {
 150          Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(
 151            context,
 152            Routes.paymentResult,
 153            arguments: {'status': state.payment.status, 'from': 'myfatoorah'},
 154          );
 155        }
 156      },
 157      builder: (context, state) {
 158        final isLoadingSession = state is MyfatoorahSessionLoading;
 159        final isExecuting = state is MyfatoorahExecuteLoading || state is PaymentVerifying;
 160        final isError = state is MyfatoorahSessionError;
 161
 162        return Scaffold(
 163          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.background,
 164          appBar: AppBar(
 165            backgroundColor: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
 166            elevation: 0,
 167            title: Text(
 168              appTranslation().get('electronic_payment'),
 169              style: TextStyle(color: ColorsManager.textPrimary, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
 170            ),
 171            centerTitle: true,
 172            leading: IconButton(
 173              icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded, color: ColorsManager.textPrimary, size: 20),
 174              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
 175            ),
 176          ),
 177          body: SafeArea(
 178            child: SingleChildScrollView(
 179              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
 180              child: Column(
 181                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
 182                children: [
 183                  const VisaCardDisplay(
 184                    cardNumber: '',
 185                    cardHolder: '',
 186                    expiryDate: '',
 187                  ),
 188                  verticalSpace24,
 189                  ConditionalBuilder(
 190                    loadingState: isLoadingSession,
 191                    errorState: isError,
 192                    errorBuilder: (context) {
 193                      final errorMsg = state is MyfatoorahSessionError ? state.error : '';
 194                      return Column(
 195                        children: [
 196                          Text('${appTranslation().get('session_error')}$errorMsg', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
 197                          verticalSpace16,
 198                          PrimaryElevatedButton(
 199                            text: appTranslation().get('retry'),
 200                            onPressed: () => PaymentCubit.get(context).initMyfatoorahPayment(_orderId),
 201                          ),
 202                        ]
 203                      );
 204                    },
 205                    successBuilder: (context) {
 206                      if (_sessionId == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
 207                      return Column(
 208                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
 209                        children: [
 210                          Text(
 211                            appTranslation().get('card_details'),
 212                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16),
 213                          ),
 214                          verticalSpace16,
 215                          
 216                          Container(
 217                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
 218                              color: Colors.white,
 219                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
 220                              boxShadow: [
 221                                BoxShadow(
 222                                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
 223                                  blurRadius: 10,
 224                                  offset: const Offset(0, 4),
 225                                ),
 226                              ],
 227                            ),
 228                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
 229                            child: SizedBox(
 230                              height: 300,
 231                              child: mfCardView,
 232                            ),
 233                          ),
 234                          
 235                          verticalSpace32,
 236                          PrimaryElevatedButton(
 237                            text: '${appTranslation().get('pay_btn_prefix')} $_amount ${appTranslation().get('currency_sar')}',
 238                            isLoading: _isProcessing || isExecuting,
 239                            onPressed: _executePayment,
 240                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1B49A8), 
 241                          ),
 242                        ],
 243                      );
 244                    }
 245                  ),
 246                ],
 247              ),
 248            ),
 249          ),
 250        );
 251      },
 252    );
 253  }
 254}

  43          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
  44        ),
  45        bottom: PreferredSize(
  46          preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(1),
  47          child: Divider(height: 1, color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
  48        ),
  49      ),
  50      body: BlocBuilder<PaymentCubit, PaymentState>(
  51        buildWhen: (_, s) =>
  52            s is HistoryLoading || s is HistoryLoaded || s is HistoryError,
  53        builder: (context, state) {
  54          final cubit = PaymentCubit.get(context);
  55          return ConditionalBuilder(
  56            loadingState: state is HistoryLoading,
  57            errorState: state is HistoryError,
  58            emptyState:
  59                state is HistoryLoaded && cubit.paymentHistory.isEmpty,
  60            errorBuilder: (_) => Center(
  61              child: Text(
  62                (state as HistoryError).error,
  63                style: TextStylesManager.regular14
  64                    .copyWith(color: ColorsManager.errorColor),
  65                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
  66              ),
  67            ),
  68            emptyBuilder: (_) => Center(
  69              child: Column(
  70                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
  71                children: [
  72                  Icon(Icons.receipt_long_outlined,
  73                      size: 60, color: ColorsManager.secondaryText),
  74                  verticalSpace16,
  75                  Text(
  76                    appTranslation().get('pay_no_history'),
  77                    style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
  78                      color: ColorsManager.secondaryText,
  79                    ),
  80                  ),
  81                ],
  82              ),
  83            ),
  84            successBuilder: (_) => RefreshIndicator(
  85              color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  86              onRefresh: () => cubit.loadHistory(),
  87              child: ListView.separated(
  88                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
  89                itemCount: cubit.paymentHistory.length,
  90                separatorBuilder: (_, __) => verticalSpace12,
  91                itemBuilder: (_, i) => PaymentHistoryItemWidget(
  92                  payment: cubit.paymentHistory[i],
  93                ),
  94              ),
  95            ),
  96          );
  97        },
  98      ),
  99    );
 100  }

  86  _ResultInfo _resultInfo(String status, String from) {
  87    switch (status) {
  88      case 'paid':
  89        return _ResultInfo(
  90          icon: Icons.check_circle_rounded,
  91          iconColor: ColorsManager.successColor,
  92          iconBgColor: const Color(0xFFDCFCE7),
  93          title: appTranslation().get('pay_result_paid_title'),
  94          subtitle: appTranslation().get('pay_result_paid_subtitle'),
  95        );
  96      case 'failed':
  97      case 'rejected':
  98        return _ResultInfo(
  99          icon: Icons.cancel_rounded,
 100          iconColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 101          iconBgColor: const Color(0xFFFEE2E2),
 102          title: appTranslation().get('pay_result_failed_title'),
 103          subtitle: appTranslation().get('pay_result_failed_subtitle'),
 104        );
 105      default:
 106        return _ResultInfo(
 107          icon: Icons.hourglass_top_rounded,
 108          iconColor: const Color(0xFF854D0E),
 109          iconBgColor: const Color(0xFFFEF9C3),
 110          title: from == 'bank'
 111              ? appTranslation().get('pay_result_pending_bank_title')
 112              : appTranslation().get('pay_result_pending_title'),
 113          subtitle: from == 'bank'
 114              ? appTranslation().get('pay_result_pending_bank_subtitle')
 115              : appTranslation().get('pay_result_pending_subtitle'),
 116        );
 117    }
 118  }
 119}

 100  _StatusInfo _statusInfo(String status) {
 101    switch (status) {
 102      case 'paid':
 103        return _StatusInfo(
 104          label: appTranslation().get('pay_status_paid'),
 105          bgColor: const Color(0xFFDCFCE7),
 106          textColor: const Color(0xFF15803D),
 107        );
 108      case 'processing':
 109        return _StatusInfo(
 110          label: appTranslation().get('pay_status_processing'),
 111          bgColor: const Color(0xFFE0F2FE),
 112          textColor: const Color(0xFF0369A1),
 113        );
 114      case 'waiting_verification':
 115        return _StatusInfo(
 116          label: appTranslation().get('pay_status_waiting_verification'),
 117          bgColor: const Color(0xFFFEF9C3),
 118          textColor: const Color(0xFF854D0E),
 119        );
 120      case 'failed':
 121        return _StatusInfo(
 122          label: appTranslation().get('pay_status_failed'),
 123          bgColor: const Color(0xFFFEE2E2),
 124          textColor: const Color(0xFFB91C1C),
 125        );
 126      case 'rejected':
 127        return _StatusInfo(
 128          label: appTranslation().get('pay_status_rejected'),
 129          bgColor: const Color(0xFFFEE2E2),
 130          textColor: const Color(0xFFB91C1C),
 131        );
 132      case 'cancelled':
 133        return _StatusInfo(
 134          label: appTranslation().get('pay_status_cancelled'),
 135          bgColor: const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
 136          textColor: const Color(0xFF64748B),
 137        );
 138      default:
 139        return _StatusInfo(
 140          label: appTranslation().get('pay_status_pending'),
 141          bgColor: const Color(0xFFFEF9C3),
 142          textColor: const Color(0xFF854D0E),
 143        );
 144    }
 145  }
 146
 147  String _methodLabel(String method) {
 148    if (method == 'moyasar') {
 149      return appTranslation().get('pay_method_online');
 150    }
 151    return appTranslation().get('pay_method_bank');
 152  }
 153
 154  IconData _methodIcon(String method) {
 155    return method == 'moyasar'
 156        ? Icons.credit_card_outlined
 157        : Icons.account_balance_outlined;
 158  }
 159
 160  String _formatDate(String? dateStr) {
 161    if (dateStr == null) return '';
 162    try {
 163      final dt = DateTime.parse(dateStr).toLocal();
 164      return '${dt.year}-${dt.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${dt.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
 165    } catch (_) {
 166      return dateStr;
 167    }
 168  }
 169}
 170
 171class _StatusInfo {
 172  final String label;
 173  final Color bgColor;
 174  final Color textColor;
 175  const _StatusInfo({
 176    required this.label,
 177    required this.bgColor,
 178    required this.textColor,
 179  });
 180}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

   6import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/spacing.dart';
   7import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/primary/primary_text_field.dart';
   8import 'package:moean/features/payment/presentation/cubit/payment_cubit.dart';
   9import 'package:moean/features/payment/presentation/cubit/payment_state.dart';
  10
  11class PromoCodeSectionWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  12  const PromoCodeSectionWidget({super.key});
  13
  14  @override
  15  State<PromoCodeSectionWidget> createState() => _PromoCodeSectionWidgetState();
  16}
  17
  18class _PromoCodeSectionWidgetState extends State<PromoCodeSectionWidget> {
  19  late final TextEditingController _controller;
  20
  21  @override
  22  void initState() {
  23    super.initState();
  24    _controller = TextEditingController();
  25  }
  26
  27  @override
  28  void dispose() {
  29    _controller.dispose();
  30    super.dispose();
  31  }
  32
  33  void _applyPromo(BuildContext context) {
  34    final cubit = PaymentCubit.get(context);
  35    cubit.validatePromo(_controller.text);
  36  }
  37
  38  void _clearPromo(BuildContext context) {
  39    _controller.clear();
  40    PaymentCubit.get(context).clearPromo();
  41  }
  42
  43  @override
  44  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  45    return BlocBuilder<PaymentCubit, PaymentState>(
  46      buildWhen: (_, s) =>
  47          s is PromoValidating ||
  48          s is PromoValidated ||
  49          s is PromoError ||
  50          s is PromoCleared,
  51      builder: (context, state) {
  52        final cubit = PaymentCubit.get(context);
  53        final isValidated = state is PromoValidated ||
  54            (cubit.promoValidation != null && state is! PromoCleared);
  55        final isLoading = state is PromoValidating;
  56
  57        return Container(
  58          width: double.infinity,
  59          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
  60          decoration: BoxDecoration(
  61            color: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
  62            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
  63            border: Border.all(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
  64          ),
  65          child: Column(
  66            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  67            children: [
  68              Text(
  69                appTranslation().get('promo_section_title'),
  70                style: TextStylesManager.bold16
  71                    .copyWith(color: ColorsManager.textPrimary),
  72              ),
  73              verticalSpace12,
  74              // Input row
  75              Row(
  76                children: [
  77                  // Apply / Remove button
  78                  AnimatedSwitcher(
  79                    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
  80                    child: isValidated
  81                        ? GestureDetector(
  82                            key: const ValueKey('remove'),
  83                            onTap: () => _clearPromo(context),
  84                            child: Container(
  85                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
  86                                  horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
  87                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
  88                                color: ColorsManager.errorColor
  89                                    .withValues(alpha: 0.1),
  90                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  91                                border: Border.all(
  92                                    color: ColorsManager.errorColor
  93                                        .withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
  94                              ),
  95                              child: Text(
  96                                appTranslation().get('promo_remove'),
  97                                style: TextStylesManager.medium14.copyWith(
  98                                    color: ColorsManager.errorColor),
  99                              ),
 100                            ),
 101                          )
 102                        : GestureDetector(
 103                            key: const ValueKey('apply'),
 104                            onTap: isLoading ? null : () => _applyPromo(context),
 105                            child: Container(
 106                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
 107                                  horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
 108                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
 109                                color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 110                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
 111                              ),
 112                              child: isLoading
 113                                  ? const SizedBox(
 114                                      width: 18,
 115                                      height: 18,
 116                                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
 117                                        strokeWidth: 2,
 118                                        color: Colors.white,
 119                                      ),
 120                                    )
 121                                  : Text(
 122                                      appTranslation().get('promo_apply'),
 123                                      style: TextStylesManager.medium14
 124                                          .copyWith(color: Colors.white),
 125                                    ),
 126                            ),
 127                          ),
 128                  ),
 129                  horizontalSpace10,
 130                  // Text field
 131                  Expanded(
 132                    child: PrimaryTextField(
 133                      controller: _controller,
 134                      hint: appTranslation().get('promo_hint'),
 135                      enabled: !isValidated && !isLoading,
 136                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
 137                      onFieldSubmitted: (_) => _applyPromo(context),
 138                    ),
 139                  ),
 140                ],
 141              ),
 142              // Feedback row
 143              if (state is PromoValidated) ...[
 144                verticalSpace10,
 145                _PromoSuccessBanner(data: state.data),
 146              ] else if (state is PromoError) ...[
 147                verticalSpace10,
 148                _PromoErrorBanner(message: state.error),
 149              ],
 150            ],
 151          ),
 152        );
 153      },
 154    );
 155  }
 156}
 157
 158class _PromoSuccessBanner extends StatelessWidget {
 159  final Map<String, dynamic> data;
 160
 161  const _PromoSuccessBanner({required this.data});
 162
 163  @override
 164  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 165    final discount = data['discount'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
 166    final discountType = discount?['type'] as String? ?? 'percentage';
 167    final discountValue = (discount?['value'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
 168    final finalAmount = (data['final_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble();
 169
 170    final discountDisplay = discountType == 'percentage'
 171        ? '${discountValue.toStringAsFixed(0)}%'
 172        : '${discountValue.toStringAsFixed(2)} ر.س';
 173
 174    return Container(
 175      width: double.infinity,
 176      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
 177      decoration: BoxDecoration(
 178        color: const Color(0xFF22C55E).withValues(alpha: 0.08),
 179        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
 180        border: Border.all(
 181            color: const Color(0xFF22C55E).withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
 182      ),
 183      child: Row(
 184        children: [
 185          if (finalAmount != null)
 186            Text(
 187              '$finalAmount ر.س',
 188              style: TextStylesManager.bold14
 189                  .copyWith(color: const Color(0xFF16A34A)),
 190            ),
 191          const Spacer(),
 192          Text(
 193            '${appTranslation().get('promo_discount_label')}: $discountDisplay',
 194            style: TextStylesManager.medium14
 195                .copyWith(color: const Color(0xFF16A34A)),
 196          ),
 197          horizontalSpace8,
 198          const Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded,
 199              color: Color(0xFF22C55E), size: 18),
 200        ],
 201      ),
 202    );
 203  }
 204}

   9class ReceiptUploadWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  10  final void Function(String filePath, String fileName) onFileSelected;
  11
  12  const ReceiptUploadWidget({super.key, required this.onFileSelected});
  13
  14  @override
  15  State<ReceiptUploadWidget> createState() => _ReceiptUploadWidgetState();
  16}
  17
  18class _ReceiptUploadWidgetState extends State<ReceiptUploadWidget> {
  19  String? _selectedFileName;
  20
  21  Future<void> _pickFile() async {
  22    final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
  23      type: FileType.custom,
  24      allowedExtensions: ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'pdf'],
  25      allowMultiple: false,
  26    );
  27    if (result == null || result.files.isEmpty) return;
  28    final file = result.files.single;
  29    if (file.path == null) return;
  30    final sizeInMb = (file.size / (1024 * 1024));
  31    if (sizeInMb > 5) {
  32      if (mounted) {
  33        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  34          SnackBar(
  35            content: Text(
  36              appTranslation().get('pay_file_too_large'),

  37  static String _formatArabicDate(DateTime? date) {
  38    if (date == null) return 'غير محدد';
  39    const arabicMonths = [
  40      'يناير',
  41      'فبراير',
  42      'مارس',
  43      'أبريل',
  44      'مايو',
  45      'يونيو',

  52    ];
  53    final monthName = (date.month >= 1 && date.month <= 12)
  54        ? arabicMonths[date.month - 1]
  55        : '${date.month}';
  56    return '${date.day} $monthName ${date.year}';
  57  }
  58
  59  static String _formatRemainingDaysText(int days) {

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/di/injections.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/theme/colors.dart';

   9
  10class TrialBannerWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  11  const TrialBannerWidget({super.key});
  12
  13  static bool isBannerVisible(SubscriptionState state) {
  14    if (state is SubscriptionLoaded) {
  15      final current = state.current;
  16      if (current.isSubscribed && !current.isSubscriptionExpired) {
  17        return false;
  18      }
  19      return true;
  20    } else if (state is SubscriptionError) {
  21      if (state.error.contains('__402__') ||
  22          state.error.contains('trial_expired') ||
  23          state.error.contains('انتهت')) {
  24        return true;
  25      }
  26    } else {
  27      final current = sl<SubscriptionCubit>().currentSubscription;
  28      if (current != null) {
  29        if (current.isSubscribed && !current.isSubscriptionExpired) {
  30          return false;
  31        }
  32        return true;
  33      }
  34    }
  35    return false;
  36  }
  37
  38  @override
  39  State<TrialBannerWidget> createState() => _TrialBannerWidgetState();
  40}
  41
  42class _TrialBannerWidgetState extends State<TrialBannerWidget> {
  43  @override
  44  void initState() {
  45    super.initState();
  46    final cubit = sl<SubscriptionCubit>();
  47    if (cubit.currentSubscription == null && cubit.lastError == null && cubit.state is SubscriptionInitial) {
  48      cubit.fetchCurrentSubscription();
  49    }
  50  }
  51
  52  @override
  53  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  54    return BlocBuilder<SubscriptionCubit, SubscriptionState>(
  55      bloc: sl<SubscriptionCubit>(),
  56      builder: (context, state) {
  57        if (state is SubscriptionLoaded) {
  58          final current = state.current;
  59          
  60          if (current.isSubscribed && !current.isSubscriptionExpired) {
  61            // Subscribed and Active -> Hidden
  62            return const SizedBox.shrink();
  63          }
  64
  65          if (current.isSubscribed && current.isSubscriptionExpired) {
  66            // Subscribed but expired
  67            return _buildBanner(
  68              context,
  69              icon: Icons.alarm,
  70              text: '⏰ انتهى اشتراكك المدفوع.',
  71              buttonText: 'جدد اشتراكك',
  72              color: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  73              isExpired: true,
  74            );
  75          }
  76
  77          if (current.isInTrial) {
  78            final days = current.dynamicDaysRemaining;
  79            if (days <= 0) {
  80              // Trial expired
  81              return _buildBanner(
  82                context,
  83                icon: Icons.alarm,
  84                text: '⏰ انتهت فترتك التجريبية المجانية.',
  85                buttonText: 'اشترك الآن',
  86                color: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  87                isExpired: true,
  88              );
  89            } else if (days == 1) {
  90              return _buildBanner(
  91                context,

  10class TrialBannerWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  11  const TrialBannerWidget({super.key});
  12
  13  static bool isBannerVisible(SubscriptionState state) {
  14    if (state is SubscriptionLoaded) {
  15      final current = state.current;
  16      if (current.isSubscribed && !current.isSubscriptionExpired) {
  17        return false;
  18      }
  19      return true;
  20    } else if (state is SubscriptionError) {
  21      if (state.error.contains('__402__') ||
  22          state.error.contains('trial_expired') ||
  23          state.error.contains('انتهت')) {
  24        return true;
  25      }
  26    } else {
  27      final current = sl<SubscriptionCubit>().currentSubscription;
  28      if (current != null) {
  29        if (current.isSubscribed && !current.isSubscriptionExpired) {
  30          return false;
  31        }
  32        return true;
  33      }
  34    }
  35    return false;
  36  }
  37
  38  @override
  39  State<TrialBannerWidget> createState() => _TrialBannerWidgetState();
  40}
  41
  42class _TrialBannerWidgetState extends State<TrialBannerWidget> {
  43  @override
  44  void initState() {
  45    super.initState();
  46    // Always force-refresh to pick up payment status changes immediately
  47    sl<SubscriptionCubit>().fetchCurrentSubscription(forceRefresh: true);
  48  }
  49
  50  @override
  51  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  52    return BlocBuilder<SubscriptionCubit, SubscriptionState>(
  53      bloc: sl<SubscriptionCubit>(),
  54      builder: (context, state) {
  55        if (state is SubscriptionLoaded) {
  56          final current = state.current;
  57          
  58          if (current.isSubscribed && !current.isSubscriptionExpired) {
  59            // Subscribed and Active -> Hidden
  60            return const SizedBox.shrink();
  61          }
  62
  63          if (current.isSubscribed && current.isSubscriptionExpired) {
  64            // Subscribed but expired
  65            return _buildBanner(
  66              context,
  67              icon: Icons.alarm,
  68              text: '⏰ انتهى اشتراكك المدفوع.',
  69              buttonText: 'جدد اشتراكك',
  70              color: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  71              isExpired: true,
  72            );
  73          }
  74
  75          if (current.isInTrial) {
  76            final days = current.dynamicDaysRemaining;
  77            if (days <= 0) {
  78              // Trial expired
  79              return _buildBanner(
  80                context,
  81                icon: Icons.alarm,
  82                text: '⏰ انتهت فترتك التجريبية المجانية.',
  83                buttonText: 'اشترك الآن',
  84                color: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  85                isExpired: true,
  86              );
  87            } else if (days == 1) {
  88              return _buildBanner(
  89                context,
  90                icon: Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
  91                text: '⚠️ آخر يوم في تجربتك المجانية!',
  92                buttonText: 'اشترك الآن',
  93                color: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  94                isExpired: false,
  95              );
  96            } else {
  97              return _buildBanner(
  98                context,
  99                icon: Icons.celebration,
 100                text: '🎉 متبقي $days أيام على التجربة المجانية',
 101                buttonText: 'اشترك الآن',
 102                color:const Color(0xFFD97706),
 103                // ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 104                isExpired: false,
 105              );
 106            }
 107          }
 108
 109          // Not in trial and not subscribed -> Trial Expired
 110          return _buildBanner(
 111            context,
 112            icon: Icons.alarm,
 113            text: '⏰ انتهت فترتك التجريبية المجانية.',
 114            buttonText: 'اشترك الآن',
 115            color: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 116            isExpired: true,
 117          );
 118        } else if (state is SubscriptionError) {
 119          if (state.error.contains('__402__') ||
 120              state.error.contains('trial_expired') ||
 121              state.error.contains('انتهت')) {
 122            return _buildBanner(
 123              context,
 124              icon: Icons.alarm,
 125              text: '⏰ انتهت فترتك التجريبية المجانية.',
 126              buttonText: 'اشترك الآن',
 127              color: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 128              isExpired: true,
 129            );
 130          }
 131        }
 132        return const SizedBox.shrink();
 133      },
 134    );
 135  }

   1class PresentationModel {
   2  final int id;
   3  final int lessonId;
   4  final String status;
   5  final String? templateId;
   6  final String? filePath;
   7  final int? slideCount;
   8  final String? generatedAt;
   9  final String? generationError;
  10  final List<PresentationSlideModel> slides;
  11
  12  PresentationModel({
  13    required this.id,
  14    required this.lessonId,
  15    required this.status,
  16    this.templateId,
  17    this.filePath,
  18    this.slideCount,
  19    this.generatedAt,
  20    this.generationError,
  21    this.slides = const [],
  22  });
  23
  24  factory PresentationModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  25    // Some endpoints wrap the model in a "presentation" key, while others might return it directly.
  26    final data = json.containsKey('presentation') ? (json['presentation'] as Map<String, dynamic>) : json;
  27    
  28    return PresentationModel(
  29      id: data['id'] as int? ?? 0,
  30      lessonId: data['lesson_id'] as int? ?? 0,
  31      status: data['status'] as String? ?? json['status'] as String? ?? 'pending',
  32      templateId: data['template_id'] as String?,
  33      filePath: data['file_path'] as String?,
  34      slideCount: data['slide_count'] as int?,
  35      generatedAt: data['generated_at'] as String?,
  36      generationError: data['generation_error'] as String?,
  37      slides: (data['slides'] as List<dynamic>?)
  38              ?.map((e) => PresentationSlideModel.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
  39              .toList() ??
  40          [],
  41    );
  42  }
  43}

   6class PresentationsRepository {
   7  Future<Either<String, PresentationModel>> generatePresentation({
   8    required int lessonId,
   9    required Map<String, dynamic> payload,
  10  }) async {
  11    final response = await DioHelper.postData(
  12      url: lessonPresentationGenerateApi(lessonId),
  13      data: payload,
  14    );
  15
  16    return response.fold(
  17      (error) => Left(error),
  18      (res) {
  19        try {
  20          return Right(PresentationModel.fromJson(res.data));
  21        } catch (e) {
  22          return Left(e.toString());
  23        }
  24      },
  25    );
  26  }
  27
  28  Future<Either<String, PresentationModel>> getPresentation({
  29    required int lessonId,
  30    required String templateId,
  31  }) async {
  32    final response = await DioHelper.getData(
  33      url: lessonPresentationApi(lessonId),
  34      query: {
  35        'template_id': templateId,
  36      },
  37    );
  38
  39    return response.fold(

  41      (res) {
  42        try {
  43          return Right(PresentationModel.fromJson(res.data));
  44        } catch (e) {
  45          return Left(e.toString());
  46        }
  47      },
  48    );

   1import 'dart:async';
   2import 'dart:convert';
   3import 'dart:io';
   4import 'dart:math';
   5import 'dart:typed_data';
   6
   7import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show rootBundle;
   8import 'package:flutter_inappwebview/flutter_inappwebview.dart';
   9import 'package:moean/features/presentations/data/models/presentation_models.dart';
  10import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
  11import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/assets_helper.dart';
  12
  13class PptxGeneratorService {
  14  static Future<String> generatePresentation(
  15    PresentationModel presentation,
  16    String title, {
  17    String? templateId,
  18    String subjectName = '',
  19    String gradeName = '',
  20    String unitName = '',
  21  }) async {
  22    final completer = Completer<String>();
  23    
  24    // Read html and js
  25    final rawHtml = await rootBundle.loadString('assets/html/pptx_generator.html');
  26    final rawJs = await rootBundle.loadString('assets/js/pptxgen.bundle.js');
  27    
  28    // Inline JS
  29    final combinedHtml = rawHtml.replaceFirst('<script src="../js/pptxgen.bundle.js"></script>', '<script>\n$rawJs\n</script>');
  30
  31    final randomImages = [
  32      AssetsHelper.scr1, AssetsHelper.scr2, AssetsHelper.scr3, AssetsHelper.scr4,
  33      AssetsHelper.scr5, AssetsHelper.scr6, AssetsHelper.scr7, AssetsHelper.scr8,
  34      AssetsHelper.scr9, AssetsHelper.scr10, AssetsHelper.scr11, AssetsHelper.scr12,
  35      AssetsHelper.scr13, AssetsHelper.scr14, AssetsHelper.scr15,
  36    ];
  37    final selectedImage = randomImages[Random().nextInt(randomImages.length)];
  38    
  39    String coverImageBase64 = '';
  40    try {
  41      final ByteData data = await rootBundle.load(selectedImage);
  42      final Uint8List bytes = data.buffer.asUint8List();
  43      final base64Str = base64Encode(bytes);
  44      coverImageBase64 = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,$base64Str';
  45    } catch (e) {
  46      print('Could not load random cover image: $e');
  47    }
  48
  49    String openingImageBase64 = '';
  50    try {
  51      final ByteData data = await rootBundle.load(AssetsHelper.presentation1);
  52      final Uint8List bytes = data.buffer.asUint8List();
  53      openingImageBase64 = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(bytes)}';
  54    } catch (e) {
  55      print('Could not load opening image: $e');
  56    }
  57
  58    String greetingImageBase64 = '';
  59    try {
  60      final ByteData data = await rootBundle.load(AssetsHelper.presentation2);
  61      final Uint8List bytes = data.buffer.asUint8List();
  62      greetingImageBase64 = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(bytes)}';
  63    } catch (e) {
  64      print('Could not load greeting image: $e');
  65    }
  66
  67    String duaImageBase64 = '';
  68    try {
  69      final ByteData data = await rootBundle.load(AssetsHelper.presentation3);
  70      final Uint8List bytes = data.buffer.asUint8List();
  71      duaImageBase64 = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(bytes)}';
  72    } catch (e) {
  73      print('Could not load dua image: $e');
  74    }
  75
  76    // Build context
  77    final jsonData = jsonEncode({
  78      'presentation': {
  79        'template_id': templateId ?? presentation.templateId ?? 'emerald-green', 
  80        'slides': presentation.slides.map((s) => {
  81          'title': s.title,
  82          'type': s.slideType,
  83          'icon_keyword': s.iconKeyword,
  84          'icon_id': s.iconId,
  85          'bodyText': s.bodyText,
  86          'order': 0, // Fallback order, array position will be used
  87        }).toList(),
  88      },
  89      'context': {
  90        'lessonTitle': title,
  91        'subjectName': subjectName,
  92        'gradeName': gradeName,
  93        'unitName': unitName,
  94        'coverImageBase64': coverImageBase64,
  95        'openingImageBase64': openingImageBase64,
  96        'greetingImageBase64': greetingImageBase64,
  97        'duaImageBase64': duaImageBase64,
  98      }
  99    });
 100
 101    HeadlessInAppWebView? headlessWebView;
 102
 103    headlessWebView = HeadlessInAppWebView(
 104      initialData: InAppWebViewInitialData(data: combinedHtml),
 105      initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(
 106        javaScriptEnabled: true,
 107      ),
 108      onLoadStop: (controller, url) async {
 109        try {
 110          final result = await controller.callAsyncJavaScript(
 111            functionBody: "return await window.generatePptxBase64(data);",
 112            arguments: {"data": jsonData}
 113          );
 114          
 115          if (result?.value != null) {
 116            final res = result!.value as Map;
 117            if (res['success'] == true) {
 118              final base64String = res['base64'] as String;
 119              final bytes = base64Decode(base64String);
 120              
 121              final tempDir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
 122              final sanitizedTitle = title.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\\/:*?"<>|]'), '');
 123              final filePath = '${tempDir.path}/$sanitizedTitle.pptx';
 124              final file = File(filePath);
 125              
 126              await file.writeAsBytes(bytes);
 127              completer.complete(filePath);
 128            } else {
 129              completer.completeError("JS Error: ${res['error']}");
 130            }
 131          } else {
 132             completer.completeError("No result from JS");
 133          }
 134        } catch (e) {
 135          if (!completer.isCompleted) completer.completeError(e.toString());
 136        } finally {
 137          headlessWebView?.dispose();
 138        }
 139      },
 140      onReceivedError: (controller, request, error) {
 141         if (!completer.isCompleted) completer.completeError("WebView Error: ${error.description}");
 142         headlessWebView?.dispose();
 143      },
 144    );
 145
 146    await headlessWebView.run();
 147
 148    return completer.future;
 149  }
 150}

  14class PresentationsCubit extends Cubit<PresentationsState> {

  17  PresentationsCubit(this.repository) : super(PresentationsInitial()) {
  18    _loadSubjects();

  31  List<String> get availableTracks {
  32    if (selectedStage == null) return [];
  33    return selectedStage!.grades
  34        .map((g) => g.track)
  35        .whereType<String>()
  36        .where((t) => t.isNotEmpty)

  38        .toList();

  41  List<CurriculumGradeModel> get availableGrades {
  42    if (selectedStage == null) return [];
  43    if (availableTracks.isNotEmpty) {
  44      if (selectedTrack == null) return [];
  45      return selectedStage!.grades.where((g) => g.track == selectedTrack).toList();
  46    }
  47    return selectedStage!.grades;
  48  }

  57      selectedStage != null &&

  65  Future<void> _loadSubjects() async {
  66    isDataLoading = true;
  67    dataErrorMessage = null;

  86    final result = await ApiService.getSubjectLessons(subjectId);

  89      (failure) => dataErrorMessage = failure.message,

  91    );

  93    isDataLoading = false;

  96
  97  void updateSelection({
  98    CurriculumStageModel? stage,
  99    String? track,
 100    CurriculumGradeModel? grade,
 101    CurriculumSubjectModel? subject,
 102    CurriculumChapterModel? unit,
 103    CurriculumLessonModel? lesson,
 104    String? template,
 105    String? slidesCount,
 106  }) {
 107    if (stage != null) {
 108      selectedStage = stage;
 109      selectedTrack = null;

 111      selectedSubject = null;
 112      selectedUnit = null;
 113      selectedLesson = null;
 114      subjectDetails = null;

 116    if (track != null) {
 117      selectedTrack = track;
 118      selectedGrade = null;
 119      selectedSubject = null;

 124    if (grade != null) {
 125      selectedGrade = grade;
