 131    if (subject != null) {
 132      selectedSubject = subject;
 133      selectedUnit = null;
 134      selectedLesson = null;
 135      subjectDetails = null;
 136      _loadSubjectLessons(subject.id);
 137    }
 138    if (unit != null) {
 139      selectedUnit = unit;
 140      selectedLesson = null;
 141    }
 142    if (lesson != null) selectedLesson = lesson;
 143    if (template != null) selectedTemplate = template;
 144    if (slidesCount != null) selectedSlidesCount = slidesCount;
 145    
 146    if (!isClosed) emit(PresentationsInitial());
 147  }
 148
 149  Future<void> createPresentation() async {
 150    if (!canCreate) return;
 151
 152    if (!isClosed) emit(PresentationsLoading());
 153    
 154    int lessonId = selectedLesson!.id;
 155
 156    final payload = {
 157      "lesson_id": lessonId,
 158      "template_id": selectedTemplate,
 159      "slides_count": int.tryParse(selectedSlidesCount.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '')) ?? 8,
 160      "slide_count": int.tryParse(selectedSlidesCount.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '')) ?? 8,
 161      "stage": selectedStage!.name,
 162      "track": selectedTrack ?? selectedGrade!.track ?? "",
 163      "grade": selectedGrade!.name,
 164      "semester": selectedLesson!.semester,
 165      "subject": selectedSubject!.name,
 166      "unit": selectedUnit!.title,
 167      "chapter": selectedLesson!.title,
 168      "lesson_title": selectedLesson!.title,
 169    };
 170
 171    final prettyJsonPayload = const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert(payload);
 172    log('================ PRESENTATION PAYLOAD JSON ================');
 173    log(prettyJsonPayload);
 174    log('===========================================================');
 175    debugPrint('PRESENTATION PAYLOAD JSON:\n$prettyJsonPayload');
 176
 177    final result = await repository.generatePresentation(
 178      lessonId: lessonId,
 179      payload: payload,
 180    );
 181
 182    if (isClosed) return;
 183
 184    result.fold(
 185      (error) {
 186        if (!isClosed) {
 187          if (error.startsWith('__402__:')) {
 188            final parts = error.split(':');
 189            final code = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : 'quota_exceeded';
 190            final msg = parts.length > 2 ? parts.sublist(2).join(':') : 'ترقية الحساب المطلوبة';
 191            emit(PresentationsPaymentRequired(msg, code));
 192          } else if (error.contains('Webhook returned HTTP 200') || error.contains('not valid JSON')) {
 193            // The n8n webhook might have started generation in the background but failed to return a JSON response.
 194            // Treat this as 'pending' and start polling.
 195            _pollPresentation(lessonId, selectedTemplate);
 196          } else {
 197            emit(PresentationsError(error));
 198          }
 199        }
 200      },
 201      (presentation) {
 202        if (!isClosed) {
 203          if (presentation.status == 'ready') {
 204            generatedPresentation = presentation;
 205            emit(PresentationsSuccess(presentation));
 206          } else if (presentation.status == 'failed') {
 207            emit(PresentationsError(presentation.generationError ?? 'فشل في إنشاء العرض'));
 208          } else {
 209            // Poll
 210            _pollPresentation(lessonId, selectedTemplate);
 211          }
 212        }
 213      },
 214    );
 215  }
 216
 217  Future<void> downloadPresentation({List<PresentationSlideModel>? extraSlides}) async {
 218    if (generatedPresentation == null) return;
 219    try {
 220      final title = selectedLesson?.title ?? 'Presentation';
 221      
 222      final presentationToDownload = extraSlides != null && extraSlides.isNotEmpty
 223          ? PresentationModel(
 224              id: generatedPresentation!.id,
 225              lessonId: generatedPresentation!.lessonId,
 226              status: generatedPresentation!.status,
 227              templateId: generatedPresentation!.templateId,
 228              filePath: generatedPresentation!.filePath,
 229              slideCount: generatedPresentation!.slideCount,
 230              generatedAt: generatedPresentation!.generatedAt,
 231              generationError: generatedPresentation!.generationError,
 232              slides: [...generatedPresentation!.slides, ...extraSlides],
 233            )
 234          : generatedPresentation!;
 235
 236      final path = await PptxGeneratorService.generatePresentation(
 237        presentationToDownload, 
 238        title,
 239        templateId: generatedPresentation!.templateId ?? selectedTemplate,
 240        subjectName: selectedSubject?.name ?? '',
 241        gradeName: selectedGrade?.name ?? '',
 242        unitName: selectedUnit?.title ?? '',
 243      );
 244      await Share.shareXFiles([XFile(path)], text: 'Presentation: $title');
 245    } catch (e) {
 246      // emit an error if needed, but since it's a download action we might just print or show a toast via UI
 247      print('Error generating PPTX: $e');
 248    }
 249  }
 250
 251  void _pollPresentation(int lessonId, String templateId) async {
 252    int attempts = 0;
 253    while (attempts < 20) {
 254      await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 3));
 255      if (isClosed) return;
 256      attempts++;
 257
 258      final result = await repository.getPresentation(
 259        lessonId: lessonId,
 260        templateId: templateId,
 261      );
 262      if (isClosed) return;
 263
 264      bool stopPolling = false;
 265      result.fold(
 266        (error) {
 267          if (!isClosed) emit(PresentationsError(error));
 268          stopPolling = true;
 269        },
 270        (presentation) {
 271          if (presentation.status == 'ready') {
 272            generatedPresentation = presentation;
 273            if (!isClosed) emit(PresentationsSuccess(presentation));
 274            stopPolling = true;
 275          } else if (presentation.status == 'failed') {
 276            if (!isClosed) emit(PresentationsError(presentation.generationError ?? 'فشل في إنشاء العرض'));
 277            stopPolling = true;
 278          }
 279        },
 280      );
 281
 282      if (stopPolling) return;
 283    }
 284    
 285    if (!isClosed) {
 286      emit(PresentationsError('استغرق إنشاء العرض وقتاً أطول من المعتاد. يرجى المحاولة لاحقاً.'));
 287    }
 288  }
 289
 290  void reset() {
 291    selectedStage = null;
 292    selectedTrack = null;
 293    selectedGrade = null;
 294    selectedSubject = null;
 295    selectedUnit = null;
 296    selectedLesson = null;
 297    subjectDetails = null;
 298    selectedTemplate = 'emerald-green';
 299    selectedSlidesCount = '8';
 300    generatedPresentation = null;
 301    if (!isClosed) emit(PresentationsInitial());
 302  }
 303}

 434  Widget _buildSlideContent(PresentationSlideModel slide, PresentationThemeData theme) {
 435    // Split bullet points by new line or bullet character
 436    final lines = slide.bodyText.split('\n').where((l) => l.trim().isNotEmpty).toList();
 437
 438    if (slide.slideType == 'random_picker') {
 439      return RandomPickerWidget(names: lines, theme: theme);
 440    }
 441
 442    return Column(
 443      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
 444      children: lines.map((line) {
 445        String text = line.trim();
 446        if (text.startsWith('-') || text.startsWith('•')) {
 447          text = text.substring(1).trim();
 448        }
 449        
 450        return Container(
 451          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
 452          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
 453          decoration: BoxDecoration(
 454            color: Colors.white,
 455            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
 456            border: Border.all(color: theme.borderColor, width: 1.5),
 457          ),
 458          child: Row(
 459            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 460            children: [
 461              Container(
 462                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4, left: 12), // RTL Support
 463                width: 8,
 464                height: 8,
 465                decoration: BoxDecoration(
 466                  color: theme.primaryAccent,
 467                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
 468                ),
 469              ),
 470              Expanded(
 471                child: Text(
 472                  text,
 473                  style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(
 474                    color: theme.textColor,
 475                    height: 1.5,
 476                  ),
 477                ),
 478              ),
 479            ],
 480          ),
 481        );
 482      }).toList(),
 483    );
 484  }

 820        'random_picker': 'اختيار عشوائي',
 821        'content': 'شرح الدرس',
 822        'cross_curricular': 'الربط بالمواد الأخرى',
 823        'reading_stages': 'مراحل القراءة',
 824        'closing_strategy': 'استراتيجية الإغلاق',

 829        'example': 'مثال تطبيقي',
 830        'summary': 'ملخص الدرس',
 831        'quiz_prompt': 'أسئلة ومناقشة',
 832      };
 833      return labels[type] ?? 'محتوى تعليمي';

 836      return 'محتوى تعليمي';

 840  IconData _getIconData(String? keyword) {
 841    if (keyword == null) return LucideIcons.layoutTemplate;
 842    final k = keyword.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '_').replaceAll('-', '_');
 843    switch (k) {
 844      case 'lightbulb': return LucideIcons.lightbulb;
 845      case 'book':
 846      case 'book_open': return LucideIcons.bookOpen;
 847      case 'target': return LucideIcons.target;
 848      case 'users': return LucideIcons.users;
 849      case 'message_circle': return LucideIcons.messageCircle;
 850      case 'check_circle': return LucideIcons.checkCircle;
 851      case 'puzzle': return LucideIcons.puzzle;
 852      case 'activity': return LucideIcons.activity;
 853      case 'star': return LucideIcons.star;
 854      case 'award': return LucideIcons.award;
 855      case 'file_text': return LucideIcons.fileText;
 856      case 'play_circle': return LucideIcons.playCircle;
 857      case 'help_circle': return LucideIcons.helpCircle;
 858      case 'info': return LucideIcons.info;
 859      case 'video': return LucideIcons.video;
 860      case 'mic': return LucideIcons.mic;
 861      case 'ear': return LucideIcons.ear;
 862      case 'eye': return LucideIcons.eye;
 863      case 'pen_tool': return LucideIcons.penTool;
 864      case 'graduation_cap': return LucideIcons.graduationCap;
 865      case 'sparkles': return LucideIcons.sparkles;
 866      default: return LucideIcons.layoutTemplate;
 867    }
 868  }
 869}

 871class RandomPickerWidget extends StatefulWidget {
 872  final List<String> names;
 873  final PresentationThemeData theme;
 874
 875  const RandomPickerWidget({
 876    Key? key,
 877    required this.names,
 878    required this.theme,
 879  }) : super(key: key);
 880
 881  @override
 882  State<RandomPickerWidget> createState() => _RandomPickerWidgetState();
 883}
 884
 885class _RandomPickerWidgetState extends State<RandomPickerWidget> {
 886  int? _highlightedIndex;
 887  int? _selectedIndex;
 888  bool _isSpinning = false;
 889
 890  @override
 891  void initState() {
 892    super.initState();
 893    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), () {
 894      if (mounted) _spin();
 895    });
 896  }
 897
 898  void _spin() async {
 899    if (_isSpinning || widget.names.isEmpty) return;
 900    setState(() {
 901      _isSpinning = true;
 902      _selectedIndex = null;
 903      _highlightedIndex = null;
 904    });
 905
 906    final random = Random();
 907    final targetIndex = random.nextInt(widget.names.length);
 908    
 909    // Total steps to take
 910    int steps = widget.names.length * 3 + targetIndex;
 911    
 912    for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
 913      if (!mounted) return;
 914      setState(() {
 915        _highlightedIndex = i % widget.names.length;
 916      });
 917      
 918      // Calculate delay: starts fast (50ms), slows down near the end (up to 400ms)
 919      int delay = 50 + (i / steps * 200).toInt();
 920      if (i > steps - 5) delay += 100; // Extra slow at the very end
 921      
 922      await Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: delay));
 923    }
 924    
 925    if (!mounted) return;
 926    setState(() {
 927      _isSpinning = false;
 928      _selectedIndex = targetIndex;
 929      _highlightedIndex = targetIndex;
 930    });
 931  }
 932
 933  @override
 934  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
 935    return Column(
 936      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
 937      children: [
 938        Wrap(
 939          spacing: 8,
 940          runSpacing: 8,
 941          children: List.generate(widget.names.length, (index) {
 942            final name = widget.names[index];
 943            final isHighlighted = _highlightedIndex == index;
 944            final isSelected = _selectedIndex == index;
 945
 946            return AnimatedContainer(
 947              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
 948              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
 949              decoration: BoxDecoration(
 950                color: isSelected 
 951                    ? widget.theme.primaryAccent 
 952                    : isHighlighted 
 953                        ? widget.theme.primaryAccent.withOpacity(0.5) 
 954                        : widget.theme.softContainer,
 955                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
 956                border: Border.all(
 957                  color: isHighlighted || isSelected 
 958                      ? widget.theme.primaryAccent 
 959                      : widget.theme.primaryAccent.withOpacity(0.3), 
 960                  width: isHighlighted || isSelected ? 2 : 1,
 961                ),
 962                boxShadow: isSelected ? [
 963                  BoxShadow(
 964                    color: widget.theme.primaryAccent.withOpacity(0.4),
 965                    blurRadius: 8,
 966                    spreadRadius: 1,
 967                  )
 968                ] : null,
 969              ),
 970              child: Text(
 971                name.trim(),
 972                style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(
 973                  color: isSelected || isHighlighted ? Colors.white : widget.theme.darkAccent,
 974                ),
 975              ),
 976            );
 977          }),
 978        ),
 979      ],
 980    );
 981  }
 982}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
   3import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/constants.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/privacy_policy/presentation/cubit/privacy_policy_state.dart';
   6import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
   7import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
   8import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
   9import 'package:share_plus/share_plus.dart';
  10
  11class PrivacyPolicyCubit extends Cubit<PrivacyPolicyState> {
  12  PrivacyPolicyCubit() : super(const PrivacyPolicyInitial());
  13
  14  static PrivacyPolicyCubit get(BuildContext context) =>
  15      BlocProvider.of(context);
  16
  17  final ScrollController scrollController = ScrollController();
  18  final TextEditingController searchController = TextEditingController();
  19
  20  final Map<int, GlobalKey> sectionKeys = {
  21    0: GlobalKey(),
  22    1: GlobalKey(),
  23    2: GlobalKey(),
  24    3: GlobalKey(),
  25    4: GlobalKey(),
  26    5: GlobalKey(),
  27    6: GlobalKey(),
  28    7: GlobalKey(),
  29    8: GlobalKey(),
  30  };
  31
  32  int? activeSection = 0;
  33  String searchQuery = '';
  34
  35  void setActiveSection(int index) {
  36    activeSection = index;
  37    if (!isClosed) {
  38      emit(PrivacyPolicyStateUpdated(
  39        activeSection: activeSection,
  40        searchQuery: searchQuery,
  41      ));
  42    }
  43  }
  44
  45  void onSearchChanged(String query) {
  46    searchQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  47    if (!isClosed) {
  48      emit(PrivacyPolicyStateUpdated(
  49        activeSection: activeSection,
  50        searchQuery: searchQuery,
  51      ));
  52    }
  53  }
  54
  55  void scrollToSection(int index) {
  56    setActiveSection(index);
  57    final key = sectionKeys[index];
  58    if (key?.currentContext != null) {
  59      Scrollable.ensureVisible(
  60        key!.currentContext!,
  61        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 450),
  62        curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic,
  63      );
  64    }
  65  }
  66
  67  Future<void> shareLink() async {
  68    final text = appTranslation().get('privacy_share_text');
  69    await SharePlus.instance.share(ShareParams(text: text));
  70  }
  71
  72  Future<void> printPdf() async {
  73    if (!isClosed) emit(const PrivacyPolicyPdfGenerating());
  74    try {
  75      final doc = pw.Document();
  76      final fontData =
  77          await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Regular.ttf');
  78      final boldFontData =
  79          await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Bold.ttf');
  80      final font = pw.Font.ttf(fontData);
  81      final boldFont = pw.Font.ttf(boldFontData);
  82
  83      final title = appTranslation().get('privacy_hero_title');
  84      final desc = appTranslation().get('privacy_hero_desc');
  85      final updated = appTranslation().get('privacy_last_updated');
  86
  87      final sections = [

  22    (index: 7, key: 'privacy_sec8_toc', icon: Icons.cookie_outlined),
  23    (index: 8, key: 'privacy_sec9_toc', icon: Icons.mail_outline_rounded),
  24  ];
  25
  26  @override
  27  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  28    final cubit = PrivacyPolicyCubit.get(context);
  29
  30    return Container(
  31      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
  32      decoration: BoxDecoration(
  33        color: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
  34        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
  35        border: Border.all(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
  36      ),
  37      child: Column(
  38        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
  39        children: [
  40          Row(
  41            children: [
  42              Icon(
  43                Icons.article_outlined,
  44                color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  45                size: 22,
  46              ),
  47              horizontalSpace8,
  48              Expanded(
  49                child: Text(
  50                  appTranslation().get('privacy_toc_title'),
  51                  style: TextStylesManager.bold16.copyWith(
  52                    color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  53                  ),
  54                  textAlign: TextAlign.right,
  55                ),
  56              ),
  57            ],
  58          ),
  59          verticalSpace16,
  60          TextField(
  61            controller: cubit.searchController,
  62            onChanged: cubit.onSearchChanged,
  63            textAlign: TextAlign.right,
  64            style: TextStylesManager.regular14.copyWith(
  65              color: ColorsManager.mainText,
  66            ),
  67            decoration: InputDecoration(
  68              hintText: appTranslation().get('privacy_search_hint'),
  69              hintStyle: TextStylesManager.regular13.copyWith(
  70                color: ColorsManager.placeholder,

  75                size: 20,
  76              ),
  77              filled: true,
  78              fillColor: ColorsManager.background,
  79              contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
  80                horizontal: 16,
  81                vertical: 10,

  83              border: OutlineInputBorder(
  84                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  85                borderSide: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
  86              ),
  87              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
  88                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  89                borderSide: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.borderColor),
  90              ),
  91              focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
  92                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  93                borderSide: BorderSide(color: ColorsManager.primaryColor),
  94              ),
  95            ),
  96          ),
  97          verticalSpace12,
  98          BlocBuilder<PrivacyPolicyCubit, PrivacyPolicyState>(
  99            buildWhen: (prev, curr) => curr is PrivacyPolicyStateUpdated,
 100            builder: (context, state) {

 102              final query = cubit.searchQuery;
 103
 104              final filteredList = _tocItems.where((item) {

 117                  return PrivacyTocItemWidget(
 118                    index: item.index,
 119                    title: appTranslation().get(item.key),
 120                    icon: item.icon,
 121                    isSelected: activeIndex == item.index,
 122                    onTap: () => cubit.scrollToSection(item.index),
 123                  );
 124                },
 125              );

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/features/profile/presentation/cubit/change_password_state.dart';
   5
   6class ChangePasswordCubit extends Cubit<ChangePasswordState> {
   7  ChangePasswordCubit() : super(ChangePasswordInitial());
   8
   9  static ChangePasswordCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  10
  11  Future<void> changePassword({
  12    required String currentPassword,
  13    required String password,
  14    required String passwordConfirmation,
  15  }) async {
  16    if (!isClosed) emit(ChangePasswordLoading());
  17
  18    final result = await ApiService.changePassword(
  19      currentPassword: currentPassword,
  20      password: password,
  21      passwordConfirmation: passwordConfirmation,
  22    );
  23    if (isClosed) return;
  24
  25    result.fold(
  26      (error) {
  27        if (!isClosed) emit(ChangePasswordFailure(error));
  28      },
  29      (success) {
  30        if (!isClosed) emit(ChangePasswordSuccess());
  31      },
  32    );
  33  }
  34}

  10import 'package:moean/features/payment/presentation/cubit/subscription_cubit.dart';
  11
  12class ProfileCubit extends Cubit<ProfileState> {
  13  ProfileCubit() : super(ProfileInitialState());
  14
  15  static ProfileCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  16
  17  ProfileModel? profileModel;
  18  bool _isLoading = false;
  19
  20  Future<void> fetchProfile({bool forceRefresh = false}) async {
  21    if (token == null || token!.isEmpty) return;
  22    if (_isLoading) return;
  23
  24    if (!forceRefresh && profileModel != null) {
  25      if (!isClosed) emit(ProfileLoadedState(profile: profileModel!));
  26      return;
  27    }
  28
  29    _isLoading = true;
  30    if (profileModel == null && !isClosed) {
  31      emit(ProfileLoadingState());
  32    }
  33
  34    final result = await ApiService.getProfile();
  35    _isLoading = false;
  36    if (isClosed) return;
  37
  38    result.fold(
  39      (error) {
  40        if (!isClosed) emit(ProfileErrorState(message: error));
  41      },
  42      (profile) {
  43        profileModel = profile;
  44        if (!isClosed) emit(ProfileLoadedState(profile: profile));
  45      },
  46    );
  47  }
  48
  49  Future<void> logout() async {
  50    if (!isClosed) emit(ProfileLogoutLoadingState());
  51
  52    try {
  53      // 1. مسح التوكن فوراً من الذاكرة والـ Storage
  54      final secureStorage = sl<SecureStorageHelper>();
  55      await secureStorage.deleteToken();
  56      token = null;
  57      clearData();
  58      sl<SubscriptionCubit>().clearData();
  59
  60      // 2. إرسال حالة النجاح فوراً لكي تلتقطها الشاشة قبل أي Rebuild
  61      if (!isClosed) emit(ProfileLogoutSuccessState());
  62
  63      // 3. تصفير جلسة مدرستي وطلب السيرفر في الخلفية
  64      sl<MadrasatiSessionService>().reset();
  65      ApiService.logout(); 
  66
  67    } catch (e) {
  68      debugPrint('Logout error: $e');
  69      // في حال حدوث خطأ، نضمن أيضاً إرسال النجاح لتسجيل الخروج محلياً
  70      token = null;
  71      clearData();
  72      sl<SubscriptionCubit>().clearData();
  73      if (!isClosed) emit(ProfileLogoutSuccessState());
  74    }
  75  }
  76
  77  void clearData() {
  78    profileModel = null;
  79    if (!isClosed) emit(ProfileInitialState());
  80  }
  81}

  10    required this.code,
  11    required this.discountValue,
  12    required this.discountType,
  13    this.expiresAt,
  14  });
  15
  16  factory ReferralRewardModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  17    return ReferralRewardModel(
  18      id: json['id'] as int? ?? 0,
  19      code: json['code'] as String? ?? '',
  20      discountValue: (json['discount_value'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
  21      discountType: json['discount_type'] as String? ?? 'percentage',
  22      expiresAt: json['expires_at'] as String?,
  23    );
  24  }
  25}
  26
  27class ReferralHistoryItemModel {
  28  final int id;
  29  final String referredName;
  30  final String status;
  31  final String registeredAt;
  32  final String? qualifiedAt;
  33
  34  const ReferralHistoryItemModel({
  35    required this.id,
  36    required this.referredName,
  37    required this.status,
  38    required this.registeredAt,
  39    this.qualifiedAt,
  40  });
  41
  42  factory ReferralHistoryItemModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  43    return ReferralHistoryItemModel(
  44      id: json['id'] as int? ?? 0,
  45      referredName: json['referred_name'] as String? ?? '',
  46      status: json['status'] as String? ?? 'pending',
  47      registeredAt: json['registered_at'] as String? ?? '',
  48      qualifiedAt: json['qualified_at'] as String?,
  49    );
  50  }
  51}
  52
  53class ReferralDashboardModel {
  54  final String referralCode;
  55  final String referralLink;
  56  final int maxReferrals;
  57  final int qualifiedReferrals;
  58  final int remainingReferrals;
  59  final int rewardsAvailableCount;
  60  final List<ReferralRewardModel> rewards;
  61  final List<ReferralHistoryItemModel> history;
  62
  63  const ReferralDashboardModel({
  64    required this.referralCode,
  65    required this.referralLink,
  66    required this.maxReferrals,
  67    required this.qualifiedReferrals,
  68    required this.remainingReferrals,
  69    required this.rewardsAvailableCount,
  70    required this.rewards,
  71    required this.history,
  72  });
  73
  74  factory ReferralDashboardModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  75    final rewardsList = (json['rewards'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [])
  76        .map((e) => ReferralRewardModel.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
  77        .toList();
  78    final historyList = (json['history'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [])
  79        .map((e) => ReferralHistoryItemModel.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
  80        .toList();
  81    return ReferralDashboardModel(
  82      referralCode: json['referral_code'] as String? ?? '',
  83      referralLink: json['referral_link'] as String? ?? '',
  84      maxReferrals: json['max_referrals'] as int? ?? 5,
  85      qualifiedReferrals: json['qualified_referrals'] as int? ?? 0,
  86      remainingReferrals: json['remaining_referrals'] as int? ?? 5,
  87      rewardsAvailableCount: json['rewards_available_count'] as int? ?? 0,
  88      rewards: rewardsList,
  89      history: historyList,
  90    );
  91  }
  92}

   1import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/features/referral/data/models/referral_dashboard_model.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/referral/presentation/cubit/referral_state.dart';
   6
   7class ReferralCubit extends Cubit<ReferralState> {
   8  ReferralCubit() : super(ReferralInitial());
   9
  10  static ReferralCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  11
  12  ReferralDashboardModel? dashboard;
  13
  14  Future<void> loadDashboard() async {
  15    if (!isClosed) emit(ReferralLoading());
  16    final result = await ApiService.getReferralDashboard();
  17    if (isClosed) return;
  18    result.fold(
  19      (error) {
  20        if (!isClosed) emit(ReferralError(error));
  21      },
  22      (data) {
  23        dashboard = ReferralDashboardModel.fromJson(data);
  24        if (!isClosed) emit(ReferralLoaded(dashboard!));
  25      },
  26    );
  27  }
  28
  29  Future<void> refresh() => loadDashboard();
  30}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/register/presentation/cubit/register_state.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/core/models/register_request.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/core/network/local/cache_helper.dart';
   7import 'package:moean/core/network/local/secure_storage_helper.dart';
   8import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/constants.dart';
   9import 'package:moean/core/utils/formatters/saudi_phone_input_formatter.dart';
  10import 'package:moean/core/di/injections.dart';
  11import 'package:moean/features/payment/presentation/cubit/subscription_cubit.dart';
  12
  13enum AccountType { teacher, supervisor }
  14
  15class RegisterCubit extends Cubit<RegisterState> {
  16  RegisterCubit() : super(RegisterInitialState());
  17
  18  static RegisterCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  19
  20  final TextEditingController fullNameController = TextEditingController();
  21  final TextEditingController emailController = TextEditingController();
  22  final TextEditingController phoneController = TextEditingController();
  23  final TextEditingController passwordController = TextEditingController();
  24  final TextEditingController confirmPasswordController =
  25      TextEditingController();
  26  final GlobalKey<FormState> formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  27
  28  bool isPasswordVisible = false;
  29  bool isConfirmPasswordVisible = false;
  30  bool agreeToTerms = false;
  31  AccountType selectedAccountType = AccountType.teacher;
  32
  33  void togglePasswordVisibility() {
  34    isPasswordVisible = !isPasswordVisible;
  35    emit(RegisterPasswordVisibilityChangedState());
  36  }
  37
  38  void toggleConfirmPasswordVisibility() {
  39    isConfirmPasswordVisible = !isConfirmPasswordVisible;
  40    emit(RegisterConfirmPasswordVisibilityChangedState());
  41  }
  42
  43  void toggleTerms() {
  44    agreeToTerms = !agreeToTerms;
  45    emit(RegisterTermsChangedState());
  46  }
  47
  48  void setAccountType(AccountType type) {
  49    selectedAccountType = type;
  50    emit(RegisterAccountTypeChangedState());
  51  }
  52
  53  Future<void> register() async {
  54    if (!(formKey.currentState?.validate() ?? false)) {
  55      if (!isClosed) emit(RegisterInitialState());
  56      return;
  57    }
  58    if (!agreeToTerms) {
  59      if (!isClosed) emit(RegisterErrorState(message: 'يجب الموافقة على الشروط والأحكام'));
  60      return;
  61    }
  62    if (!isClosed) emit(RegisterLoadingState());
  63
  64    try {
  65      final referralCode = CacheHelper.getData(key: 'referral_code')?.toString();
  66
  67      final request = RegisterRequest(
  68        name: fullNameController.text.trim(),
  69        email: emailController.text.trim(),
  70        phone: SaudiPhoneInputFormatter.normalizePhoneNumber(phoneController.text.trim()),
  71        password: passwordController.text,
  72        passwordConfirmation: confirmPasswordController.text,
  73        referralCode: referralCode,
  74      );
  75
  76      final result = await ApiService.registerUser(request);
  77      if (isClosed) return;
  78
  79      result.fold(
  80        (error) {
  81          if (!isClosed) emit(RegisterErrorState(message: error));
  82          debugPrint('Register Error: $error');
  83        },
  84        (response) async {
  85          await CacheHelper.saveData(key: 'auth_token', value: response.token);
  86          await sl<SecureStorageHelper>().saveToken(response.token);
  87          
  88          // Clear the referral code after successful registration
  89          if (referralCode != null && referralCode.isNotEmpty) {
  90            await CacheHelper.removeData(key: 'referral_code');
  91            debugPrint('Cleared locally stored referral code after successful registration.');
  92          }
  93
  94          token = response.token;
  95          sl<SubscriptionCubit>().fetchCurrentSubscription();
  96          if (!isClosed) emit(RegisterSuccessState(email: response.user.email));
  97          debugPrint('Register Success: $response');
  98        },
  99      );
 100    } catch (e, stack) {
 101      debugPrint('Register Exception: $e\n$stack');
 102      if (!isClosed) emit(RegisterErrorState(message: e.toString()));
 103    }
 104  }
 105
 106  @override
 107  Future<void> close() {
 108    fullNameController.dispose();
 109    emailController.dispose();
 110    phoneController.dispose();
 111    passwordController.dispose();
 112    confirmPasswordController.dispose();
 113    return super.close();
 114  }
 115}

 172      prefixIcon: Padding(

 174        child: Row(

 176          children: [

 184              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
 185              style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(

 191              height: 20,

   6class ReportPdfService {
   7  static final PdfColor _primaryColor = PdfColor.fromHex('073F49');
   8  static final PdfColor _headerBg = PdfColor.fromHex('0B4A45');
   9  static final PdfColor _subHeaderBg = PdfColor.fromHex('E8F5F1');

  13  static final PdfColor _textMuted = PdfColor.fromHex('64748B');
  14
  15  static String _fixArabic(String text) {
  16    if (text.isEmpty) return text;
  17    return text
  18        .replaceAll('مسار إداري', 'مسار\u00A0إداري')
  19        .replaceAll('مسار ادارى', 'مسار\u00A0ادارى')
  20        .replaceAll('مسار اداري', 'مسار\u00A0اداري')
  21        .replaceAll('مسار إدارى', 'مسار\u00A0إدارى');
  22  }
  23
  24
  25  static Future<Uint8List> generatePdf({
  26    required Map<String, dynamic> reportData,
  27    required String teacherName,
  28    required String grade,
  29    required String subject,
  30    required String unit,
  31    required String semester,
  32    required String schoolName,
  33    required String educationOffice,
  34    required String reportType,
  35    required String reportDate,
  36    required List<String> selectedLessons,
  37  }) async {
  38    final ByteData fontData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Regular.ttf');
  39    final pw.Font ttf = pw.Font.ttf(fontData);
  40
  41    final ByteData boldFontData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Tajawal-Bold.ttf');
  42    final pw.Font ttfBold = pw.Font.ttf(boldFontData);
  43
  44    final ByteData ministryImageData = await rootBundle.load('assets/images/minstry.jpg');
  45    final pw.MemoryImage ministryImage = pw.MemoryImage(ministryImageData.buffer.asUint8List());
  46
  47    final ByteData logoImageData = await rootBundle.load('assets/images/logo_icon-removebg-preview.png');
  48    final pw.MemoryImage logoImage = pw.MemoryImage(logoImageData.buffer.asUint8List());
  49
  50    final pdf = pw.Document(
  51      theme: pw.ThemeData.withFont(
  52        base: ttf,
  53        bold: ttfBold,
  54      ),
  55    );
  56
  57    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> achievementRows =
  58        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(reportData['achievementRows'] ?? []);
  59    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> lessonPlanRows =
  60        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(reportData['lessonPlanRows'] ?? []);
  61    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> goalRows =
  62        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(reportData['goalRows'] ?? []);
  63    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> challengeRows =
  64        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(reportData['challengeRows'] ?? []);
  65    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> checkUnderstandingRows =
  66        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(reportData['checkUnderstandingRows'] ?? []);
  67    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> modelingRows =
  68        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(reportData['modelingRows'] ?? []);
  69    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> strategySections =
  70        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(reportData['strategySections'] ?? []);
  71
  72    final pw.TextStyle arabicRegular = pw.TextStyle(
  73      fontSize: 9,
  74      color: _textDark,
  75    );
  76    final pw.TextStyle arabicBold = pw.TextStyle(
  77      fontSize: 9,
  78      fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
  79      color: _textDark,
  80    );
  81    final pw.TextStyle headerStyle = pw.TextStyle(
  82      fontSize: 10,
  83      fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
  84      color: PdfColors.white,
  85    );
  86    final pw.TextStyle titleStyle = pw.TextStyle(
  87      fontSize: 13,
  88      fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
  89      color: PdfColors.white,
  90    );
  91
  92    // Build pages
  93    pdf.addPage(
  94      pw.MultiPage(
  95        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
  96        textDirection: pw.TextDirection.rtl,
  97        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(24),
  98        build: (pw.Context context) {
  99          return [
 100            // ── Page Header ──
 101            _buildPageHeader(
 102              teacherName: _fixArabic(teacherName),
 103              grade: _fixArabic(grade),
 104              subject: _fixArabic(subject),
 105              unit: unit,
 106              semester: semester,
 107              schoolName: schoolName,
 108              educationOffice: educationOffice,
 109              reportType: reportType,
 110              reportDate: reportDate,
 111              lessonsCount: selectedLessons.length.toString(),
 112              titleStyle: titleStyle,
 113              headerStyle: headerStyle,
 114              arabicRegular: arabicRegular,
 115              arabicBold: arabicBold,
 116              ministryImage: ministryImage,
 117              logoImage: logoImage,
 118            ),
 119            pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
 120
 121            // ── Achievement Rows Table ──
 122            if (achievementRows.isNotEmpty) ...[
 123              _buildSectionTitle('بيانات الإنجاز التعليمي', headerStyle),
 124              pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
 125              _buildAchievementTable(achievementRows, arabicRegular, arabicBold),
 126              pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
 127            ],
 128
 129            // ── Lesson Plan Table ──
 130            if (lessonPlanRows.isNotEmpty) ...[
 131              _buildSectionTitle('خطة الدرس', headerStyle),
 132              pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
 133              _buildLessonPlanTable(lessonPlanRows, arabicRegular, arabicBold),
 134              pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
 135            ],
 136
 137            // ── Goals Table ──
 138            if (goalRows.isNotEmpty) ...[
 139              _buildSectionTitle('الأهداف', headerStyle),
 140              pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
 141              _buildGoalTable(goalRows, arabicRegular, arabicBold),
 142              pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
 143            ],
 144
 145            // ── Challenges Table ──
 146            if (challengeRows.isNotEmpty) ...[
 147              _buildSectionTitle('التحديات والخطط المقترحة', headerStyle),
 148              pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
 149              _buildChallengeTable(challengeRows, arabicRegular, arabicBold),
 150              pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
 151            ],
 152
 153            // ── Check Understanding Table ──
 154            if (checkUnderstandingRows.isNotEmpty) ...[
 155              _buildSectionTitle('التحقق من الفهم', headerStyle),
 156              pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
 157              _buildCheckUnderstandingTable(
 158                  checkUnderstandingRows, arabicRegular, arabicBold),
 159              pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
 160            ],
 161
 162            // ── Modeling Rows Table ──
 163            if (modelingRows.isNotEmpty) ...[
 164              _buildSectionTitle('النمذجة', headerStyle),
 165              pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
 166              _buildModelingTable(modelingRows, arabicRegular, arabicBold),
 167              pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
 168            ],
 169
 170            // ── Strategy Sections ──
 171            if (strategySections.isNotEmpty) ...[
 172              _buildSectionTitle('مقاطع الاستراتيجية', headerStyle),
 173              pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
 174              _buildStrategyTable(strategySections, arabicRegular, arabicBold),
 175              pw.SizedBox(height: 12),
 176            ],
 177
 178            // ── Footer ──
 179            _buildFooter(arabicRegular),
 180          ];
 181        },
 182      ),
 183    );
 184
 185    return pdf.save();
 186  }

   1class SavedReportModel {
   2  final int id;
   3  final String reportType;
   4  final String grade;
   5  final dynamic subject; // Can be String or List
   6  final List<String> selectedLessons;
   7  final Map<String, dynamic> reportData;
   8  final String createdAt;
   9
  10  SavedReportModel({
  11    required this.id,
  12    required this.reportType,
  13    required this.grade,
  14    required this.subject,
  15    required this.selectedLessons,
  16    required this.reportData,
  17    required this.createdAt,
  18  });
  19
  20  factory SavedReportModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  21    List<String> lessons = [];
  22    if (json['selected_lessons'] != null) {
  23      if (json['selected_lessons'] is List) {
  24        lessons = List<String>.from(json['selected_lessons'].map((e) => e.toString()));
  25      }
  26    }
  27
  28    Map<String, dynamic> rData = {};
  29    if (json['report_data'] is Map<String, dynamic>) {
  30      rData = json['report_data'];
  31    }
  32
  33    return SavedReportModel(
  34      id: json['id'] is int ? json['id'] : int.tryParse(json['id']?.toString() ?? '0') ?? 0,
  35      reportType: json['report_type']?.toString() ?? '',
  36      grade: json['grade']?.toString() ?? '',
  37      subject: json['subject'] ?? '',
  38      selectedLessons: lessons,
  39      reportData: rData,
  40      createdAt: json['created_at']?.toString() ?? '',
  41    );
  42  }
  43
  44  String get displaySubject {
  45    if (subject is List) {
  46      return (subject as List).join('، ');
  47    }
  48    return subject?.toString() ?? '';
  49  }
  50}
  51
  52class SavedReportsMeta {
  53  final int currentPage;
  54  final int lastPage;
  55  final int perPage;
  56  final int total;
  57
  58  SavedReportsMeta({
  59    required this.currentPage,
  60    required this.lastPage,
  61    required this.perPage,
  62    required this.total,
  63  });
  64
  65  factory SavedReportsMeta.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  66    return SavedReportsMeta(
  67      currentPage: json['current_page'] ?? 1,
  68      lastPage: json['last_page'] ?? 1,
  69      perPage: json['per_page'] ?? 15,
  70      total: json['total'] ?? 0,
  71    );
  72  }
  73}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/features/reports/presentation/cubit/report_state.dart';
   5
   6class ReportCubit extends Cubit<ReportState> {
   7  ReportCubit() : super(const ReportInitial());
   8
   9  static ReportCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  10
  11  Future<void> generateReport({
  12    required String reportType,
  13    required String grade,
  14    required dynamic subject,
  15    required List<String> selectedLessons,
  16  }) async {
  17    if (!isClosed) emit(const ReportLoading());
  18
  19    final result = await ApiService.generateEducationalReport(
  20      reportType: reportType,
  21      grade: grade,
  22      subject: subject,
  23      selectedLessons: selectedLessons,
  24    );
  25    if (isClosed) return;
  26
  27    result.fold(
  28      (error) {
  29        if (!isClosed) {
  30          if (error.startsWith('__402__:')) {
  31            final parts = error.split(':');
  32            final code = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : 'quota_exceeded';
  33            final msg = parts.length > 2 ? parts.sublist(2).join(':') : 'ترقية الحساب المطلوبة';
  34            emit(ReportPaymentRequired(message: msg, code: code));
  35          } else {
  36            emit(ReportError(message: error));
  37          }
  38        }
  39      },
  40      (data) {
  41        if (!isClosed) emit(ReportSuccess(data: data));
  42      },
  43    );
  44  }
  45
  46  void reset() {
  47    if (!isClosed) emit(const ReportInitial());
  48  }
  49}

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   2import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/features/reports/data/saved_report_model.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/features/reports/presentation/cubit/saved_reports_state.dart';
   6
   7class SavedReportsCubit extends Cubit<SavedReportsState> {
   8  SavedReportsCubit() : super(const SavedReportsInitial());
   9
  10  static SavedReportsCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  11
  12  String _currentFilter = 'الكل';
  13
  14  String get currentFilter => _currentFilter;
  15
  16  Future<void> fetchReports({String? filter}) async {
  17    if (filter != null) {
  18      _currentFilter = filter;
  19    }
  20
  21    if (!isClosed) emit(const SavedReportsLoading());
  22
  23    final String? apiType = (_currentFilter == 'الكل') ? null : _currentFilter;
  24
  25    final result = await ApiService.getSavedEducationalReports(
  26      reportType: apiType,
  27      perPage: 30,
  28    );
  29    if (isClosed) return;
  30
  31    result.fold(
  32      (error) {
  33        if (!isClosed) emit(SavedReportsError(message: error));
  34      },
  35      (response) {
  36        try {
  37          final List<dynamic> listData = response['data'] is List ? response['data'] : [];
  38          final reports = listData.map((e) => SavedReportModel.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();
  39          final meta = SavedReportsMeta.fromJson((response['meta'] as Map<String, dynamic>?) ?? {});
  40          
  41          if (!isClosed) {
  42            emit(SavedReportsSuccess(
  43              reports: reports,
  44              meta: meta,
  45              selectedFilter: _currentFilter,
  46            ));
  47          }
  48        } catch (e) {
  49          if (!isClosed) emit(SavedReportsError(message: e.toString()));
  50        }
  51      },
  52    );
  53  }
  54}

  15class SavedReportsScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  16  final String teacherName;

  18  const SavedReportsScreen({
  19    super.key,
  20    required this.teacherName,
  21  });
  22
  23  @override
  24  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  25    return BlocProvider(
  26      create: (context) => SavedReportsCubit()..fetchReports(),
  27      child: Directionality(
  28        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
  29        child: Scaffold(
  30          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.background,
  31          body: SafeArea(
  32            child: BlocConsumer<SavedReportsCubit, SavedReportsState>(
  33              listener: (context, state) {
  34                if (state is SavedReportsError) {
  35                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  36                    SnackBar(
  37                      content: Text(state.message, style: TextStylesManager.bold14),
  38                      backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  39                      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
  40                    ),
  41                  );
  42                }
  43              },
  44              builder: (context, state) {
  45                final cubit = SavedReportsCubit.get(context);
  46                final reports = state is SavedReportsSuccess ? state.reports : [];
  47
  48                return SingleChildScrollView(
  49                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 16),
  50                  child: Column(
  51                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  52                    children: [
  53                      SavedReportsHeaderWidget(
  54                        onRefresh: () => cubit.fetchReports(),
  55                      ),
  56                      verticalSpace24,
  57                      SavedReportsFilterWidget(
  58                        selectedFilter: cubit.currentFilter,
  59                        onFilterChanged: (filter) => cubit.fetchReports(filter: filter),
  60                      ),
  61                      verticalSpace20,
  62                      ConditionalBuilder(
  63                        loadingState: state is SavedReportsLoading,
  64                        errorState: state is SavedReportsError,
  65                        emptyState: state is SavedReportsSuccess && reports.isEmpty,
  66                        emptyBuilder: (context) => Padding(
  67                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 40),
  68                          child: Center(
  69                            child: Text(
  70                              appTranslation().get('no_saved_reports'),
  71                              style: TextStylesManager.regular16.copyWith(
  72                                color: ColorsManager.secondaryText,
  73                              ),
  74                            ),
  75                          ),
  76                        ),
  77                        errorBuilder: (context) => Padding(
  78                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 40),
  79                          child: Center(
  80                            child: Column(
  81                              children: [
  82                                Text(
  83                                  (state as SavedReportsError).message,
  84                                  style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(
  85                                    color: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  86                                  ),
  87                                ),
  88                                verticalSpace12,
  89                                ElevatedButton(
  90                                  onPressed: () => cubit.fetchReports(),
  91                                  child: Text(appTranslation().get('retry')),
  92                                ),
  93                              ],
  94                            ),
  95                          ),
  96                        ),
  97                        successBuilder: (context) => LayoutBuilder(
  98                          builder: (context, constraints) {
  99                            final isWide = constraints.maxWidth > 600;
 100                            if (isWide) {
 101                              return GridView.builder(
 102                                shrinkWrap: true,
 103                                physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
 104                                gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
 105                                  crossAxisCount: 2,
 106                                  crossAxisSpacing: 16,
 107                                  mainAxisSpacing: 16,
 108                                  mainAxisExtent: 260,
 109                                ),
 110                                itemCount: reports.length,
 111                                itemBuilder: (context, index) => SavedReportCardWidget(
 112                                  report: reports[index],
 113                                  onOpen: () => _openDetails(context, reports[index]),
 114                                ),
 115                              );
 116                            }
 117                            return ListView.separated(
 118                              shrinkWrap: true,
 119                              physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
 120                              itemCount: reports.length,
 121                              separatorBuilder: (context, index) => verticalSpace16,
 122                              itemBuilder: (context, index) => SavedReportCardWidget(
 123                                report: reports[index],
 124                                onOpen: () => _openDetails(context, reports[index]),
 125                              ),
 126                            );
 127                          },
 128                        ),
 129                      ),
 130                      verticalSpace32,
 131                    ],
 132                  ),
 133                );
 134              },
 135            ),
 136          ),
 137        ),
 138      ),
 139    );
 140  }

  13
  14class ReportFormWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  15  final String teacherName;
  16  final void Function({
  17    required String reportType,
  18    required String grade,
  19    required String subject,
  20    required String unit,
  21    required String semester,
  22    required String schoolName,
  23    required String educationOffice,
  24    required String reportDate,
  25    required List<String> selectedLessons,
  26  }) onSubmit;
  27  final bool isLoading;
  28
  29  const ReportFormWidget({
  30    super.key,
  31    required this.teacherName,
  32    required this.onSubmit,
  33    required this.isLoading,
  34  });
  35
  36  @override
  37  State<ReportFormWidget> createState() => _ReportFormWidgetState();
  38}
  39
  40class _ReportFormWidgetState extends State<ReportFormWidget> {
  41  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  42  final _stageController = TextEditingController();
  43  final _gradeController = TextEditingController();
  44  final _subjectController = TextEditingController();
  45  final _unitController = TextEditingController();
  46  final _semesterController = TextEditingController();
  47  final _schoolController = TextEditingController();
  48  final _educationOfficeController = TextEditingController();
  49  final _reportDateController = TextEditingController();
  50
  51  String _selectedType = 'اسبوعي';
  52  List<String> _selectedLessons = [];
  53
  54  bool _isLoadingSubjects = false;
  55  List<CurriculumStageModel> _stages = [];
  56  
  57  CurriculumStageModel? _selectedStage;
  58  CurriculumGradeModel? _selectedGrade;
  59  CurriculumSubjectModel? _selectedSubject;
  60  
  61  bool _isLoadingLessons = false;
  62  SubjectDetailsModel? _subjectDetails;
  63
  64  @override
  65  void initState() {
  66    super.initState();
  67    _fetchSubjects();
  68  }
  69
  70  Future<void> _fetchSubjects() async {
  71    setState(() => _isLoadingSubjects = true);
  72    final result = await ApiService.getSubjects();
  73    if (mounted) {
  74      result.fold(
  75        (failure) {
  76          setState(() => _isLoadingSubjects = false);
  77        },
  78        (stagesData) {
  79          setState(() {
  80            stagesData.sort((a, b) {
  81              int getWeight(String name) {
  82                if (name.contains('الابتدائية')) return 1;
  83                if (name.contains('المتوسطة')) return 2;
  84                if (name.contains('الثانوية')) return 3;
  85                return 4;
  86              }
  87              return getWeight(a.name).compareTo(getWeight(b.name));
  88            });
  89            _stages = stagesData;
  90            _isLoadingSubjects = false;
  91          });
  92        },
  93      );
  94    }
  95  }
  96
  97  void _showStageSelector() {
  98    if (_isLoadingSubjects) {
  99      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 100        SnackBar(
 101          content: Text('جاري التحميل...', style: TextStylesManager.bold14),
 102          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 103        ),
 104      );
 105      return;
 106    }
 107
 108    final stageNames = _stages.map((e) => e.name).toList();
 109
 110    SelectionBottomSheet.show(
 111      context: context,
 112      title: 'اختر المرحلة الدراسية',
 113      items: stageNames,
 114      initialSelectedItems: _stageController.text.isNotEmpty ? [_stageController.text] : [],
 115      isMultiSelect: false,
 116      onSelectionConfirmed: (selected) {
 117        if (selected.isNotEmpty) {
 118          setState(() {
 119            _stageController.text = selected.first;
 120            _selectedStage = _stages.firstWhere((e) => e.name == selected.first);
 121            
 122            _gradeController.clear();
 123            _selectedGrade = null;
 124            
 125            _subjectController.clear();
 126            _selectedSubject = null;
 127            
 128            _unitController.clear();
 129            _selectedLessons.clear();
 130            _subjectDetails = null;
 131          });
 132        }
 133      },
 134    );
 135  }
 136
 137  void _showGradeSelector() {
 138    if (_selectedStage == null) {
 139      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 140        SnackBar(
 141          content: Text('الرجاء اختيار المرحلة أولاً', style: TextStylesManager.bold14),
 142          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 143        ),
 144      );
 145      return;
 146    }
 147
 148    final gradeNames = _selectedStage!.grades.map((e) => e.name).toList();
 149
 150    SelectionBottomSheet.show(
 151      context: context,
 152      title: 'اختر الصف',
 153      items: gradeNames,
 154      initialSelectedItems: _gradeController.text.isNotEmpty ? [_gradeController.text] : [],
 155      isMultiSelect: false,
 156      onSelectionConfirmed: (selected) {
 157        if (selected.isNotEmpty) {
 158          setState(() {
 159            _gradeController.text = selected.first;
 160            _selectedGrade = _selectedStage!.grades.firstWhere((e) => e.name == selected.first);
 161            
 162            _subjectController.clear();
 163            _selectedSubject = null;
 164            
 165            _unitController.clear();
 166            _selectedLessons.clear();
 167            _subjectDetails = null;
 168          });
 169        }
 170      },
 171    );
 172  }
 173
 174  void _showSubjectSelector() {
 175    if (_selectedGrade == null) {
 176      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 177        SnackBar(
 178          content: Text('الرجاء اختيار الصف أولاً', style: TextStylesManager.bold14),
 179          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 180        ),
 181      );
 182      return;
 183    }
 184
 185    final subjectNames = _selectedGrade!.subjects.map((e) => e.name).toList();
 186
 187    SelectionBottomSheet.show(
 188      context: context,
 189      title: 'اختر المادة',
 190      items: subjectNames,
 191      initialSelectedItems: _subjectController.text.isNotEmpty ? [_subjectController.text] : [],
 192      isMultiSelect: false,
 193      onSelectionConfirmed: (selected) {
 194        if (selected.isNotEmpty) {
 195          setState(() {
 196            _subjectController.text = selected.first;
 197            _selectedSubject = _selectedGrade!.subjects.firstWhere((e) => e.name == selected.first);
 198            
 199            _unitController.clear();
 200            _selectedLessons.clear();
 201            _subjectDetails = null;
 202            
 203            _fetchSubjectDetails(_selectedSubject!.id);
 204          });
 205        }
 206      },
 207    );
 208  }
 209
 210  Future<void> _fetchSubjectDetails(int subjectId) async {
 211    setState(() => _isLoadingLessons = true);
 212    final result = await ApiService.getSubjectLessons(subjectId);
 213    if (mounted) {
 214      result.fold(
 215        (failure) {
 216          setState(() => _isLoadingLessons = false);
 217        },
 218        (details) {
 219          setState(() {
 220            _subjectDetails = details;
 221            _isLoadingLessons = false;
 222          });
 223        },
 224      );
 225    }
 226  }
 227
 228  void _showUnitSelector() {
 229    if (_selectedSubject == null || _subjectDetails == null) {
 230      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 231        SnackBar(
 232          content: Text('الرجاء اختيار المادة والانتظار للتحميل', style: TextStylesManager.bold14),
 233          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 234        ),
 235      );
 236      return;
 237    }
 238
 239    final isMonthly = _selectedType == 'شهري';
 240    final chapterTitles = _subjectDetails!.chapters.map((e) => e.title).toSet().toList();
 241
 242    SelectionBottomSheet.show(
 243      context: context,
 244      title: isMonthly ? 'اختر الفصول' : 'اختر الفصل',
 245      items: chapterTitles,
 246      initialSelectedItems: _unitController.text.isNotEmpty 
 247          ? _unitController.text.split('، ').map((e) => e.trim()).toList() 
 248          : [],
 249      isMultiSelect: isMonthly,
 250      onSelectionConfirmed: (selected) {
 251        setState(() {
 252          _unitController.text = selected.join('، ');
 253          _selectedLessons.clear();
 254        });
 255      },
 256    );
 257  }
 258
 259  void _showLessonsSelector() {
 260    if (_unitController.text.isEmpty) {
 261      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 262        SnackBar(
 263          content: Text('الرجاء اختيار الفصل أولاً', style: TextStylesManager.bold14),
 264          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 265        ),
 266      );
 267      return;
 268    }
 269
 270    if (_selectedType == 'شهري' || _subjectDetails == null) return;
 271
 272    final selectedChapterTitle = _unitController.text;
 273    final chapterModel = _subjectDetails!.chapters.cast<CurriculumChapterModel?>().firstWhere(
 274      (e) => e?.title == selectedChapterTitle,
 275      orElse: () => null,
 276    );
 277
 278    if (chapterModel == null) return;
 279    
 280    // Auto-fill semester based on selected chapter
 281    _semesterController.text = chapterModel.semester;
 282
 283    final availableLessons = chapterModel.lessons;
 284
 285    if (availableLessons.isEmpty) {
 286      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 287        SnackBar(
 288          content: Text('لا توجد دروس متاحة لهذا الفصل', style: TextStylesManager.bold14),
 289          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 290        ),
 291      );
 292      return;
 293    }
 294
 295    SelectionBottomSheet.show(
 296      context: context,
 297      title: 'اختر الدروس',
 298      items: availableLessons.map((e) => e.title).toList(),
 299      initialSelectedItems: _selectedLessons,
 300      isMultiSelect: true,
 301      onSelectionConfirmed: (selected) {
 302        setState(() {
 303          _selectedLessons = selected;
 304        });
 305      },
 306    );
 307  }
 308
 309  Future<void> _selectReportDate() async {
 310    DateTime initialDate = DateTime.now();
 311    if (_reportDateController.text.isNotEmpty) {
 312      final parsed = DateTime.tryParse(_reportDateController.text);
 313      if (parsed != null) {
 314        initialDate = parsed;
 315      }
 316    }
 317
 318    final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
 319      context: context,
 320      initialDate: initialDate,
 321      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
 322      lastDate: DateTime(2030),
 323    );
 324    if (picked != null) {
 325      setState(() {
 326        _reportDateController.text =
 327            '${picked.year}-${picked.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${picked.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
 328      });
 329    }
 330  }
 331
 332  void _submit() {
 333    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
 334    if (_selectedType == 'اسبوعي' && _selectedLessons.isEmpty) {
 335      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 336        SnackBar(
 337          content: Text(
 338            appTranslation().get('report_lessons_required'),
 339            style: TextStylesManager.bold14,
 340          ),
 341          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
 342        ),
 343      );
 344      return;
 345    }
 346    widget.onSubmit(
 347      reportType: _selectedType,
 348      grade: _gradeController.text.trim(),
 349      subject: _subjectController.text.trim(),
 350      unit: _unitController.text.trim(),
 351      semester: _semesterController.text.trim(),
 352      schoolName: _schoolController.text.trim(),
 353      educationOffice: _educationOfficeController.text.trim(),
 354      reportDate: _reportDateController.text.trim(),
 355      selectedLessons: _selectedType == 'اسبوعي' ? _selectedLessons : [],
 356    );
 357  }
 358

 361    _stageController.dispose();
 362    _subjectController.dispose();
 363    _unitController.dispose();
 364    _gradeController.dispose();
 365    _semesterController.dispose();
 366    _schoolController.dispose();
 367    _educationOfficeController.dispose();
 368    _reportDateController.dispose();
 369    super.dispose();
 370  }

  83    );
  84  }
  85
  86  Widget _buildTable() {
  87    return Table(
  88      border: TableBorder.all(
  89        color: ColorsManager.borderColor,
  90        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
  91      ),
  92      defaultColumnWidth: const IntrinsicColumnWidth(),
  93      children: [
  94        // Header row
  95        TableRow(
  96          decoration: BoxDecoration(
  97            color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  98          ),
  99          children: columnLabels
 100              .map(
 101                (label) => Padding(
 102                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
 103                  child: Text(
 104                    label,
 105                    style: TextStylesManager.bold12.copyWith(
 106                      color: Colors.white,
 107                    ),
 108                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
 109                  ),
 110                ),
 111              )
 112              .toList(),
 113        ),
 114        // Data rows
 115        ...rows.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
 116          final index = entry.key;
 117          final row = entry.value;
 118          final isEven = index % 2 == 0;
 119          return TableRow(
 120            decoration: BoxDecoration(
 121              color: isEven
 122                  ? ColorsManager.background
 123                  : ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
 124            ),
 125            children: columnKeys
 126                .map(
 127                  (key) => Padding(
 128                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
 129                        horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
 130                    child: Text(
 131                      (row[key] ?? '').toString(),
 132                      style: TextStylesManager.regular12.copyWith(
 133                        color: ColorsManager.mainText,
 134                      ),
 135                      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
 136                    ),
 137                  ),
 138                )
 139                .toList(),
 140          );
 141        }),
 142      ],
 143    );
 144  }
 145}

  18  String _formatDate(String dateStr) {
  19    if (dateStr.isEmpty) return '';
  20    try {
  21      final dateTime = DateTime.parse(dateStr);
  22      final months = [
  23        'يناير', 'فبراير', 'مارس', 'أبريل', 'مايو', 'يونيو',
  24        'يوليو', 'أغسطس', 'سبتمبر', 'أكتوبر', 'نوفمبر', 'ديسمبر'
  25      ];
  26      return '${dateTime.day} ${months[dateTime.month - 1]} ${dateTime.year}';
  27    } catch (_) {
  28      return dateStr.split('T').first;
  29    }
  30  }

   1import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

   6import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/spacing.dart';
   7import 'package:moean/core/utils/extensions/context_extension.dart';
   8
   9class SelectionBottomSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  10  final String title;
  11  final List<String> items;
  12  final List<String> initialSelectedItems;
  13  final bool isMultiSelect;
  14  final ValueChanged<List<String>> onSelectionConfirmed;
  15
  16  const SelectionBottomSheet({
  17    super.key,
  18    required this.title,
  19    required this.items,
  20    this.initialSelectedItems = const [],
  21    this.isMultiSelect = true,
  22    required this.onSelectionConfirmed,
  23  });
  24
  25  static Future<void> show({
  26    required BuildContext context,
  27    required String title,
  28    required List<String> items,
  29    List<String> initialSelectedItems = const [],
  30    bool isMultiSelect = true,
  31    required ValueChanged<List<String>> onSelectionConfirmed,
  32  }) {
  33    return showModalBottomSheet(
  34      context: context,
  35      isScrollControlled: true,
  36      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
  37      builder: (context) => SelectionBottomSheet(
  38        title: title,
  39        items: items,
  40        initialSelectedItems: initialSelectedItems,
  41        isMultiSelect: isMultiSelect,
  42        onSelectionConfirmed: onSelectionConfirmed,
  43      ),
  44    );
  45  }
  46
  47  @override
  48  State<SelectionBottomSheet> createState() => _SelectionBottomSheetState();
  49}
  50
  51class _SelectionBottomSheetState extends State<SelectionBottomSheet> {
  52  late List<String> _selectedItems;
  53  List<String> _filteredItems = [];
  54  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  55
  56  @override
  57  void initState() {
  58    super.initState();
  59    _selectedItems = List.from(widget.initialSelectedItems);
  60    _filteredItems = List.from(widget.items);
  61    _searchController.addListener(_onSearchChanged);
  62  }
  63
  64  @override
  65  void dispose() {
  66    _searchController.dispose();
  67    super.dispose();
  68  }
  69
  70  void _onSearchChanged() {
  71    final query = _searchController.text.trim().toLowerCase();
  72    setState(() {
  73      if (query.isEmpty) {
  74        _filteredItems = List.from(widget.items);
  75      } else {
  76        _filteredItems = widget.items
  77            .where((item) => item.toLowerCase().contains(query))
  78            .toList();
  79      }
  80    });
  81  }
  82
  83  void _toggleItem(String item) {
  84    setState(() {
  85      if (widget.isMultiSelect) {
  86        if (_selectedItems.contains(item)) {
  87          _selectedItems.remove(item);
  88        } else {
  89          _selectedItems.add(item);
  90        }
  91      } else {
  92        _selectedItems = [item];
  93      }
  94    });
  95  }
  96
  97  @override
  98  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  99    return Directionality(
 100      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
 101      child: SafeArea(
 102        child: Container(
 103          height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.7,
 104          decoration: BoxDecoration(
 105            color: ColorsManager.background,
 106            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
 107          ),
 108          child: Column(
 109            children: [
 110              // Handle
 111              Center(
 112                child: Container(
 113                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12, bottom: 8),
 114                  width: 40,
 115                  height: 4,
 116                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 117                    color: ColorsManager.borderColor,
 118                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
 119                  ),
 120                ),
 121              ),
 122              // Header
 123              Padding(
 124                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 8),
 125                child: Row(
 126                  children: [
 127                    Expanded(
 128                      child: Column(
 129                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
 130                        children: [
 131                          Text(
 132                            widget.title,
 133                            style: TextStylesManager.bold16.copyWith(
 134                              color: ColorsManager.mainText,
 135                            ),
 136                          ),
 137                          if (widget.isMultiSelect) ...[
 138                            verticalSpace2,
 139                            Text(
 140                              'تم اختيار ${_selectedItems.length} من ${widget.items.length}',
 141                              style: TextStylesManager.regular12.copyWith(
 142                                color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 143                              ),
 144                            ),
 145                          ],
 146                        ],
 147                      ),
 148                    ),
 149                    IconButton(
 150                      onPressed: () => context.pop(),
 151                      icon: Icon(
 152                        Icons.close_rounded,
 153                        color: ColorsManager.secondaryText,
 154                      ),
 155                    ),
 156                  ],
 157                ),
 158              ),
 159              const Divider(height: 1),
 160              // Search Box
 161              Padding(
 162                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
 163                child: Container(
 164                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
 165                    color: ColorsManager.surfacePrimary,
 166                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

  57  factory ClassModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  58    final lessonTitle = json['subject_name'] as String? ?? json['lesson_title'] as String?;
  59    
  60    ClassStatus parsedStatus = ClassStatus.notPrepared;
  61    final statusStr = json['status'] as String?;
  62    
  63    if (statusStr == 'تم إعداد الدرس') {
  64      parsedStatus = ClassStatus.prepared;
  65    } else if (statusStr == 'نشاط') {
  66      parsedStatus = ClassStatus.activity;
  67    } else if (statusStr == 'بإعداد الدرس' || statusStr == 'بانتظار إعداد الدرس') {
  68      parsedStatus = ClassStatus.waiting;
  69    } else if (json.containsKey('is_prepared')) {
  70      parsedStatus = (json['is_prepared'] == true) 
  71          ? ClassStatus.prepared 
  72          : ClassStatus.notPrepared;
  73    } else if (statusStr != null) {
  74      // Fallback for any other unexpected string
  75      parsedStatus = ClassStatus.notPrepared;
  76    }
  77
  78    int pNum = json['period_number'] as int? ?? 0;
  79    if (pNum == 0) {
  80  final periodStr = json['period'] as String? ?? '';
  81
  82  if (periodStr.contains('الأولى')) {
  83    pNum = 1;
  84  } else if (periodStr.contains('الثانية')) {
  85    pNum = 2;
  86  } else if (periodStr.contains('الثالثة')) {
  87    pNum = 3;
  88  } else if (periodStr.contains('الرابعة')) {
  89    pNum = 4;
  90  } else if (periodStr.contains('الخامسة')) {
  91    pNum = 5;
  92  } else if (periodStr.contains('السادسة')) {
  93    pNum = 6;
  94  } else if (periodStr.contains('السابعة')) {
  95    pNum = 7;
  96  }
  97}
  98
  99    int dNum = json['day_of_week'] as int? ?? 1;
 100    final dayStr = json['day'] as String?;
 101   if (dayStr != null) {
 102  if (dayStr == 'الأحد') {
 103    dNum = 1;
 104  } else if (dayStr == 'الاثنين') {
 105    dNum = 2;
 106  } else if (dayStr == 'الثلاثاء') {
 107    dNum = 3;
 108  } else if (dayStr == 'الأربعاء') {
 109    dNum = 4;
 110  } else if (dayStr == 'الخميس') {
 111    dNum = 5;
 112  }
 113}
 114
 115    return ClassModel(
 116      id: json['lesson_id']?.toString() ?? json['id']?.toString() ?? '',
 117      periodNumber: pNum,
 118      lessonTitle: lessonTitle,
 119      classroomId: json['grade'] as String? ?? json['classroom_id'] as String? ?? '',
 120      status: parsedStatus,
 121      dayOfWeek: dNum,
 122      realSchoolId: json['real_school_id']?.toString() ?? '',
 123      timeTaleId: json['time_table_id']?.toString() ?? '',
 124      subjectId: int.tryParse(json['subject_id']?.toString() ?? '') ?? 0,
 125      lessonId: int.tryParse(json['lesson_id']?.toString() ?? '') ?? 
 126                int.tryParse(json['lesson_madrasati_id']?.toString() ?? '') ?? 0,
 127      time: json['time'] as String? ?? '',
 128      date: json['date'] as String? ?? '',

 130      subjectName: json['subject_name'] as String? ?? '',
 131      classroomName: json['classroom_name'] as String? ?? '',
 132      madrasatiStatus: json['madrasati_status'] as String? ?? '',
 133    );
 134  }
