  10class ScheduleCubit extends Cubit<ScheduleState> {
  11  StreamSubscription? _sessionActiveSubscription;
  12
  13  ScheduleCubit() : super(ScheduleInitial()) {
  14    _sessionActiveSubscription = sl<MadrasatiSessionService>().onSessionActive.listen((_) {
  15      // Re-fetch schedule when session is refreshed
  16      if (state is ScheduleError) {
  17        getSchedule();
  18      }
  19    });
  20  }
  21
  22  static ScheduleCubit get(BuildContext context) =>
  23      BlocProvider.of<ScheduleCubit>(context);
  24
  25  @override
  26  void onChange(Change<ScheduleState> change) {
  27    super.onChange(change);
  28    debugPrint('🔄 ScheduleCubit State Changed: ${change.currentState.runtimeType} -> ${change.nextState.runtimeType}');
  29  }
  30  Future<void> getSchedule() async {
  31    final weekDate = _currentWeekDate();
  32    
  33    // Emit loading state initially
  34    if (!isClosed) emit(ScheduleLoading());
  35    
  36    // 1. Fetch from /api/schedule
  37    final result = await ApiService.getSchedule(weekDate: weekDate);
  38    
  39    if (isClosed) return;
  40    
  41    result.fold(
  42      (error) {
  43        debugPrint('❌ Schedule Error Response: $error');
  44        if (!isClosed) emit(ScheduleError(error));
  45      },
  46      (data) {
  47        _handleData(data, weekDate);
  48        // 2. After successfully displaying (or handling empty), sync in background
  49        _syncScheduleBackground(weekDate);
  50      },
  51    );
  52  }
  53
  54  Future<void> _syncScheduleBackground(String weekDate) async {
  55    // Sync from madrasati in the background
  56    final syncResult = await ApiService.syncSchedule(weekDate: weekDate);
  57    
  58    if (isClosed) return;
  59    
  60    syncResult.fold(
  61      (error) {
  62        debugPrint('❌ Background Sync Error: $error');
  63      },
  64      (syncData) async {
  65        debugPrint('✅ Background Sync Success, re-fetching schedule...');
  66        // 3. Once synced, fetch from /api/schedule again to reflect in UI
  67        final freshResult = await ApiService.getSchedule(weekDate: weekDate);
  68        if (isClosed) return;
  69        
  70        freshResult.fold(
  71          (error) {
  72            debugPrint('❌ Fresh Schedule Error: $error');
  73          },
  74          (data) {
  75            _handleData(data, weekDate);
  76          },
  77        );
  78      },
  79    );
  80  }
  81
  82  Future<void> refreshSchedule() async {
  83    if (!isClosed) emit(ScheduleLoading());
  84    final weekDate = _currentWeekDate();
  85    
  86    // When user explicitly clicks refresh, we trigger the sync process
  87    final syncResult = await ApiService.syncSchedule(weekDate: weekDate);
  88    
  89    if (isClosed) return;
  90    
  91    syncResult.fold(
  92      (error) {
  93        debugPrint('❌ Refresh Sync Error: $error');
  94        if (!isClosed) emit(ScheduleError(error));
  95      },
  96      (syncData) async {
  97        // Then get from /api/schedule
  98        final freshResult = await ApiService.getSchedule(weekDate: weekDate);
  99        
 100        if (isClosed) return;
 101        
 102        freshResult.fold(
 103          (error) {
 104            debugPrint('❌ Fresh Schedule Error: $error');
 105            if (!isClosed) emit(ScheduleError(error));
 106          },
 107          (data) {
 108            _handleData(data, weekDate);
 109          },
 110        );
 111      },
 112    );
 113  }
 114
 115  Future<void> syncSchedule() async {
 116    final weekDate = _currentWeekDate();
 117    await _syncScheduleBackground(weekDate);
 118  }
 119
 120  Future<void> prepareLesson({
 121    required ClassModel classModel,
 122    required List<String> selectedModules,
 123  }) async {
 124    debugPrint('🚀 Starting Lesson Preparation for: ${classModel.lessonTitle}');
 125    debugPrint('   - Lesson ID: ${classModel.lessonId}');
 126    debugPrint('   - Subject ID: ${classModel.subjectId}');
 127    debugPrint('   - Classroom ID: ${classModel.classroomId}');
 128    debugPrint('   - Modules: $selectedModules');
 129
 130    // emit(SchedulePrepareLoading()); // Could emit a specific loading state if needed.
 131
 132    final result = await ApiService.prepareLesson(
 133      lessonId: classModel.lessonId,
 134      subjectId: classModel.subjectId,
 135      classroomId: classModel.classroomId,
 136      schoolMadrasatiId: classModel.realSchoolId,
 137      timeTableId: classModel.timeTaleId,
 138      selectedModules: selectedModules,
 139      encryptedToken: classModel.encryptedToken,
 140    );
 141
 142    if (isClosed) return;
 143
 144    result.fold(
 145      (error) {
 146        debugPrint('❌ Lesson Preparation Error: $error');
 147        if (!isClosed && error.startsWith('__402__:')) {
 148          final parts = error.split(':');
 149          final code = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : 'quota_exceeded';
 150          final msg = parts.length > 2 ? parts.sublist(2).join(':') : 'ترقية الحساب المطلوبة';
 151          emit(SchedulePaymentRequired(msg, code));
 152        }
 153        // emit(SchedulePrepareError(error)); // Handle error state if UI needs to react
 154      },
 155      (data) {
 156        debugPrint('✅ Lesson Preparation Success!');
 157        debugPrint('   - Response: $data');
 158        
 159        final preparationId = int.tryParse(data['preparation_id']?.toString() ?? '');
 160        if (preparationId != null) {
 161          _startPolling(preparationId);
 162        }
 163      },
 164    );
 165  }
 166
 167  Timer? _pollingTimer;
 168
 169  void _startPolling(int preparationId) {
 170    _pollingTimer?.cancel();
 171    _pollingTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 3), (timer) async {
 172      if (isClosed) {
 173        timer.cancel();
 174        return;
 175      }
 176      debugPrint('⏳ Polling preparation status for ID: $preparationId');
 177      final result = await ApiService.checkPreparationStatus(preparationId: preparationId);
 178      if (isClosed) {
 179        timer.cancel();
 180        return;
 181      }
 182      
 183      result.fold(
 184        (error) {
 185          debugPrint('❌ Polling Error: $error');
 186          timer.cancel();
 187        },
 188        (data) {
 189          debugPrint('✅ Polling Response: $data');
 190          final status = data['status'] as String?;
 191          if (status == 'completed' || status == 'success' || status == 'failed' || status == 'error') {
 192            timer.cancel();
 193            if (status == 'completed' || status == 'success') {
 194               refreshSchedule();
 195            }
 196          }
 197        },
 198      );
 199    });
 200  }
 201
 202  @override
 203  Future<void> close() {
 204    _pollingTimer?.cancel();
 205    _sessionActiveSubscription?.cancel();
 206    return super.close();
 207  }

 211    final current = state as ScheduleLoaded;
 212    final selected = current.days[index];
 213    if (!isClosed) {
 214      emit(ScheduleLoaded(
 215        days: current.days,
 216        classes: _classesForDay(current.allClasses, selected.dayOfWeek),
 217        allClasses: current.allClasses,
 218        selectedDayIndex: index,
 219        availableLessons: current.availableLessons,
 220      ));
 221    }
 222  }
 223
 224  Future<void> fetchAvailableLessonsIfNeeded() async {
 225    if (state is! ScheduleLoaded) return;
 226    final current = state as ScheduleLoaded;
 227    if (current.availableLessons != null && current.availableLessons!.isNotEmpty) return;
 228
 229    final weekDate = _currentWeekDate();
 230    final result = await ApiService.getAvailableLessons(weekDate: weekDate);
 231    if (isClosed) return;
 232    result.fold(
 233      (error) => debugPrint('❌ Available Lessons Error: $error'),
 234      (data) {
 235        if (!isClosed) {
 236          emit(ScheduleLoaded(
 237            days: current.days,
 238            classes: current.classes,
 239            allClasses: current.allClasses,
 240            selectedDayIndex: current.selectedDayIndex,
 241            availableLessons: data,
 242          ));
 243        }
 244      },
 245    );
 246  }
 247
 248  void _handleData(Map<String, dynamic> data, String weekDate) {
 249    debugPrint('✅ ScheduleCubit Success Full Response: $data');
 250
 251    final weekStart = data['week_start'] as String? ?? weekDate;
 252    final days = _parseDays(weekStart, <String, dynamic>{}); // mock doesn't need rawSchedule for days
 253    final allClasses = <ClassModel>[];
 254
 255    final daysList = data['days'] is List 
 256        ? data['days'] as List 
 257        : (data['schedule'] is List ? data['schedule'] as List : null);
 258    final fakeData = data['data'] is List ? data['data'] as List : null;
 259
 260    if (daysList != null) {
 261      for (final dayItem in daysList) {
 262        if (dayItem is Map && dayItem['periods'] is List) {
 263          final int dayOfWeekValue = dayItem['day_of_week'] as int? ?? 0;
 264          final int normalizedDayOfWeek = dayOfWeekValue + 1; // 0 -> 1 (Sunday)
 265          for (final periodItem in dayItem['periods']) {
 266            if (periodItem is Map) {
 267              final p = Map<String, dynamic>.from(periodItem);
 268              p['day_of_week'] = normalizedDayOfWeek;
 269              allClasses.add(ClassModel.fromJson(p));
 270            }
 271          }
 272        }
 273      }
 274    } else if (fakeData != null) {
 275      // Parse fake API structure
 276      for (final item in fakeData) {
 277        if (item is Map) {
 278          allClasses.add(ClassModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)));
 279        }
 280      }
 281    } else {
 282      // Parse old structure
 283      final scheduleRaw = data['schedule'] ?? data['data'];
 284      final rawSchedule = scheduleRaw is Map
 285          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(scheduleRaw)
 286          : <String, dynamic>{};
 287      allClasses.addAll(_parseAllClasses(rawSchedule));
 288    }
 289
 290    allClasses.sort((a, b) => a.periodNumber.compareTo(b.periodNumber));
 291
 292    final firstDayClasses = days.isNotEmpty
 293        ? _classesForDay(allClasses, days.first.dayOfWeek)
 294        : <ClassModel>[];
 295
 296    final newState = ScheduleLoaded(
 297      days: days,
 298      classes: firstDayClasses,
 299      allClasses: allClasses,
 300      selectedDayIndex: 0,
 301      availableLessons: null,
 302    );
 303
 304    debugPrint('✅ ScheduleCubit Success: week_start=$weekStart | days=${days.length} | classes=${allClasses.length}');
 305
 306    if (!isClosed) {
 307      emit(newState);
 308    }
 309  }
 310
 311
 312
 313  DateTime? _currentWeekStart;
 314
 315  String _currentWeekDate() {
 316    if (_currentWeekStart == null) {
 317      final now = DateTime.now();
 318      // Dart weekday: Monday=1 … Sunday=7
 319      final daysFromSunday = now.weekday == 7 ? 0 : now.weekday;
 320      _currentWeekStart = now.subtract(Duration(days: daysFromSunday));
 321    }
 322    return '${_currentWeekStart!.year}-'
 323        '${_currentWeekStart!.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
 324        '${_currentWeekStart!.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
 325  }
 326
 327  void nextWeek() {
 328    _currentWeekDate();
 329    _currentWeekStart = _currentWeekStart!.add(const Duration(days: 7));
 330    getSchedule();
 331  }
 332
 333  void previousWeek() {
 334    _currentWeekDate();
 335    _currentWeekStart = _currentWeekStart!.subtract(const Duration(days: 7));
 336    getSchedule();
 337  }
 338
 339  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 340  // Private — parse helpers (no Widget returned — compliant with rules.md)
 341  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 342
 343  List<DayModel> _parseDays(
 344    String weekStart,
 345    Map<String, dynamic> rawSchedule,
 346  ) {
 347    final startDate = DateTime.parse(weekStart);
 348    // Always show Sunday (1) to Thursday (5)
 349    final sortedKeys = ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5'];
 350
 351    const dayNameKeys = <String, String>{
 352      '1': 'sunday',
 353      '2': 'monday',
 354      '3': 'tuesday',
 355      '4': 'wednesday',
 356      '5': 'thursday',
 357    };
 358
 359    return sortedKeys.map((key) {
 360      final dayOfWeek = int.parse(key);
 361      final dayDate = startDate.add(Duration(days: dayOfWeek - 1));
 362      return DayModel(
 363        nameKey: dayNameKeys[key] ?? 'day_$key',
 364        date: '${dayDate.day} ${_arabicMonth(dayDate.month)}',
 365        dayOfWeek: dayOfWeek,
 366      );
 367    }).toList();
 368  }
 369
 370  List<ClassModel> _parseAllClasses(Map<String, dynamic> rawSchedule) {
 371    final classes = <ClassModel>[];
 372    rawSchedule.forEach((_, dayList) {
 373      if (dayList is List) {
 374        for (final item in dayList) {
 375          if (item is Map) {
 376            classes.add(ClassModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)));
 377          }
 378        }
 379      }
 380    });
 381    classes.sort((a, b) => a.periodNumber.compareTo(b.periodNumber));
 382    return classes;
 383  }
 384
 385  List<ClassModel> _classesForDay(
 386    List<ClassModel> allClasses,
 387    int dayOfWeek,
 388  ) {
 389    final dayClasses =
 390        allClasses.where((c) => c.dayOfWeek == dayOfWeek).toList();
 391    if (dayClasses.isEmpty) return [];
 392
 393    // Fixed to 7 periods as standard
 394    const maxPeriod = 7;
 395
 396    final filledClasses = <ClassModel>[];
 397    for (int i = 1; i <= maxPeriod; i++) {
 398      final existing = dayClasses.where((c) => c.periodNumber == i).toList();
 399      if (existing.isNotEmpty) {
 400        filledClasses.addAll(existing);
 401      } else {
 402        filledClasses.add(
 403          ClassModel(
 404            id: 'empty_${dayOfWeek}_$i',
 405            periodNumber: i,
 406            classroomId: '',
 407            status: ClassStatus.notPrepared,
 408            dayOfWeek: dayOfWeek,
 409            lessonTitle: null,
 410          ),
 411        );
 412      }
 413    }
 414    return filledClasses;
 415  }
 416
 417  /// Arabic month names — data utility, not UI label.
 418  String _arabicMonth(int month) {
 419    const names = [
 420      '',
 421      'يناير',
 422      'فبراير',
 423      'مارس',
 424      'أبريل',
 425      'مايو',
 426      'يونيو',
 427      'يوليو',
 428      'أغسطس',
 429      'سبتمبر',
 430      'أكتوبر',
 431      'نوفمبر',
 432      'ديسمبر',
 433    ];
 434    return names[month];
 435  }
 436}

 114  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _getAvailableLessonsForThisClass() {
 115    final state = ScheduleCubit.get(context).state;
 116    if (state is ScheduleLoaded && state.availableLessons != null) {
 117      final available = state.availableLessons!;
 118      try {
 119        final timeTableId = widget.classModel.timeTaleId;
 120        final subjectId = widget.classModel.subjectId.toString();
 121        
 122        dynamic targetList;
 123
 124        if (timeTableId.isNotEmpty && available.containsKey(timeTableId)) {
 125          targetList = available[timeTableId];
 126        } else if (subjectId != '0' && available.containsKey(subjectId)) {
 127          targetList = available[subjectId];
 128        } else if (available.containsKey('data')) {
 129           final dataObj = available['data'];
 130           
 131           if (dataObj is List) {
 132             for (var item in dataObj) {
 133               if (item is Map && item['time_table_id']?.toString() == timeTableId) {
 134                 targetList = item['lessons'] ?? item['available_lessons'];
 135                 break;
 136               }
 137             }
 138             if (targetList == null && dataObj.isNotEmpty && dataObj.first is Map) {
 139               if (dataObj.first.containsKey('lesson_id') || dataObj.first.containsKey('id')) {
 140                 targetList = dataObj;
 141               }
 142             }
 143           } else if (dataObj is Map) {
 144             if (dataObj.containsKey(timeTableId)) {
 145               targetList = dataObj[timeTableId];
 146             } else if (dataObj.containsKey(subjectId)) {
 147               targetList = dataObj[subjectId];
 148             } else if (dataObj.values.length == 1 && dataObj.values.first is List) {
 149               targetList = dataObj.values.first;
 150             }
 151           }
 152        } else if (available.containsKey('periods')) {
 153           final periodsList = available['periods'];
 154           if (periodsList is List) {
 155             for (var period in periodsList) {
 156               if (period is Map && (period['time_table_id']?.toString() == timeTableId || period['subject_id']?.toString() == subjectId)) {
 157                 targetList = period['available_lessons'] ?? period['lessons'];
 158                 if (targetList != null && (targetList as List).isNotEmpty) break;
 159               }
 160             }
 161           }
 162        } else if (available.containsKey('lessons')) {
 163           targetList = available['lessons'];
 164        } else {
 165           var lists = available.values.whereType<List>().toList();
 166           if (lists.isNotEmpty) {
 167             targetList = lists.first;
 168           }
 169        }
 170        
 171        if (targetList is List) {
 172          return targetList.map((e) => e is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(e) : {'value': e.toString()}).toList();
 173        }
 174      } catch (e) {
 175        debugPrint('Error parsing available lessons: $e');
 176      }
 177    }
 178    return [];
 179  }
 180
 181  String _getLessonDisplayName(Map<String, dynamic> lesson) {
 182    return lesson['title']?.toString() ?? 
 183           lesson['lesson_title']?.toString() ?? 
 184           lesson['name']?.toString() ?? 
 185           lesson['value']?.toString() ?? 'Lesson';
 186  }

  26  factory SearchResultModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json, String type) {

  30    }
  31
  32    return SearchResultModel(
  33      id: json['id'] as int?,
  34      type: type,
  35      title: (json['title'] ?? json['question_text'] ?? json['name'] ?? '').toString(),
  36      subtitle: (json['subject_name'] ?? json['lesson_name'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
  37          ? (json['subject_name'] ?? json['lesson_name'] ?? '').toString()
  38          : null,
  39      description: (json['description'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
  40          ? json['description'].toString()
  41          : null,

  43          ? json['difficulty'].toString()
  44          : null,
  45      questionType: (json['question_type'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
  46          ? json['question_type'].toString()
  47          : null,
  48      options: options,
  49      correctAnswer: (json['correct_answer'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
  50          ? json['correct_answer'].toString()
  51          : null,

Feature / Search 68 Lines • Dart 
   1import 'package:dartz/dartz.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_endpoints.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/dio_helper.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/features/search/data/models/search_result_model.dart';
   5
   6class SearchRepository {
   7  Future<Either<String, List<SearchResultModel>>> search({
   8    required String query,
   9    String? type,
  10    int limit = 20,
  11  }) async {
  12    final response = await DioHelper.getData(
  13      url: searchApi,
  14      query: {
  15        'query': query,
  16        if (type != null && type.isNotEmpty) 'type': type,
  17        'limit': limit,
  18      },
  19    );
  20
  21    return response.fold(
  22      (error) => Left(error),
  23      (res) {
  24        try {
  25          final data = res.data;
  26          final List<SearchResultModel> results = [];
  27
  28          if (data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
  29            final dataBody = data['data'];
  30
  31            if (dataBody is Map<String, dynamic>) {
  32              // Grouped response: { questions: [...], resources: [...], ... }
  33              final typeKeys = {
  34                'questions': 'questions',
  35                'resources': 'resources',
  36                'exams': 'exams',
  37                'lessons': 'lessons',
  38              };
  39              typeKeys.forEach((key, label) {
  40                final items = dataBody[key];
  41                if (items is List) {
  42                  for (final item in items) {
  43                    if (item is Map<String, dynamic>) {
  44                      results.add(SearchResultModel.fromJson(item, label));
  45                    }
  46                  }
  47                }
  48              });
  49            } else if (dataBody is List) {
  50              // Flat list response
  51              for (final item in dataBody) {
  52                if (item is Map<String, dynamic>) {
  53                  final itemType = (item['type'] ?? type ?? 'resources').toString();
  54                  results.add(SearchResultModel.fromJson(item, itemType));
  55                }
  56              }
  57            }
  58          }
  59
  60          return Right(results);
  61        } catch (_) {
  62          return const Left('حدث خطأ أثناء معالجة البيانات');
  63        }
  64      },
  65    );
  66  }
  67}

   1import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   2import 'package:moean/features/search/data/repositories/search_repository.dart';
   3import 'package:moean/features/search/presentation/cubit/search_state.dart';
   4
   5class SearchCubit extends Cubit<SearchState> {
   6  SearchCubit() : super(const SearchInitial());
   7
   8  final SearchRepository _repository = SearchRepository();
   9
  10  String _activeFilter = 'all';
  11  String _lastQuery = '';
  12
  13  String get activeFilter => _activeFilter;
  14
  15  static const Map<String, String?> _filterTypeMap = {
  16    'all': null,
  17    'questions': 'questions',
  18    'resources': 'resources',
  19    'exams': 'exams',
  20    'lessons': 'lessons',
  21  };
  22
  23  Future<void> search(String query) async {
  24    if (query.trim().isEmpty) return;
  25    _lastQuery = query.trim();
  26    if (!isClosed) emit(const SearchLoading());
  27
  28    final typeParam = _filterTypeMap[_activeFilter];
  29
  30    final result = await _repository.search(
  31      query: _lastQuery,
  32      type: typeParam,
  33      limit: 20,
  34    );
  35    if (isClosed) return;
  36
  37    result.fold(
  38      (error) {
  39        if (!isClosed) emit(SearchError(message: error));
  40      },
  41      (items) {
  42        if (!isClosed) {
  43          if (items.isEmpty) {
  44            emit(SearchEmpty(query: _lastQuery));
  45          } else {
  46            emit(SearchLoaded(
  47              results: items,
  48              query: _lastQuery,
  49              activeFilter: _activeFilter,
  50            ));
  51          }
  52        }
  53      },
  54    );
  55  }
  56
  57  Future<void> changeFilter(String filter) async {
  58    if (_activeFilter == filter) return;
  59    _activeFilter = filter;
  60
  61    if (_lastQuery.isNotEmpty) {
  62      await search(_lastQuery);
  63    } else {
  64      if (!isClosed) emit(const SearchInitial());
  65    }
  66  }
  67
  68  void reset() {
  69    _lastQuery = '';
  70    _activeFilter = 'all';
  71    if (!isClosed) emit(const SearchInitial());
  72  }
  73}

   1import 'dart:async';
   2import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
   3import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
   4import 'package:moean/core/network/remote/api_service.dart';
   5import 'package:moean/core/utils/constants/constants.dart';
   6import 'package:moean/features/verify_email/presentation/cubit/verify_email_state.dart';
   7
   8class VerifyEmailCubit extends Cubit<VerifyEmailState> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
   9  final String email;
  10
  11  VerifyEmailCubit({required this.email}) : super(VerifyEmailInitialState()) {
  12    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
  13    _startPolling();
  14  }
  15
  16  static VerifyEmailCubit get(BuildContext context) => BlocProvider.of(context);
  17
  18  int cooldownSeconds = 0;
  19  Timer? _cooldownTimer;
  20  Timer? _pollingTimer;
  21  bool isResending = false;
  22  bool isChecking = false;
  23
  24  void _startPolling() {
  25    _pollingTimer?.cancel();
  26    _pollingTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 4), (timer) {
  27      if (state is VerifyEmailSuccessState) {
  28        timer.cancel();
  29      } else {
  30        checkVerificationStatus(isSilent: true);
  31      }
  32    });
  33  }
  34
  35  @override
  36  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
  37    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed && this.state is! VerifyEmailSuccessState) {
  38      checkVerificationStatus(isSilent: true);
  39    }
  40  }
  41
  42  void startCooldown([int seconds = 60]) {
  43    cooldownSeconds = seconds;
  44    _cooldownTimer?.cancel();
  45    if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailCooldownTickState(cooldownSeconds: cooldownSeconds));
  46    _cooldownTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
  47      if (cooldownSeconds <= 1) {
  48        timer.cancel();
  49        cooldownSeconds = 0;
  50        if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailCooldownTickState(cooldownSeconds: 0));
  51      } else {
  52        cooldownSeconds--;
  53        if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailCooldownTickState(cooldownSeconds: cooldownSeconds));
  54      }
  55    });
  56  }
  57
  58  Future<void> resendVerificationEmail() async {
  59    if (cooldownSeconds > 0 || isResending) return;
  60
  61    isResending = true;
  62    if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailResendLoadingState());
  63
  64    try {
  65      final result = await ApiService.resendEmailVerification(email: email);
  66      if (isClosed) return;
  67
  68      result.fold(
  69        (error) {
  70          isResending = false;
  71          if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailErrorState(message: error));
  72        },
  73        (data) {
  74          isResending = false;
  75          if (data['already_verified'] == true) {
  76            _pollingTimer?.cancel();
  77            if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailSuccessState());
  78            return;
  79          }
  80          startCooldown(60);
  81          final message = data['message'] as String? ?? appTranslation().get('resend_verification_sent');
  82          if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailResendSuccessState(message: message));
  83        },
  84      );
  85    } catch (e) {
  86      isResending = false;
  87      if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailErrorState(message: e.toString()));
  88    }
  89  }
  90
  91  Future<void> checkVerificationStatus({bool isSilent = false}) async {
  92    if (isChecking || state is VerifyEmailSuccessState) return;
  93    isChecking = true;
  94
  95    if (!isSilent && !isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailLoadingState());
  96
  97    try {
  98      final result = await ApiService.getMe();
  99      isChecking = false;
 100      if (isClosed) return;
 101
 102      result.fold(
 103        (error) {
 104          if (!isSilent && !isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailErrorState(message: error));
 105        },
 106        (user) {
 107          if (user.isEmailVerified) {
 108            _pollingTimer?.cancel();
 109            if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailSuccessState());
 110          } else {
 111            if (!isSilent && !isClosed) {
 112              emit(VerifyEmailErrorState(message: appTranslation().get('email_unverified_banner')));
 113            }
 114          }
 115        },
 116      );
 117    } catch (e) {
 118      isChecking = false;
 119      if (!isSilent && !isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailErrorState(message: e.toString()));
 120    }
 121  }
 122
 123  Future<void> verifyEmailToken({
 124    required String id,
 125    required String hash,
 126    required String expires,
 127    required String signature,
 128  }) async {
 129    if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailLoadingState());
 130
 131    try {
 132      final result = await ApiService.verifyEmailToken(
 133        id: id,
 134        hash: hash,
 135        expires: expires,
 136        signature: signature,
 137      );
 138      if (isClosed) return;
 139
 140      result.fold(
 141        (error) {
 142          if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailErrorState(message: error));
 143        },
 144        (user) {
 145          _pollingTimer?.cancel();
 146          if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailSuccessState());
 147        },
 148      );
 149    } catch (e) {
 150      if (!isClosed) emit(VerifyEmailErrorState(message: e.toString()));
 151    }
 152  }
 153
 154  @override
 155  Future<void> close() {
 156    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
 157    _cooldownTimer?.cancel();
 158    _pollingTimer?.cancel();
 159    return super.close();
 160  }
 161}

  82                  },
  83                ),
  84              ),
  85            ),
  86          ),
  87        ),
  88      ),
  89    );
  90  }
  91
  92  void _onStateChanged(BuildContext context, VerifyEmailState state) {
  93    if (state is VerifyEmailErrorState) {
  94      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  95        SnackBar(
  96          content: Text(state.message),
  97          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  98        ),
  99      );
 100    }
 101    if (state is VerifyEmailResendSuccessState) {
 102      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
 103        SnackBar(
 104          content: Text(
 105            state.message.isNotEmpty
 106                ? state.message
 107                : appTranslation().get('resend_verification_sent'),
 108          ),
 109          backgroundColor: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
 110        ),
 111      );
 112    }
 113  }

   8class EmailVerificationBanner extends StatefulWidget {
   9  final bool isEmailVerified;
  10  final String? email;
  11
  12  const EmailVerificationBanner({
  13    super.key,
  14    required this.isEmailVerified,
  15    this.email,
  16  });
  17
  18  @override
  19  State<EmailVerificationBanner> createState() =>
  20      _EmailVerificationBannerState();
  21}
  22
  23class _EmailVerificationBannerState extends State<EmailVerificationBanner> {
  24  bool _dismissed = false;
  25  bool _isResending = false;
  26
  27  Future<void> _handleResend() async {
  28    if (_isResending) return;
  29    setState(() => _isResending = true);
  30
  31    final result =
  32        await ApiService.resendEmailVerification(email: widget.email);
  33    if (!mounted) return;
  34    setState(() => _isResending = false);
  35
  36    result.fold(
  37      (error) {
  38        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  39          SnackBar(
  40            content: Text(error),
  41            backgroundColor: ColorsManager.errorColor,
  42          ),
  43        );
  44      },
  45      (data) {
  46        final message = data['message'] as String? ??
  47            appTranslation().get('resend_verification_sent');
  48        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
  49          SnackBar(
  50            content: Text(message),
  51            backgroundColor: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  52          ),
  53        );
  54      },
  55    );
  56  }
  57
  58  @override
  59  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  60    if (widget.isEmailVerified || _dismissed) return const SizedBox.shrink();
  61
  62    return Container(

  64      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
  65      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
  66        color: Color(0xFFFFF8E7),
  67        border: Border(
  68          bottom: BorderSide(
  69            color: Color(0xFFF4E3B2),
  70          ),
  71        ),
  72      ),
  73      child: SafeArea(
  74        bottom: false,
  75        child: Row(
  76          children: [
  77            const Icon(
  78              Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
  79              color: Color(0xFFC98D14),
  80              size: 18,
  81            ),
  82            horizontalSpace8,
  83            Expanded(
  84              child: Text(
  85                appTranslation().get('email_unverified_banner'),
  86                style: TextStylesManager.bold12.copyWith(
  87                  color: const Color(0xFF8A5807),
  88                ),
  89              ),
  90            ),
  91            InkWell(
  92              onTap: _isResending ? null : _handleResend,
  93              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
  94              child: Container(
  95                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
  96                  horizontal: 10,
  97                  vertical: 5,
  98                ),
  99                decoration: BoxDecoration(
 100                  color: const Color(0xFFE2AD3B),
 101                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
 102                ),
 103                child: _isResending
 104                    ? const SizedBox(

 106                        height: 12,
 107                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(

 109                          color: Colors.white,
 110                        ),
 111                      )
 112                    : Text(

 116                        ),
 117                      ),
 118              ),
 119            ),
 120            horizontalSpace4,
 121            IconButton(
 122              icon: const Icon(

 125                color: Color(0xFF8A5807),

  10
  11class VerifyEmailActionsWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  12  const VerifyEmailActionsWidget({super.key});
  13
  14  @override
  15  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
  16    return BlocBuilder<VerifyEmailCubit, VerifyEmailState>(
  17      buildWhen: (previous, current) =>
  18          current is VerifyEmailCooldownTickState ||
  19          current is VerifyEmailResendLoadingState ||
  20          current is VerifyEmailResendSuccessState ||
  21          current is VerifyEmailErrorState,
  22      builder: (context, state) {
  23        final cubit = VerifyEmailCubit.get(context);
  24        final bool isCooldown = cubit.cooldownSeconds > 0;
  25        final bool isLoading = cubit.isResending;
  26
  27        final String resendLabel = isCooldown
  28            ? appTranslation()
  29                .get('resend_verification_cooldown')
  30                .replaceAll('{seconds}', cubit.cooldownSeconds.toString())
  31            : appTranslation().get('resend_verification_link');
  32
  33        return Column(
  34          children: [
  35            SizedBox(
  36              width: double.infinity,
  37              height: 52,
  38              child: OutlinedButton(
  39                onPressed: isCooldown || isLoading
  40                    ? null
  41                    : () {
  42                        cubit.resendVerificationEmail();
  43                      },
  44                style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
  45                  side: BorderSide(
  46                    color: isCooldown
  47                        ? ColorsManager.placeholder.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
  48                        : ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  49                    width: 1.5,
  50                  ),
  51                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
  52                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
  53                  ),
  54                  backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
  55                ),
  56                child: isLoading
  57                    ? SizedBox(
  58                        width: 20,
  59                        height: 20,
  60                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
  61                          strokeWidth: 2,
  62                          color: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  63                        ),
  64                      )
  65                    : Row(
  66                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
  67                        children: [
  68                          Icon(
  69                            Icons.refresh_rounded,
  70                            size: 20,
  71                            color: isCooldown
  72                                ? ColorsManager.placeholder
  73                                : ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  74                          ),
  75                          horizontalSpace8,
  76                          Text(
  77                            resendLabel,
  78                            style: TextStylesManager.bold14.copyWith(
  79                              color: isCooldown
  80                                  ? ColorsManager.placeholder
  81                                  : ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  82                            ),
  83                          ),
  84                        ],
  85                      ),
  86              ),
  87            ),
  88            verticalSpace14,
  89            PrimaryElevatedButton(
  90              text: appTranslation().get('continue_to_platform'),
  91              height: 52,
  92              radius: 24,
  93              isLoading: cubit.isChecking,
  94              backgroundColor: ColorsManager.primaryColor,
  95              icon: const Icon(
  96                Icons.arrow_back,
  97                color: Colors.white,
  98                size: 20,
  99              ),
 100              onPressed: () {
 101                cubit.checkVerificationStatus();
 102              },
 103            ),
 104          ],
 105        );
 106      },
 107    );
 108  }
 109}
